name.zh: 智慧空間互動程式設計
name.en: Interaction design and programming in a smart space

description.zh: 互動智慧空間設計著重虛實整合，再加上智慧代理人觀念，結合使用者經驗，促使程式專業人員與互動設計師合作，來發展使用者與環境隨時互動之智慧介面。本課程結合電子、資工、互動領域，針對無人機(大疆/Parrot)、生成對抗網路、軟體開發應用(Open source SDK)、APP開發、介面設計、小型企業創新研發等主題，由學習者發想設計，並深入發展程式與開發實務。課程內含空間認知與視覺化、空間資訊與介面設計、機器學習、類神經網路、SCRUM、軟體開發測試。相關程式與應用包括JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.
description.en: This course is integrated with AR、VR、MR, smart agent concepts, and user experiences study.  The purpose is to incorporate programmer and designer in designing a mixed-reality space which is actually a physical space considered as a real-time interface to trig many human-environment interactions. Based on Electronic Engineering, Computer Science and Information Engineering, and Interaction Design, we set study topics as Drones (Dji /Parrot), gan, Open source SDK, APP development, interface design, small business innovation. Students are encouraged to create their own concepts then develop programming. Course contents included of spatial perception and information visualization, spatial information and interface, machine learning, neural network, Scrum, software development and testing. The program and application included of JavaScript、JSON、Firebase、D3.JS、Apache ECharts、CNN、Python.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description:
This course integrates information visualization programming, interactive web applications, project development, and hands-on practice. Students will learn JavaScript, cloud databases, Scrum, and Git tools to enhance programming skills in smart space and interaction design. The course also covers drone operation and the implementation of spatial exercise care devices. Through project-based learning, students will strengthen teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative application skills.
Course Objectives:
1. Master JavaScript programming and fundamentals of information visualization.
2. Gain experience in interactive web programming with example implementations.
3. Learn to apply Scrum and Git version control in project development.
4. Develop cloud database application and front-end/back-end integration skills.
5. Implement advanced interactive Geographic Information System (GIS) interfaces.
6. Acquire knowledge of drone applications and spatial exercise care device implementation.
7. Enhance teamwork, presentation, and project development skills.
------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
課程簡介：
本課程結合資訊視覺化程式設計、互動式網頁應用、專案開發與實作練習，透過 JavaScript、雲端資料庫、Scrum 與 Git 協作工具，培養學生在智慧空間與互動設計中的程式開發能力。課程同時涵蓋無人機操作與空間運動照護裝置實作，並透過專案導向學習，訓練學生團隊合作、問題解決與創新應用能力。
教學目標：
1. 掌握 JavaScript 程式設計與資訊視覺化基礎。
2. 熟悉互動式網頁程式設計與範例實作。
3. 學習 Scrum 與 Git 版本控制於專案開發中的應用。
4. 建立雲端資料庫應用與前後端整合能力。
5. 實作進階互動式地理資訊系統 (GIS) 介面與應用。
6. 學習無人機應用與空間運動照護互動裝置開發。
7. 強化團隊合作、簡報表達與專案開發能力。

4. Code Refinement: Optimization and improvement of the code (25%)

- 期末評圖作業（含平時成績、出席狀況）：50%

3. 團隊合作：會議與協作過程，Trello 使用狀況（25%）
4. 程式修改：程式的優化與改良（25%）

description.zh: 中文課程共分四年三階段授課。 第一、二年以華語教學為主，授課重點為：（一）華語基本句型句法；（二）華語基本會話；（三）生活語言；（四）標音系統。第三年(一學期)，除延續第一、二年華語授課重點外，以段落朗讀和基本認字為主要訓練，並給與中國文字書寫訓練。 第四年(一學期)，加強會話能力，認字與閱讀能力，並傳授中國文化。
description.en: The course of Chinese is categorized as three individual stages for four years. In the first year, the course focuses on: (a) Basic Sentence Patterns, (b) Basic Conversation, (c) Languages in the Real Life and (d) the phonetic system for the Chinese language. In the second and the third year (one semester), the training focuses on paragraph reading and term/character recognition-in addition to the teaching themes set in the first year. Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

description.en: This course applies design and programming into interaction design projects. To achieve this goal, students will familiarize the theories, methodology and implications of interaction design in this course. By interaction design issues, students create and implement ideas by brainstorming through independent study or cooperative learning. For competition without any gap, industry-academic cooperation is one way to prepare student’s critical competencies same as the desired competencies required by the industry.

syllabi.outline:
Course Objectives:
Understand the fundamental principles and applications of interactive design.
Develop creative design skills to complete individual or group interactive design projects.
Foster teamwork and communication skills.
Explore the applications of various interactive design media and platforms.
Teaching Methods: Lectures, group discussions, hands-on guidance, case studies, and project presentations.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Course Introduction
Overview of the course and expected outcomes.
Introduction to the fundamentals of interactive design with case studies.
Student introductions and group assignments.
Week 2: Interactive Design Theories and Tools Overview
User experience design and human-computer interaction theories.
Introduction to commonly used tools (e.g., Figma, Unity, Processing).
Week 3: Topic Selection and Requirement Analysis
Guide students in selecting their interactive design topics.
User research and goal setting.
Week 4: Creative Brainstorming and Concept Development
Brainstorming activities.
Each group presents initial concept sketches.
Week 5: Storytelling and User Journey Design
Crafting user stories and journey mapping.
Group feedback and discussions.
Week 6: Technical Experimentation and Prototype Testing
Guide students in creating low-fidelity prototypes using design tools.
Test user interaction experiences and record feedback.
Week 7: Design Refinement
Provide guidance to further refine interactive designs.
Discuss visual design and technical details.
Week 8: Midterm Review
Groups present their design progress.
Feedback and improvement suggestions from the instructor and peers.
Week 9: Motion and Responsive Design
Teach principles of animation and interaction effects.
Apply these concepts to student projects.
Week 10: Multisensory Interaction Design
Explore the application of sensory elements such as sound and touch.
Group experiments and sharing.
Week 11: Technical Integration
Guide students in integrating various technologies into their projects.
Solve technical challenges and difficulties.
Week 12: Mid-Stage Testing and User Feedback
Groups showcase their interim results.
Conduct simulated user testing and collect improvement suggestions.
Week 13: Iteration and Optimization
Analyze testing results and iterate designs.
Ensure the technical and design feasibility of the projects.
Week 14: Final Touches
Refine the interactive experience and visual details of projects.
Discuss strategies for project presentations.
Week 15: Final Project Production
Groups focus on completing their final projects.
Address technical issues and offer guidance.
Week 16: Presentation Rehearsal
Groups conduct mock presentations.
Collect feedback and make final adjustments.
Week 17: Final Project Presentation
Showcase final projects to the instructor and peers.
Group feedback and evaluations.
Week 18: Course Review and Reflection
Class discussion on course takeaways and challenges.
Instructor summary and evaluations.

syllabi.outline:
工業產品須靠模具才能量產，所以模具在工業發展過程中一直擔任著重要的角色。本課程內容:
(1)沖壓模具設計。(2)塑膠模具設計。(3)壓鑄模具設計。(4)鍛造模具設計
      Industrial products can only be mass-produced by molds, so molds have always played an important role in the process of industrial development.
   Contents of this course:
 (1) Stamping die design.(2) Plastic mold design.(3) Die casting mold design
 (4) Forging Die Design
syllabi.schedule:
第1週 第5章  衝壓模具設計，剪切原理，剪切斷面之特性。
第2週 第5章  影響剪切斷面之因素，剪切壓力及剪切中心，剪斜角。
第3週 第6章  衝切加工，衝切模概念，衝孔與下料，母模穴刃口的設計。
第4週 第6章  衝頭與母模穴的間隙，衝頭刀刃與下模刀刃尺寸的設計。
第5週 第6章  衝頭尺寸的設計，料帶的佈置，衝屑跳上及衝屑堵塞問題，衝切   
                      模之基本構造，衝切模的設計。
第6週 第7章  彎形加工概念，彎形加工名詞解釋，彎曲半徑，彎形材料的展開長
                     度計算。
第7週 第7章  彈回及彈去之改善方法，彎形加工之加工力，彎形模圓角半徑與衝
                     壓深度。
第8週 第7章  彎形加工常用之機構設計，彎形模之基本構造。
第9週  期中考   
第10週 第8章  引伸加工概念，引伸力與壓料力，胚料尺寸的展開。
第11週 第8章  引伸加工基本設計，引伸加工其他考慮事項，凸緣成形。
第12週 第8章  圓筒引伸的設計，引伸模之構造及種類。
第13週 第9章  連續衝模的分類及構造，連續衝模的設計流程。
第14週 第9章  製品圖重組，料帶的佈置，料帶導引附件。
第15週 第9章  衝切連續模設計實例，彎形連續模設計實例，引伸連續模設計實
                        例。
第16週 第3章  塑膠模具設計，流道的形狀。
第17週 第3章  澆口的類型，流道與澆口尺度計算。
第18週 期末考

一、本課程凡十六學分，供學生前四年修習之用。
二、本課程教學目標旨在透過適當選文，增進學生閱讀、鑑賞與寫作能力，誘使學生對我國重要典籍及傳統文化有一粗淺認識，並從而培植其人文素養，啟發其愛國、愛家、愛人之情操。
三、本課程所選範文，類別遍於經史子集，時代該及古今。編者於每篇選文，除有生字、難詞、典故之註釋，提意、出處、著作背景之說明，而作者生平、作品、風格及其地位、事功，亦有簡要之評述。
四、本課程亦講授公文及書信。公文之內容包括函、簽、公告、報告等各類常用公文的作法與寫作要領，並兼及處理公文之注意事項。書信之內容包括傳統及現代書信的寫法與寫作要領，並兼及便條與做為便條使用之名片的寫法。
description.en:
a) The course is designed for the students to study in the first four years, with a sum total of 16 credit hours. 
b) Course Objective: Through proper readings, the students will increase their ability to read, write and even appreciate literary works, and better understand significant books of ancient times and of traditional culture. With better development of humanity, they are likely to have more sense of loving the country, family and people. 
c) The Readings are adopted from a diversity of sources, including Classics, History Books, individual writings and literary anthology-ancient or modern. In addition to the explanation and discussion of vocabulary items, difficult words, classic allusions, main ideas, origin and the time background of the articles, a brief comment is also made on the authors' life, their works, literary styles/status. 
d)The course is to teach students how to write and handle official correspondences and social letters.

description.zh: 此專科英文課程共四年：專一、專二、專三、專四。其課程目標為培養學生獨立閱讀、進階寫作與口語溝通能力，並培育學生逐漸成為獨立的語言學習者。教學採符合溝通互動取向與全語言哲學的教學法，並依學生特點和課堂文化做適當教學調整與輔助。學生經由大量閱讀具知識性、趣味性、適合其程度的作品，經由經常參與角色扮演、分組討論、口頭報告與短文寫作等學習活動，逐漸提昇語言溝通能力與善用學習策略來解決問題的能力。
description.en: This junior-college English program consists of four-year English courses, with the purposes to develop fluency in reading and writing, and to improve listening and speaking abilities. The communicative approach and the whole language philosophy are thus adopted to implement the curriculum. In these courses, students have plenty of opportunities to take part in role-plays, oral presentations, pair work, small-group discussions and whole-class discussions for communicative purposes; they have good opportunities to express their feelings and thoughts in their essays and journal entries. A variety of reading, writing, and oral communication tasks are provided with a view to developing students' reading, writing, and oral communication skills, and to facilitating their using appropriate, effective learning strategies to accomplish learning tasks. In a word, the purpose of this curriculum is to motivate students to learn English, and to help them gradually become confident and competent use

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調人文專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
This course aims to provide pre-service cultural business students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.zh: 本課程設計予五專部工科學生，其目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: This course is designed for the five-year-degree-program students.In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為五專部工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週4小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en:
The course is aimed directly at the five-year-degree-program students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to
emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester, and 4 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Series.

description.zh: 本課程適用於P-TECH學校。透過多元化的課程設計，透過教學培養學生職場中所需具備的技能及軟實力，為將來進入職場提前做好準備。其課程涵蓋七大主題：協同合作(collaboration)、溝通技巧(communication)、分析式思維(analytical thinking)、自我管理能力(self-management)、激勵(motivation)、領導力(leadership)、專責(responsibility)、好奇心(curiosity)等課程，並搭配企業參訪(worksite visits)、實習課程及企業導師等安排，培養具備職場技能及競爭力的學生。
description.en: The primary focus of Workplace Learning Curriculum is to provide students with introductory units on communication, collaboration, analytical thinking, leadership and responsibility, self-management, curiosity and motivation. The 7 skills are a framework for talking about professional skills within the P-TECH model. We are calling out these skills for the IBM P-TECH schools in hopes that our students will begin to develop fluency in discussing them, which will be highly valuable in distinguishing their readiness for internships and?? jobs from their competition.

description.zh: 本程式設計課程以C語言為基礎，先介紹程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入C++程式語言物件導向概念。內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練以應付各類工程上之應用，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計專業之基礎。
description.en: To familiarize the student with basic computer programming concepts. Topics cover the methods for analyzing problem statements, designing computer solutions, as well as an introduction into the syntax and semantics of the C and C++ programming language. An important objective of the course is to present effective methods of program design using modular construction and structured programming notions of sequence, selection, and iteration structures.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹材料力學之各主題：(1) 了解與分析可變形體力學；(2) 物體在受到軸力、扭矩、剪力、彎矩等受力狀態下之變形；(2) 分析各不同受力下結構之反應如:應力、應變、變形、位移、應變能、極限承載力；(3) 材料之應力與應變轉換方程式；(4) 利用莫耳圓計算主軸應力、主軸應變及其轉換；(5) 介紹柱、樑、及軸等結構之設計原理；(6) 鐵道系統中材料的應用與材料機械性質；(7) 導入鐵道系統案例(如長焊鋼軌內應力、橋軌互制應力、車輛與軌道變形等)

description.en:
1. Introduction to computer networks and the Internet. Protocolarchitectures (TCP/IP, OSI). Packet switching 
2. Application Layer Protocols: HTTP, FTP, SMTP, DNS, P2P. Socket programming and Web server implementations. 
3. Transport Layer Protocols: TCP, UDP 
4. Network Layer Protocols: IP 
5. Data Link Layer Protocols: Ethernet. Local area networks 
6. Wireless and Mobile Network

syllabi.outline: The course aims to provide a comprehensive introduction to Internet and computer networking technologies. Unlike traditional course, it pursues a top-down approach to the topics, starting with the application layer and then describing the transport and network layers, finally covering the physical layer. The topics covered in course are: (1) Network Application, (2) TCP and UDP protocols, (3) Network Layer - Data Plane, (4) Network Layer - Control Plane, (5) Link Layer & Local Area Networks, (6) Wireless and Mobile Network, and (7) Multimedia Networking.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括五大項：
一 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，拉譜拉斯轉換，   特殊函數。
二 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。
三 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。
四 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
五 複變分析及映射轉換。

Week 1 Introduction, Terminology and Separable Equations
第1週  課程介紹；微分方程用語與可分離方程式
Week 2 The Linear First-Order Equation, Exact Equations
第2週  一階線性微分方程式、正合方程式
Week 3 Integrating Factors, Homogeneous Equations
第3週  積分因子法、齊性微分方程式
Week 4 Bernoulli and Riccati Equations, Additional Applications
第4週  伯努利方程式及雷卡迪方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 5 The Linear Second-Order Equation, Reduction of Order
第5週  二階線性微分方程式、降階法
Week 6 The Constant Coefficient Homogeneous Equation
第6週  常係數齊性微分方程式
Week 7 Particular Solutions of the Nonhomogeneous Equation
第7週  非齊性微分方程式的特解
Week 8 The Euler Differential Equation, Additional Applications
第8週  尤拉微分方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 9 High Order Differential Equations, Midterm Exam.
第9週  高階微分方程式、期中考
Week 10 Definition and Notation of Laplace Transform
第10週 拉氏轉換式的定義與標號
Week 11 Solution of Initial Value Problems, Shifting Theorem and the Heaviside Function
第11週 含有初值問題的解、移位定理與赫維賽德函數
Week 12 Convolution, Impulses and the Dirac Delta Function
第12週 摺積、單位脈衝及狄拉克德爾塔函數
Week 13 Solution of Systems of Laplace Transform
第13週 線性微分方程式系統的解
Week 14 Polynomial Coefficients Differential Equations
第14週 多項式係數的拉氏轉換式
Week 15 Power Series Solutions
第15週 冪級數的解
Week 16 Frobenius Solutions and the real roots
第16週 弗羅貝尼斯的解與實根
Week 17 Frobenius Solutions with k≠0
第17週 具有k≠0弗羅貝尼斯的解
Week 18 Final Exam.
第18週  期末考

電子學實習的課程在教授測試跟設計類比電路，在課程中將會介紹基本的儀器使用說明、電子零件之認識、二極體電路（特性）、電晶體電路（特性）、線性電壓調整器及濾波器等應用。課程在規劃搭配原理的介紹及電路的模擬與實務的驗證，以專案式的教學作為學習的導向。

The course of the electronics experiment laboratory teaches testing and designing of analog circuits. The course will introduce basic instrumentation instructions and understanding of electronic parts, including diode circuits (characteristics), transistor circuits (characteristics), linear voltage regulators and filters, and electronics applications. The course introduces the principle of electronics, the simulation of the circuit, and practical verification of circuits with project learning-based teaching methods.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.en:
Course Title:Electronics and Electronics Lab.
Description:The properties of semiconductor and fabrication of a PN
diode and BJT, and their characteristics are explained. Part 2
concentrates on analog circuit and system. Method of biasing a
discrete BJT or EET are given, and stability of the operating point is
discussed. The small-signal model for each device is abstained and used
to calculate the performance of low frequency single stage and
cascaded amplifiers. The feedback concepts of AMP. OP AMP, its
characteristics and applications are described.

description.zh:
介紹用於工程系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包含：(1)常微
分一階，二階及高階方程式之解法 (2)拉普拉斯(Laplace)轉
換及其應用 (3)冪級數（Power Series）(4)向量分析及應用
 (5)矩陣代數 (6)傅立葉（Fourier）級數及轉換(7)偏微分
方程。
description.en:
1.ordinary differential Equations of the Frist Order

2.Linear Ordinary Differential Equations of the Second Order

3.Laplace Transforms

4.Series Solution of Ordinary Differential Equations,  

  special Functions 

5.Higher Order Ordinary Differential Equations

6.Matrix Analysis

7.Vector Analysis

8.Fourier Series and Integrals,Fourier Transforms

9.Partial Differential Equations

10.Complex Variables

11.Transforms

12.Digital Signals and Differential Equations

syllabi.outline:
本課程將介紹工程上、物理上系統解析的相關數學工具，內容包括五大項：
一 常微分方程式：一階，二階，及高階常微分方程，拉譜拉斯轉換，   特殊函數。
二 向量幾何與分析：矩陣行列式及特徵問題。
三 傅立葉級數，積分及轉換。
四 偏微分方程及邊界值問題。
五 複變分析及映射轉換。
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction, Terminology and Separable Equations
第1週  課程介紹；微分方程用語與可分離方程式
Week 2 The Linear First-Order Equation, Exact Equations
第2週  一階線性微分方程式、正合方程式
Week 3 Integrating Factors, Homogeneous Equations
第3週  積分因子法、齊性微分方程式
Week 4 Bernoulli and Riccati Equations, Additional Applications
第4週  伯努利方程式及雷卡迪方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 5 The Linear Second-Order Equation, Reduction of Order
第5週  二階線性微分方程式、降階法
Week 6 The Constant Coefficient Homogeneous Equation
第6週  常係數齊性微分方程式
Week 7 Particular Solutions of the Nonhomogeneous Equation
第7週  非齊性微分方程式的特解
Week 8 The Euler Differential Equation, Additional Applications
第8週  尤拉微分方程式、微分方程的應用
Week 9 High Order Differential Equations, Midterm Exam.
第9週  高階微分方程式、期中考
Week 10 Definition and Notation of Laplace Transform
第10週 拉氏轉換式的定義與標號
Week 11 Solution of Initial Value Problems, Shifting Theorem and the Heaviside Function
第11週 含有初值問題的解、移位定理與赫維賽德函數
Week 12 Convolution, Impulses and the Dirac Delta Function
第12週 摺積、單位脈衝及狄拉克德爾塔函數
Week 13 Solution of Systems of Laplace Transform
第13週 線性微分方程式系統的解
Week 14 Polynomial Coefficients Differential Equations
第14週 多項式係數的拉氏轉換式
Week 15 Power Series Solutions
第15週 冪級數的解
Week 16 Frobenius Solutions and the real roots
第16週 弗羅貝尼斯的解與實根
Week 17 Frobenius Solutions with k≠0
第17週 具有k≠0弗羅貝尼斯的解
Week 18 Final Exam.
第18週  期末考

description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.en: This course introduces students of engineering to those areas of mathematics which are important in connection with practical engineering problems. The material in this course is arrange accordingly in four parts: (1) Fist-order, second-order and higher order differential equations. (2) Systems of differential equations. (3) Series solutions of differential equations and special function. (4) Laplace transforms.

syllabi.schedule:
一 分組(每組每週做不同實驗，請明確第二週實驗順序)、安全衛生教育講習
二、三 實驗實做前課程講解
四 固體密度的測定 藉比重瓶測定粒狀或粉狀等不規則形固體的密度
五 液體密度的測定 藉漢埃氏法測定液體或溶液的密度
六 表面張力的測定 藉毛細管上升法測定不同溫度下液體的表面張力
七 液體黏度的測定 以奧士瓦黏度計測定純液體或溶液於各種溫度時之相對黏度，並了解相對黏度及絕對黏度的定義及測定法
八 備課
九 全校期中考週
十 凝固點下降法測定分子量 依據Clausius-Clapeyron方程式及稀薄溶液理論，藉貝克曼凝固點下降分子量測定裝置，以圖解法求溶質之真正分子量
十一 中和熱的測定 藉由量熱器測定各種酸與鹼溶液的中和熱，並熟悉量熱器水當量的測定法
十二 液體蒸氣壓的測定 藉等壓管法測定液體蒸氣壓，並與Clausius-Clapeyron方程式相驗證，進而估算液體的汽化熱
十三 固體溶質溶解度的測定 了解溶解度的定義及其測定方法，以測定固體溶質在不同溫度下的溶解度並求該物質的溶解熱
十四 溶質於相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率 測定溶質在相互不溶解二溶劑間的分配率，並依據熱力學原理，由分配律測求其會合度或解離度
十五 二成份系之液液平衡 測定水-酚系溶液之溶解度曲線（成份與溫度的關係），並求其臨界溶解溫度（或稱會溶溫度）及其組成
十六 期末實驗室器材整理
十七 期末打掃實驗室
十八 全校期末考週

description.zh: 介紹化工程序中物質於一系統中流進、流出間質量、能量均衡之原理與計算，使學生學習列出質能均衡之基本式子並查尋相關文獻，手冊上所登錄之物性資料以解決問題。
description.en: The course introduces the material and energy balances of the chemical process.  Students learn to define the system, practice the conservation law of mass and energy, and look up handbook for necessary information.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹化學工程程序中物質於一系統中流進、流出間質量、能量均衡之原理與計算，主要銜接化學專業與工廠內化工製程操作，因化工廠內工作人員被要求對「參與化學反應的質量關係，以及反應中能量的去除或加入」必需清楚明瞭，熟讀本科可擁有足夠的化學專業知識，故可「以最經濟的化學反應成本來量產高附加物品，獲取最大的益」。使學生學習列出質能均衡之基本式並查尋研讀相關文獻、與手冊上所登錄之物性資料以解決各種相關問題。
1.瞭解化學工廠中質量與能量變化之相關知識
2.瞭解化學專業應用在工廠操作之產程放大技術與考量
3.瞭解化學產業之市場動態及其發展情形

description.zh: 以數學與物理的方法來探討化學之原理，物質之結構與性質，內容包括由氣體動力論衍導熱力學之基本定律，物理平衡（相平衡）、化學平衡、溶液論、電化學、反應動力學、量子力學、光譜學、表面現象、輸送性質等。
description.en: This course deals with the principle of chemistry, structure and properties of matter by the matter matical and physical methods. Topics include the kinetic theory of gases, basis laws of thermodgnamics, physical equilibria (phase equilibria ), chemical equilibria, solutions, electrochemistry, chemical kinetics, quantum mechanics, spectroscopy, surface phenomena and transport properties etc.

syllabi.outline: In the first semester, this course first introduces the core areas of physical chemistry by defining systems, states, and processes. Later, traditional thermodynamics is described and applied to understand the reaction spontaneous direction of macroscopic systems, including the explanation of the three laws of thermodynamics, to the description of thermodynamic behavior applied to gaseous and liquid systems.

2.	The zeroth law of thermodynamics & Kelvin temperature scale
3.	The first law of thermodynamics-
4.	Heat, Work, and energy.
5.	Internal energy, enthalpy
6.	Heat capacity and internal pressure
7.	Thermochemistry
8.	The second law of thermodynamics-Heat energy & the concept of entropy
9.	Mid-term exam
10.	Equilibrium and spontaneity
11.	The third law of thermodynamics
12.	Entropy changes for specific processes
13.	The Helmholtz and Gibbs free energies
14.	Combining the First and Second Laws
15.	Phase equilibrium
16.	Physical transformations, mixing, and Colligative properties
17.	Chemical equilibrium
18.	Final exam

The schedule is dependent on the actual progress of lesson.

description.zh: 本課程介紹自然科學的起源、近代自然科學的誕生與發展。各領域含物理學、化學、生物學、天文學、數學等，並介紹各項科學技術。
description.en: This is an introductory course concerning about the origin of nature science, the genesis and developments of the modern physics science.  The topics of physics science are physics, chemistry, biology, astronomy, and mathematics.  The contents and characteristic of various technology are also discussed in this course.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 配合顯微組織學課程，使學生從實際顯微組織觀察中，依據相圖的理論觀念，分析和判斷材料的基本特徵。藉由應用顯微鏡設備，結合試片製作與處理的技術，從事試片構造的觀察，據此作為熱處理物件之分析，塑性加工或鑄件之研判，是為本課程的訓練目的。實習內容含括影片教學，熱電偶之測定與應用，熱分析法、以及試片的製作與處理等實作練習。
description.en: This course is to introduce Microstructure Practices.It focus on the purpose of material testing, the structure of material testing equipment, and the operation method, its content covers tensile, bending, compression, impact and various hardness test equipment, let student fully aware of operation method, to the extent of skillfulness, and it matches other curriculums to judge the specifics of the analytic materials

syllabi.outline: 本課程主旨在使修課學生能實際進行材料科學及工程領域相關實驗，以使學生能具備材料基礎實作能力，並具備分析能力。實驗內容主要分成兩大類別，第一部分為材料機械性質測試，包含拉伸性質(tensile property)、衝擊性質(impact property)、維氏硬度(Vickers hardness)、洛式硬度(Rockwell hardness)、勃氏硬度(Brinell hardness)等。第二部分為材料金相試片製備(Preparation for metallographic specimen)

description.zh: 將熱力學定律應用於計算凝結相之化學位能與其平衡，逸壓和活性因素，溶液熱力學，多元金屬溶液，相圖和相變化，運用電腦模擬相反應和相圖，及研擬冶金數學模式。
description.en: It applies the theory of thermaldynamics to calculate chemical potential energy and its equilibrium of condensed phase, released pressure and activated factors, solution thermaldynamics, complex metal solution , phase diagram and phase change, computer-aided phase reaction and phase diagram simulation, and planning a mathmatics model of metallurgy.

syllabi.outline:
This course applies the theories of thermodynamics to evaluate the chemical potentials equilibrium phases. Three fundamental laws of thermodynamics will first be introduced.  The effects of temperature and pressure upon Gibbs Free energy are then discussed. Applications for solutions, phase diagram, and chemical reaction evaluations with aids of computers will be the main practical topics for thermodynamics. The concepts of thermodynamics will be used extensively for metallurgical and materials-related fields.

本課程討論材料熱力學的基本理論、技巧及應用等，特別是平衡時化學熱力學有關氣相，氣体定理，熱量，功，熱力學第一、第二及第三定律，溫度與壓力對焓，熵，自由能之影響等概念；利用電腦輔助計算溶液、相圖與相平衡、及化學反應平衡等均為熱力學的應用範疇，這些概念對於諸多冶金、材料相關的場域皆十分重要。

description.zh:
材料之特性取決於材料內部組織，所以課程內容也注重內部組織與材料特性之間的關係，內部組織的變化對材料特性之影響，由理論為基礎之探討至實際之應用上。對本課程有關的基本概念，則詳加說明，初學材料者能得到材料上所必備之基本知識，若基本概念已有充分了解，則利用這些知識即可參考材料規格或手冊就可得到欲知之條件，進而以此概念作基礎，亦可研習更高深之學問，本課程內容著重於介紹材料之結構，基本原理有： 1. 金屬之基本理論，金屬及合金之構造，材料之組織，塑性加工變形之理論，材料之物理化學，機械性質及其實驗。 2. 鋼和鐵之製造，組織及其熱處理，變態理論。 3. 構造用鋼，合金鋼，工具鋼，特殊鋼之特性、用
途及其熱處理方法。4. 鋼之表面硬化理論及其熱處理方法。 5. 鑄鐵之冶煉，種類及其熱處理方法。6.非鐵金屬材料，銅，鋁，鈦，鎂，錫，鋅，鉛，鎳等合金種類之特性及其處理方法。
description.en:
The chacteristics of material depend on the inside tissue, therefore, the content also
put more emphasis on the relationship between the inside tissue and material chacter-
istics, how the change of inside tissue influences it in full details from the discussion 
of the theory basis to practical application. It has a detail description to the basic idea
of this course, the novice may get requisite fundamental knowledge. Once they fully
perceive these basic ideas, they may refer to material specification or manual to get
the conditions they request, or they may use these fundation to further explore
advanced knowledge.

description.zh: 本課程主要是介紹最新的製造技術。利用物理式及化學式的製造方法來加工新進材料，使用新進光電能源及新進製造工具如雷射、鑽石、電子束、離子束、電漿、化學反應劑等，適應生產微小精密工件之需求，由冶金技術製造的材料與產品包括：高熔點材料、超硬質材料、超耐熱材料、燒結機械另件、燒結摩擦材料、燒結磁性材料等，以期讓學過冶金課程的學生，能進一步對製造技術之應用有更多的了解。

description.zh: 介紹各種奈米結構材料：奈米碳管、奈米線、量子點、量子線和奈米複合材料的基本特性以及製備與應用技術，期能對奈米材料的物性、製造與應用有整體的認識。
description.en: This course will deal with the chemical and physical properties of nanomaterials. It will cover the preparation, structure, properties and applications of quantum dots and lines, carbon nanotubes, and nanocomposites.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要概括性介紹分為三部分：第一、奈米基本理論－介觀物理奈米微粒、奈米碳管與奈米線、奈米薄膜的結構特性、奈米粉體材料的性能等；第二、奈米加工與檢測；第三、奈米材料之應用。
This course is divided into three parts. Part 1: the fundamental of nanostructure materials. The topics include: nanoparticles, carbon nanotube, nanowire, nanostructure coating, bulk materials, etc. Part 2: fabrication of nanomaterials. The topics include: self-assembled, scanning probe microscope. The measurement of nanomaterials include scanning probe microscope, scanning tunneling microscope, Raman spectroscopy, etc. Part 3: the state-of-the art review the application of nanomateria.

description.zh: 課程主要目標，是要使工程科系，發展出以簡單而合於邏輯的方式分析任何問題，並應用一些為大家熟悉的基本原理加以解答。本課程內容分成質點力學及剛體力學兩部分，剛體力學部分又分為靜力學及動力學。除介紹力學中的基本觀念及定理外更解釋及預測各種物理現象，進而打好工程應用的基礎。提供同學分析及設計各種機件和承載荷重結構的方法，課程內容將介紹某些依據基本定理而化簡的數學模式，進而分析及設計作用在結構上的各種條件，使同學在選擇或運用材料上有安全與正確的觀念，以便在理論與經驗的配合下，順利地處理材料在工程上所發生的問題。
description.en: The major target of this course is to let the engineering students develop and analyze any questions with an easy and logical way, and to try to solve them with some well-recognized fundamental principles. The course can be divided into particle dynamics and rigid body dynamics, the latter can be further divided into statics and dynamics. Apart from introducing the fundamental concept and law, it also explains and forecasts all kinds of nature physic phenomenon, in order to establish a good foundation for engineering application science. It provides methods for students to analyze and design all kinds of machine elements, bearing load structure as well, the course content will introduce some implified math models which are based on fundamental principles, and further analyze and design all conditions to the structure , let students have a safe and exact concept in choosing and utilizing materials, so that the theory and experience can be well matched, and the problems arisen from hand.

syllabi.outline: 本課程歷經幾屆學生的反應與討論, 老師最終將大二上學期的應用力學與下學期的材料力學, 從原本偏向機械系與土木系的靜力學/材料力學, 轉為以物理系的統計力學以及材料系的熱力學為主的(材料特色)應用力學, 我們會從機械系的引擎(熱機)出發, 進入熱力學第二定律, 最終將物理系的統計(熱)力學中的排列方法數(微觀態)與材料(熱)力學中的熵(巨視態)結合成一套連貫性知識

name.zh: 程式設計與人工智慧(二)

description.zh: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python語言為基礎，在Python包索引（PyPI中）的主機中，擁有成千上萬的Python模組。本課程內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。除此之外，也會介紹AI的相關應用如ChatGPT、類神經網路及深度學習等。
description.en: This course mainly teaches students the concepts and methods of programming, with Python as the programming language foundation. As a programming language, Python has thousands of modules available in the Python Package Index (PyPI). This course emphasizes training in logical thinking and programming skills while also focusing on essential aspects of programming, such as program structure, debugging, portability, and fundamental software engineering concepts. This aims to lay a solid foundation in programming for the learners. The course will also introduce related applications of AI, such as ChatGPT, neural networks, and deep learning.

syllabi.outline: 本課程主要授與學生程式設計的觀念與方法，程式設計語言以Python語言為基礎，在Python包索引（PyPI中）的主機中，擁有成千上萬的Python模組。本課程內容著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
syllabi.schedule:
Ｗeek 1-2 運算思維與程式設計 - 跨入程式設計的大門
程式設計，是針對電腦要解決的問題提供處理方式的過程，也是軟體開發時的重要步驟。Python是一個執行功能強大，但語法簡潔優雅的程式語言，不僅容易學習，更容易應用實作在許多專題上！

Ｗeek 3-5 變數與運算式 - 不只先乘除後加減
變數建立時，應用程式就會配置一塊記憶體，並以變數名稱做為辨識此塊記憶體的標誌，設計者就可在程式中將各種資料存入使用。運算式包含了運算元與運算子，可以進行程式的運算動作。
‧本章範例包括：成績單、稅率報表及薪資表格式化輸出\梯形、長方形面積計算\複利本金計算...等。

Week 6-8 判斷式 - 邏輯思維的起點
程式設計也和日常生活雷同，常會遇到一些需要做決策的情況，再依決策結果執行不同的程式碼，這就是「判斷式」。
‧本章範例包括：密碼比對判斷\輸入成績評等\電影分級判斷\百貨公司折扣戰\數字比大小...等。

Week 9 期中上機檢核

Week 10-11 迴圈 - 翻滾吧！程式碼
電腦最擅長處理的工作就是重複執行的事情，而日常生活中到處充斥著這種不斷重複的現象，程式專門用來處理重複事件的命令稱為「迴圈」。
‧本章範例包括：建立數列\計算正整數總和\井字直角三角形\九九乘法表\找最小公倍數\階乘計算...等。

Week 12-14  串列與元組 - 大量數據收納術
串列又稱為清單或列表，與其他語言的陣列相同，其功能與變數相類似，是提供儲存資料的記憶體空間。元組的結構與串列完全相同，不同處在於元組的元素個數及元素值皆不能改變。
‧本章範例包括：串列初值設定\迴圈讀取串列\成績計算\刪除串列元素\成績排序...等。

Week 15  字典 - 為資料貼上標籤
字典資料型態，其元素是以「鍵-值」對方式儲存，運作方式為利用「鍵」來取得「值」。‧本章範例包括：血型個性查詢\四季天氣查詢\成績查詢\產品銷售查詢\世大運獎牌數查詢...等。

Week 16 期末上機檢

Week 17 線上授課
核函式與模組 - 簡化運算擴充功能的利器
在程式中通常會將具有特定功能或經常重複使用的程式，撰寫成獨立的小單元，稱為函式。Python擁有許多模組，可讓功能可以無限擴充。
‧本章範例包括：攝氏華氏溫度\公斤英磅轉換\均分蘋果\電費、家庭支出查詢\網址格式檢查\檔案格式檢查\成績單、業績報表列印\日期時間格式轉換\擲骰子遊戲\大樂透抽獎\四星彩開獎...等。

Week 18  線上授課
演算法：排序與搜尋 - 用邏輯來解決問題
演算法就是為了解決一個問題而採取的方法和步驟，通常會以虛擬碼來表示，再以熟悉的語言來實現。‧本章範例包括：數字排排站\追蹤泡沫排序\搜尋中獎者\彩券對獎...等。

syllabi.materials:
■「Python零基礎入門班」本書適用無程式設計經驗，想打好程式語言基礎者，內容為程式觀念的建立與重要語法的學習+實用小範例，可一步一步紮實打好基本功。
■「Python初學特訓班」本書適用初學Python，想一次就從基礎跨入專案開發者，內容為基礎語法+專案實例，以快速具備Python開發力。
■「Python大數據特訓班：資料自動化收集、整理、分析、儲存與應用實戰」本書適用想完整學習Python資料處理三大觀念與技術「擷取分析、視覺化呈現與儲存應用」者，內容全面深入不同應用面向，如：網路爬蟲、資料正規化/視覺化/儲存與讀取…等，並以國內熱門實例進行大數據專案實作。
■「Python架站特訓班：Django最強實戰」本書適用想直接打造超強互動網站者，內容涵蓋正規化網站開發流程，結合資料庫，並透由主題範例實戰，架構出專業實用的網站。

description.zh: 本課程討論結晶質固體之基本概念，含晶體之幾何學及數學理論，並進一步討論結晶化學及結晶構造之原理，同時輔以電子顯微鏡法及X-射線法作結晶構造分析。
description.en: This course is to introduce Elements of Crystallography.

syllabi.outline: 本課程討論結晶質固體之基本概念，含晶體之幾何學及數學理論，並進一步討論結晶化學及結晶構造之原理，同時輔以電子顯微鏡法及X-射線法作結晶構造分析。

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原 理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺 陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物 理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度 、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。

description.en: Laboratory tests of concrete and its materials, Brick and stone,Wood,Asphalt,Reinforcing steel and other materials of Civil Engineering,Include test procedures,instrumentation,and interpretation of results.

syllabi.outline:
1. 水泥比重試驗 (Density Test of Hydraulic Cement)
2. 水泥標準稠度試驗 (Water Ratio Test for Normal Consistency of Hydraulic Cement Paste)
3. 水泥砂漿流度試驗+水泥砂漿抗壓試體製作 (Flow Test of Hydraulic Cement Mortar + Compressive Strength Test of Hydraulic Cement Mortars - Part 1)
4. 混凝土坍度試驗、混凝土圓柱及矩形梁試體製作(Slump Test of Hydraulic-Cement Concrete + Making and Curing of Concrete Test Specimens in the Laboratory )
5. 粗粒料比重及吸水率試驗 (Density, Relative Density, and Absorption Test of Coarse Aggregate)
6. 細粒料比重及吸水率試驗 (Density, Relative Density, and Absorption Test of Fine Aggregate)
7. 粒料篩分析試驗 (Sieve Analysis of Fine and Coarse Aggregates)
8. 混凝土圓柱劈裂抗張強度試驗 (Splitting Tensile Strength Test of Cylindrical Concrete Specimens)

syllabi.outline:
1. 首先在訓練學生基本數學思惟及推理的能力，另外也銜接基礎數學及微積分的課程，以奠定各專業領域所需的數學基礎。 
2. 課程內容以教導學生具有分析處理實際工程問題所需之基本數學觀念及能力為主。 
3. 強調理論基礎、運算技巧及實際應用領域，另特別增強解題技巧及演算能力，使對將來繼續深造能預作準備。 
4. 使學生具備未來成為頂尖工程師或科學家所需要之入門工具。
5. 本學期課程以常微分方程為主
syllabi.schedule:
1-3週: First order differential equations (一階常微分方程)
4-9週: Linear differential equations of second and higher order (高階線性微分方程)
10週: Nonlinear differential equations-introduction (非線性微分方程簡介)
11-13週: Series solutions of differential equations (微分方程之級數解)
14週: Boundary value problems (邊界值問題)
15-17週: Partial differential equations and Laplace Transforms 
18週: 期末考

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.en: The aim of this course is to educate students to think independently about organic chemistry. description.zh: 本課程將介紹一系列的生物大分子及構成這些生物分子的基本分子。課程從認識細菌、植物、動物細胞及各種細胞胞器開始，接著探討蛋白質、酵素、DNA、RNA、脂質、糖類結構和功能及他們在生命中的重要性。構成蛋白質的二十種氨基酸和組成DNA或RNA的四個核甘酸及構成脂質、糖類結構的生物分子將詳細被探討。
description.en: This course is to introduce a serials of biomaterials and their functions. Begins from bacterial, plant, and animal cells and the differences between these cell organs. To learn of DNA, RNA, proteins, and enzymes base on their structures and functions. The characters of 20 amino acids and 4 nucleotides will be studied in detail. Carbohydrates and lipids are learned by their specific functions.

description.en: Inorganic chemistry is one of the three frames of chemistry. Various materials in our daily life are composed of inorganic materials. This course will be given in a manner of easy-getting-point. The contents comprise of chemistry of main group elements and transition elements. The course covers the following topics: (1) Survey of principles (2) Chemistry of main group elements (A. Boron; B. Group 1, 2, 15, 16, 17 Elements) (3) Chemistry of transition elements (A. Survey of Transition Elements; B. Elements of the first transition series; C. Titanium, Chromium, Cobalt, Nickel and Copper (4) Atomic Structure (5) Simple Bonding Theory (6) Symmetry, Vibration Application and Group Theory (7) Molecular Orbitals and (8) Acid-Base and Donor-Acceptor Chemistry.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 1.瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含：(1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件 (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等 (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應 (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域 (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。2.瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路 (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析 (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換 (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數 (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用 (6)Laplace轉換及應用。

syllabi.outline:
Course Introduction
Discrete mathematics is a branch of mathematics devoted to the study of discrete objects (i.e., objects that are distinct and unconnected). This course will introduce and apply various discrete structures and techniques to solve real-world problems.
Main Topics
1.	The Foundations: Logic and Proofs
o	Understanding the fundamentals of logical reasoning and constructing mathematical proofs.
2.	Basic Structures: Sets, Functions, Sequences, Sums, and Matrices
o	Exploring fundamental mathematical structures used in computer science and mathematics.
3.	Algorithms
o	Designing and analyzing algorithms for various computational problems.
4.	Number Theory and Cryptography
o	Applying number theory in cryptographic algorithms and understanding their mathematical underpinnings.
5.	Counting
o	Learning basic counting principles and techniques, including permutations and combinations.
6.	Discrete Probability
o	Introducing probability theory with discrete random variables and their applications.
7.	Advanced Counting Techniques
o	Delving deeper into combinatorial analysis and advanced counting methods.
8.	Relations
o	Examining relations and their properties, including equivalence relations and partial orderings.
Learning Objectives
•	Development of Mathematical Thinking and Logical Reasoning: Cultivate the ability to understand and create mathematical arguments, laying the foundation for advanced mathematical studies.
•	Foundations in Computer Science: Provide the necessary mathematical background for advanced courses in computer science, such as data structures, algorithms, compiler theory, and more.
•	Operations Research and Applications: Equip students with the mathematical background required to solve problems in operations research, chemical engineering, biology, and related fields.
Course Features
•	Emphasis on Problem-Solving: The course focuses on teaching mathematical reasoning and problem-solving rather than merely imparting skills.
•	Fostering Creativity and Critical Thinking: Through diverse topics and problems, students are encouraged to apply their knowledge to new challenges.
•	Practice in Mathematical Proofs: Students will learn how to read, write, and validate mathematical proofs, which will be valuable for advanced courses.

This course aims to equip students with the necessary tools and skills to tackle challenges in future courses and professional work.

syllabi.outline:
Course Introduction
Discrete mathematics is a branch of mathematics devoted to the study of discrete objects (i.e., objects that are distinct and unconnected). This course will introduce and apply various discrete structures and techniques to solve real-world problems.
Main Topics
1.	The Foundations: Logic and Proofs
o	Understanding the fundamentals of logical reasoning and constructing mathematical proofs.
2.	Basic Structures: Sets, Functions, Sequences, Sums, and Matrices
o	Exploring fundamental mathematical structures used in computer science and mathematics.
3.	Algorithms
o	Designing and analyzing algorithms for various computational problems.
4.	Number Theory and Cryptography
o	Applying number theory in cryptographic algorithms and understanding their mathematical underpinnings.
5.	Counting
o	Learning basic counting principles and techniques, including permutations and combinations.
6.	Discrete Probability
o	Introducing probability theory with discrete random variables and their applications.
7.	Advanced Counting Techniques
o	Delving deeper into combinatorial analysis and advanced counting methods.
8.	Relations
o	Examining relations and their properties, including equivalence relations and partial orderings.
Learning Objectives
•	Development of Mathematical Thinking and Logical Reasoning: Cultivate the ability to understand and create mathematical arguments, laying the foundation for advanced mathematical studies.
•	Foundations in Computer Science: Provide the necessary mathematical background for advanced courses in computer science, such as data structures, algorithms, compiler theory, and more.
•	Operations Research and Applications: Equip students with the mathematical background required to solve problems in operations research, chemical engineering, biology, and related fields.
Course Features
•	Emphasis on Problem-Solving: The course focuses on teaching mathematical reasoning and problem-solving rather than merely imparting skills.
•	Fostering Creativity and Critical Thinking: Through diverse topics and problems, students are encouraged to apply their knowledge to new challenges.
•	Practice in Mathematical Proofs: Students will learn how to read, write, and validate mathematical proofs, which will be valuable for advanced courses.

This course aims to equip students with the necessary tools and skills to tackle challenges in future courses and professional work.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

syllabi.outline: This course is an introduction to statistical computing and will be taught in Python or Minitab. It is assumed students have exposure to basic statistics and knowledge of calculus (i.e., differential and integral calculus). The main focus of the class will be on statistical analysis and graphics in Python or Minitab. Students will cover basic statistical concepts and various statistical methods such as estimation, hypothesis tests, regression analysis, and ANOVA.

Week 4 Random variables and probability distributions – Continuous random variables

Week 7 Decision making for a single sample – Inference on the mean of a population
Week 8 Quiz, independent Study
Week 9 Midterm exam (In-class, 1 Cheat Sheet, Calculator)
Week 10 Decision making for a single sample – Inference on the variance of a normal population
Week 11 Decision making for a single sample – Inference on a population proportion, goodness of fit test
Week 12 Decision making for two samples – Inference on the means of two populations (Part I)
Week 13 Decision making for two samples – Inference on the means of two populations (Part II)
Week 14 Decision making for two samples – Paired t-test, inference on the ratio of variances of two normal populations
Week 15 Decision making for two samples – Inference on two population proportions
Week 16 ANOVA
Week 17 Quiz, independent Study
Week 18 Final exam

description.zh: 本課程旨在為學生提供創業和經營新創企業所需的基本知識和技能。 課程內容涵蓋當前各種形態的創業模式和創業家精神所具備的一些關鍵特質與必要的技能，學生將學習到如何識別市場機會並評估將想法商業化的可行性。本課程也將深入介紹行銷的核心概念與市場運作，包括市場細分，目標顧客定位和行銷組合，學生將學習到如何根據市場需求制定行銷策略並有效地實施。該課程還將涵蓋品牌策略、定價策略、推廣和銷售等主題。完成本課程後，學生將獲得關於創業以及經營企業的關鍵知識和技能，以及對行銷在創業過程中的作用有更深入的理解。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with the foundational knowledge and skills necessary to start and operate a new business venture. Students will learn about the various forms of entrepreneurship and entrepreneurship essentials, such as the characteristics, traits, and skills of successful entrepreneurs. Students will learn how to identify opportunities and assess the feasibility of a business idea. The course will then delve into the core concepts of marketing, including market segmentation, targeting, positioning, and the marketing mix. Students will learn how to develop a marketing plan and implement it effectively. The course will also cover topics such as branding, pricing strategies, promotion, and distribution. Upon completion of this course, students will have gained the knowledge and skills necessary to launch and operate a new business, as well as a deeper understanding of the role of marketing in entrepreneurship.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在訓練學生，使學生熟悉經常使用之統計方法與理論，能利用已知之資料整理、分析未知之現象，打好修習其他相關學科之基礎。課程內容包括：機率理論、推定、假設檢定、迴歸分析、變異數分析等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to train student and to provide a background in the theory and methodology of general statistical issues. Topics include probability theory, inference, hypothesis testing, regression analysis and variance analysis.

description.zh: 本課程講授家具工程製圖技術及相關知識，著重在家具工程製圖與一般工程製圖的主要差別，其能讓學生將所設計的家具產品以圖面表達其細部結構與工程要件。
description.en:
This is the lecture of furniture engineering drawing technique and related knowledge, It emphases on the main difference between furniture engineering drawing and normal engineering drawing. The aim is for students to present the
detailed construction and main parts of their furniture design product by drawing.

syllabi.outline:

syllabi.schedule:
課程進度
第一週：
1.課程大綱、評量標準與相關規定說明
2.製圖標題欄設定與作業內容及繳交時效說明
3.圖學基本工具說明／投影與角法複習與說明

第一階段（2-8週）A3圖紙 
1.第一篇作業-線條練習
2.字體練習
3.木工常用榫接的三視圖繪製
4.丙級家具木工1 -圖面解說與繪製
5.丙級家具木工2 -圖面解說與繪製
6.第一階段作業PDF上傳

第九週：期中測驗

第二階段（9-16週）
1.丙級家具木工3 -圖面解說與繪製
2.乙級家具木工1 -圖面解說與繪製
3.乙級家具木工2 -圖面解說與繪製
4.第二階段作業PDF上傳

第十七週：期末測驗
第十八週：期末檢討

Week 1:
1. Course outline, evaluation criteria and related regulations.
2. Drawing title bar setting, assignment content and deadline.
3. Basic drawing tools/review and explanation of projection and angle method.

Phase 1 (2-8 weeks) A3 size.
1. First assignment - line practice.
2. Font practice.
3. Three-view drawing of common mortise and tenon joints in woodworking.
4. Class C furniture carpentry 1 - explanation and drawing.
5. Class C furniture carpentry 2 - explanation and drawing.
6. Upload PDF of first phase assignment.

Week 9: Midterm exam.

Phase 2 (9-16 weeks) A3 size.
1. Class C furniture carpentry 3 - explanation and drawing
2. Class B furniture carpentry 1 - explanation and drawing
3. Class B furniture carpentry 2 - explanation and drawing
4. Upload PDF of second phase assignment

Week 17: Final exam
Week 18: Final review

syllabi.outline: 以專題設計方式，訓練學生獨立企劃、分析、評斷、組織、歸納與創新之思考，並實際演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組或獨自完成一設計主題。上學期課程以題目界定、資料收集、分析調查、結論定義、構想發展及草模提交等為教學內容，下學期則進行細部設計、模型製作、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容,以培養專業設計之能力。

第 1 週	專題導入與健康背景	介紹午休復原主題、課程結構、組隊
第 2 週	健康與睡眠知識	醫學實證導讀：Power Nap 如何影響生理與認知表現
第 3 週	使用者研究方法	教學：觀察、訪談、日誌紀錄法
第 4 週	現地觀察與調查	實作：訪談、情境觀察
第 5 週	痛點歸納與洞察	整理研究結果，製作共感地圖、旅程圖
第 6 週	問題聚焦與挑戰定義	使用HMW框架轉化洞察為設計機會
第 7 週	系統思維與服務藍圖	學習服務藍圖與行為介入策略設計
第 8 週	中期簡報	簡報：使用者研究、需求洞察、設計挑戰
第 9 週	創意發想工作坊	SCAMPER、Crazy 8s等創意發想
第 10 週	IoT技術導入	感測器、震動、光/聲控制等元件介紹
第 11 週	互動流程設計	設計使用流程圖、行為場景演練
第 12 週	低逼真原型測試	草模、行為劇場、介面原型測試
第 13 週	高逼真原型製作	互動原型、App介面製作
第 14 週	使用者測試與驗證	模擬測試、收集使用者回饋
第 15 週	系統整合與視覺呈現	精煉細節、製作說明板與導引介面
第 16 週	成果影片與腳本設計	編排影片腳本、模擬展場流程
第 17 週	成果展示彩排	簡報流程確認、設備測試
第 18 週	期末成果發表	簡報+互動展示+講評

syllabi.outline:
本課程與產品設計有關。目標是訓練教導學生能夠：
•	設定和掌控產品設計進度；
•	系統化產品設計；
•	創新設計提案；
•	精緻模型製作技能。
本課程包括一系列複雜性不斷增加的設計議題，最終制定產品製造和交付的運營計劃。練習包括產品設計和產品製造注意事項。廣泛使用電腦輔助設計軟件。設計教學資源將在工作坊中提供。


This course is concerned with product design. The objectives are to enable students to:

•	set and control the schedule of product design;
•	systemise product design;
•	sketch performance;
•	prototype skill.

The course consists of a series of design projects of increasing complexity, culminating in developing an operations plan for product manufacture and delivery. Exercises include both product design and product manufacturing considerations. Extensive use is made of CAD software. Resources for the design exercises are presented in working studio sessions.
syllabi.schedule:
產品設計是對產品設計過程的介紹，重點是為日常產品設計。這是一個以項目為中心的課程。 學生以 1-3人進行產品設計專題工作，設計新產品並製作精緻模型。將向學生介紹創新產品設計與開發方法及針對各種設計主題進行產品設計，包括頭腦風暴、設計評估、設計素描、平面設計、手繪和電繪、草圖建模、概念發展、設計美學、精緻模型製作，以及書面、視覺和設計交流。產品設計課程圍繞三個主要內容方向：

•	設計規劃；
•	設計繪圖；
•	精緻模型製作。


Product Design is an introduction to the product design process focusing on designing for daily products. It is a project-centric class. Students work with 1-3 students to design and prototype new products. Students will be introduced to various design topics, including brainstorming; estimation; sketching; graphic design; drawing and CAD rendering; sketch modelling; concept development; design aesthetics; prototyping; and written, visual, and oral communication. The Product Design course is organised around three main content areas:-

•	planning;
•	sketch;
•	prototype.

description.zh: 介紹傳統以及特殊加工法、製造法、金屬、非金屬材料之製造加工。
description.en: In the design and manufacturing of a product is is essential that the machine as wellas the process be understood, Manufacturing requires tools and machines that can produce products economically as well as accurately. Economy depends to a large extent on the proper selection of a machine or process that will give a satisfactory finished porduct. This course serves as an introduction to various manufacturing, foundry, special casting, and special working process.

description.zh: 練習設計構想草圖速繪法；從基本幾何形體至複雜產品、空間循序漸進；常用材質（木質、金屬、透明材質、石材及皮革等）之表現技法；產品精描、透視圖法、三視圖、爆炸圖、組立圖等之精描，說明圖板及各種畫材（麥克筆、粉彩、色鉛筆及水彩）等之應用。
description.en: This course put emphasis on offering students having enough skills on :1.Abilities to sketch their idea visible to the others.2.Coloring design sketches to let the drawings have better comprehensibility.3.Good skill for Renderings. Medias for this course shall include markers, pastels water colors and color pencils.

syllabi.outline:
1.利用電腦軟體SketchUp來表現設計的手法，從基本幾何形體至家具到空間、循序漸進完成透視圖、平立面圖、爆炸圖等表現手法。
2.介紹SketchUp軟體基礎知識、帶領學生快速進入SketchUp的世界，認識SketchUp工作介面，打下良好基礎。SketchUp輔助設計工具主要作用是對模型進行不同的編輯操作，讓家具放入空間實例結合。
3. 介紹SketchUp樣式，可表現各種顏料素材的形式應用。
4.利用layout軟體，建立剖立圖面關係，進而培養透視與立面的關係，利用電腦繪圖方式建立的設計表現手法。
1. Use computer software SketchUp to express design techniques, from basic geometric shapes to furniture to space, and gradually complete perspective drawings, plan elevation drawings, exploded drawings and other expression techniques.
2. Introduce the basic knowledge of SketchUp software, lead students to quickly enter the world of SketchUp, understand the SketchUp working interface, and lay a good foundation. The main function of SketchUp auxiliary design tools is to perform different editing operations on the model, allowing furniture to be integrated into space instances.
3. Introduce SketchUp styles that can express the application of various paint materials.
4. Use layout software to establish the relationship between section and elevation drawings, and then cultivate the relationship between perspective and elevation, and use computer graphics to establish design expression techniques.

description.zh: 本課程為整合家具與室內設計之基礎課程。藉由相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，以創意激發的訓練為主，透過實際設計程序的演練，習得設計的方法並培養解決問題的能力。
description.en: This course is a foundational program that integrates furniture design and interior design. Through related design competitions or industry-academia cooperation projects, creativity is emphasized in the training, and students will learn design methods and cultivate problem-solving abilities by practicing actual design procedures.

syllabi.outline:
本課程藉由家具相關設計競賽活動或產學合作計畫案，讓學生實際演練家具設計程序及創新方法。本課程同時配合家具材料、家具結構與實習、家具製圖、電腦輔助家具設計等課程，期能習得家具創新設計與產品工程的能力。
The course through furniture design contest or industry-academy cooperation project, let students practice the design procedure and creative methods. The course coordinate the other courses: furniture construction and practice, furniture drawing, computer aided furniture design etc, expect getting the capability of creativity design and product engineering.

description.zh: 1.進階的設計表現技法，藉由意象表徵，仿生擬人，情境描繪等方法，探求設計表達的背後的意義。2.設計表現法主要素求是由簡易材料之運用以手繪快速描繪出蘊釀中造形，呈現將來產品形態。3.發表的概念草圖與版面設計規劃技巧，也是本課程的訓練重點。4.本課程以團對合作來執行設計表達。

syllabi.outline:
利用電腦來呈現設計的表現手法，表現擬真的渲染軟體眾多，深入研究駕馭V-Ray，藉由V-Ray渲染產品與搭配空間完成精彩設計，面對 VRay複雜的渲染參數、光源、材質等設定，以真實場景為例，最終渲染出圖，並且製作360環繞圖片，藉由後期處理等方式，表現更加擬真，為本課程學習重點。
Using computers to present the design expression method, there are many rendering softwares that can show the reality. In-depth research and mastering VRay, through V-Ray rendering products and matching space to complete the wonderful design, facing VRay's complex rendering parameters, light sources, materials and other settings, taking the real scene as an example, finally rendering the picture, and making 360 surround pictures, through post-processing and other methods, the performance is more realistic, which is the learning focus of this course.

description.zh: 本課程通過理論與實際案例介紹3D創作與空間設計軟體：3DS MAX的概念與應用範圍，接續將3D環境建構的方法導入實務案例練習操作，最後透過專題設定進行學生自己的內容創作。課程目的是訓練學生在運用3DS MAX軟體進行3D模型、角色造型、空間和相關物件的建構能力，並接續應用在空間展示的內容設計和表現。
description.en: This course content is about 3D creation and space design software through theoretical and practical cases: 3DS MAX - the concept and application scope, and then teacher introduces the methods of 3D environment construction into practical case practice operations, and finally creates students' own creation project. The purpose of the course is to train students to use the 3DS MAX software to construct 3D models, character modeling, space, and related objects, and use the result and performance to space display.

description.zh: 各學院指定向度學分規定如下： 機電學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 電資學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 工程學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 管理學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分。 設計學院：人文與藝術向度課程4學分、社會與法治向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 人社學院：社會與法治向度課程4學分、自然與科學向度課程4學分、創新與創業向度課程4學分。 修完學院指定向度課程12學分，剩餘6學分可在人文與藝術向度、社會與法治向度、自然與科學向度及創新與創業向度自由修滿，達到通識畢業18學分。
description.en: The dimension credits stipulated by each college are as follows： College of Mechanical and Electrical Engineering：4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Engineering： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum. College of Management： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the nature and science curriculum. College of Design： 4 credits for the humanities and art curriculum, 4 credits for the Social and Rules of Law curriculum, and 4 credits for the innovation and entrepreneurship curriculum.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
description.en:
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

syllabi.schedule:
本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：第一學年——-主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：一.基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用—-線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。第二學年—---主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：1.在範圍上—-以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。2.在設計內容上—-進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。3.在實質因素上—-訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。4.在實務人才的養成上—-具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。
第三學年—---主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接
未來之實務。
*細節課程進度由召集老師同所有教課教師統一開會決議
後於學期初公布

syllabi.outline: 本課程分三年（六學期）教授，各學年課程教授內容如下：第一學年----主要在教導學生對美學基本素養、空間的體驗及空間構成演練，使具備建築設計之基本能力與知識，其主要授課要點如下：一.基本設計訓練及空間的體驗：1.設計基本原理的認識與操作。2.空間經驗的掌握與表達。二、空間的構成：1.基本元素的應用--線、版、體。2.比例、尺度、材質與構造的訓練。3.開口及光影的表現。4.空間的界定與串連。三、空間與造型：1.空間與造型的關係。2.量體與空間、造型。3.結構概念與空間、造型。四、機能與組織：1.行為模式分析。2.機能與動線安排。3.空間的組織。第二學年----主要在教導學生探討空間組織、造型與行為模式等使學生具備整合建築設計相關知識及操作之能力，其主要授課要點如下：1.在範圍上--以各種使用性質的單棟建築為主題。2.在設計內容上--進一步探討空間組織、造型、行為特性及模式。3.在實質因素上--訓練對基地實質環境的認識及掌握，並著重材料、構造、設備、結構等系統的結合。4.在實務人才的養成上--具備整合建築設計相關專業知識及操作的能力。第三學年----主要在教導學生對環境或都市之認知，並使其具備細部設計以至整體建築設計及監造之能力，以銜接未來之實務。

syllabi.outline:
本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。
This four-year course will be taught within eight semesters and aims to train students in the core competencies as follows:
■ First year: foundations of architectural design
Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

description.zh:
本課程主要教導學生認識建築物理環境之基本理論，包含光環境、溫熱環境、空氣環境、音環境等，做為學習建築環境控制系統與建築設備之基礎。本課程內容分為七大部分，包括(一)建築氣象學概論、(二)建築微氣候環境、(三)建築採光與照明、(四)建築傳熱與隔熱、(五)室內通風換氣、(六)濕氣與結露、(七) 隔音與吸音等課題。
本學期介紹物理環境基本學理外，同時輔以相關案例補充說明，幫助學生在建築設計中能關注到使用者舒適、健康需求，並使其建築設計符合節能的永續建築要求。
description.en:
In this course, students will learn about the fundamental theories of architecture physics which include luminous environment, thermal environment, air environment, and sound environment as an introduction to understanding Systems of Environment Control and Architectural Equipment. The course is divided into 7 sections, (1) Introduction to Architecture Meteorology, (2) Architecture Microclimate, (3) Natural Lighting and Illumination of architecture, (4) Thermal Conduction and Proofing of Architecture, (5) Indoor Air Change and Ventilation, (6) Humidity and Condensation, and  (7) Sound absorption and proofing.
  In this semester, other than introducing the fundamental theories, related case studies are also incorporated as additional support to help students to be attentive toward issues such as comfort and health in their architectural design class at the same time to encourage the utilization of such knowledge to create energy saving and sustainable architectural designs.

description.zh:
現代主義運動，帶動了新建築的發展，也致使廿世紀的建築有了全新的可能。工業革命之後所帶動的，不僅僅是生產與製造的工業化，也不僅僅是資本的集中以及資本量的大幅成長。整個十九世紀的發展都是為了邁向一個全新的紀元，營建材料的開發、營建技術的發展、空間概念的突破，開創新的建築面貌以及新的建築歷史。
這個將近兩百年的建築發展，影響了廿世紀的建築教育，並且提供養分，供給新的世代的建築新發展。本課程將就十九、廿世紀的建築發展的歷史脈絡進行梳理，學生將由本課程理解今日其所進行的建築設計之來源。
description.en:
The Modern Movement of Architecture leads the development of new architecture, it thus deduce a whole new possibility of architecture. The Industrial Revolution is the motor of the whole movement. The building construction is industrialized under this overall influence to the society, not only on the concentration of capitals. The social life has been changed. Nineteenth Century is a struggling period with European tradition, moving forward to a new imagination, on the development of construction material, technics, also on the breakthrough on the spatial concept.

This evolution on architecture influences architectural education of 20th Century, and feeds the new creation of architecture. This course is to understand this historic evolution and context, to understand the source and establish knowledge in face of their future architectural activities.

description.en: This course is an introduction to the study and practice of fundamental principles of design in terms of creative arts, relationship between art and engineering, and the importance of aesthetics applying to design.

syllabi.outline:
EMI Course: All class material will be delivered in English. All submitted works and presentation shall be in English as well.
Base on introduction to aesthetics.  By daily observation of our surroundings and environment, students are asked to take a closer look to our living world.  Class will focus on case studies of aesthetic application and renovation on various design fields.  The goal of the class is to develop the daily behavior to living environment attention and eventually promoting aesthetic standards in every profession. 
Class will include individual presentation and group discussion.
In class exercise/ discussion counts major part of the grades.
全英語授課: 授課/作業/簡報均需以英語呈現。
以美學入門為基礎，觀察日常生活美學的可能，進而達到提升美學的培養。
課程將著重於各個產業別對於”美“的建構，探討各面向”美“的改造及創新等。以大眾美學為觀察目標進而達到在各專業裡推廣”美“的最終目的。
課堂活動及討論為佔總成績百分之五十。

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Dynamics (動力學)
Pre-requisite: 3001011 or approved by the course instructor. 
Course Contents: Force, mass, and acceleration, particle kinematics, particle dynamics, work and energy, impulse and momentum, rigid body motion, and dynamics of the rigid body system.
General applications, vehicle dynamics, and railway vehicles will be introduced, such as basic dynamics, vehicle dynamics, wheel-rail coupled, railway vehicle climbing and slipping, aerodynamics, vehicle dynamics and resistance of railway vehicles, railway vehicle braking, and applications of railway vehicles.
This course can be counted for credits if pursuing a micro-program in railway vehicles.

先修課程：無。本實習內容為汽車電系實習，包括：引擎電系，起動系統及充電系統檢測，點火系統檢測，電池之檢測與換裝，電腦控制系統檢測，電腦診斷系統，檢測車輛新式電子設備，檢修汽車空調系統。
95學年度前入學者適用下列實習內容: 結構力學分析與實習。學生將學習使用套裝電腦應用軟體，了解並學習如何做常用的結構力學前處理、分析及後處理。 課程著重學生實作練習。
description.en:
Automobile Electrical System Service Shop Practice , Include Service of the Engine Electrical System , Starting and Charging System, Ignition System, Battery inspection and replacement, Computer Control System, Computer Diagnostic System, New Electronic Equipment Inspection , Air Condition Test and Repair.
For those students who enter the school before 2006 Fall Semester , this class is to utilize computers to do the experiments on different vehicle/engineering problems. Student will learn the basic concept of Finite Element Method (FEM), learn how to utilize FEM in Vehicle Engineering to solve problems. Classes include Geometry modeling, creating FEA models, learning different analysis types (such as Statics, Normal mode, Buckling, and Optimization).

syllabi.outline:

The content of this internship is the internship of the automotive electrical system, including: starting, charging, integrated switch, lamp circuit, wiper motor, interior lamp and horn and other circuit wiring and maintenance .

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.en: Instructing the basis of computer engineering drawing, including the concepts of orthographic projection of 3D space and the methods of geometry graphics. Training the skills to raw sketch, various 3D views. Learning to mark dimensions, tolerance and fittings correctly. This lesson also demands students to able to be familiarized the drawings of steel structures, hydraulic and fluid systems, and related mechanical devices.

description.en: (1) Introduction to basic circuit components; (2)The review of basic circuit theories; (3)Introduction to the characteristics of semiconductors; (4)Circuit analysis techniques for semiconductor PN diode; (5)The applications of PN diode: Rectifier, Filter, Clipper, Clamper, and Voltage-doubler; (6)Special diodes: Light emitting diode(LED), Zener diode, etc.; (7)The operation principles of bipolar junction transistor(BJT); (8)DC biasing circuits for BJTs; (9)Small signal analysis for BJT circuits; (10)The classification of field effect transistor(FET): JFET, Enhancement-MOS, Depletion-MOS, VMOS, and CMOS; (11)The operation principles of FET; (12)DC bias circuits for FETs; (13)Small signal analysis for FET circuits

description.zh: 網路拓樸理論及特立勤定理；節點與網路分析；迴路與切集分析；狀態變數法；自然頻率；網路函數；雙埠網路；計算機輔助分析（PSPICE）；傅氏分析；拉氏轉換。
description.en:
1. The power of single phase and poly- phase, and complex    frequency and power factor correction; the phasor    conception to the Damped sinusoidal forcing function.
2. The resonant of frequency response, quality factor and    the width of a resonance     response curve of half-power    frequencies.
3. Magnetically coupled circuits and Two-port networks.
4. Fourier Analysis and Laplace Transform Techniques.

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在介紹和深入探討電路分析的進階概念和技術。將涵蓋正弦穩態功率計算、平衡三相電路、拉普拉斯變換及其在電路分析中的應用、頻率選擇電路、主動濾波電路、傅立葉級數和傅立葉轉換、雙埠網路等主題，旨在培養學生在電路設計與分析方面的能力。
This course aims to introduce and delve into advanced concepts and techniques in circuit analysis. It will cover topics such as sinusoidal steady-state power calculation, balanced three-phase circuits, Laplace transforms and their applications in circuit analysis, frequency selective circuits, active filter circuits, Fourier series and Fourier transforms, and two-port networks. The course is designed to develop students' abilities in circuit design and analysis.

description.zh: 本科目旨在探討現實世界裡語言和溝通的種種現象，如：社會中之語言變化、大眾媒體的語言使用等，並介紹應用語言學門之緣起和現況。學生將需要分享自己對於本地或國際有關語言應用議題的觀察，例如：職場溝通模式、辨識性言詞分析、語言教學/測試趨勢、口筆翻譯項目、語言在新型媒體中之應用等。
description.en: This course aims to explore a variety of phenomena in language and communication in the real world, e.g., language variations in societies, language in the mass media, etc. It will also provide an overview of the historical background and the existing profile of applied linguistics as an academic discipline. Students are expected to share their own observations on AL-related issues, e.g., workplace communication modes, critical discourse analysis, language instruction/testing trends, translation/ interpretation projects, language use in the new forms of media, etc., in the local or international context.

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

description.zh: 本課程的重點在於闡述統計學之基本概念，主要的內容涵蓋三個領域：敘述統計、機率理論與推論統計，其中包含概念介紹、敘述統計、機率理論、推論統計。另有統計學的應用領域於推論未知的情況以作為相關決策之依據，並包含統計軟體使用介紹。
description.en: The purpose of Statistics is to give students an introductory of statistical thinking, methods development and the assessment of credibility and value of inferences made from data.  A conceptual introduction to the field of statistics and its many applications with extensive coverage of data collection and analysis as needed to evaluate the reported results of statistical students and make a good decision will be included as well. The statistical software introduction will also be introduced in the class.
