description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

本課程分四年（八學期）教授， 四學年課程培養的核心專業能力如下: 
■	第一年 : 以建築設計的基礎為範疇。
訓練造型基礎，包括尺度、比例﹑秩序與韻律、實虛、量體與空間等造型的基本設計能力。                                                                                                                                        
■	第二年 ：以人與空間為範疇，並學習建築的內部構成要素。
在具備設計基礎能力之後，進一步接觸建築的基本向度與原理的設計練習，包括身體與空間、使用行為模式、建築物理環境、構造與結構系統、建築構成系統、建築的類型與形態。  
■	第三年 ：都市建築為主要範疇。
將建築的關注聚焦到與其連結的環境系統或城市紋理，學習從外部環境或都市理論回饋到建築的規劃設計。
第四年：即畢業設計，培養學生針對特定建築問題之探究能力，鼓勵以建築思索如何關注社會、文化與自然的課題，最終以設計方案回應之。

Training of fundamental modeling, including basic designing concepts such as scale, proportion, order and rhythm, solid and void, volume, and space
■ Second year: people and space, and internal elements of architecture
Beyond competency in elementary design, further practicing basic aspects and principles of architecture design, including human body and space, user behavior model, physical environment of buildings, construction and structure system, architectural composition system, architectural type and form, etc.
■ Third year: Urban architecture
Focus of environmental system or urban structure relating to architecture, which helps students apply what they have learned from the external environment or urban theory to the planning and design of buildings
■ Fourth year: Graduation project

description.zh: 本課程目標針對大一新生入門介紹建築專業分支領域。由建築學基本涵構作概略介紹，輔以案例介紹及適當實地參觀研討，進而了解建築學相關知識體系，並對未來四年建築專業課程內容有全盤性認識，進ㄧ步結合未來出路願景。著重訓練思考及觀察能力，以利學生認識建築學之整體關聯性，進而建立其全方位學習藍圖。內容包括建築相關產業與建造程序、體驗建築、建築單位尺寸、建築結構系統之美、建築設計風格、建築教育、新一代建築師、建築構造與材料、建築的社會文化性、建築與環境共生、建築與都市發展、建築相關法令等。

description.zh: 本課程整體目標為奠定學生建築製圖基礎能力，以期培育學生成為符合建築業界所需之人才；針對建築製圖之知識、技能、態度進行授課；主要為灌輸學生建築製圖基本常識、觀念；以所學實際運用於各種圖說之實際練習與操作。課程內容有(1)製圖用筆、比例尺、三角板、圓規等工具之介紹與應用；(2)各種線條與工程字傳授與練習；(3)建築圖說符號之說明與應用；(4)三視圖與輔助視圖之講解及練習理解；(5)空間應有尺度介紹與圖說練習；(6)人物、植栽、舖面等點景之介紹與練習；(7)建築平、立、剖面之陰影等建築表現法指導與操作。本課程符合系教育目標如下： 1. 訓練學生建築設計與工程基礎專業能力； 2. 透過實作方式彙整建築設計與建築構造之技能； 3. 引導建立建築專業道德倫理態度； 4. 整合建築理論與實務提升就業競爭力。
description.en: This is a fundamental course in architecture. The goal of the course is to establish the basic ability in handmade graphics. This class introduces fundamental issues in graphics such as(1) Introduce the graphics tools. (2) The usage of architectural graphic symbols. (3)Lines and fonts. (4)Reading and practicing three-dimensional diagrams. (5) Handling the relationship between space and scale. (6) Drawing practice on Landscape and human figure. (7)Shades and Shadows on the architectural graphics. After this course the students will acquire the following aspects: 1). Basic knowledge in architectural design and engineering. 2). Practical skill in architectural design and structure. 3). Correct attitude in architectural professions moral. 4). Integrate theory and real-life practice.

syllabi.outline:
一、從建築史發展過程中，解析不同時期及不同構造形式之建築案例，探討材料、結構及構造方式，對設計者理念之詮釋、空間品質之塑造及建築美學之發展等課題，所產生的影響與關連性。
二、本課程將從哥德式之磚石構造建築（Masonry Construction）、工業革命發展之鐵構造建築（Iron Construction）、混凝土構造建築（Concrete Construction）、鋼構造建築（Steel Construction）及現代木構造建築(Wood Construction)，這些不同時期之建築形式，藉由不同之材料特質、結構及構造方式等工程技術，詮釋設計者之理念，並表達不同社會文化及建築風格，進而闡述建築工程技術如何引導合理的建築設計方案及創造獨特建築美學。
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 : 課程綱要及重點介紹，磚石構造特性
Week 2 : 哥德式教堂特點，仿羅馬半圓拱構造Vs.哥德式尖拱構造
Week 3 : 石構造技術之演進及其古典設計概念，探討構造對建築之影響
Week 4 : 19c.鍛鐵、鑄鐵及鋼材之製造發展，鐵構造-新建築潛力的演進
Week 5 : 國慶日放假
Week 6 : Viollet-Le-Duc 的建築觀點，及鐵構造建築案例與設計理念分析
Week 7 : 光復節補假
Week 8 : 鐵構造Vs.石構造之差異探討。混凝土、鋼筋混凝土及預力混凝土之原理及特質
Week 9 :繳交期中報告，當日上課。
              早期混凝土構造之發展：Hennebique、Baudot、Perret案例分析
Week 10 : 工程師對於混凝土構造之詮釋：Maillart鋼筋混凝土板的結構美學
Week 11 : 創造混凝土構造之新語彙：Corbusier與Kahn之觀點及案例分析
Week 12 : 早期鋼構造高層建築之發展：Chicago School之發展與案例分析
Week 13 : Archigram建築思潮，龐畢度中心設計理念與構築技術案例分析
Week 14 : 木構造特性、新型木構件與板材發展
Week 15 : 木構造的演進與重型木構造系統
Week 16 : 輕型木構造的改良與構造系統
Week 17 : 校慶補假
Week 18 : 繳交期末報告，當日上課:建構建築與構築技術之橋樑。

syllabi.outline:
將建築的自明性融合在地與環境共生，是一種環境至上、尊重土地的設計理念，在這樣的前提之下，如何以環境的不浪費、資源再利用的構築方式，建構出一個剛剛好且可彈性運用的建築，反映出建築恆久永續的價值。
  本課程旨在以環境設計角度，重新思考建築定位及空間規劃，使學生能具備基本  設計所需思維能力，並將人、土地、環境納為系統性整合對象，引導學生具備建築整合環境之能力與環境永續為建築設計者責任之意識。

syllabi.outline:
課程內容主要包括兩個項目:
 
1. 設計的思維與邏輯:
這堂課程與一般的設計概論不同，主要的目的在建立清晰的設計思維概念，從實務的觀點，來解說"什麼是設計"以及"什麼是好的設計"。本課程會透過理論的講解以及大量的影片與實際案例，建立對設計邏輯的基本理解
2. 手繪實作與練習: 
除了觀念的建立外，這堂課也會講解基本手繪的技巧，並以作業實作的方式，建立大家對設計的流程，方法與觀念初步的認識，期末將讓大家以手繪的方式設計一個"座椅"，成為你的第一個設計案

本課程分上課週與評圖週
從第二週起，有手繪作業，第三周則是上課週，第四週則是評圖週，隔週上課，隔週評圖，設計手繪作業，有兩週的時間完成

**本課程是針對未來想要從事設計相關產業的同學所設計的專業課程，目的在建立實作流程技法與觀念理論的專業基礎

** 本課程不是常識性(通識性質)的課程,但是如果你想深入了解:
1基礎的設計流程與技法,
2建立做設計應有的專業素養,
3對設計應有的基本概念,
這會是相當扎實的課程

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

name.zh: 文化事業發展與人才培育
name.en: Cultural Vocation Development and its Men Power Cultivation

description.zh:
文化事業是以「文化」為素材所開展的事業，性質上以文化、美學或社會價值為訴求，但也往往同時兼具經濟價值。本課程旨在介紹文化事業的內涵與範疇，比較其與當前政府推展的「文化創意產業」間的異同，其中「文化」、「文化政策」、「國際文化生態」等都是觸及的議題。其次，討論「高品質的文化服務」與「從業人員的素養」，探討從事者應具備的基本能力與人格特質，並借重測驗工具協助同學理解個人人格特質組成及分布。
    對於重要文化事業區塊，或將採取主題介述方式，邀請業界人士進行講座，而實地參訪與場景演練也是重要的教學活動。
description.en: Cultural Vocation is a developing vocation base on culture. The scope of the nowadays so-called "Cultural Business" has more or less been verlapped with "The Business of Culture and Creativeness" with the essence of emphasis not only on the economic values but also on those of culture, esthetics and society. The course will be focused on introductory methodology through main topic discussions by inviting professionals from different realms of industries for panel symposiums. In addition, on-site visits and case simulations are also to be included as important educational activities. The initial courses will be discussions on cultural relevant topics such as "Culture", "Cultural policies", "Cultural Development" and "International Cultural Systems". Further various scopes and contents of "Cultural Vocation" and status quo of its development will be introduced and discussed.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生認識中國及台灣本土的文學題材，熟悉各家的文學特色，進而懂得欣賞，並且能夠將之轉譯成文化符碼，靈活應用。然礙於文學作品繁多，課程時間有限，是以無法按照時間序，以史的方式一一介紹文學作品。是以為了避內容過於概論性或過於淺薄，本課程將以主題來進行教學。亦即依文類、時代、作家或風格來帶領同學由深而廣，逐漸培養同學賞析文學的能力。
description.en: This course aims to introduce students to literary topics in China and Taiwan, familiarize them with the literary characteristics of various authors, and enable them to appreciate and translate them into cultural codes for flexible application. However, due to the vast number of literary works and limited course time, it is not possible to introduce literary works in a chronological or historical manner. Therefore, in order to avoid overly general or shallow content, this course will be taught thematically. That is, students will be guided from depth to breadth by literary genres, time periods, authors, or styles, gradually cultivating their ability to appreciate literature.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在引導學生透過學習文學作品來說屬於自己的故事。這學期本課程會帶兩位作家：陳又津及白先勇，來讓同學從別人的故事看見自己。比較特別的是，本學期會以工作坊的方式，來將課程融入AI生圖技術，帶同學以繪本的創作方式來了解故事創作的方法來產出繪本，將文學創作與圖像生成相結合，進一步提升同學的創作能力。最後的繪本創作，希望能以線上策展的方式呈現，讓學生學習如何將創意成果轉化為現代人習慣的接收方式，好跟更廣泛的觀眾分享。

name.en: Fundamental Programming and Introduction to Practical Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 本課程為非資訊科系的程式設計入門課程，期能讓學生瞭解運算思維概念，並對資訊程式運作與設計方式有初步掌握。課程將以Python語言為實作演練工具，透過實際規劃、編寫、除錯與測試等階段，逐步培養學生基本程式設計能力。課程也將規劃人工智慧(AI)入門概念與基本做法，並由學生實際動手完成AI應用於文化發展領域議題的專題作品，讓學生能體會AI新科技對產業發展的現況，並思考面對未來AI新時代的準備方向。
description.en: This course is an introductory programming course for non-computer science majors, aiming to facilitate students understand the concept of computational thinking and gain a preliminary grasp of information program operation and design methods. The course will employ Python as the implementation and practice tool, gradually cultivating students' basic programming skills through practical planning, coding, debugging, and testing stages. Furthermore, the course will introduce the concepts and basic practices of Artificial Intelligence (AI). Students will have hands-on experience completing a project applying AI to cultural development issues. This allows students to appreciate the status of AI technology in industry and contemplate the preparation directions for the upcoming AI era.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為針對非資訊背景學生所設計的 Python 與 AI 程式設計入門課程，期望透過趣味化、任務導向的方式，幫助學生降低學習程式的門檻，建立正向的學習態度。課程初期以遊戲化學習平台為引導，結合故事情境與互動任務，讓學生逐步掌握 Python 的基礎語法與運算邏輯。中期後則導入人工智慧（AI）基本應用，包括圖像辨識、簡易分類器、語意生成與 Chatbot 設計，培養學生實作與應用能力。
學生將透過每週小任務與兩次專題實作（期中個人、期末小組）進行成果統整與創意思考，鼓勵學生發想文化、創意或生活議題的 AI 解決方案，強化其數位素養與跨域實作經驗。

This course is designed as an introductory Python and AI programming class for students without a computer science background. Through a gamified and task-based approach, it aims to lower the barrier to learning programming and foster a positive attitude towards coding. The course begins with game-based learning platforms to help students grasp Python syntax and logic in a fun and interactive environment. As the course progresses, students are introduced to foundational AI applications, including image recognition, simple classifiers, semantic generation, and Chatbot development.
Weekly mini-assignments and two project-based assessments (an individual midterm and a group final project) guide students in synthesizing and applying their knowledge creatively. Students are encouraged to develop AI solutions for cultural, creativity, or daily life issues, thereby enhancing their digital literacy and interdisciplinary practice.

description.zh: 本課程以衣食住行、飲食男女等日常活動、交往、思維為主軸，考察一般人的歷史活動與日常生活在各時期的變化。當歷史不再只是帝王將相的豐功偉業或名流大家的傳奇生活，升斗小民的日常生活看似微不足道，點點滴滴的匯聚而成的正是一個社會的大歷史。
description.en: This course focuses on different aspects of daily activities of ordinary people throughout historical periods trying to explore the development and structure of their culture including clothing, housing, foods, family functions, and transportation. By taking a close look at their interactions, concerns, manners and customs can the students gain an insight into the other side of history far beyond kings and queens, wars and struggles that construct orthodox historical accounts and documents.

description.zh: 本校體育課程目標為鍛鍊健全身心、促進身心健全發展、培養運動道德、發揚團隊精神及養成終身運動習慣。四技一、二年級實施專項分組教學，由具有專長之教師授課。開課項目：籃球、排球、桌球、羽球、保齡球、射箭、高爾夫球、網球、體操遊戲、慢速壘球、太極拳、國際標準舞、體適能、國術。學生得按自己興趣選擇修習。
description.en: All students are required to attend two hours per week of Physical Education class. This requirement applies to Freshman and Sophomore students, classes are interest-oriented, thus giving students the opportunity to select specific activities they are interested in. Choices include Basketball, Volleyball, Table Tennis, Badminton, Bowling, Archery, Golf, Tennis, Gymnastics, Slow pitch, Tai Chi Chuan, Ballroom Dancing, Physical Fitness and martial arts, to mention a few.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

Course Duration: 2 weeks

Course Duration: 8 weeks
Topics: Disaster Prevention and Relief Knowledge, Disaster Prevention and Relief, Disaster Preparedness and Defense Mobilization Simulation Drills, Battlefield First Aid and Self-Rescue, Heat Stroke Prevention, and CPR

Course Duration: 2 weeks

description.en: "First step to achieving the goals of universities" is a campus-wide course provided for all of the first-year students at this school. description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description
This course aims to provide students with a solid understanding of differential and integral calculus. It is designed to cultivate logical reasoning, inspire creative thinking, strengthen computational and deductive skills, and emphasize practical applications and graphing techniques. The goal is to build a strong mathematical foundation for future studies in engineering mathematics and related professional courses, ultimately achieving the objective of applying what is learned in real-world contexts.
Course topics include:
1.	Limits and Continuity
2.	Derivatives and Their Applications
3.	Indefinite and Definite Integrals
4.	Transcendental Functions and Their Inverses
5.	Integration Techniques
6.	Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integrals
7.	Applications of Definite Integrals
8.	Solid Geometry and Vector Calculus
9.	Partial Derivatives
10.	Multiple Integrals
11.	Series

description.zh: 本課程主要使學生能強化會計學的基本觀念，並以國際會計原則(IFRS)為架構，熟悉會計流程與財務報表之編製。課程內容包含會計恆等式與財務報表的介紹、借貸法則、會計處理程序(分錄、過帳、試算)與調整、結帳與會計循環的完成、買賣業會計、存貨的會計處理、現金、應收帳款、不動產、廠房與設備、無形資產、負債、股東權益、以及投資活動的會計處理，最後則是現金流量表的編制，與財務報表的運用與分析。
description.en: This course is an introduction to the basic concepts and standards underlying financial accounting systems. Several important concepts will be studied in detail, including: cash, accounts and notes receivable, inventory, marketable securities, equity investments, PPE, intangibles, debt, equity issuance, and dividends. The course emphasizes the construction of the basic financial accounting statements - the income statement, retained earnings statement, statement of financial position, and statement of cash flows - as well as their interpretation. Financial accounting focuses on providing information that is relevant and useful for external users. This course expands your knowledge of understanding of the basic language and conceptions of accounting. The basic accounting concepts that will help you solve problems and exercises designed to transaction recording and financial statement preparation.

name.zh: 數位科技與人工智慧導論
name.en: Introduction to Digital Technology and Artificial Intelligence

description.zh: 數位科技與人工智慧是資訊科技發展的兩大重要驅動力，本課程旨在培養本系學生在此領域學習的藍圖與概念建立。本課程將介紹數位科技與人工智慧的基本概念、原理與應用。在數位科技方面，將涵蓋IT基礎設施、網際網路、資訊安全、虛擬化與雲端，IoT等主題。在人工智慧方面，將涵蓋機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、電腦視覺等主題。
description.en:
Digital Technology and Artificial Intelligence are two major driving forces of the development of information technology. This course aims to cultivate students' learning blueprints and concepts in this field. This course will introduce the basic concepts, principles and applications of digital technology and artificial intelligence.
In the areas of digital technology, it will cover topics such as IT infrastructure, the Internet, information security, virtualization and cloud computing, and IoT. In the areas of artificial intelligence, it will cover topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and computer vision.

description.zh: 課程的目標期待透過理論與案例研究幫助學生理解「金融科技」，包括改變付款方式的破壞力、分析不斷變化的監管環境，並對人工智慧、區塊鏈、上雲、行動銀行、開放銀行、機器人顧問、眾籌、P2P借貸等金融科技議題有著更深入的了解；此外，也介紹資訊安全與目前監管機構在金融科技的角色。
description.en: The objective of the course is to help students understand "Financial Technology" through theory and case studies, including the disruptive impact of changing payment methods, analyzing the constantly evolving regulatory environment, and gaining a deeper understanding of financial technology topics such as artificial intelligence, blockchain, cloud computing, mobile banking, open banking, robo-advisors, crowdfunding, peer-to-peer lending, etc. Additionally, it introduces information security and the role of current regulatory agencies in financial technology.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、實務與理論基礎、方法與技術、科技支援與應用等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。課程亦安排至相關領域業界的參訪以及互動相關展覽參觀，以加深對於互動設計實務的印象與了解。
description.en: The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course topics include essential factors of interactive system, interaction design theory and practice, methods and techniques, technical support and application. Course also incorporates case studies, company visits and exhibitions relevant to interaction design to enhance the understanding of integrating theory and practice.

前言
二、互動設計的首要原則：使用者經驗

本書，「互動設計概論-創造互動設計無限應用的可能」的中心思想不同於過去其他書籍強調在原理原則的說明、或是技術導向應用的介紹，而是由使用者相關的感知經驗為核心延伸至相關的人-機-境的應用。本章的目標在於介紹使用者經驗的基本概念理論，透過使用者經驗目標的了解、問題-解決過程邏輯、以人為本的思維構築以及創意思考的使用者行為探索與研究方法。

description.zh: 本課程旨在瞭解設計的基本要素與美的形式原理，應用各種媒材的特性與構成，從平面及立體的構成的實作練習中，激發出設計美感與創造力。透過「使用者—產品—環境」三者間互動關係的深入探討，掌握住視覺傳達與多媒體的基本語彙，作為互動設計的基礎，創造出全新的體驗與感受。
description.en: The course is to prepare students for understanding the basic elements of design and the form and principle of art. To achieve these goals, the course provides opportunities for students to apply characteristics and compositions of diverse media for the form of two-dimension and three-dimension in practice. Also, the course arouses student’s design aesthetics and creativity. To explore the context of user-product-environment, students understand visual communication and multimedia language as a basis of interaction design toward completely new experiences and sensation.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹情境劇本法 (scenario) 之相關知識與其在互動設計上之應用。藉由此課程的學習，學生可以了解如何使用代表性的角色擬定以及故事板的操作以發現關鍵設計議題。透過方法的了解以及實作模擬，學生能具備業界所需之互動情境或介面設計應有之情境敘事技巧與能力。課程內容包含情境故事法介紹、人-機-境概念、互動情境模擬、代表性角色擬定以及故事板製作。學生評量方式則包含報告撰寫以及作業繳交。
description.en: The aim of the course is to introduce basic knowledge and application of scenario technique on interaction design. Through this course, students can understand how to define the characters of an interactive scenario and develop storyboard to draw out key design theme. Course contents include introduction of scenario method, human-machine-scenario, interactive scenario narration, character mapping and storyboard. Students will be evaluated by reports and their works.

syllabi.outline:
The primary goal of this course is to equip students with foundational 3D modeling and rendering skills, while guiding them through the complete process of transforming a design concept into a tangible output. The course will focus on Rhino 3D, a widely used tool in both fabrication and industrial design. Through a series of tutorials and hands-on exercises, students will develop a solid understanding of the software and gain essential skills applicable to various design industries.

By the end of the semester, each student is expected to complete a comprehensive Graphic Doding project, which must include codes, renderings, animations, and a 3D model. This final package will serve as the key evaluation criteria for the course.

In addition, we will dedicate part of the class to introducing digital fabrication workflows, providing students the opportunity to gain hands-on experience with turning digital models into physical objects.

Writing courses are also added during this stage. In the fourth year (one semester), we add more emphasis on the conversational ability, term/character recognition and reading ability. More culture-related information will be included.

syllabi.outline:
Principle of Interaction Design: Autumn 2024 - Syllabus
Credit Hours: 2.0
Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang


Course Description: 
"Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in the areas of visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design and industrial design purposes. 
An interface is the link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” to take place between users and design.
 In this course, we will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and have opportunity to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and practices of interaction design. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function" and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences, and understand the role that interaction with contents and installment fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas.
This is a class with time devoted to lecture, discussion, practice activities, design work sessions, and critique of practical work. 


Course Objectives/Goals: 
At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 
1.	Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 
2.	Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 
3.	Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 
4.	Apply iterative cycles of research, testing and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals and experiences. 
5.	Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 
6.	Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 
7.	Utilize client based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design. 
8.	Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design.

description.zh: 「全民國防教育法」自民國95年2月開始施行，以國際情勢、國防政策、全民國防、防衛動員、國防科技五大主軸作為全民國防教育的課程規畫。「國際情勢」單元，主要論述區域安全與兩岸情勢發展，培育學生宏觀的國際視野；更進一步說明在全球化浪潮下，國際重要的安全議題及我國的因應之道。「國防政策」單元，在論述我國國防政策內涵及大陸政策的發展，使學生認識當前國防政策施政方針，增進國防安全知識；並介紹我國國家安全法制與危機管理機制，藉此體認國家安全的重要性，加強全民國防意識。「全民國防」單元，主要論述國家意識及全民防衛的概念、內涵與重要性，並介紹國防與經濟、文化、心理的關聯，讓學生理解國防事務其實與生活息息相關，加強全民國防意識，增進對國家的認同。「防衛動員」單元，在探討全民防衛動員的意義與功能，說明全民防衛動員對國家安全的重要性；並介紹青年服勤動員內涵，讓學生體會自己在全民防衛動員體系中所扮演的角色，進而涵養愛國意識，深化全民國防共識。「國防科技」單元，主要使學生了解武器系統概況，並認識國防科技發展與我國國防產業現況，引發對國防科技的興趣，進而認同國防、支持國防。
description.en: In order to meet the requirement of Act of All-Out Defense Education that put into action in February 2006, the curriculum of All-Out Defense Education Military Training planned by Ministry of Education is divided into five sections: International Situations, National Defense Policies, Civil Defense, Defense Mobilization, and Military Technology. In International Situations, the object is to cultivate students’ broader international perspectives through discussing Asian-Pacific regional security and the development of cross-strait relation. In Civil Defense, the object is to make students aware that national defense affairs are closely related to their daily life. In Defense Mobilization, the object is to let students recognize their roles in all-out defense mobilization system. In Defense Technology, the main object is to let students overview the development of weapon systems, and understand the current development of the nation’s defense technology and defense industry.

一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。

description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is aimed directly at the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature. And to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will design this course under deliberating the differences of each departments to emphasize or to omit some contents. The course is designed for 6 credits for two semesters; 3 credits for each semester,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.en: Introduction of Modern Control Theory﹒Linear space Analysis , State equation and Response, Controllability and Observability , Stability Analysis, State Feedback and Estimation, Controller Design and Applications, Observer Design and Applications, Nonlinear systems, Time varying Systems, Applications of Modern Control theory.﹒

syllabi.outline: Modern control theory mainly focuses on linear system analysis and design.  This is the course where students from a variety of backgrounds begin to acquire the mathematical tools used in research literature involving linear systems.  The core material covered in this course is the theory of time-varying linear systems, in both continuous-time and discrete-time, with frequent specialization to the time invariant case.

This course will teach the analysis and design of circuits for the application of electronic circuits in power electronic converters. This course covers the fields of power electronics, electronics, and control systems.

Course content includes:

1. Review of power electronics background
2. Learning a simulation software
3. Introduction of the principle of the passive components
4. Description of the circuit topologies of the converter
5. Analysis of the circuit operation principle of the converter
6. Introduction of the characteristics of power switches and their applications
7. Introduction of the loss analysis of power converters 
8. Introduction to the control method of the converter
9. Introduction of the control loop design and simulation verification of the converter
10. Introduction of peripheral protection circuit and sensing circuit
11. Design case review
12. Introduction of the advanced power electronics topic

description.zh: 本課程旨在全面介紹網絡和分佈式計算技術。 與傳統課程不同，它採用自上而下的主題方法，從應用層開始，然後描述傳輸層和網路層，最後涵蓋實體層。課程從應用層向下延伸到實體層，讓學生在學習網路的早期就接觸重要概念來激發他們的興趣。 本課程專注於互聯網和網路的基本重要問題，對計算機科學和電氣工程感興趣的學生提供良好的基礎，而無需廣泛的程式或數學知識。
description.en: The course aims to provide a comprehensive introduction to networking and distributed computing technologies. Unlike traditional course, it pursues a top-down approach to the topic, starting with the application layer and then describing the transport and network layers, finally covering the physical layer. The course works its way from the application layer down toward the physical layer, motivating readers by exposing them to important concepts early in their study of networking. Focusing on the Internet and the fundamentally important issues of networking, this course provides an excellent foundation for students interested in computer science and electrical engineering, without requiring extensive knowledge of programming or mathematics.

description.zh: 本課程希望協助學生瞭解如何以標準積體電路系統設計流程來設計超大型積體電路系統，旨在採用多種數位與類比電腦輔助設計軟體來訓練學生，使其能熟悉並使用超大型積體電路系統的設計軟體，培育學生具備超大型積體電路系統設計實務與經驗。本課程的主要內容包括：1.超大型積體電路簡介；2.晶片製程介紹；3.MOSFET元件；4. MOSFET走線；5.Hspice軟體介紹 ；6. Hspice電路模擬；7.類比電路佈局與實作；8.Verilog HDL(硬體描述語言)；9.電路合成 ；10.自動測試圖樣產生；11.時脈靜態分析；12.電路佈局與佈線；13.DRC與LVS檢測；14.寄生參數萃取與佈局後模擬；15.設計功能驗證16. 設計方案報告
description.en:
Students will learn how to design VLSI circuits and systems based on a standard VLSI system design flow, where various electronic design automation (EDA) tools will be used extensively in the semester. Those EDA tools includes analog and digital circuits and systems. The main purpose of this course includes the following:
1.	VLSI Introduction.
2.	Manufacturing Process.
3.	MOSFET Devices.
4.	MOSFET Wires.
5.	Hspice Software.
6.	Hspice Simulation.
7.	Analog IC Layout and Practice.
8.	Verilog-HDL.
9.	Synthesis.
10.	Design for Testability and Automatic Test Pattern Generation.
11.	Static Timing Analysis.
12.	Placement and Routing.
13.	Design Rule Check, Layout Versus Schematic.
14.	Layout Parasitic Extraction and Simulation.
15.	Design Verification.
16.	Project Presentation.

syllabi.outline:
This course provides an in-depth study of digital signal processing (DSP) principles and techniques. Some ideas are built using MATLAB codes. Topics include discrete-time signals and systems, Fourier analysis, Z-transform, filter design and implementation, sampling rate conversion, random signal processing, and spectral analysis. The course emphasizes both theoretical foundations and practical applications through assignments, projects, and research paper studies. By the end of this course, students will be able to:
1. Analyze and process discrete-time signals and systems.
2. Apply the Fourier and Z-transform techniques to signal analysis.
3. Design and implement FIR and IIR digital filters.
4. Perform spectral analysis and sampling rate conversion.
5. Critically review and present recent research papers in DSP.
6. Complete a comprehensive final project demonstrating mastery of course concepts.

description.en: Introduce the experiment design methods and conclusion. Such as: one factor experiment, Latin square, Multi factors experiment, ANOVA, regression.

syllabi.outline: Statistical design of experiments is a wide subject that treats a large number of methods for planning experimental investigations in a manner that ensures statistically valid conclusions. This course introduces students to concepts and techniques of classical and applied experimental design and covers the statistical design of experiments for systematically examining how a system functions. Topics covered will include: introduction to fundamentals and principles of experiments, blocking designs, completely randomized designs (CRD), randomized completely block designs (RCBD), full factorial designs with two levels, fractional designs with two levels, Latin square designs, 3-leval designs (CCD, BBD, Cuboidal designs), and response surface methodologies.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1 Introduction to fundamentals of engineering statistics and principles of experimentation
Week 2-3 Simple comparative experiments: CRD (Completely randomized design)
Week 4-5 RCBDs (Randomized complete block designs)
Week 6-8 Factorial designs and 2-level factorial designs
Week 9 Midterm or assignment
Week 10-13 2-level fractional factorial design and resolution
Week 14-15 3-level (fractional) factorial designs and multi-factor designs (Latin square design, CCD, BBD, Cuboidal designs)
Week 16-17 Fitting regression model including GLM: Estimation, diagnostics 
Week 18 Final exam or assignment

description.en: Scheduling consists of planning and prioritizing activities that need to be performed in an orderly sequence of operation. It is a tool that optimizes use of available resources. This course focuses on theoretical as well as applied aspects of scheduling of resources. The purpose of this course is to guide the students to learn the basic concept and rules of sequencing and scheduling, and to understand the different scheduling application aspects for various shop floors.

description.zh: 本課程引入生活性的學習方法來誘發學生學習動機，並培養可在社會與職場運用的四項英文基本技能。課程目標在幫助學生在生活實境習得英文，為他們裝備可溝通表達於日常、社交活動，並提升職涯的整合性英文技能。每堂課程都注重在以學生為中心的學習活動中帶入全真、應用性高的英文技巧。課程設計涵蓋的功能包括課堂分享與作業、日常互動英文以及專業英文練習。主要課題包括溝通，簡報與談判技巧，應用閱讀與寫作，聽力技巧運用，語言與文化。
description.en: This course introduces real-world based learning approaches for students to raise their learning aspirations and to develop four essential English skills that are applicable in social and professional encounters. This course aims to help students practice English in most real-life settings and to equip them with integrated skills to advance their careers. Every class session focuses on bringing authentic and applied English in student-centered leaning activities. The class design covers the functions like information sharing and task-based activities, social interactions, and professional English practices. description.zh: 本課程提供供應鏈中協同管理的重要多面向，探討供應商、零售商及終端消費者間腳色互動及運作，以及能促使供應鏈鄭和及協同之機制。課程目標在使(1) 在現今高度競合產業環境中，提供對整合及協同供應鏈的理解、專業管理及未來願景。(2) 提供學生具高階供應鏈管理者之必要認知及知識。
description.en: The course takes a broad view of the critical facets of supply chain coordination and management, expanding beyond internal company operations to include the suppliers, the retailers and the end consumers. Aligning supply chain management with integrated strategies and policies. The goal of the course is (a) to provide professionals with the vision and skill set necessary to understand and manage the integration and coordination of activities within today's increasingly complicated supply chains and (b) to equip students with the knowledge and perceptions demanded for supply chain management leaders today.

description.zh: 隨工業物聯網的快速發展，越來越多的感測數據得以被記錄，除了依賴專家的經驗判斷，更可藉由數據分析的結果提供決策上的輔助。本課程將介紹資料科學的基本分析架構，從問題定義、數據前處理、特徵工程、模型建立、結果解釋與評估等，除課堂講授資料科學工具與方法外，並利用作業、個案研究、案例資料，以訓練同學資料分析的能力與解決問題的經驗。
description.en: With the advanced technology in Industrial Internet of Things, amount of sensors are installed to collect data during manufacturing production and service process. In addition to rely on domain knowledge, we can also construct a data-driven model and extract useful information and rule for decision support and management.. This course will introduce analytics framework of data science including problem definition, data preprocessing, feature engineering, model construction, and result evaluation and interpretation. In addition to lecture, this course also training students how to analyze the data and problem solving through homework, term project and case studies.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to the process of data science, covering problem formulation, data acquisition, modeling and analysis, and presentation and integration into action. Students will learn useful skills as well as basic statistical methods by completing several hands-on problems focused on real-world data. This course starts with a brief introduction to multivariate data analysis and data summarization including visualization. Then it extends to focus on using data to develop predictive capabilities using supervised and unsupervised machine learning models (regression, classification, clustering, PCA, etc.).

Week 15-17 Unsupervised learning (Clustering, k-means)
Week 18 Exam or assignment

description.zh: 本課程主要是介紹六標準差方法。六標準差(Six Sigma)是一套管理系統，它是透過聆聽顧客的聲音(Voice of Customer)，經由關鍵品質(Critical to Quality)的分析，利用專案的方式，以流程改善工具解決有問題的企業流程。本課程著重了解“Six Sigma”理論、分析工具及統計應用軟體(Minitab)之運用，針對六標準差綠帶、黑帶專業培訓課程，藉由理論分析與實際操作使用的說明，協助學生將”Six Sigma”導入企業，以獲得關鍵流程的改進。
description.en: This course primarily introduces the Six Sigma methodology. Six Sigma is a management system that listens to the Voice of Customer, analyzes Critical to Quality factors, and utilizes project-based approaches with process improvement tools to address problematic business processes. The course focuses on understanding the theory of Six Sigma, analysis tools, and the application of statistical software (Minitab). It is designed for Green Belt and Black Belt professional training in Six Sigma. Through theoretical analysis and practical exercises, the course assists students in implementing Six Sigma in enterprises to achieve improvements in key processes.

description.en: The objective of this course is not only to explore the basic theoretical basis of Neural Networks, but also further introduce the versatility the applications of artificial neural networks.  This course will briefly review the essence of Perceptron, Backpropagation, ART, Hopfield NN, and Fuzzy Neural Networks, and then adopts the data (offered by public database such as UCI) to on-hand practice in applying ANN in classification, clustering, prediction and diagnostics.

description.zh: 先修課程：負責教授同意。膜披覆製程是近年來高科技產業技術一項前途被看好的製程技術之一，廣用於刀具、模具、光學元件、感測器及半導體工業等等。此門課程將提供此項技術之介紹、相關配備、原理與能量提供方式、將包括：沉積技術與應用、化學氣相沉積法、物理氣相沉積法、電鍍技術、真空工程、直流電源、射頻電源、微波、熱燈絲等各種能量介紹、以及膜的成核與生長理論。
description.en: The technology of films coating has advanced dramatically. This advancement was driven primarily by the need for new products and devices in the electronics and optical industries etc.. The rapid progress in various devices would not have been possible without the development of new files coating technology, improved film characteristic and superior file qualities. This course is intended to serve us a guide for the student or practitioner in the field, as a review and overview of this rapidly evolving technology for the graduate students in several branches of science and engineering.

syllabi.outline:
鍍膜製程為近代製造業廣泛利用之表面處理技術，常用於刀具、模具、光學元件、感測器及半導體裝置等。本課程提供物理、化學法鍍膜技術之原理、設備之介紹。並講述膜成核、生長理論與近代薄膜科技於能源、光電、生醫與環境領域之應用。
Film deposition process, a surface treatment technology, has been widely used in modern manufacturing. It is commonly applied in the development of cutters, molds, optical component, sensor and semiconductor devices, etc. This course provides an introduction regarding the basic principle and apparatus of the coating technology (physical and chemical routes). Besides, the film nucleation, growth theory and their applications in energy, optoelectronic, biomedical and environmental fields are described as well.

The application of computer about civil engineering, such as officials Dispatch to handle in Chinese and English, the software of drawings and using software of data base etc.

syllabi.outline:
結構工程上的問題一般都會以微分方程式來表示，微分方程式的求解除了少數簡單及線性的結構系統能以解析的方法求解外，大都需要使用數值方法來求解。例如使用有限元素法來進行結構分析，其中就隱含相當多的數值分法，如微分方程式的離散化，函數插值法，數值積分，數值微分，非線性方程式的求解以及矩陣計算等等。主要課程內容有:
(1)	Numerical Systems and Errors
(2)	Interpolation by Polynomial
(3)	Numerical Solution of Nonlinear Equations
(4)	Numerical Differentiation and Integration
(5)	Numerical Solution of Differential Equations
(6)	Numerical Linear Algebra

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要介紹財務管理的基礎知識，分析、診斷、控制與健全企業財務的方法。其中，主要內容包括閱讀、分析與診斷財務報表，評價「錢」與「時間」的關係，評估最適工程方案的決策，營建業投資開發財務可行性分析與決策，財務風險的衡量與應用等。本課程的目標，透過財務管理基礎知識的建立，與診斷分析控制方法的介紹，輔以實務或專題討論，培養工程領域學生處理工程財務管理的能力，進而提昇工程管理的執行力。
This course offers an introduction to the fundamental concepts of financial management, with a focus on methods for analyzing, diagnosing, controlling, and improving corporate financial performance. Core topics include the interpretation and evaluation of financial statements, the time value of money, decision-making for selecting optimal engineering alternatives, financial feasibility analysis for investment and development projects in the construction industry, and techniques for measuring and managing financial risk.  The course is designed to build foundational financial knowledge while introducing analytical and diagnostic tools. Through a combination of practical applications and topic-based discussions, students in the engineering field will develop the ability to manage financial aspects of engineering projects, thereby enhancing their overall effectiveness in engineering management.

description.zh: 許多現成的工程軟體並無法滿足所有客製化的需求，因此會開放作謂的「應用程式介面」（Application Programming Interfaces, API）供使用者進行二次開發，使其能自行拼湊、重組與創造需要的功能。本課程以建築資訊塑模（BIM）或人工智慧（AI）應用為主要示範案例，訓練學生有系統地理解API的規格說明文件，並且有效率地開發API應用程式，以達到各種工程應用軟體的客製化應用，並提升不同軟體間的交互操作性。
description.en: Many engineering software packages may not fully meet all customized requirements, thus they provide Application Programming Interfaces (APIs) for users to engage in secondary development. This course takes Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications as primary demonstration examples, and trains the enrolled students to systematically understand API documentations as well as efficiently develop API applications. It can help the enrolled students to customize their software for solving the engineering problems. In addition, it also enhances the  interoperability between different engineering software packages.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的在於提供方法，用來分析任何型式的結構物受任意動荷重所產生的應力與變化。
description.en: The primary purpose of this course is to present methods for analyzing the stresses and deflections developed in any given type of structure whenit is subjected to an arbitary dynamic loading.

syllabi.outline:
本課程為碩士班結構材料組一年級的核心選修課程。本課程內容著重在了解結構動力學基本原理與分析方法。以大學部的靜力學、材料力學、結構學等相關課程為基礎，進一步了解結構物在受具有時間特性的動態載重下引發的動態反應。本學期課程內容可大致分為：運動方程式、自由振動、強制振動、數值分析方法、反應譜分析、多自由度系統分析、阻尼特性、頻率域分析簡介等。
This course is a core elective designed for first-year graduate students in the Structural Materials division of the Master’s program. The course focuses on the fundamental principles and analytical methods of structural dynamics. Building upon undergraduate-level courses such as statics, mechanics of materials, and structural analysis, students will further explore the dynamic responses of structures subjected to time-dependent loads. The main topics covered during the semester include: Equations of motion, Free vibration, Forced vibration, Numerical analysis methods, Response spectrum analysis, Multi-degree-of-freedom (MDOF) system analysis, Damping characteristics, and Introduction to frequency domain analysis.

Whether it is an experiment or a model, the final regression data should be statistical analysis, and professional figure/table drawing.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description 
Introduction to multi-media sampling techniques and analytical methods for evaluation outdoor/indoor air, soil/surfaces, and water. The course will also emphasize environmental investigative techniques, instrument selection, and quality control, including documentation, calibration, and sample management.

Course Goals 
This course will provide an introduction to multi-media sampling techniques and analytical methods for evaluation outdoor/indoor air, soil/surfaces, and water. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to: 
1.	Collect samples in their research and in their professions. 
2.	Identify and quantify environmental pollution. 
3.	Defend their data and can base good decisions on their measurements.

description.en:
The recurrent occurrences of various natural and manmade disasters like the December 2004 Tsunami, the bomb blasts in the cinema halls of Delhi and many such incidences have diverted our focus towards safety of one’s own life. The goals of this course are three-fold: (1) To educate students about the underlying natural process that give rise to hazards. (2) To emphasize how society evaluates and confronts the dangers posed by these natural processes from a political, social, and ethical perspective. (3) Expose students to the technological innovations that are allowing an increasing large human population to monitor, predict, and warn society about natural hazards and impending disasters. Case studies of recent and past natural disasters will be discussed. This course is designed for students without an extensive background in science or math and can be used to partly satisfy minor programs in Environmental Geosciences.

syllabi.outline: Disaster is divided to natural and anthropogenic disaster. Either natural or anthropogenic disaster damage can be minimized by proper management, including pre- and post- management. Learning from the history, several disasters have been identified and more and more technologies have been developed to mitigate the possible disasters. In this course, natural disasters are focus because it is more difficult to predict and prevent. With the changing environment and climate, the intensity and frequency of natural disasters become more strong and unpredictable; therefore, the disaster management is very important. Real cases for different types of disaster will be chosen and discussed in this course. Facing these disasters, what we can do and how we can prepare is a survival issue. Through the comprehensive discussion, the students are expected to learn the structural and nonstructural solutions for the various disasters. Especially, the solutions are focus on ecological engineering and environmental friendly methods. A new and widely accepted idea, natural-based solutions (NBS) or ecosystem-based approaches, is increasingly applied to disaster management and will be discussed in this course.

syllabi.outline: This is a graduate course for students who have already followed the introductory course “Hydrology” at undergraduate level.  The objective of this course is to provide knowledge and skill in advanced techniques of hydrological data analysis, modeling and prediction.  The course will involve both the use of probabilistic techniques and physical principles to characterize hydrologic processes and hands on computer practices.  Such analyses are characterized by data collection, analysis and interpretation, simulation, and forecasting.

description.zh:
本課程是較大學部的「岩石力學」課程為之深入探討岩石行為的課程，將針對岩石的指數性質、透水性、強度及變形性做更詳細的研究，並將比較岩石和土壤的不同，以及介紹機率概念在岩石力學上的應用。上課時將以研究論文為主，，書籍、報告為輔，其涵蓋的課程內容大致如下：
1、岩石的指數性質
2、岩石和土壤的不同
3、岩體分類法
4、岩石的透水性
5、立體投影圖
6、岩石的強度
7、岩石的破壤準則
8、岩石的變形性
9、弱面的分析
10、機率在岩石力學上的應用
description.en: Compared to the undergraduate Rock Mechanics course, this is a more advanced course to examine the behaviors of rocks under different stress conditions。 It will focus on the index properties, the permeability properties, the strength properties, and the deformation properties of rocks。 In addition, it will address the difference between rocks and soils by contrast。 Finally, this course will introduce students to the concept of probability, and how it can be applied to the Rock Mechanics。 The students taking this course will have plenty of reading assignments, and are required to participate in the classroom discussions。

syllabi.outline:
本課程是較大學部的「岩石力學」課程為之深入探討岩石行為的課程，將針對岩石的指數性質、透水性、強度及變形性做一回顧，並介紹岩力在基礎、隧道、邊坡等工程上之應用。上課並將佐以論文研究，以培養學生之研究興趣鍛鍊相關研究工具及方法為主。其涵蓋的論文內容大致如下： 1、量綱分析與相似性 2、裂力在岩石力學上之應用 (如貫裂破壞、水力破壞) 3、後尖峰強度之穩定性 4、榫塊理論 (暫定，依實際需要調整之)等 。
Compared to the undergraduate Rock Mechanics course, this is a more advanced course to examine the behaviors of rocks under different stress conditions。 It will review the index properties, the permeability properties, the strength properties, and the deformation properties of rocks, and focus on the application of rock mechanics to (1). Underground tunneling and mining, (2). Slope stability, and (3). Foundation engineering。 Additionally, to improve research motivation and ability, this course will introduce students to some concepts: (1) Dimensional analysis and Similarity; (2). Fracture mechanics including indentation fracture and hydrofracturing; (3). Post-peak response and stability/bifurcation; (4). (To be adjusted). The students taking this course will have plenty of reading assignments, and are required to participate in the classroom discussions.

description.en: Open channel hydraulics treats the motion of water in conduits that have a free surface, that is, in which the flow of water is not completely bounded by the channel perimeter and one surface is exposed to atmospheric pressure.  The flows can be steady (time-invariant) or unsteady, uniform (space-invariant) or non-uniform (gradually, rapidly, or spatially varied).  For engineers, open channels are very common for the conveyance of natural waters, storm discharges, sewage collection systems, and aqueducts for water distribution systems. Knowledge of the mechanics of open-channel flow, then, is important for the proper design of these facilities.

description.zh: 應用統計學之目的乃教導學生機率與統計的理論，其強調利用統計方法及資料分析之技巧，以解決工程上可能面臨的問題，因此本課程將大量引用真實資料及實例，以說明如何處理相關的問題。本課程的包含的內容將涵蓋資料分析、機率、隨機變數、機率分佈、推估、假設檢定、取樣、線性迴歸、機率過程、變異數分析及多變量分析。
description.en: This is a comprehensive course in probability and statistics for students in engineering and technology discipline.  It emphasizes modern statistical methods and data analysis using real data and examples to offer students exposure to practical applications.  This course will provide an opportunity to learn how probabilistic analysis and statistical reasoning and testing can be applied to a wide range of problems in civil engineering.  Topics to be covered will include data analysis, probability, random variables, probability distributions, estimation, hypothesis testing, sampling, linear regression, statistical process control and analysis of variance.

syllabi.outline: The objective of the course is to familiarize the students with statistical topics that frequently arise in engineering application. Realistic applications of moderate complexity will be considered. Students will be expected to become familiar with at least one major statistical software (e.g., Minitab).

description.en: This course is concerned with the theory and practice of hydrology, the science of water in subsurface environments which are helpful for groundwater resource exploitation and management. It is divided into two main parts: (1) basic concepts dealing with the origin, movement of groundwater, and its recovery from wells, and (2) a qualitative and quantitative assessment of the chemistry of natural and contaminated systems.

description.en: This course is mainly designed for graduate students. This course includes Introduce to power electronic system, Diode Rectifiers, DC-DC Switch-Mode Converters, Switch-Mode DC-AC Inverters, Zero-Voltage or Zero-Current Switchings, Switching DC Power Supplies, Power Conditioners and Uninterruptible Power Supplies, Introduction to Motor Drives, Residential and Industrial Applications and Electric Utility Applications.

syllabi.outline: The applications of power electronics include electric vehicles, lighting, power systems, transportation, etc. The goal of this course is to help students understand the basic principles of power electronics and to integrate the comprehensive applications of electronic, circuit, and electromagnetic disciplines.

description.zh: 本課程為研究所熱流科學基礎課程之一，內容主要包括質量、動量與能量守恆方程式的推導，以及它們的解析與近似解，應用範圍包含非旋轉流、低雷諾數流以及高雷諾數(邊界層)流等等。
description.en: This course is one of the fundamental courses in the thermofluid sciences for graduate students. Based upon the concept of conservation, the equations of mass, momentum, and energy will be derived. This course will deal with solutions of these equations, both exact and approximate. The application of solutions includes irrotational flow, low Reynolds number flow, and high Reynolds number (boundary layer) flow, etc.

description.zh:
本課程使學生充分瞭解燃料電池專業學科基礎知識，並進一步啟發及增進學生未來能源科技發展知能。
燃料電池是一種電化學的發電裝置，其運作原理係利用電化學反應將燃料內之化學能直接轉換為電能，因其在能量轉換過程中並不經過熱機過程，因此能量轉換效率較高。本課程之授課綱要可分為以下幾項：
燃料電池系統簡介、燃料電池效率及開迴路電壓、燃料電池工作電壓、質子交換膜燃料電池、磷酸燃料電池、鹼性燃料電池、直接甲醇燃料電池、固態氧化物燃料電池、燃料電池的燃料供應、燃料電池電力傳輸、燃料電池系統分析。
description.en:
This course enables students to fully understand the basics of professional disciplines of the fuel cell, and to further inspire and enhance the knowledge of students about future energy technology. 
Fuel cell is an electrochemical power generating device. It can directly convert the chemical energy of fuel into the electrical energy via the electrochemical reaction. Because it does not go through the process of thermal engine in the energy conversion process, and therefore a higher energy conversion efficiency. Teaching outlines of the course can be divided into the followings:
Introduction to fuel cell system, Efficiency and open voltage, Operational fuel cell voltages, Proton exchange membrane fuel cell, Phosphoric acid fuel cell, Alkaline fuel cell, Direct methanol fuel cell, Solid oxide fuel cell, Fueling fuel cell, Delivering fuel cell power, Analysis of fuel cell system.

syllabi.outline:
FUEL CELLS are an important component in Energy Engineering and can be defined as an electrochemical system that converts chemical energy in the fuel into electrical energy with the help of electrodes and redox electrochemical. There are many kinds of fuel cells that help us in meeting the energy demands of this modernizing world. Understanding them theoretically is very significant for research advancements in the field of Energy. 
This course ' FUEL CELLS’ is a basic course taught entirely in English. 
The aim of this course is to provide introductory knowledge to students about the basics, types, working mechanism, applications and advancements in the field of fuel cells.
This class will also deal with sustainable fuel cells for producing clean energy and thereby preventing hazardous environmental issues through significant energy efficiency improvements and sustainable use of resources.
This course enables students to fully understand the basics of professional disciplines of the fuel cell, and to further inspire and enhance the knowledge of students about future energy technology. 
This course also has an important objective of motivating non-native English students to improve their English language skills like conversing, discussing and writing assignments in English.
These practices will help them deliver better English presentations and also enhance their thesis and paper writing abilities.

description.zh: 本課程適合修過工程數學及基礎熱流的碩博士班學生選修。授課內容主要是應用Matlab及CFD套裝軟體分析能源與熱流科學領域的相關問題，並著重於案例分析。課程內容主要包括利用數值分析解析邊界層問題、有限差分法求解穩態與暫態熱傳導以及二維強制驅動流問題，案例分析包括室內氣流運動、潔淨室氣流分佈、熱交換器性能分析、儲冰系統分析、電子散熱以及氫能系統等。
description.en: This course is suitable for the graduate students who have taken fundamental courses of engineering mathematics and thermofluid sciences. The objective of this course is to apply Matlab and CFD packages to analyze the problems related to energy and thermofluid sciences. Case study is the focus of this course. Course contents mainly include the application of numerical methods on solving boundary-layer problems, analyzing steady and transient heat conduction problems, and 2-D lid-driven flow problems by finite difference method. Case study covers room air flow motion, clean room simulation, heat exchanger performance, electronic cooling, thermal ice storage system and hydrogen energy, etc.

syllabi.outline: 本課程適合修過工程數學、基礎熱流以及具備基本操作ANSYS FLUENT軟體的碩博士班學生選修。授課內容主要是應用Matlab及CFD套裝軟體分析能源與熱流科學領域的相關問題，並著重於案例分析。課程內容主要包括利用數值分析解析邊界層問題、有限差分法求解穩態與暫態熱傳導以及二維強制驅動流問題，案例分析包括室內氣流運動、潔淨室氣流分佈、熱交換器性能分析、儲冰系統分析、電子散熱以及氫能系統等。

name.zh: 能源績效量測驗證與碳管理
name.en: Energy Performance Measurement and Verification and Carbon Management

description.zh: 因應全球淨零碳排趨勢，能源管理與碳管理為國家各產業提升競爭力的重要環節。本課程將從ISO50001能源管理與ISO14064碳管理制度出發，講授能源管理、能源績效評估、碳管理、和績效提升/減碳計算之量測與驗證方法學。講授內容涵蓋：關鍵觀念、節能/減碳技術、績效/減碳量測與驗證方法、節能/減碳統計分析方法學、和案例EXCEL操作與討論。
description.en: In response to the global trend of net-zero carbon emissions, energy management and carbon management are important links in improving the competitiveness of various industries in the country. This course will start from the ISO50001 energy management and ISO14064 carbon management systems and teach the measurement and verification methodologies of energy management, energy performance assessment, carbon management, and performance improvement/carbon reduction calculations. The teaching contents cover: key concepts, energy saving/carbon reduction technology, performance/carbon reduction measurement and verification methods, energy saving/carbon reduction statistical analysis methodology, and EXCEL case practice and discussion.

In response to the global trend of net-zero carbon emissions, energy management and carbon management are important links in improving the competitiveness of various industries in the country. This course will start from the ISO50001 energy management and ISO14064 carbon management systems and teach the measurement and verification methodologies of energy management, energy performance assessment, carbon management, and performance improvement/carbon reduction calculations. The teaching contents cover: key concepts, energy saving/carbon reduction technology, performance/carbon reduction measurement and verification methods, energy saving/carbon reduction statistical analysis methodology, and EXCEL case practice and discussion.

本課程主要探討高分子在溶液及固態時的物理化學現象及其應用。內容包括輔G熱力學?高分子的微結構及定性。
輔G熱力學探討統計熱力學、晶格理論、Flory-Huggin理論、Flory-Krigbaum理論、相分離、θ-溫度、滲透壓、GPC測分子量、高分子膠體。
?高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。
description.en:
The course is to investigate the physical phenomena of macromolecules in the solution and solid state. It includes the solution thermodynamics and chemical microstructure of polymer chains.
The solution thermodynamics is to study lattice theory, statistical thermodynamics, Flory-Huggin theory, Flory-Krigbaum theory, phase separation, θ-temperature, Osmometry, GPC, and polymer gels.
Light scattering and Neutron scattering are used to characterize the polymer microstructure. Polymer radius of gyration, freely rotating chains, excluded volume, fractal, and scaling are also discussed. Finally, spectroscopy methods are used to study polymerization models and microstructure.

description.en: The materials of the course include structure identification and property analysis of materials. Methods of structure identification  of materials are : elemental analysis, absorption spectroscopy, vibration spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, x-ray spectroscopy and electron microscopy. Metheds of property analysis of materials are : thermal properties of materials (DSC,TGA,TMA,DMA) and mechanical properties of materials (tensile, compression and shear strengths).

syllabi.outline: In this course, we will systematically introduce various analysis techniques including UV-vis spectroscopy, photoluminescence spectroscopy, fourier-transform infrared spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance, mass spectrometer, thermal analyses, optical microscopy, electron microscopy and atomic force microscopy. Students who study this course can establish a theoretical framework for the analysis of various organic materials, which will help their future research and employment development.

description.en: This course is to elucidate the polymer synthesis and Kinetics studies. The synthesis includes step polymerization, free radical chain polymerization, emulsion polymerization, ionic chain polymerization, chain copolymerization, ring opening polymerization, sterospecific polymerization and living free radical polymerization. The synthesis scheme is optimized with the structure-properties relationship and molecular design. The potential application of these methods in high-tech materials, such as optoelectronics, and composites, will be elucidated.

Organometallics provides not only the powerful tools for chemist in their research but also for chemical engineers in the design of their reactors.  The course covers the following topics: (1) Main-group organometallics (2) Organometallic compounds of the transition elements (3) Organometallics of the boron group (4) Organometallics of Copper, Silver and Gold (5) The 18-Valence-Electron (18-VE) Rule (6) s, p donors and acceptors (7) Organotin

Nanomaterials: simulation; 6. Carbon-based nanomaterials; 7. Synthesis and processing 8. Growth and application of semiconductor nanoparticles; 9. Prospective future of nanomaterials.

description.zh: 本課程區分為四個實習，共一學年之都市設計實習，每學期應從事幾項實習，依該學期之情況而定：(一)大型基地開發之建築規劃與都市設計實習：參照台北市都市發展局擬定之「都市設計與土地使用開發許可」之審議標準，練習建築、敷地與都市設計三者整合關係之設計實習。(二)都市更新地區都市設計實習：以台北市更新地區為範例，選定基地範圍從事都市更新地區之改造，建立地區未來像，並擬定都市設計準則。(三)都市計畫通盤檢討地區都市設計實習：依據都市計畫通盤檢討第八條規定，都市計畫通盤檢討地區必須依據該地區之交通、產業、文化、生態及基地等因素，擬定都市設計準則；以台北市都市計畫通盤檢討為例，練習都市設計準則之訂定，或以都市計畫細部計畫為例，研擬土地使用分區管制與設計準則。(四)新發展區都市設計實習：選定一個地區，可能是擴大都市發展地區或新市鎮、新社區之規劃設計實習。

description.zh: 研究生相較於大學期間訓練的最主要差別在於其必須從事個人的學術研究。因此，研究生須要資訊與洞察力以達成獲得較高學位之論文寫作能力。故本課程主要內容包括： 一、 研究的特性 二、 智慧收集-「什麼」的問題 三、 研究-「何故」的問題 四、 良好研究的特質 五、 研究的基本類型 六、 從事研究的技能 七、 研究倫理 八、 研究設計練習
description.en: The necessity for personal academic research is the key cultural change that postgraduate students will encounter compared with their undergraduate days. Thus, postgraduate students need information and insights to develop the capacity to operate successfully achieving a higher-level degree. To examine these concerns, the course includes: 1. Characteristics of research 2. Intelligence-gathering-the "what" questions 3. Research-the "why" questions 4. Characteristics of good research 5. Basic types of research 6. The craft of doing research 7. Research ethics 8. Research design practice

description.zh: 本課程授課主要內容分為三部分：第一部份為都市防災概論，此部分主要針對國內外文獻作一回顧，進而瞭解都市防災整體架構，區分為（1）文獻回顧；（2）防災基本計畫；及（3）防災整體架構等。期使國內都市計畫能逐步邁向防災都市計畫，以建立『安全都市』為目標。此部分的主要內容區分為：（1）都市災害風險理念的形成；（2）防災都市計畫與地區防災系統規劃；（3）都市計畫防災系統規劃原則；（4）都市計畫防災作業準則內容架構；（5）都市計畫防災作業準則；（6）安心都市計畫的形成與實現。第三部分為實務操作部分，以草屯鎮為例，藉九二一大地震的實例，深入探討災情調查的方法，實際調查狀況及研訂災後重建的程序與計畫內容，期望成為國內都市重建計畫的範例，主要內容區分為：（1）緒論；（2）重建理論；（3）草屯鎮現況發展；（4）災情調查方法與重建程序之建立；（5）災情調查分析與重建計畫內容研訂等。

description.zh:
施工歷史可以被視為了解建築理論的關鍵基礎。按照慣例，建築學院提供建築歷史方面的研究方面，包括建築風格和哲學的發展，或者建築材料和建築技術的最新進展。此外，關於建築的理論辯論也更加關注哲學的討論，而不是物理建築的表現。
但是，建築理論主要討論材料和建築系統的表示。因此，材料的構造方法實際上會極大地影響建築理論的解釋。因此，該課程可以分為兩個部分：首先，將回顧東西方世界的建設歷史以及現代時期。其次，將討論結構論和相對論的爭論。本課程的目的是發展與會學生的能力，使他們能夠回顧自己論點的要點，並運用適當的理論來支持或爭論他們對建築理論的理解。

Each participant needs to study a required article in advance and brief the article for all participants in the class of the required day for 20 minutes.
  (Week 4) Frampton’s chapter 1 (____)
  (Week 6) Semper’s four elements  (____)
  (Week 8) Frampton’s chapter 7 (____)

In the first half of the courses, each participant has to find a project with vivid material expressions, which can be discussed in terms of tectonic theories and interpretations. The project can be international or domestic. It should be easier if the participant might find its design drawings. Students should present their plans of their final reports in the mid-term class about 10 minutes, in order to collect some feedback from colleagues and class instructor for further develop to achieve the final report.
＊＊Research thesis 30%
One should submit his/her thesis by the noon of 1/21 (12:00pm) to Dr. Wu in person. The words of the thesis should not be less than 5000 words. It should be in thesis format (word) instead of brief presentation format (power point).
Employed materials of one’s chosen architectural project for the thesis should be clarified. Please note that the referred theories should be reviewed firstly. Aftermath, the discussion of material deployment should be referred to at least one of the architectonic or atectonic theories.

description.zh: 隨著跨學門的多元連結,當代建築學的設計與史論研究向度越趨廣泛且複雜。為回應此變動的條件,研究方法作為知識體系建構的工具,亦需重新思考如何提供理解當代建築學和認識論的新興維度。因此,本課程首先以「研究為一門藝術的概念」-透過理解自身意識與研究的關係,作為開啟研究的初步引導。接著,將從人文社會科學研究方法的基礎出發,探討如何在建築學門內適切轉化及運用此些方法。透過本課程,學習者將能夠有效辯證和梳理不同研究主體(知識論)以及該研究所對應之方法邏輯(方法論),並以此作為設計研究的基礎建構。同時,期待學習者能夠理解在建築研究中,學門的部分特殊性質所衍伸出的方法論修正,並鼓勵為當代建築設計與史論研究提供新的思路。
description.en:
With the growing interdisciplinary connections, contemporary architectural design, theoretical research, and historical dimensions have become increasingly expansive and intricate. In response to these evolving conditions, research methods, as essential tools for constructing knowledge systems, need to be reconsidered in order to offer fresh insights into understanding contemporary architecture and its epistemology.

This course starts by embracing the concept of "research as an art" as a foundational guide to initiate research, emphasizing the crucial relationship between self-awareness and the research process. It then builds upon the established research methods in the humanities and social sciences, exploring how to effectively adapt and apply these methods within the field of architecture. Throughout the course, learners will learn to skillfully articulate and organize diverse research subjects (epistemology) and their corresponding methodological frameworks (methodology), estab

name.en: Theories and Practice in English for Professional Purposes

description.zh: 本課程旨在研討專業英文研究及應用, 課程包括專業領域英語文之語域分析, 探討各領域中的語法及詞彙特點,並進一步分析不同領域中之修辭及言語萹章使用,進而研討語言溝通目標功能分析並結合策略研究,以將理論應用於專業實務及研究中。
description.en: This course is intended for graduate students who are pre-experienced in working in specific fields of professions. For other students who are inexperienced in the workplace are required to have consolidated knowledge and observations of the world industries. It aims to address the applicability of theories in EPP and the plethora of situations raised from such applications. The course will provide theoretical studies for applications in respect to register analysis, rhetorical and discourse analysis, functionality analysis and skills and strategies. It is also expected that the course will describe other models in EPP studies.

name.zh: 語音學和英語發音教學

description.zh: 傳統發音教學大多根據教師直覺認為語音是該如何產製的、或發音課本中教條式的規則。在這堂課，學生將透過具體的聲學和構音資料、來學習重要語音學原則，並學習將原則正確地應用在發音教學當中。學生也將探討如何將這些知識轉化成不同年齡層和語言程度之學生可以接受的內容。
description.en: Traditionally, pronunciation teaching has been based on "armchair data" (e.g., the instructor's intuition on how a sound should be articulated) or prescriptive statements in pronunciation textbooks. In this course, students will learn fundamental principles of phonetics through experimental acoustic and articulatory data and learn how to apply them to pronunciation teaching. Students will be challenged to translate what they have learned to digestible pronunciation instructions for students of different ages and proficiency levels.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹英語全球化、全球英語，以及英語作為國際語言的發展與相關論述，並針對英語在全球擴散的現象，檢視相關的概念與理論。本課程將探討因英語全球化所造成，在社會語言學、文化、政治經濟與教育等方面的重要議題，以及與全球英語相關的議題與爭論。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of English varieties, and the development of the popularization of English as a lingua franca. It examines the various concepts and theories developed in academia to account for the unprecedented global expansion of English. Through readings and class discussion, this course will look at key sociolinguistic, cultural, politico-economic and educational issues arising from the spread of English as well as the current issues and debates surrounding Global Englishes. Students will be encouraged to conduct original research on or detailed analysis of the implications of English as the international language.

This course aims to provide students with an overview of the spread of the English language around the world, the emergence of World Englishes/ Global Englishes, and the development of the popularization of English as a world lingua franca. It examines the various concepts and theories developed in academia to account for the unprecedented global expansion of English. Through readings and class discussion, this course will look at key sociolinguistic, cultural, politico-economic and educational issues arising from the spread of English as well as the current issues and debates surrounding World Englishes/ Global Englishes. Students will be encouraged to conduct original research on or detailed analysis of the implications of English as the international language.

syllabi.outline:
This course provides a comprehensive introduction to numerical methods and their application in solving scientific and engineering problems.
本課程旨在全面介紹數值方法及其在解決科學與工程問題上之應用。
Students will learn to translate real-world problems into mathematical models and apply various numerical algorithms for their solution.
學生將學習如何將實際問題轉化為數學模型，並應用各種數值演算法進行求解。
Key topics include mathematical modeling, error analysis, linear algebra, interpolation, approximation, numerical integration and differentiation, solving ordinary and partial differential equations, Monte Carlo methods, optimization, and an introduction to numerical methods in data science and high-performance computing.
主要內容包括數學建模、誤差分析、線性代數、內插法、逼近法、數值積分與微分、常微分與偏微分方程求解、蒙地卡羅方法、數值優化，以及數據科學與高效能計算中數值方法之簡介。
The course emphasizes hands-on experience through in-class programming sessions and utilizes online weeks for flexible learning.
本課程強調透過課堂程式設計實作獲得實務經驗，並利用線上教學週進行彈性學習。

課程重要事項 (Important Course Notes)

Bilingual Instruction (雙語教學): This course will be conducted with materials and explanations provided in both English and Chinese to support diverse learning needs. 本課程將以中英文雙語提供教材與解說，以支持多元學習需求。
Language of Assessment (評量語言): Major assignments, presentations, and examinations are required to be completed in English. 主要作業、報告及考試需以英文完成。
Programming Sessions (程式設計實作課): This course includes several in-class programming sessions. 本課程包含數次課堂程式設計實作。 Active participation and completion of programming tasks are mandatory. 學生必須積極參與並完成程式設計作業。
Online Teaching Weeks (線上教學週): Specific weeks will be conducted online. 特定教學週將採線上教學。 Students are expected to engage with materials and activities as directed on the [LMS/Email/Course Website]. 學生應依循[學習管理系統(LMS)/電子郵件/課程網站]之指示參與課程材料與活動。
Attendance Policy (出席規定): Students who are absent three (3) or more times (including programming sessions and online sessions where applicable) during the semester will automatically receive a failing grade for the course. 一學期內缺席三（3）次（含以上，適用於程式設計實作課與線上課程應參與部分）者，該課程成績以不及格計。(缺席三次不及格)
