description.zh:
本課程深入探討人工智慧領域的基礎知識和最新技術，包括機器學習、深度學習、自然語言處理、生成對抗網絡等領域。學員將從人工智慧的概述和歷史開始，逐步深入了解機器學習和深度學習的基礎概念和演算法，並探討其在不同領域的應用。課程還介紹了最新的AI技術趨勢，包括注意力機制、自監督學習、大型AI通用模型和元學習等。
課程運作模式：每週講授一個主題，包括理論授課和實習操作。學員將參與課堂討論和小組活動，以促進想法交流和知識分享。
description.en:
This course delves into the fundamentals and latest advancements in the field of artificial intelligence, covering topics such as machine learning, deep learning, natural language processing, and generative adversarial networks. Participants will begin with an overview of artificial intelligence and its historical development, progressively delving into the foundational concepts and algorithms of machine learning and deep learning, along with their applications across various domains. The course also introduces the latest trends in AI technology, including attention mechanisms, self-supervised learning, large-scale AI models, and meta-learning.
Course Execution: Each week covers a specific topic, including theoretical lectures and practical exercises. Participants will engage in classroom discussions and group activities to facilitate idea exchange and knowledge sharing.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在全面介紹人工智慧（AI）的基礎知識與最新技術發展，涵蓋資料科學、機器學習、深度學習、自監督學習與自然語言處理等核心主題。學生將從 AI 的歷史與概念入門，逐步探索各種學習模型的理論基礎與實務應用，進而理解如注意力機制、生成對抗網絡（GAN）、大型語言模型（如 GPT）等前沿技術。
課程強調「理論與實作並重」，每週安排主題式教學，搭配實務操作與小組討論，以培養學生的問題解決能力、跨領域整合能力與實作經驗。學員將有機會使用如 Python 實作各類 AI 應用，並於課程末完成一項小組專題。
This course offers a comprehensive overview of the foundations and cutting-edge developments in Artificial Intelligence (AI), covering core topics such as data science, machine learning, deep learning, self-supervised learning, and natural language processing. Students will begin by learning the history and core concepts of AI, then progressively explore theoretical foundations and practical applications of various learning models, including advanced techniques such as attention mechanisms, generative adversarial networks (GANs), and large-scale language models like GPT.
Designed with a strong balance of theory and hands-on practice, the course features weekly thematic modules combining lectures, coding exercises, and collaborative discussions. Students will gain essential skills in using tools like Python to develop real-world AI applications, culminating in a final group project.

description.en: The course mainly discusses concepts of business research methods. The contents will include following topics：（1）the nature of business research, （2）elements of research and research process, （3）research problem and hypothesis,（4）literature review, （5）research design, （6）research proposal, （7）case study, （8）analysis and the interpretation of data, （9）quantitative and qualitative research,(10) research report.

syllabi.outline:
This course introduces the methods essential to business research. The first focus is on research methods, particularly applied quantitative statistical analysis—interpreting results, as well as applying them to actual data. Students should become informed consumers of statistics—to be able to understand and assess the quality of statistical methods in the papers they read, and to use those methods in their research. The second focus is on research design and data collection methods, which will be essential to master’s dissertation, and practical business roles (such as consultant or market researcher). Students will participate in a project in which they have the chance to collect and analyze their data.

The course is on fundamentals, up to multiple regression, so we will not have time to discuss more advanced statistical techniques. However, you should leave this class with a solid foundation for further education on these topics.

description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making at the top management level. Traditionally, this course has been the capstone course in the business program and is taught at the last year of study so that students can integrate functional area knowledge into a coherent one. Students are expected not only to learn a body of knowledge on strategic management, but also to synthesize economics, accounting, and marketing as an aid top management level decisions. We will use a combination of readings, case studies, and lectures to achieve the goals of the course.

description.en: The need for information-based support for managers is increasing as the modern management imperatives of reach and to meet their organization's goals. Information management function provides information to support operations, management analysis, and decision- making functions in an organization. We will also look at the role in formation play in helping managers meet goals by examining the characteristics of information systems that make managers' job easier. Topic of learning: Acquiring strategic advantage through information systems. Supporting managers and executives through IS applications. Managing the risk inherent in developing and using IS applications. Attaining and practicing technological leadership. This course is taught by HBS cases.

description.zh: 面對各種數位化革新技術浪潮的衝擊，零售業者必須置入各項智能科技進行數位行銷與商業模式的開發，例如零售業者使用無人商店、智能支付系統、擴增/虛擬實境、元宇宙、物聯網 (IoT)、消費數據分析、人工智慧 (AI)、機器學習等先進技術，將傳統零售環境轉變為更智慧、更便捷、更個性化的消費體驗。甚至利用這些新興數位科技與和數據資源實踐零售業態的升級和轉型，進而不斷涌現出新型業態和新型商業模式的品牌體驗與管理。據此，本課程將以介紹當代智慧零售個案為主軸，介紹智慧零售實務的同時，也帶出其背後運作的主要理論基礎，藉此以促進實務與理論並重的學習效益。
description.en: Faced with the impact of various digital innovation waves, retailers must integrate various smart technologies to develop digital marketing and business models. For example, retailers use advanced technologies such as unmanned retail stores, smart payment systems, augmented/virtual reality, the metaverse, the Internet of Things (IoT), consumption data analysis, artificial intelligence (AI), and machine learning to transform the traditional retail environment into more intelligent, more convenient and more personalized consumption experience. Retailers use these emerging digital technologies and data resources to implement retail upgrading and transformation and then emerge with new business models for brand experience and management. Accordingly, this course will focus on introducing contemporary smart retail cases. Introducing smart retail cases will also bring out the main theoretical foundations, resulting in learning benefits that emphasize practice and theory.

description.en: Corporate governance is the combination of legal and political governance mechanisms external to the firm, along with monitoring and incentive governance mechanisms internal to the firm, linked and driven by the forces of investment markets, to produce value-increasing outcomes for firms' owners and, ultimately, society at large. In this course, we will survey corporate governance, taking the investor's point of view. By the end of the course, you should have a well-informed understanding of the basic corporate governance problem and the major issues in corporate governance, prominent proposed solutions to the corporate governance problem, the way the problem is actually addressed in a variety of companies and countries, and evidence on the prospects for and drawbacks of the various solutions. This course is therefore comprised of distinct intellectual components-the practice and the science-which are intertwined throughout the semester's activities.

name.en: Implementation of Business Operation Efficiency Analysis

description.zh: 本課程的目的在於讓同學們瞭解經營績效評估的方法，強調理論與實作並重。首先會介紹資料包絡分析法(DEA)的基本概念，讓同學們對於DEA理論有基本的瞭解，接下來再讓同學們學習如何使用電腦套裝軟體進行實際運算，並探討各種企業經營效率分析上的應用。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to let students understand the methods of business performance evaluation, emphasizing both theory and practice. Firstly, this course will introduce the basic concept of Data Envelopment Analysis (DEA) so that students can understand DEA theory. Then students will learn how to use computer-packaged software for actual calculations and discuss the application of various business efficiency analyses.

description.en: The purpose of this course is to integrate the most resent thinking about organization design with classic and traditional ideas and theories. This course covers the following three major parts: Part 1: organization and organization theories Part 2: organization structure and design Part 3: new thinking of organization design in the Internet era, Part IV case study.

syllabi.outline: The goal of this course is to survey the major theoretical perspectives in organizational theory (OT). More specifically, we introduce the foundation questions of the strategy field and focus on the strategy ‘content” research in this class. The major purpose of this class is to expose students to samples of contemporary strategy content research and to point out some access points to the broader universe of thought on each topic. In other words, we will start from the fundamentals in order to have a solid understanding of the theoretical approach. This elaboration will be followed by a more in-depth exploration of the empirical articles assigned for each week, and how this contributes to organization theory. Finally, we will move on to the assessment and critique of the theoretical view. One or two students will be assigned to lead each week’s discussion.

description.zh: 建立學生對各類資料探勘技術與理論的基礎觀念及架構，以奠定學生日後從事資料探勘分析與研究工作時之需。相關的分析技術將包括應用在分類(classification)、推估(estimation)、預測(prediction)、關聯式分組(affinity grouping)、同質分組(clustering)等功能中的決策樹、(decision tree)多變量分析(multivariate analysis)及類神經網路(neural network)等方法。此外為了讓學生對相關技術有更深的瞭解，課程中將以個案實例為主，並配合各種資料探勘套裝軟體，以應用的觀點使學生更容易接受了解在商業智慧分析上資料探勘分析的功用。
description.en: Several fundamental theories of data mining techniques are included in this course. For examples, decision tree, multivariate analysis and neural network. All these techniques will be applied in different areas, such as classification, association rule, forecasting, and pattern recognition. And various applications in different enterprises are also included.

description.zh: 本課程教導及訓練研究生有關英文在管理領域內特定專題的溝通運用，學生將在本課程中以英文學習: (1)管理常見之專有名詞，(2)英語備忘錄的草擬與撰寫，(3)會議資料如：議程、動議、記錄等的準備與撰寫，(4)企業計劃書的編寫，及(5)現代化全球管理相關專題英文資料的閱讀與溝通討論。學生必須在課堂上就選定的管理題材以英文做報告與其它同學討論。
description.en: This course teaches students the communication in English on the special topics within the context of management. Students are expected to learn the followings in English: (1) Terminologies commonly used in management; (2) Draft and write-up of English memorandum; (3) Development of meeting materials such as agenda, motions, minutes, etc.; (4) Business proposals and plans; and (6) Contemporary topics and trend in global management issues. Students will be required to make group presentations and discussions on the selected management topics in English.

syllabi.outline: This course, A.I. in Business Management, provides a comprehensive introduction to the core principles of business management and explores the role of Artificial Intelligence (AI) in transforming business management practices. Students will examine how AI enhances decision-making, improves operational efficiency, and drives innovation across industries. The course combines with theoretical frameworks, real-world case studies, in class focus group discussion to equip students with the skills needed to leverage AI in strategic business applications.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在探討如何運用量化的管理決策模型來解析管理上的各種問題，主要決策模型求解方法有：線性規劃、整數規劃、非線性規劃、層級分析法與網路分析法等。課程內容主要以案例說明為主，讓同學瞭解理論如何與實際問題結合，故課程中會用工程與管理上之各種實際應用問題做說明，最佳化求解軟體與決策工具軟體會用來進行問題求解與輔助說明所得數據之管理意涵，並進行模型成本效益分析。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to discuss how to use quantitative management decision-making models to analyze various management problems. The methods for solving the decision-making models include: linear programming, integer programming, nonlinear programming, hierarchical analysis process and network process etc. The course content is mainly based on case illustrations such that students can understand how the theory is combined with practical problems. Therefore, various practical application problems in engineering and management will be used to explain the models. Optimization software and decision-making tools will be used to solve the problems and assist in explaining the management implications of the obtained data, and perform model cost-benefit analysis.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹有效研發/創新管理的概念、原則、與標準，這些概念、原則與標準將成為知識密集型的組織與企業的關鍵競爭優勢。本課程將介紹一些相關企業個案和練習活動，用以連結國家、產業和企業的研發或創新活動，並選定方法和工具進行有效的整合功能、企業業務、研發和創新活動。
description.en: This course is intended to introduce the concepts, principles, and standards for effective R&D/innovation management that is becoming the critical competitive advantages for the knowledge-intensive organizations and firms. The course will introduce a number of related cases and exercises with a view to bridge the national, industrial and corporate R&D/innovation activities, along with the presentation of selected approaches, methods and tools to effectively integrate functional, business and corporate R&D and innovation activities as a whole.

description.en: This course is a survey of research methodology that is relevant to the Industrial Design field. It focuses on conducting an industrial design research, collect, and report the data. syllabi.outline:
傳說中的研究方法回來了！本課程旨在教導學生一個簡潔、廣泛又清楚的工業設計研究方法的知識及技能架構，課程包括二大部份；第一部份探討工業設計研究計畫的準備及撰擬，第二部份除比較分析主要的工業設計研究方法外，也同時探討其中一種研究方法在工業設計專業領域的應用實例。
This course is a survey of research methodology that is relevant to the Industrial Design field. It focuses on conducting an industrial design research, collect, and report the data. This course also highlights the difference among that mainstream research methodology in Industrial Design field.
syllabi.schedule:
1	一、設計與研究的基礎
課程導入與暖身：了解課程範圍和目標、前測	
	活動：課程目標講座、分組專題主題腦力激盪和LLM輔助構思。PjBL作為解決現實世界設計問題的框架。
2	問題定義與研究基礎：使用LLM擬定明確的問題並進行文獻回顧		  
        活動：學習使用LLM來定義研究問題並進行文獻回顧。
3	資料蒐集與分析：資料蒐集方法並使用LLM協助分析使用者和情境見解	
	活動：資料蒐集技術工作坊、基於LLM的樣本資料集分析以及研究結果小組討論。
4	設計研究中的行動反思工作坊：應用 Schön 的反思實踐進行原型迭代及確定使用者為中心的意義	
	活動：講解行動中反思、原型工作坊和LLM支持的反思日誌。
5	二、以人為本和符合倫理的研究方法
描繪利害關係人地圖：確定利害關係人及其塑造以使用者為中心的設計解決方案中的角色
活動：介紹利害關係人地圖方法、利害關係人地圖分組、基於LLM的利害關係人模擬。
6	倫理研究實踐：使用結構化框架和LLM評估設計決策的道德影響
	活動：關於研究倫理的結構化框架、真實案例研究分析和基於LLM的道德情景生成的講解。
7	迭代原型設計：透過迭代原型設計和使用者回饋分析來優化設計概念
活動：迭代原型製作工作坊、利害關係人回饋會議以及LLM輔助回饋分析。

活動：迭代原型製作工作坊、利害關係人回饋會議以及LLM輔助回饋分析。
9	三、創意與推測性及批判性的研究方法
推測性設計工作坊：使用推測性設計來探索未來場景並挑戰傳統設計規範
活動：講解關於推測性設計原理、推測性場景的小組頭腦風暴以及基於LLM的構思。

	活動：關於批判性設計原則的講解、關於問題重構的工作坊以及基於LLM的反敘事探索。
11	用於創意解決問題的生成式AI：應用生成式AI擴展設計可能性與克服創意限制
活動：關於生成式AI在設計中的應用、生成工具的實踐探索以及基於LLM的構思細化的講解。

description.zh: 設計是造就其所處時代和文化下的產物。它是社會共有的價值觀體現，但設計的思考過程也用於代表特定的概念，鼓勵某些活動，從而影響社會和文化。本課程介紹現代和後現代設計的時代精神，涉及的重要發展包括建築、平面設計、產品設計、家具設計、室內設計、數字設計，甚至商業設計。本課程提供理解設計史上的精彩作品，透過政治、宗教、技術、文化、氣候和地理因素影響下的背景梳理。
description.en: Design is a product of the period and culture in which it is created. It is a representation of values shared by society but also used to represent specific ideals, encourage certain activities, and thus influence society and culture. This course provides an introduction to the zeitgeist of Modern and Postmodern Design. It deals with the most important developments including architecture, graphic design, product design, furniture design, interior design, digital design, and even business design. This course provides the background needed for understanding the rich heritage of historical design in the arts, as influenced by political, religious, technological, cultural, climatic and geographic factors.

description.zh: 本課程將涵蓋電腦科學的理論基礎。其內容包含自動機理論，電腦語言學，以及計算形式等。電腦相關的基本數學也將涵蓋在課程範圍之中。包括集合論，基本關係及及操作，以及理論證明工具與技術。課程大綱:基礎理論介紹，有限狀態自動機 / 一般敘述語法，Regular 集合的基本性質，前後文無相關文法， Pushdown 自動機，杜林機（turning machines），Chomsky 層次結構，基本關係及操作，理論證明技術及工具。
description.en: This course will look the theoretical foundation in computer science.  Automata theory, languages, and computation formalism will be examined in details.  Various fundamental computer-related mathematics will also be covered.  They include, sets/subsets, basic relations and operations and tools/techniques for proving theorems. Course Outline: Introduction to Theoretical Foundations, Finite Automata / Regular Expression, Properties of Regular Sets, Context-Free Grammars, Pushdown Automata, Turing Machines, The Chomsky Hierarchy (tentative), Basic Relations and Operations, Tools/Techniques for Proving Theorems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將涵蓋電腦科學的理論基礎。其內容包含自動機理論，電腦語言學，以及計算形式等。電腦相關的基本數學也將涵蓋在課程範圍之中。包括集合論，基本關係及及操作，以及理論證明工具與技術。課程大綱:基礎理論介紹，有限狀態自動機 / 一般敘述語法，Regular 集合的基本性質，前後文無相關文法， Pushdown 自動機，杜林機（turning machines），Chomsky 層次結構，基本關係及操作，理論證明技術及工具。
This course will look the theoretical foundation in computer science.  Automata theory, languages, and computation formalism will be examined in details.  Various fundamental computer-related mathematics will also be covered.  They include, sets/subsets, basic relations and operations and tools/techniques for proving theorems. Course Outline: Introduction to Theoretical Foundations, Finite Automata / Regular Expression, Properties of Regular Sets, Context-Free Grammars, Pushdown Automata, Turing Machines, The Chomsky Hierarchy (tentative), Basic Relations and Operations, Tools/Techniques for Proving Theorems.
syllabi.schedule:
1)	Regular Languages (4 weeks): Deterministic and non-deterministic finite automata, closure properties, regular expressions, Brzozowski derivatives, the pumping lemma for regular languages, DFA minimization, the Myhill-Nerode theorem.   
2)	Context-Free Languages (4 weeks): Context-free grammars, normal forms, the pumping lemma for context-free languages, pushdown automata, closure properties.
3)	Decidable and Undecidable Languages (5 weeks): Turing machines, the Church-Turing thesis, computability, undecidability, the Halting Problem, reductions, basic complexity classes.
4)    Model Checking (3 weeks): Buechi-Automata, Kripke system, Linear Temporal Logic, Conputational Tree Logic, Model Checking Problem, Algorithms for MC.


Week 1: Introduction
Week 2--4: Finite State Automata & Regular Language
Week 5--8: Context-Free Languages & Pushdown Automata
Week 9: mid-term
Week 10--12: Turing Machine & Complexity Theorem
Week 13--16: Model Checking
Week 17: Final Project Presentation
Week 18: Final Project Presentation

description.zh: 本課程介紹密碼學的理論與實際，其主要內容如下：簡介；背景知識；DES保密系統；RSA保密系統；其他公開金匙系統；數位簽章；網路安全
description.en: Principles and practice of cryptography are covered in this course. It contains the following material:  Introduction；Background Theory；Data Encryption Standard (DES)；RSA Cryptosystem；Other Public-key Cryptosystems；Digital Signatures；Internet Security

syllabi.outline:
Cryptography is a science used to design algorithms and formulate protocols for achieving security requirements, e.g. privacy, authentication, and data integrity. Recently, with the vigorous development of electronic communication and e-commerce, the importance of cryptography has gone beyond its historical military use. Cryptography provides technology to achieve security, for example: it allows us to successfully use credit cards for online transactions without revealing the card number to others. Over the past 25 years, cryptography has transformed from a technology developed for a specific purpose to a science with a solid theoretical foundation. This course will also teach the following directions of cryptography. Its main purpose is to arouse students' interest in cryptography and cultivate cryptography talents. 1. Definition: Discuss how to clearly and clearly define cryptographic problems (also known as cryptographic concepts), and quantify the so-called security in different cryptographic concepts. 2. Cryptographic architecture and security proof: The complete cryptographic architecture will be introduced, and the security of its architecture can be guaranteed by some difficult assumptions. 3. Theoretical basis: Cryptography architectures are all based on difficult assumptions. This part will introduce commonly used difficult assumptions, and discuss current theoretical and practical developments. 4. Cryptographic application: How to use the cryptographic architecture to apply it to higher-level security requirements is also a very important topic in cryptography. 5. Information Security: Realize network security or multimedia security through cryptography.

密碼學是一門用來設計演算法和訂定協議的科學，目的為如何在不安全的環境中達到安全的需求，如：隱私、認證、以及資料的完整性。近期，在電子通訊和電子商務的蓬勃發展下，密碼學的重要性已遠超越它在歷史上的軍事用途，而已經充滿在我們的生活當中。非常重要的是密碼學提供了實現安全的技術，例如：它讓我們可以成功使用信用卡於線上交易，同時又不洩漏卡號給其他人。 由過去25年來的進展，密碼學已經從一個為了達成特定目的所開發的技術轉變成一門富有嚴謹理論基礎的科學。本課程並將會教授以下密碼學的方向，其主要目的是激起學生對密碼學的興趣，並培育密碼學人才。 1. 定義：探討如何明確且清楚的定義密碼學問題(又稱密碼概念)，以及量化所謂的安全性於不同的密碼概念上。 2. 密碼架構與安全性證明：將會介紹完整的密碼學架構，並且證明分析其架構安全性可以被某些困難的假設所保證。 3. 理論基礎：密碼架構都會接於困難假設，這部分將會介紹常用的困難假設，以及探討目前在理論以及實務上的發展。 4. 密碼應用：如何利用密碼架構應用在更高層的安全訴求上也是密碼學相當重要的課題。 5. 資訊安全：透過密碼學來實現網路安全或多媒體安全。

description.zh: 本課程探討處理空間資料的模式與演算法則，主題包含: (1) 空間資料庫介紹與應用, (2) 空間概念與資料模式, (3) 空間搜尋語言, (4) 空間資料儲存與索引, (5) 搜尋處理與最佳化, (6) 空間網路, (7) 空間資料庫的研究趨勢。
description.en: This course studies the models and algorithms for the efficient handling of data related to space. The topics include: (1) Introduction to Spatial Databases, (2) Spatial Concepts and Data Models, (3) Spatial Query Languages, (4) Spatial Storage and Indexing, (5) Query Processing and Optimization, (6) Spatial Networks, and (7) Trends on Spatial Databases.

syllabi.outline:
In this class, we introduce the role, principles, and wide-range applications of spatial databases. The relationship to traditional databases will be discussed first, and then the general architecture of spatial databases will be introduced. After understanding the concepts of spatial data and the relevant models, we discuss effective ways to manage and process spatial data. The topics include:(1) Introduction and applications of spatial databases, (2) Spatial concepts and data models, (3) Spatial search languages, (4) Spatial data storage and indexing, (5) Spatial search processing and optimization, and (6) Spatial networks. In addition, with the advances in computing techniques and environments, we also explore the recent trends of spatial databases, such as distributed databases, big spatial data, vector databases, and how AI models help.
在本課程中，我們將介紹空間資料庫的角色、原則和廣泛的應用。我們將先討論空間資料庫與傳統資料庫的關係，然後再介紹空間資料庫的整體架構。在理解空間資料的概念和相關模型後，我們將討論管理和處理空間資料的有效方法。主題包括：(1) 空間資料庫的介紹和應用；(2) 空間概念和資料模型；(3) 空間搜尋語言；(4) 空間資料儲存和索引；(5) 空間搜尋處理和最佳化；以及 (6) 空間網路。此外，隨著運算技術和環境的進步，我們也將探討空間資料庫的最新趨勢，例如分散式資料庫、空間大數據、向量資料庫以及人工智慧模型如何助力空間資料庫的發展。

syllabi.outline:
學生將會學習從較宏觀的視野來認識屬於人文與社會層面的環境管理。課程將會透過系統思考及永續創新的角度，來反思地球的現在與未來；闡述新經濟時代的來臨與綠色資本主義的重要性及其四種策略，來緩解氣候變遷及全球暖化的趨勢，創造企業競爭優勢，並開創人類永續發展的新契機。
Students will be guided from a broader and global perspective to learn the social and human aspects of protecting the Earth. Lectures will cover systems thinking and its importance to Sustainable Development. Innovative and emerging technologies for sustainability and "net zero" emissions will be explored. Natural Capitalism and its strategies, Circular Economy, and the Bottom (Base) of the Pyramid (BoP) theory will also be taught to help strive for a sustainable future.

Week 2 系統思考與系統化管理(Systems Thinking and Environmental & Sustainable Systems Management)
Week 3 永續創新及生物模擬－師法自然Sustainable Innovation and Learning from Nature- Biomimicry
Week 4 服務與流動的經濟(產品服務系統)及循環經濟 Product Service System (PSS)& Circular Economy
Week 5 金字塔底層及包容性經濟Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP) & Inclusive Business
Week 6 結語及分組報告(Conclusion and Group Presentation)

name.en: Environmental Economics and Environmental Policies Analysis

description.zh: 政策研究能檢視理論和實務的切合程度。本課程將帶領大家認識環境政策的經濟分析方法，學習經濟的思維觀點，以及如何運用經濟方法瞭解解決環境問題。除此之外上課內容並與法律結合，探討環境法的經濟分析觀點和傳統思維有何不同，尤其是對環境行為上之改變效果。希望學生能夠具體瞭解經濟分析方法幫助政府解決環境問題及規劃環境政策時所扮演的角色。
description.en: There is a significant trade-off between economic growth and environmental quality.  From this course, students will learn fundamental concepts in Environmental Economics and how to analyze environmental policy issues by using economic tools.  In additions, this course combines economic analysis to law, especially shows students how regulations affect people's behavior.  After this class, students not only know how economic approaches help the government deal with environmental issues and the differences between theory and practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程由微觀經濟學角度出發，分析各種環境問題，並介紹各種經濟誘因行政策工具，以補足傳統環境工程教育偏重工程面之不足。
This course applies theories in micro economics to analyze environmental problems. Policy tools that are often applied in solving environmental problems are further introduced and being evaluated using micro economic principals.

．Atmospheric Aerosois and Bioaerosols
．Measurement of aerosol

name.zh: 防減災與氣候變遷調適
name.en: Disaster Prevention and Reduction, Climate Change Adaptation

description.zh: 全球暖化與氣候變遷已對人類社會造成面臨前所未有的挑戰。不論是哪個國家，都遭受其帶來的影響。並且在IPCC發布的報告中，諸多科學證據證實氣候變遷已是不可改變的事實，因此為了謀求世界各地環境的永續發展，「減緩」與「調適」是現階段全球順應氣候變遷積極採取的方式。在聯合國報告中曾經指出我國臺灣舉凡環境及氣候條件隸屬於氣候變遷高危險群，極端氣候事件，例如熱浪、颱風、洪水…等皆逐漸嚴重影響我們的家園，因此，防減災與氣候變遷調適相對更加重要。其中氣候變遷調適更是能夠面對未來氣候可能產生的衝擊，透過周延的規畫以適應充滿挑戰與變化的新環境。因此本課程針對國際與我國減少災害風險與氣候變遷調適介紹，並探討其各中因應方式與困境等課題，期藉培養與提高對氣候變遷防減災與氣候變遷調適的認識。
description.en:
Global warming and climate change are the biggest challenges to human society. With current warming trend proceeds at an unprecedented rate, climate change poses a threat to all countries. In the IPCC assessment reports, much of scientific evidence indicates climate change an unalterable fact, so in order to meet the needs of present generations without jeopardizing the ability of futures generations to meet their own need, approaches on "mitigation" and "adaptation" needed to be adopted in response to climate change. 
Taiwan is vulnerable and at high risk to climate change because of geographic exposure and climatic conditions. Extreme weather events, such as heat wave, typhoon, and flood, bring catastrophic damages in Taiwan. Hence, proper climate change adaptation and disaster risk reduction measures needed to be taken proactively to reduce many of the adverse impacts and to enhance beneficial impacts. description.zh: 本課程主要探討多輸入多輸出系統(MIMO)其系統行為之描述，內容包括MIMO系統之穩定性分析、觀察性分析及其控制器設計，並探討MIMO系統的物理觀念及其數學描述的各種方法，是線性系統之進階課程，適合碩士班以上之學生學習。
description.en: The main objective of this course is to explore the behaviors of multivariable systems. The contents includes: stability analysis, observability analysis, and controller designs for MIMO linear systems. Besides, we will introduce the physical concept of MMIO linear systems and various methods of describing MIMO linear systems via mathematical model. This is an advanced course to linear system theory, and is especially for graduate students.

description.zh: 本課程主要探討非線性系統與線性系統之間的不同，並介紹Lyapunov stability及其相關觀念。除此之外，將介紹如何利用各種穩定性分析的觀念及各種方法探討非線性系統的穩定性，最後並介紹如何設計控制器使非線性系統穩定。
description.en: This course mainly explores the different between the nonlinear system and linear system, and introduces the concept Lyapunov stability. Besides, one wants to introduce how to utilize the concept and method of stability analysis to explore the stability of nonlinear system. Finally, the designs of nonlinear controllers are introduced to stabilize the nonlinear systems.

syllabi.outline: 傅氏光學是波動光學中的基本理論。當光波在像空氣一樣的單純介質中傳播時，光波在兩個平行的平面上的光場分佈呈現著相似於二傅立葉轉換的關係，這樣大大的方便我們以線性系統理論加以分析和計算，於是，我們可以將光學系統中所有的線性元件，包括光在自由空間中的傳播行為，都用二的複數函數加以表示，光學系統便是這些元件函數的組合，這也就方便了我們對它的分析和計算。和幾何光學不同的是，傅氏光學提供了光波中繞射現象的影響，我們也因此可以更完整、精確的計算出光學系統的功用和性能。

syllabi.outline:
(1)基本理論(2)光學薄膜設計之圖示法(3)分光鏡(4)高反射鏡(5)	截止濾光片(6)帶通濾光片(7)斜向入射薄膜

基本理論	 
1.單界面之反射係數(率)與透射係數(率)之計算。
2.探討單層膜各界面之穿透與反射情形。
3.多層膜之反射係數(率)與透射係數(率)之計算。
4.探討多層膜矩陣的一些特性。
5.非相干性之反射與透射之計算。                            

光學薄膜設計之圖示法         
1.利用向量法設計抗反射膜層以及一些膜層之設計。      
2.利用導納軌跡法得知其導納隨膜層厚度的變化有益設計各種不同特性之膜層。

分光鏡	
1.各種中性分光鏡之設計與應用。
2.雙色分光鏡之設計與應用。
3.偏振光分光鏡之設計與應用。

高反射鏡	
1.介紹常用的金屬膜。
2.金屬膜反射率提高及保護膜之設計。
3.利用全介電質四分之一膜堆設計高反射鏡。
4.全介電質膜高反射帶之拓寬設計。
5.探討膜層損耗對四分之一膜堆的影響。

截止濾光片	
1.非干涉型截止濾光片之設計。
2.介紹基本結構之對稱膜堆以及其光學成效進而設計干涉型截止濾光片。

帶止濾光片	
1.利用高低折射率膜堆法設計帶止濾光片。
2.利用折射率漸變膜及非均向膜法設計帶止濾光片。

帶通濾光片	
1.帶通濾光片之介紹。
2.寬帶濾光片與窄帶濾光片之設計。
3.利用對稱膜堆設計多腔窄帶濾光片並探討其吸收特性。
4.誘導透射濾光片之設計。

業界授課	
1.光學薄膜的製鍍方法與製鍍設備的介紹
2.各種光學薄膜之特性介紹與製鍍技術的改進。

description.zh: 本課程介紹固體，尤其是半導體的光學性質，目的在了解光學檢測及光電元件的基礎原理。 藉由學習電磁波與半導體的交互作用，一方面可了解光在半導體中的產生、傳播、吸收、散射、及在界面的透射與反射等現象的規律，另一方面亦可認識光學特性與能帶結構、聲子結構、束縛與自由電子、及各種激發態之間的關係。課程內容包含固態物理複習、光學特性簡介、古典模型、帶間躍遷、激子、螢光現象、半導體低維系統的光學性質、自由載子及缺陷的光學性質、聲子相關特性、非線性光學性質等。
description.en: This course introduces the optical properties of solids, mainly semiconductors. The fundamental principles of absorption, reflection, luminescence and light scattering will be illustrated in terms of classical and quantum theories as appropriate. It mainly includes (1) Introduction (2) Classical propagation (3) Interband absorption (4) Excitons (5) Luminescence (6) Low-dimensional systems of semiconductors (7) Free electrons (8) Luminescence centers (9) Phonons (10)Nonlinear properties.

syllabi.outline: 本課程介紹固體，尤其是半導體的光學性質，目的在了解光學檢測及光電元件的基礎原理。 藉由學習電磁波與半導體的交互作用，一方面可了解光在半導體中的產生、傳播、吸收、散射、及在界面的透射與反射等現象的規律，另一方面亦可認識光學特性與能帶結構、聲子結構、束縛與自由電子、及各種激發態之間的關係。課程內容包含固態物理複習、光學特性簡介、古典模型、帶間躍遷、激子、螢光現象、半導體低維系統的光學性質、自由載子及缺陷的光學性質、聲子相關特性、非線性光學性質等。

name.en: Application of Fiber Optical Broadband Network

description.zh: 以光纖取代傳統銅纜，可避免干擾，傳輸品質佳。且傳輸服務不中斷，網路架構簡單。此外高速FTTB線路具有客戶頻寬管理功能，可依客戶需求提供更彈性、更高頻寬(至1Gbps)。FTTB提供高速上網外，可提供企業VPN、都會網路、校園專案及互動式多媒體(MOD)等多樣寬頻服務。
description.en: Using fiber optics to replace coaxial cable, the method could avoid interference and achieve high-quality of transmission as well as no interrupting transmission services and simple network architectures. Besides, high-speed FTTB have management functionality of customer broadband, which can provide requirements of more flexibility and high bandwidth to customers. FTTB could offer Business VPN, Metropolitan Area Network, school project, MOD, and various broadband services...etc.

syllabi.outline:
本課程深入探討光纖寬頻網路在現代與未來通訊基礎設施中的核心角色，涵蓋從基礎傳輸原理到高階應用服務的完整範疇。
課程著重於光纖取代傳統銅纜的優勢，包括抗干擾能力、卓越傳輸品質、網路架構簡化以及服務不中斷特性。
同時探討高速光纖到大樓（FTTB）系統的頻寬管理功能，並分析其在5G混合專用網路N78、N79與新興跨域物聯網技術(GM2MC)及多元異質網路服務模式。
This course provides an in-depth examination of the pivotal role of fiber-optic broadband networks in both contemporary and next-generation communication infrastructures, encompassing the full spectrum from fundamental transmission principles to advanced application services. Emphasis is placed on the advantages of replacing conventional copper cabling with fiber optics, including superior immunity to electromagnetic interference, exceptional transmission quality, simplified network architectures, and the inherent capability for uninterrupted service delivery. 
The curriculum further investigates the bandwidth management capabilities of high-speed Fiber-to-the-Building (FTTB) systems, alongside a comprehensive analysis of their integration within 5G hybrid private networks (N78, N79), emerging cross-domain Internet of Things (IoT) technologies such as Global Machine-to-Machine Connectivity (GM2MC), and diverse heterogeneous network service models.

description.zh: 生物電化學可以獲得更多先進的訊息，其中包括生化反應、形態學，以及物理、化學和電學等相關性質。運用相關的技術方法，例如電化學工具，可用以研究異相與均相反應，亦可獲得諸多界面間的化學活性和圖譜以利用於微裝置的發展。對生物分析而言，生物電化學感測器具有最大的再現性，並能夠成功的引用於電活性生化物種、母體材料，以及其規格上。生物電分析方法包括最先進和有用的方法，其中大部分皆建立在此領域的的基礎上。
description.en: Bioelectrochemistry can be investigated to get more and more advanced information about biochemical reaction, morphology, and physical, chemical, and electric properties. The techniques have been used in a variety of ways, for example, as an electrochemical tool to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, for high-resolution imaging of the chemical reactivity and topography of various interfaces, and for microfabrication. For bioanalysis, bioelectrochemistry sensors have maximum reliability and can be successfully employed in electroactive biomaterials, matrix materials, and their size. Bioelectroanalysis include descriptions of the most advanced and successful methods, which in large part build on the fundamentals will be described.

Bioelectrochemistry can be investigated to get more and more advanced information about biochemical reaction, morphology, and physical, chemical, and electric properties. The techniques have been used in a variety of ways, for example, as an electrochemical tool to study heterogeneous and homogeneous reactions, for high-resolution imaging of the chemical reactivity and topography of various interfaces, and for microfabrication. name.en: Special Topics of Materials Science and Engineering

description.zh: 本課程主要針對非材料系背景之研究生開設， 對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質）.
description.en: Special topics in 1.The structure of crystalline solids. 2.Imperfections in solids. 3.Phase transformation and phase equilibrium. 4.Strengthening mechanism of materials. 5.Metal alloys 6.Ceramics 7.Polymers

syllabi.outline:
This course is aimed for, but not limited to, graduate students who are lack of background in Materials Science and Engineering. The topics will include: 1.The structure of crystalline solids, 2. imperfections in solids, 3. phase transformation and phase diagram,  4. properties, process and applications of metallic alloys, ceramics, and polymers.

本課程主要針對非材料系背景之研究生開設， 對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質）。

description.zh: 電化學工程特論的領域眾多，舉凡腐蝕現象與電泳作用的探討，電分析感測器或電池元件的製作，以及電鍍、拋光或鋁和氯氣的生產技術等均為電化學工程的範疇。本課程除了介紹基本的電化學原理外，另將著重於電化學分析方法在能源與生醫系統研究上的應用。
description.en: Special topics in the field of electrochemistry include many different phenomena (e.g., corrosion and electrophoresis, electro analytical sensors and batteries devices, and the electroplating of metals and the large-scale production of aluminum and chlorine technologies……). In addition to an overview of the basic principles of electrochemistry, the main emphasis here is on the application of electro-analytical methods to the study of energy and biomedical systems.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在探討如何運用科學與系統化的方式解決管理上的問題。整個過程包括：資料蒐集與問題分析、數量模式的建構、問題求解、成本效益分析、系統規劃設計與執行等步驟。課程內容主要以應用案例說明為主，讓同學瞭解理論如何與實際問題結合，也會介紹最佳化計算軟體來求解數學模式並輔助說明所得數據之意涵。
description.en: The purpose of this course is talking about how to utilize scientific and systematical approaches to solve management problems. The solution process includes data collection and problem investigation, model formulation, optimal solution derivation, cost and efficiency analysis, system implementation and execution etc. This course mainly contains various application cases. Accordingly, participant can understand how to apply theoretical methods on solving real problems. Computational software is also utilized to solve the formulated models and analyze and interpret the obtained solutions.

description.zh: 「企業領導力」是企業經營管理中非常重要元素和指標。我們將由學術理論和商業實務案例中，共同分析和探討企業領導力的管理策略; 並著重於企業價值創新，以培育高教學生具有全球商業開發和經營管理的領導技能。
description.en: The course, Corporate leadership, is offered from a practitioner’s viewpoints on how to deploy the concepts, knowledge, theories and experiences for the development of business leadership practice and to achieve the corporate value creation. In the current market-lead and ubiquitous technology driven world, the Corporate Leadership role is not just the corporate internal management concerning but also needs a broad range of issues, such as cross-cultural knowledge and strategic thinking on business development, communication skills with innovative ideas, and management techniques for the long-term business goals. We will expand the scope and scale of the research related, review articles, complete class projects, and discuss real business cases.

*This is a flipped classroom. You're required to watch my video lectures prior to each class, actively participate in weekly sessions (following the designed course plan), and collaborate effectively with your team members to achieve high scores. This course is designed to be highly interactive.

The primary purpose of this course is to introduce the basic knowledge of the computer operating system, system module, and overall operation mechanism. Course content includes operating system architecture, processes and threads, CPU scheduling, deadlock, memory systems, file systems, I/O systems, and the concepts of computer security.

Course objectives:
* To understand the functions of operating systems
* To understand the design considerations of the components of an operating system.
* To know the important algorithms of operating systems.

description.zh: 嵌入式系統目前愈來愈普遍。它將會大大地影響我們的生活方式。可攜式裝置如智慧型手機、掌上型電腦、以及所謂的IA裝置如家用網路閘道器、數位視訊錄影機、和常見的遊戲機都是屬於嵌入式系統的範疇。在本課程中,我們將會討論何謂嵌入式系統、嵌入式系統的形式、以及如何建構一個嵌入式系統。由於嵌入式系統包含硬體及軟體的議題，我們也會探討相關的主題。 本課程的先修課程包含計算機組織與結構、C程式語言、資料結構、系統程式、以及作業系統。課程主要內容如下：嵌入式系統簡介與概論、嵌入式精簡指令集結構、ARM指令集、嵌入式計算平台、嵌入式程式設計與分析、嵌入式作業系統、系統設計技術、裝置操作、網路。本課程亦包含實習與學期專題作業。
description.en: Embedded systems are more and more popular today. It will affect the human life greatly. Portable devices like smart phone, PDA, and MP3 player, and so-called IA devices such as home gateway, DVR, and game machine are all categorized as embedded systems. In this course, we will discuss what an embedded system is, what it looks like, and how to build an embedded device. Since an embedded system involves hardware and software issues, we will discuss the related subjects. The prerequisite courses for this class include computer organization and architecture, the C programming language, data structure, system programming, and operating system. The major topics of this course are listed as follows: Introduction and Basic Concepts, The RISC Embedded Architectures, The ARM instruction Set, The Embedded Computing Platforms, Program Design and Analysis, The Embedded Operating Systems, System Design Techniques, Device Manipulation, Networks.

syllabi.outline:
An embedded system is a computing system designed for a specific function or set of tasks and integrated into a device or product. 
1. Design and implement a basic communication protocol (packet format, length, checksums, error handling, and retransmission strategy).
2. Use an RTOS (such as FreeRTOS or Zephyr) to establish multitasking, synchronization (Semaphore, Queue, Mutex), and time management.
3. Create a userspace program + systemd service + simple network communication (Socket, MQTT, HTTP) on an Embedded Linux platform.
4. Write modular firmware/system services on an MCU or Linux platform, implementing GPIO, timers, UART, I2C, SPI, ADC, and PWM.

description.en: This course introduces the concepts in big data mining and advanced applications in machine learning. Topics include big data concepts, distributed computing infrastructure, and machine learning methods commonly used in processing big data, such as neural networks, support vector machines. In addition to concept introduction, parallel programming exercises and term projects are included to help students understand the processing steps and practical tools in big data anlaytics.

syllabi.outline:
This course is a graduate-level course for advanced big data analytics and applications. The major topics include: the concepts and principles of big data analytics, frameworks of distributed computing, and applications including: Link Analysis, Social Network Graph Mining, and Recommender Systems. 
In addition to conceptual introduction, with intensive programming exercises in parallel programming and term project, students are expected to learn the big data analytics tools, and to design programs in real big data applications.

description.zh: 本課程講授如何使用Westlaw International資料庫進行IP研究。主要的專利資料庫的檢索方式也會展示。在每堂課前，學生必須要閱讀教材。課堂參與是必須的。其他資訊請見英文課程摘要。
description.en: This course is intended to expose students to various research skills for studying IP issues. Primarily, this course teaches how to use the Westlaw International database to do IP research. The framework of the database is based on the legal research methodology applied to American law. So, the basic knowledge of the American legal research methodology will be introduced. In addition, this course will demonstrate major patent databases to students. Students will be assgined to one research project. Students are required to study reading materials before each class. Class participation is also required.

syllabi.outline:
本課程是學生之「必修」課程，乃是講授如何使用Westlaw International資料庫進行IP研究，而主要專利資料庫的檢索方式也會展示。在每堂課前，學生必須要閱讀教材。課堂參與是必須的。其他資訊請見課程摘要。事實上，本課程之進行，30%以英文講授、70%以中文講授，而且課堂教材以中文為主。

This course is a “required course” for students, and it is intended to expose students to various research skills for studying IP issues. Primarily, this course teaches how to use the Westlaw International database to do IP research. The framework of the database is based on the legal research methodology applied to American law. So, the basic knowledge of the American legal research methodology will be introduced. In addition, this course will demonstrate major patent databases to students. Students will be assigned to one research project. Students are required to study reading materials before each class. Class participation is also required. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 30% and in Chinese 70%, and the class materials are mainly in Chinese.

description.zh: 本課程重點在於台灣專利法的主要法律議題，包括產業利用性、新穎性、進步性、可實施性、說明書支持性、請求項不明確性、請求項解釋、侵權行為、救濟手段、專利授權、強制授權、專利訴訟之展開和舉發。本課程教材包括專利法教科書、智慧局頒發的專利審查基準和智慧財產法院裁判。
description.en: This course focuses on the main legal issues of the Taiwan Patent Law including industrial utility, novelty, inventive step, enablement, written description, claim indefiniteness, claim interpretation, infringement, remedies, patent licensing, compulsory licensing, initiation of patent litigation, and opposition. The class materials include a patent law textbook, patent examination guidelines issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office and recent decisions from the Taiwan Intellectual Property Court.

syllabi.outline:
一、課程內容：本課程係碩士一年級的基礎課程，係對專利法制的一般性、綜觀(巨觀)性介紹；其主要內容：包括我國的專利法制、其他國家的重要專利理論與學說。
二、教學目標：期使同學於期末，能對現今專利法制的重要觀念與趨勢，能有普遍性的認識與瞭解。
三、授課對象，主要為本所一年級的同學，其他系所同學，亦歡迎選修本課程。
四、注意事項：修習本課程的同學，前半學期為專利基礎知識的介紹，而於期中後，則須於上課前閱讀指定教材，並參與課程中的討論與回答問題，期末則需完成一篇期末報告。

description.zh: 為保障商標權及消費者利益，維護市場公平競爭，促進工商企業正常發展，國家特制定商標法，本課程以介紹我國商標法為重點，主要內容包括商標規範之基本原理、商標之構成要素、商標之分類方式及各類型商標之特性與功能、申請商標註冊之程序、商標註冊之審查及核准、商標權之取得及行使、異議程序及紛爭處理、權利侵害之救濟等。
description.en: Trademark Act is formulated to safeguard trademark rights and the consumers' interest, maintain fair competition of markets, and facilitate normal development of industries and commerce. This course is focusing on the introduction of Trademark Act. Topics will mainly include the basic principle of trademark standard, the integrant part of trademark, the characteristic and the function of trademark, the application procedures, examination and approval, acquisition of the trademark rights and exercises, the procedure of opposition and the dispute processes, remedies for right infringement and so on.

name.zh: 科技發展與法律策略：案例研析
name.en: Technology Development and Legal Strategy: Case Study

description.zh: 在科技發展快速的年代，有些人認為產業和市場需要更多新的法律規範，也有些人認為舊有法律需要鬆綁。但無庸置疑地，法律在科技、產業與市場的發展中，扮演著一個攸關重要的角色。基於此，本課程嘗試以設計案例討論，鼓勵不同背景的學生，經由案例分析得到綜合性的知識、從中了解科技發展如何影響法律變遷，並進而學習專業的法律策略。
description.en: In an age of rapid technology advancement, some people might insist more laws are necessary to regulate the industry and the market, on the contrary, others might think de-regulation is the best approach to encourage the free flow of the market. Nonetheless, it is beyond question that law and regulations play an vital role in the technology-driven economy today. Therefore this course is designed to help students from various backgrounds to engage in the group discussions on assigned cases. Students are expected to learn how the technology development shapes the legal environment and learn how to analyze the legal strategies.

name.en: Examination Guidelines for Patent and Utility Model (I)

description.zh: 本課程上學期將以智慧財產局頒佈之「專利審查基準」為藍本，依「先程式後實體」原則先就「程式審查」部分介紹專利申請之程式，再就專利申請之「實體審查」部分依序說明專利說明書暨圖式之構成、可專利類型、產業利用性、新穎性、進步性等專利要件。
description.en: This course will be based on the "Patent Examination Guidelines" issued by the Taiwan Intellectual Property Office, and introduces the procedure for patent application according to the principle of "formality before substantive examination". Firstly, in the "formality examination" section, topics such as the constitution of a patent specification and drawings, the allowable subject matter for patents, utility, novelty, inventiveness and other patent elements, the first-to-file rule, unity of invention, and the priority of an patent application, will be sequentially discussed.

name.en: Practice in Biomedical Materials/Devices Patent Application

description.zh: 本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際醫材產品或相關技術，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利佈局的策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書(含申請專利範圍)撰寫實習，模擬實際上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論之後專利答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
description.en: This course focuses on the procedural aspects of the patent prosecution in biomedical materials/devices. The topics cover patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and office action response. In addition, the practical aspect of international patent prosecution is presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies are also discussed in class.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將以案例研討為討論基礎，準備實際醫材產品或相關技術，讓同學模擬實際申請專利的過程，首先是進行專利檢索與分析，討論專利布局策略；接著讓同學進行專利說明書(含申請專利範圍)撰寫實習，模擬實務上申請各國專利之程序，然後討論之後專利答辯、領證繳費及後續維護事宜。
We will discuss the procedural aspects of the patent prosecution in biomedical materials/devices in this course. The topics cover patent search and analysis, write specification/drawings/claims, and office action response. In addition, the practical aspect of international patent prosecution is presented. The patent filing and maintenance strategies are also discussed in class.

name.en: Exhibitions and the Intervention of Moving Images

description.zh: 隨著各類型博物館廣泛使用動態影像，本課程聚焦在動態影像的歷史、理論與實踐。探究博物館內的動態影像如何以當代藝術實踐手法，重塑空間敘事，挑戰展示傳統。課程主題包含：美術館的當代影像實踐、以物為中心的博物館的展示策略、動態影像技術、策展策略和數位媒體的影響。課程預計分析藝術作品、探索展覽空間，並探討科技技術、觀眾參與和藝術表達之間，彼此交互不斷演變的關係。
description.en: With various types of museums widely incorporating moving images, this course focuses on the history, theory, and experiential aspects of such imagery. It delves into how moving images within museums, employing contemporary artistic practices, reshapes spatial narratives and challenges traditional displays. Topics include contemporary image practices in fine art museums, object-centred museum display strategies, technology, curatorial strategies, and the impact of digital media. The course entails analyzing artworks, exploring exhibition spaces, and discussing the evolving relationship between technological advancements, audience engagements, and artistic expression to cultivate critical skills in curation and interpretation.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹企業的管理系統如何有效的計畫、設計和分析及實行，包括管理系統的分析、可行性研究、系統設計、系統發展、雛形設計、測試、文件製作和評估等。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to provide the students with a broad understanding of information systems, information technologies, information systems development and management in business and other organizations.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠：
1.	訓練研究生學術期刊論文研讀及講評能力
2.	論文研究計畫大綱撰寫
3.	論文發表口頭練習

syllabi.outline:
本課程在使學生了解各種資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，包含目前熱門資訊科技議題以及發展趨勢，並以實際個案進行學術研究。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。上課方式為教師資訊系統議題分享、論文探討、個案分系討論以及分組課堂報告討論為主，訓練學生提出具有研究價值之論文研究計畫為目標，本課程目的有三：
(一)	建立學生對總體數位科技環境的認知，提升未來職場資訊技術以及學術研究之觀念性技能開發。
(二)	訓練研究生學術期刊論文研讀及講評能力。
(三)	透過分組進行研究探討及口頭練習論文發表及論文研究計畫大綱撰寫。

description.zh: 本課程主要闡述財務管理中最重要的投資決策、融資決策與短期資金管理決策之基本架構及企業經理人之財務決策，配合各項相關議題進行個案研討，結合資訊工具與軟體運用、以深入淺出方式介紹財務管理之基本觀念及理論架構，並搭配財務軟體、財金資料庫、與財金資訊網站的應用。藉由這些資訊工具與技術，將財務管理的觀念與原理加以運用於重要的融資與投資決策制定。課程內容涵蓋：金融市場與金融機構、財務報表與現金流量分析、財務規劃與預測、風險與報酬、債券與股票之評價、資金成本、資本預算決策、資本結構與財務槓桿、營運資金管理、股利政策…等。本課程結合財務管理實務並融入財務決策研討，以培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才。透過本課程之修習，期許學生能具備財務管理領域之學科知識與專業技術整合能力、獨立研究之能力、判斷性思考與決策能力，以及制訂並解決財務管理問題之能力。

description.zh: 本課程主要是在於介紹一些駭客常用的攻擊方法和可能使用工具，並藉由這些技術的解說讓學生瞭解實際駭客的攻擊行為與思維模式，進而習得如何保護所管理的網路或資訊系統免於被攻擊成功。課程中將輔以實機操作，教導您如何利用現有電腦資源掃描及測試系統的安全問題，藉以保護系統安全，課程中將加強實際的上機操作，藉由上課所模擬的網路環境中，讓同學能夠實際感受攻擊的可能實況
description.en: This course is mainly to introduce network and system attack methods and security assessment tools used by hackers, and to explain the attack behavior and thinking strategy of hackers through the explanation of these technologies. In addition, this course teaches students learn how to protect the managed network or information system to against from being compromised successfully. The course will be supplemented by practices, and teaching students how to use the existing tools to scan and test the security of the system. In order to protect the security of the system, the course will focus on the system and network practices, which can let the students feel the possible network and system attacks.

description.zh: 來自於內部與外部的攻擊使企業在系統及網路保護遭遇許多挑戰，為了有效控制企業風險，政府在內部控制相關法規明確要求資訊系統相關的內部控制，而電腦稽核為確保內部控制的關鍵角色。本課程內容以國際電腦稽核師(CISA)認證的各項領域內容為主。期望學生能夠對於瞭解資訊系統稽核及其風險管理相關概念有初步的瞭解，進而瞭解資訊安全及資訊系統稽核的機制與手法，作為協助學生順利考取國際電腦稽核師(CISA)認證碁石。
description.en: Internal and external attacks have caused enterprises to encounter many challenges in system and network protection. In order to effectively control enterprise risks, the government's accounting regulations explicitly require information system-related internal controls, and computer audit is a key role for ensuring internal control. The content of this course is based on the content of various fields of the International Computer Auditor (CISA) certification. Students are expected to have a preliminary understanding of the information system audit and its risk management related concepts, and then understand the mechanisms and techniques of information security and information system auditing. Finally, it is expected as a way to help students successfully obtain the CISA certification.

description.zh: 本門課程是財務、電腦、與數學的結合，其主要目標為啟發學生如何設計電腦演算法來解決財務或經濟上的問題。一開始，此課程會複習一些基本的知識，如利率期間結構、選擇權評價理論、隨機過程模型、數值方法、與寫程式時所需的資料結構。之後，會講到一些新奇選擇權的演算法，包括亞洲式選擇權，障礙選擇權、回顧選擇權、重設選擇權、彩虹選擇權、可轉換公司債。
description.en: The major goal of this course is to provide students with complete understanding of many financial markets and products. Topics such as forward and futures, swaps, and options will be fully covered. In addition, the basic pricing methods of these innovative products will be emphasized in this course. Finally, even to a MBA student, the knowledge mentioned in this course is sure to be helpful for his (or her) future career.

syllabi.outline: This course will shed light on the methodology for evaluating derivatives, hedging and managing investment risk. The pricing algorithm will be implemented in C language and Matlab. The problems that will be dealt with include the approximation of internal rates of returns via the bisection and Newton method,  and the calculation of spot rate curves via the bootstrap method.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹數位金融理論以及介紹代表性的實務案例，課程中除了學習數位金融及人工智慧專業知識外，並結合實作來了解如何應用APP及聊天機器人於智慧金融及金融行銷等領域。在實作過程中，將鏈結進駐金融科技創新園區金融機構及新創公司所有業師資源，共同創建教學大綱和案例研究，並導入業師進行課程教學或講座或協同教學 (Co-teaching)，在授課過程中，學生不僅可以學習到APP的應用程式開發以及最有系統的方式學會如何設計並建立一支經過用戶體驗設計（介面設計與互動設計）的Chatbot，同時教導學生如何透過實證場域驗證進行串接API，發想創意，鼓勵金融創新實證之共創生態發展、降低金融科技創新實證門檻、同時兼顧創新風險控管與不影響市場運作機制，並將科技導入進行創新創業。課程內容包括：創業思維、設計思考、數位金融創新商業模式、無現金社會新興平台與行動支付的發展趨勢、保險科技 (InsurTech) 的應用及發展趨勢、籌資模式演進與P2P 貸款、金融科技的新興資訊工具應用發展趨勢、虛擬貨幣與區塊鏈專題探討、及機器人理財與AI的創新應用等，並探討數位新科技與人工智慧發展對金融產業衝擊、新典範的反思與影響。
description.en: This course will provide students with the latest empowering and practical knowledge on Digital Finance enabling them to understand some of the FinTech changes taking place currently in the financial services industry and, most importantly, the trends that will impact the industry in the future. The course content will include peer to peer lending platforms and crowdfunding, internet finance, online finance, bitcoin, digital currencies, digital payments, big data, insurtech, machine learning and its applications in FinTech such as robo-advising. etc. and their practical impact on global banking and finance.

The course content will include peer to peer lending platforms and crowdfunding, internet finance, online finance, bitcoin, digital currencies, digital payments, big data, insurtech, machine learning and its applications in FinTech such as robo-advising. etc. and their practical impact on global banking and finance.
syllabi.schedule:
教學進度規劃如下：

1. 課程主題：金融科技的發展演進
課程內容包括：金融科技之起源與發展、金融科技對傳統金融業之衝擊、國際銀行業金融科技之因應趨勢、我國金融科技之發展政策、數位新科技對金融理論衝擊、新典範的反思與影響

2. 課程主題：雲端運算
課程內容包括：雲端運算的定義與特色、雲端運算的三大服務模式、雲端運算佈署的三種模型、雲端運算的應用、雲端運算的安全問題

3. 課程主題：大數據與新市場平台
課程內容包括：數據資料的基本單位、大數據的定義及特性、大數據資料類型、大數據資料分析的五步驟、金融業大數據應用方向、大數據發展的困難與挑戰、新市場平台

4. 課程主題：人工智慧
課程內容包括：人工智慧簡介、人工智慧於金融之應用發展、人工智慧的風險與挑戰、人工智慧發展對金融產業發展衝擊、反思與影響

5. 業師專題演講：互聯網金融創新模式發展與應用
課程內容包括：互聯網金融定義、互聯網金融的應用、互聯網金融的發展趨勢及應用案例

6. 課程主題：Blockchain(區塊鏈)的發展與應用
課程內容包括：區塊鏈定義、區塊鏈的形成、特性、制度類型、優點以及在金融上與商業上的應用

7. 課程主題：生物辨識技術
課程內容包括：生物辨識的緣起、生物辨識技術種類現況、導入何種最適生物辨識技術之評估、生物辨識在金融創新之運用現況與趨勢

8. 課程主題：保險科技創新模式及發展趨勢
課程內容包括：保險科技定義、保險科技簡介、保險科技之應用與發展、保險科技的影響與挑戰

9. 業師專題演講：金融科技園區Open API資源介紹、應用及串接實作
課程內容包括：金融科技園區Open API資源介紹、Open API應用案例、金融科技園區RESTful API串接實作等，並透過「數位沙盒」驗證環境試行國內第一個「場域限定」金融科技創新實證API數位共通環境

10.	課程主題：聊天機器人介面設計與AI 簡介(學生實作)
課程內容包括：什麼是人工智慧?人工智慧發展的歷史、聊天機器人介面設計、人工智慧應用與實作

11. 課程主題：聊天機器人於金融商品數位行銷之應用(學生實作)
課程內容包括：建置智能聊天機器人學生實作、數位行銷功能導入Line Bot應用

12. 業師共授與學生實作：聊天機器人串接 Open API應用工作坊
課程內容包括： Chatbot 建置與Open API串接、LINE Chatbot Open API 案例介紹、Jupyter實作

13. 業師共授與學生實作：APP製作與串接API之應用
課程內容包括：使用軟體Thunkable及APP Inventor資源介紹、APP製作及開發技巧、股市資料庫資料API之串接實作

14. 業師共授與學生實作：股市資訊查詢APP 之製作與開發
課程內容包括：股市資料查詢APP製作、選股APP介面開發及應用、APP上架Google Play商店實作

15. 課程主題：創新創業資源與創業計畫書之撰寫
課程內容包括：政府創新創業資源簡介、創業計劃書撰寫技巧、創業簡報架構

16. 課程主題：如何與投資人共創價值與專利佈局
課程內容包括：投資人的類型與屬性、募資計畫撰寫、新創估值評價方法、專利佈局實務簡介

17. 分組專題期末報告(一)
課程內容包括：分組專題的科技應用應分為兩個部分，一是導入通用式AI透過串接Line及Facebook的API建置聊天機器人；二是透過Thunkable 製作 App，以及應用App串接外部的API，來發揮App所應包含之功能     。首先將透過競賽篩選出具有發展潛力及可行性最高的學生團隊；其次，參與本校與金融科技創新園區合作開展「金融科技API 數據應用培育計劃」，內容包括：金融科技 API 介紹、技術指導與實際操作應用、學生小組討論主題實作，最後是成果發表。     

18. 分組專題期末報告(二)
課程內容包括：分組專題的科技應用應分為兩個部分，一是導入通用式AI透過串接Line及Facebook的API建置聊天機器人；二是透過Thunkable 製作 App，以及應用App串接外部的API，來發揮App所應包含之功能首先將透過競賽篩選出具有發展潛力及可行性最高的學生團隊；其次，參與本校與金融科技創新園區合作開展「金融科技API 數據應用培育計劃」，內容包括：金融科技 API 介紹、技術指導與實際操作應用、學生小組討論主題實作，最後是成果發表。

description.zh: 雲端(Cloud)與物聯網(Internet of Things, IoT)重塑了整個計算世界對於事物的運行方式。除了為各行業提出了新的前沿應用外，也衍生更多在兩者融合對於管理、資訊安全與隱私保護等不得不重視的課題。本課程主要討論雲端與物聯網相關的安全性問題，包括由物聯網衍生出來的新威脅、弱點及兩者融合的相關安全議題。引領學生具備發展雲端與物聯網安全的重要觀念與技術，進而可以分析、設計與規劃未來物聯網與雲端運算融合之應用、與安全管理。
description.en: Cloud and the Internet of Things (IoT) have reshaped the way things are performed across the computing world. In addition to proposing new cutting-edge applications for various industries, there are also more issues that must be paid attention to in the integration of the two, such as management, information security and privacy protection. This course mainly discusses the security issues related to cloud and the IoT, including new threats and weaknesses derived when the two technologies converge. To lead students to understand important concepts and technologies for cloud and IoT security, and then to able to analyze, design, plan application and implement security management of the integration of the cloud and IoT.

description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

description.en:
The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis.
This research methods one focus on quantitative research that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis, research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

本課程之目標在於研討互動設計和互動媒體之相關研究專題，藉由密集討論以及設計專題之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本課程另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究和創作。教學將以課堂講授、場域觀察以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。

互動媒體設計專題是互動設計研究所碩一的重要專題課程，採分組指導方式。本學期本組(黃儀婷老師組別)的課程預計以USR專案: 原住民部落安居構築與綠色樂業推動計畫；南投仁愛鄉賽德克東岸部落之災害來臨應變app開發作為個案研究重點，藉由與部落族人和土木系水土保持研究室的密集討論、學生彼此間有效率地交換意見，獲得對此議題更深入的體驗，以增強學生之研究、分析、及實作能力。

本課程鏈結SDG11所探討的永續城市與社群及SDG15-保育陸域生態的主題。授課教師本身為USR- 原住民部落安居構築與綠色樂業推動計畫的共同主持人，負責第三期USR 賽德克東岸部落的互動行銷規畫與實踐項目，然2023年8月初的卡努風災導致土石流導致我們的場域家園毀損嚴重，因此本USR計畫將調整執行方向到災害應變和復原。故此次課程亦將以” 當災害來臨 app”作為專題，預計在課程中開闢三個講次談SDG11/15相關的概念和東岸部落的災前災後生態復育，另安排一次東岸部落的據點觀察(移地教學)及四週當災害來臨 app討論和實作課程實施。

description.en: The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. syllabi.outline:
Principle of Interaction Design: Autumn 2024 - Syllabus
Credit Hours: 2.0
Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang

Course Description: 
"Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in the areas of visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design, and industrial design purposes. 
An interface is the link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” to take place between users and design.
 This course will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and able to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and interaction design practices. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function", and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences, and understand the role that interaction with content and installation fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas.
This class is devoted to lecture, discussion, practice activities, design work sessions, and critique of practical work. 


Course Objectives/Goals: 
At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 
1.	Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 
2.	Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 
3.	Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 
4.	Apply iterative cycles of research, testing and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals and experiences. 
5.	Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 
6.	Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 
7.	Utilize client-based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction, and interface design. 
8.	Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction, and interface design.

syllabi.outline: Interaction design can be considered as an extension of the long-established fields of architectural, industrial, and graphical design. This course introduces the concept of digital pipeline which is mediated on wide range of image related digital technologies. Through those modularized technologies, we can form a working pipeline to create a prototype for an interaction design proposal.

description.zh: 本課程介紹整合即時影像、即時音訊、實體裝置、及相關表演科技（如燈光控制、各類感應器應用等）之技術與應用實務，並藉由圖形化、物件導向程式設計系統，引導未有程式設計經驗的視覺設計者或輔助已有程式設計能力者，以更有效率的方式進行相關互動系統設計，藉以達成互動裝置、表演科技、與表演藝術之整合。
description.en: This course introduces the technology that help integrates real-time video, audio, installations, and associated performance arts technology (such as lighting control, the application of various types of sensors, etc.) into performing arts. Through a graphical, object-oriented programming system, the course is intended to help visual designers with no programming experiences or to assist experienced programmers to efficiently design the interactive systems that combine interactive installations, performance arts technology, and performing arts itself as a whole.

syllabi.outline:
This course will explore the possibilities and developments of using interactive technology in contemporary performing arts and installation design. It will introduce forms and aesthetics of interactive performance, computer vision and listening, real-time video processing, and real-time audio synthesis. Through proposing and executing actual performance projects and interdisciplinary collaboration, students will have the opportunity to integrate interactive technology, interactive installations, and performing arts. The course will emphasize project proposal and conceptualization, performance scripting, stage and interactive installation design, and interactive audio-visual application design.

本課程將探討互動科技運用於當代表演藝術、裝置設計之可能性與相關發展，並介紹互動表演形式與美學、電腦視覺與電腦聆聽、即時影像處理、即時音訊合成等，藉由實際展演計畫之提案與執行，透過跨領域合作，讓學生有機會將互動科技、互動裝置、表演藝術三者結合。本課程將注重展演計畫之提案與發想、表演之腳本安排、舞台與互動裝置設計、互動影音應用設計等。

description.en: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. syllabi.outline: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and practical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis. This research method course focuses on quantitative research that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis (i.e. SPSS), research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The teaching methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

description.zh: 系統工程是一個專注於複雜系統設計、開發和管理的工程領域，通常涉及許多不同類型的元件。 系統工程結合了幾個不同領域的方面，包括機械工程、電氣工程、工業工程、生產工程、化學工程和電腦科學，以分析、設計和管理複雜的系統。 系統工程工作的例子可能包括分析流程和生產週期、最佳化製造或分銷系統，以及開發系統模型或改進現有系統等項目。本課程將包含：基礎系統工程概論、專案生命週期、系統設計流程、產品實現、技術管理等部分。
description.en: Systems engineering is a field of engineering that focuses on the design, development, and management of complex systems, often involving many different types of components. Systems engineering combines aspects of several different fields, including mechanical engineering, electrical engineering, industrial engineering, production engineering, chemical engineering, and computer science, to analyze, design, and manage complex systems. This course will include an introduction to system engineering, project life cycle, system design process, product realization, technical management.

description.en: The aim of the Space Science & Technology Seminar is to enable students to understand and master practical skills and knowledge in the field of space engineering, as well as to cultivate their teamwork, problem-solving, and innovative thinking abilities. Students will undertake a practical space engineering design project to understand the design, testing, implementation, and management processes of space engineering through practice, and demonstrate project outcomes through reports, presentations, and assessments. Through this course, students can understand the latest developments in the field of space engineering, master relevant skills and knowledge, and enhance their teamwork and project management abilities. This course can also provide practical exercises through industry-academia collaboration.

syllabi.outline:

The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

description.zh: 本課程以實踐機器人和人工智慧應用為核心，採用美國麻省理工學院（MIT）的專案任務導向學習模式。透過結合講授、討論、實際應用和案例分析，課程將會幫助學生深入理解人工智慧和機器人技術。學生有機會積極參與小組項目，透過情境思考實際應用所學知識，並親自操作機器學習工具和機器人平台，以培養實際技能。
description.en: This course is designed for the practical application of robotics and artificial intelligence (AI). It adopts the project-based learning model inspired by the Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT). The course combines lectures, discussions, and case studies to give students an in-depth understanding of AI technology and robotic applications. Students can engage in group projects, apply their knowledge in real-world scenarios, and gain hands-on experience with machine learning tools and mobile robot platforms.

syllabi.outline:
學生自備: 電腦及Python3 環境
課程大綱: 
這是個由麻省理工學院教授所設計的課程。同學們將循序漸進的了解機器人作業系統與AI的運用。本課堂業界最先進的四足機器人——波士頓動力公司研發的AI狗, Spot。透過這堂課程，學員將了解最新的AI技術。透過AI狗的運作原理、相關機構設計，馬達設計，機電架構，高階控制軟體。課程將提供最新的SPOT軟體與API的運用。同學們將不僅有機會親手操作SPOT，還將為SPOT開發各類自動控制與AI應用。

隨著機器人的普及，同學們也將學習機器人的控制軟體ROS2。並了解各式傳感器的運用，如LiDAR、Radar、IMU、相機等機器人領域的硬體。也將運用ROS2來做高階的運用，如地圖建構、定位、導航，路徑規劃，模擬工具，AI影像辨識與機器學習等應用。課程結束後學員能夠由基礎到進階，逐步掌握AI機器人的技術。此外，透過小組協作，實機操作與課程互動，同學們將上課習得的知識需轉化成解決問題的技能。挖掘知識如何應用。

With the increasing adoption of robotics, students will learn the robot operating software ROS2 and gain an understanding of various sensors such as LiDAR, Radar, IMU, and cameras, which are essential in the field of robotics. They will also apply ROS2 in advanced applications, including mapping, localization, navigation, path planning, simulation tools, AI-based image recognition, and machine learning. By the end of the course, students will be able to progressively master AI robotics technologies, from the fundamentals to advanced topics. In addition, through group collaboration, hands-on practice, and interactive learning, students are expected to transform the knowledge acquired in class into problem-solving skills, exploring how to apply what they have learned in real-world contexts.

description.en:
This course covers the following Topics.
1.Theory of air cleaning Mechanism.
2.Clean room configuration, construction and         verification.
3.Air filtration theory.
4.Paper discussion.

syllabi.outline: To teach students with scientific and theoretical approaches for the design of state-of-art cleanrooms (including industrial and bio cleanrooms), while providing students with hands-on knowledge of practical experience.
syllabi.schedule:
Cleanroom history and application (2 hrs)
Design criteria of industrial and bio cleanrooms (2 hrs)
Ventilation theory for cleanroom(4 hrs)
HVAC theory for cleanroom(6 hrs)
Mid-term exam(3 hrs). 
Facility system – nine sub-system(6 hrs)
Utility system – gas, water, power etc. (3 hrs)
Airborne molecular contamination – influence, testing, and solution(3 hrs)
Cleanroom testing, adjustment and balancing(3 hrs)
Cleanroom verification (3 hrs)
Final design project (9 hrs)
syllabi.assessment:
Mid term exam 30%
Final eaxm 30%
participation 20%.
homework      20%

description.zh:
本課程擬建立學生對於半導體製程中真空技術等基礎認知，做為未來投入半導體產業時學習製程設備之知識基礎；本課程亦提供真空設備產業資訊與技術概況。
本課程包含半導體製程中真空技術及薄膜工程知識，真空技術內容包含真空原理、系統、量測與測漏；薄膜工程則是在真空技術基礎上，提供學生半導體薄膜製程與設備原理，內容涵蓋半導體元件製程常用之薄膜技術(PVD、CVD、ALD與磊晶)。
description.en:
In this course, basic knowledges of vacuum technology and thin film engineering will be provided, and can be the foundation for learning semiconductor process equipment as students join the industry.  Vacuum equipment and industry outlook will also be covered.
Basics of vacuum principle, equipment and measurement/leak detection will be provided in the course.  With the basics of vacuum technology, students will further explore the knowledge of thin film processes, such as PVD, CVD, ALD and epitaxy, especially for manufacturing semiconductor devices.
The syllabus of course is outlined as follows.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生們一個可以改善他們的科技英文寫作技巧的環境，內容將包括：1. 扼要複習英文句型與文法，2. 撰寫論文常發生的錯誤，3. 分享論文審稿的經驗，4. 提供淺顯實用的寫作原則，5. 同儕分享讀論文與寫作的錯誤心得。
description.en: This course provides an environment to help students improving their English skill in writing technical paper or thesis. What will be included in the class are: 1. concise review of sentence structure and grammar, 2. frequent writing mistakes of paper or report, 3. share of the experience in paper review, 4. offering simple and practical writing principles, 5. share the experience in reading and writing papers.

syllabi.outline: The goal of this course is to improve the reading and writing ability of graduate student. The contents include general formats of sentences, vocabularies, reading skill, and infrastructure of English report and academic papers.

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

description.zh: 課程內容主要介紹無機化學研究過程中﹐所使用的各種物理方法。首先介紹光譜學之基本原理。隨後將較深入的探討應用在無機化學與固體材料上的各種光譜技術。包括：各種吸收光譜、核磁共振光譜、電子順磁共振光譜、Ｘ光吸收光譜及Ｘ光繞射等應用於化學之常用分析技術﹐也都包括在課程討論範圍之內。

syllabi.outline: The course content mainly introduces various physical methods used in the research process of inorganic chemistry. First, the basic principles of spectroscopy are introduced. The various spectroscopic techniques applied to inorganic chemistry and solid materials will then be discussed in more depth. Including: various absorption spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, electron paramagnetic resonance spectroscopy, X-ray absorption spectroscopy and X-ray diffraction and other commonly used analytical techniques in chemistry are also included in the course discussion. The content includes chemical bonds, molecular vibrations, electronic spectra of transition metal compounds, atomic cluster compounds and crystal structures.

description.zh: 本課程說明如何利用質量及動量守恆建立可以描述速度、應力及壓力等流體系統物理量間關係之統制方程式。其內容包括：線及角動量守衡、應力張量、平滑近似理論、非穩態流動、邊界層近似法、線性穩定度理論及紊流系統。
description.en:
We will learn how fundamental principles such as conservation of mass and momentum lead to equations that govern or describe the interrelationships of velocity, stress, pressure, and so on. Content includes macroscopic balance for linear and angular momentum, the stress tensor, 
lubrication approximation, unsteady flow、the boundary layer approximation, linear stability theory, and turbulent flows.

syllabi.outline: This course surveys the principal concepts of fluid dynamics. Topics include mass and momentum conservation, the Navier-Stokes equation for viscous flows, as well as dimensional analysis. Emphasis is placed on being able to utilize the concepts to solve the real problems encountered during conducting research

name.zh: 半導體材料檢測技術及原理

description.zh: 本課程將探討半導體材料之表面化學性質之分析技巧、以及界面和分子間引力之量測方法、表面形態分析、晶相結構分析以及電磁性質量測之技術和其原理。並針對半導體材料的特性，實際操作拉曼及FTIR顯微鏡、原子力顯微鏡、x光光電能譜、以及材料晶相、機械、電磁特性相關設備。
description.en: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the Raman/FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, x-ray photoelectric spectrometer. Furthermore, instruments to measure crystalline, micro-mechanical, and electrical properties specifically for semiconductor materials will also be introduced.

syllabi.outline: This course will present the techniques and their corresponding theories on the surface property measurements including chemical information, stress analysis, morphology, crystalline structure and intermolecular forces between interfaces. The course also includes a practical training on the FTIR microscope, atomic force microscope, reology meter on the semiconductor materials.

description.zh: 本課程探討電子材料性質、固態物理基礎、元件物理等相關內容，強化電子材料與半導體元件技術之關聯性，藉由剖析材料結構與元件電性，深入探討電子元件在實際應用時可能遭遇之材料議題。本課程將介紹多種半導體元件技術應用，內容包括p-n接面、發光二極體與太陽能電池等。
description.en: This course will introduce the material properties, the basics of solid-state physics, and semiconductor devices and physics to provide knowledge of electronic materials and modern semiconductor devices. The content will include various semiconductor device technologies, such as p-n junction, light emitted diodes (LEDs), and solar cells.

description.zh: 生質能源(bioenergy)指的是儲存在現有(活著或剛失去生命)的動植物體的能量。生質能源的來源，主要是植物將太陽能經由光合作用轉換成葡萄糖，在進一步合生物高分子衍生物(如多醣體(polysaccharides)) 。新一代生質能源技術強調環保技術，整合跨領域之技術，包含應用分子生物技術所發展出之基因轉殖、醱酵控制及生物觸媒技術-利用生物酵素進行催化化學反應達成環保及高效率與節能之目的。本課程將介紹動植物的多醣體種類及如何運用新興生物系統學的技術開發生質能源。
description.en: Bioenergy is referred to the energy stored in living or recently living biological organisms, such as animals, plants and microbes. The source of bioenergy can be traced back from plants harvesting the sunlight and converting it to glucose, then to other biopolymers such as polysaccharides. The technologies for developing bioenergy, with an emphasis on environmentally compatible, consist of gene cloning technology from molecular biology and enzymatic control and catalytic chemistry (i.e. green chemistry).  The course is an introduction course on the types of polysaccharides in animals and plants, how scientist use system biology to develop bioengergy.

description.zh: 本課程介紹如何將電化學技術應用於生物燃料電池上。生物燃料電池的觸媒主要是由酵素或是微生物甚至是生物細胞所組成，反應過程區分為電子直接轉移(mediatorless)與間接轉移(mediator)，並介紹此各種生物燃料電池的原理及應用，個別討論電池之反應過程、電池電極材料、電化學修飾電極及各種不同電池電解質溶液等個別元件。
description.en: The aim and purpose of this course is to introduce and expand the electrochemistry to develop the biofuel cells. Generally the catalysts of biofuel cell are composed by enzymes, microbial, creature cells and the bio-reduction process. In the biofuel cells the reaction process can be distinguished into mediator less and mediator transfer process. In this course, we will introduce the principle, reaction process and the application of biofuel cells. Especially, a detailed study about the utilization of film modified electrodes and different electrolyte solutions for the development of biofuel cells.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹如何將電化學技術應用於生物燃料電池上。生物燃料電池的觸媒主要是由酵素或是微生物甚至是生物細胞所組成，反應過程區分為電子直接轉移(mediatorless)與間接轉移(mediator)，並介紹此各種生物燃料電池的原理及應用，個別討論電池之反應過程、電池電極材料、電化學修飾電極及各種不同電池電解質溶液等個別元件。
The aim and purpose of this course is to introduce and expand the electrochemistry to develop the biofuel cells. Generally the catalysts of biofuel cell are composed by enzymes, microbial, creature cells and the bio-reduction process. In the biofuel cells the reaction process can be distinguished into mediator less and mediator transfer process. In this course, we will introduce the principle, reaction process and the application of biofuel cells. Especially, a detailed study about the utilization of film modified electrodes and different electrolyte solutions for the development of biofuel cells.

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

成績標準：出席&報告
(1)上課請親自簽名於座位表上，請勿代簽。
(2)每出席一次完成簽到得總成績4分，繳交當次出席的心得報告再加4分，若該次專討未出席，不得繳交心得報告。
(3)整學期繳交六份手寫 300 字稿紙之心得報告（用稿紙且寫滿300字、不可空行、不可抄上課ppt、可不寫時間日期及上課題目，若沒用稿紙完成則不算分），並將報告拍照成 pdf檔或 jpg檔，於上課當日至隔日下午17 點前，上傳至網路 I 學園，逾時不接受補交(因於第三、四周才開放上傳，故僅本次能補上傳前兩、三周之報告) 。 
(4) 心得報告繳交除六份外，每多寫一份加總成績 2 分，至多可多繳二份報告。
(5) 上課後一周內，由邀請老師之研究室同學製作海報，將張貼於中走廊，檔案經指導教授審閱修正後，將電子檔傳楊先生信箱，並註明製作人學號姓名，可抵一份心得報告。
請假規則：（於系網列印填寫專討用請假單）
(1)事假：務必於上課前填妥請假單並檢附相關證明，並請指導教授簽名繳回系辦，逾時視同曠課。
(2)病假：請於事後一周內填妥請假單，並檢附就診證明，請指導教授簽名繳回系辦，逾時視同曠課。
(3)出席專討課程請勿穿脫鞋上課。
(4)期中、期末考週均不上課，將不另行通知。
(5)請隨時注意系走廊電視或系網頁公佈上課相關訊息。(題目&上課地點)
(6)本學期欲提出寒畢同學，需事先登記上台報告論文，方能申請提出口試。

description.zh: 本課程將有系統的介紹專業英文論文的寫作格式，以及文件編修的技巧，且用深入淺出的例子作為示範，並輔以實際寫作練習與錯誤訂正。學員學習研究論文組織寫作﹐包含修改本身論文結構之基本技巧﹐正確組織文章的各個片段﹐避免口語用字寫字的陋習﹐使所作之文章能掌握其涵意﹐亦即能更有效率的利用英文寫出科技論文之佳作。
description.en: The goal of English Technical Writing is to help students developing the writing skills through the manipulation of scientific and technical data. Students will learn a variety of rhetorical principles that guide the writing process, apply these principles to scientific and technical writing, and write papers in their own academic fields. Lectures on the writing principle, students' presentations on the reading sections and follow-up activities, pair and individual work on writing practice will be the major activities in the class.
