syllabi.outline:
課程中主要的訓練可分為三個方向：一、人為環境管理；二、自然環境管理；三、環境系統分析。在此規劃方向的考慮下，將會邀請專家學者進行相關主題的演講。參與者透過密集討論、書面報告、或舉行口頭發表等方式，可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的認識。
Three categories are stressed in these basic training courses: the management of human environment, the management of natural environment, and the system analysis towards environment.  Under the above goals, inviting addresses for special topics will be arranged though the courses.  The Participants are encouraged to have intensive discussion, written reports, or further oral presentation.  Efficient opinion exchange would be also expected to derive more extensive interest.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供所有博士生共同參與研究討論的園地。將進行設計專題報告、專題演講、研究小組討論。論文撰寫、投稿及專題報告
1.人數：全部博士生參與，與授課老師協商指導，需於本學期末之前投稿，提交投出證明，方才取得學分。
2.論文投稿範圍：以最近5年內與論文相關之SCI、SSCI、EI、A＆HCI、TSSCI（如科技部2014年通過之相關TSSCI名單：戶外遊憩研究、地理學報、住宅學報、建築學報、都市與計劃、運輸計劃季刊、運輸學刊、台灣土地研究、歐美研究、藝術教育研究…）或該領域經審查後出版之學術性期刊文章；或國內外研討會。
3.語文：中英文皆可，需於本學期末之前投稿，提出證明，方才取得學分；並請準備演講或報告摘要給同學參考。
4.時間：論文進行定期全班報告，由授課老師共同排定時間；其餘週次，各組帶開，由授課教師進行論文討論。
5.作業討論繳交：論文題目確定、撰寫過程與分組授課老師討論。論文投出後學期結束前，以E-mail繳交全文及投稿證明給所長，由全體授課老師評分。未完成繳交視同期末考缺考，不得補交，成績不及格論。

syllabi.outline:
本課程透過創新科技之電腦，心理學，人機互動應用多學科類期刊文導讀，來建構學生對設計研究者在投稿專業期刊時所應具備的專業背景理論知識的探索，透過廣泛閱讀與師生討論的形式引導學生能夠對其感興趣的研究進行論文撰寫與期刊投稿。建構學生基本概念與專業技能，並引導其發展具有創意潛力的研究題目，訂立，與主題發展，最終引導到資料分析與評估，並讓學生能夠藉由對該研究主題的瞭解與實際操作進而具有撰寫國際頂尖一流期刊的專業能力。

1. 給予修課同學在收集、閱讀及分析學術期刊文獻上的訓練。 
2. 透過現場討論的方式培養積極參與學術活動的動機與辯證態度。 
3. 了解其他學術單位的成就及最新學術發展方向。

description.zh: 研究生在第一年必須選定指導教授，以決定設計創作或論文寫作的方向，從事設計創作的研究生必須發展創作理念、創作過程與實作說明，最後彙整創作報告形同於研究論文；從事論文寫作的研究生針對互動媒體設計的相關主題進行研究，並將研究成果撰寫成為論文，其內容包含緒論、文獻探討、研究設計與實施、研究結果與討論、結論與建議等。本課程目的旨在培養獨立企劃研究能力，建構研究設計與研究寫作的能力，對設計創作組而言，過程中培養協同合作的能力是必須具備的要項。
description.en: In the first year graduate students are requested to determine design creation and research topic under the supervision of their advisor. Graduate students who are chosen the fields of design creation should be developed creation principle, design process and practical work. The results of design creation are considered as research thesis. Graduate students who are focus on the research of interactive media design should be undertaken the results of research as a thesis. The content of thesis includes introduction, literature review, research design and approaches, results and discussion, conclusion and suggestions. The aims of this course are to provide students with opportunity to initiate personal research into industrial design related topic. The course includes a training of developing research, writing up and references. To design creation groups. The collaborative capability is in need of the cultivation of ability during the process.

syllabi.outline:
1. Students will be able to solve dynamic mass and energy balances for chemical processes.
2. Students will be able to understand of the unit operations with a focus on liquid-liquid and fluid solid separation processes, membrane separation processes, and mechanical-physical separation processes.
3. Students will be able to calculate and design the unit operations in multi component systems.
syllabi.schedule:
1st week : Introduction conservation momentum, mass, and energy
2nd week: Liquid-liquid and fluid-solid separation processes (Ch. 12)
3rd week : Batch adsorption and design of fixed-bed adsorption columns
4th week : Ion-exchange processes and liquid-liquid extraction
5th week : Liquid-solid leaching and crystallization
6th week : Membrane separation process (Ch. 13)
7th week : Liquid and gas separation by membranes 
8th week : RO membrane processes and short review for midterm exam
9th week : Midterm exam 
10th week: Applications membrane processes
11th week: Mechanical-physical separation processes (Ch. 14)
12th week: Solid-liquid separation
13th week: Settling and sedimentation in particular-fluid separation
14th week: Centrifugal separation process
15th week: Mechanical size reduction
16th week: Review and problems exercise
17th week: Review and problems exercise
18th week: Final exam

description.zh: 稀土是高科技產品必備元素且應用廣泛。本課程主要介紹稀土元素在化工、生物科技、生醫工程、綠色能源、光電半導體、奈米科技、環境工程等諸多領域中的應用。除此，並探討台灣發展稀土產業因應對策。
description.en: Rare earths are essential elements in high-tech products and are widely used. This course mainly introduces the application of rare earth elements in chemical industry, biotechnology, biomedical engineering, green energy, optoelectronic semiconductor, nanotechnology, environmental engineering and many other fields. In addition, countermeasures for the development of Taiwan's rare earth industry will also be discussed.

syllabi.outline:

description.zh: 反應工程是在商業規模之考慮下對化學反應開發利用之相關工程活動。其目的在成功的設計和操作化學反應器，並使化學工程在工程專業中成為一個獨特的支系。此高等反應工程是延續大學部己學習在均相中有關之簡單觀念及理論，並推展到非均相較複雜系統之設計及操作上。學生在修習此課後，對於較複雜之反應器有清晰及整體之概念。
description.en: Under commercial scale consideration, chemical reaction engineering is that engineering concerning the exploitiaton of chemical reactions Its goal is the successful design and operation of chemical reactors and it sets chemical engineering apart as a distinct branch of the engineering profession. This aduanced chemical reaction engineering is a continuative study of simple idea and principle for homogeneous systems and extended to heterogeneous and more complex systems for design and operation. After study in this course, the student can obtain clear and unified coucept of complex reactor systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程之目的在於使學生瞭解化學反應工程之原理以及訓練學生能夠應用此些原理於設計，分析或操作化學反應器。此課程首先複習大學部已學習在均相中動力學之基礎理論，再推廣至非均相較複雜之系統。

In this course, a structure is developed that allows the student to solve reaction engineering problems through reasoning rather than through memorization and recall of numerous equations, restrictions and conditions under which each equation applies. A special emphasis on bioreaction engineering and more industrial chemistry with real reactors and real reactions will be covered and wide range of applications to which chemical reaction engineering principles will be applied.

description.zh:
本課程主要的概念於利用設計思考以使用者導向之設計方法，將使用者需求作為設計提案及解決方案的啟始點，並整合分析設計對象、使用者所遭遇的問題、如何提高性能及實現可擴展性等問題。透過資料科學與工具的整合應用，導引資料分析人員與設計專業人員進行跨領域的整合，以建構未來設計創新的機會與願景。
課程的主要目標是：1.建構以用戶為導向之人本設計重要設計流程。2.使用高品質的數據，可以創建設計工件，滿足真實使用者的需求。3.鼓勵學生在互動設計領域中，整合兩者的優勢，建構未來的設計優勢和機會。4.最重要的目標是確保使用者體驗人本設計的品質。
description.en:
"The IxD uses their sensibility and methods to match users' need in a way that is technologically feasible and viable enough to generate user value and tap market opportunity. The idea is, design thinking puts user and their needs as the starting point of developing new product and solution and ask questions like for whom are we designing, what is the problem user is experiencing, how to improve the performance and achieve scalability, among others.
The main objectives of this course provide:
1. Creating a vital user-centered design process.
2. Work with the high-quality data, design artifacts can be created, addressing the needs of the real user.
3. Encourage student to mix these two together in IxD to reap design benefits and opportunities.
4. The most important objective is to ensure the quality of user-centricity of user experience.

syllabi.outline:
使用者導向之設計已成為大多數互動設計的依循主軸。他翻轉了以產品為導向的傳統，強調以使用者的偏好引領設計的價值。而這就是設計思考的方法導入互動設計中，利用其敏感性和方法，透過可行及可用的技術滿足使用者的需求，從而產生使用者價值並發展市場機會。研究建議，由世界級的設計公司IDEO所主導，設計思考與決策科學相結合，觸發了同理心設計與工程技術的融合。這不僅可以確保提出兼容實際性和創造性地問題解決方案外，而且在設計的開始便融入使用者導向的設計概念，將有助於創新設計與解決方案的提出。同時，在設計的初始階段導入資料應用與分析的方法，更能在設計中正確的整合敏感性，技術可行性，商轉可行性和使用者的需求。
本課程主要的概念在於利用設計思考以使用者導向之設計方法，將使用者及其需求作為設計提案以及解決方案的啟始點，並整合分析設計對象，使用者所遭遇的問題，以及如何提高性能以及實現可擴展性等問題。並透過資料科學與工具的整合應用，導引資料分析人員與設計專業人員進行跨領域的整合，以建構未來設計創新的機會與願景。
本課程主要是希望能連結科技與設計人才，做跨領域的學習。本課程的核心主軸，將利用史丹佛大學d.School所提出設計思考的方法，針對資料科學的關鍵知識進行跨領域的盤點、整理與設計，以創造其具人本設計(Human-Centered Design)的創新價值。
本課程將採用專案/問題導向(Project/Problem-Based Learning)的學習與互動模式。因為是跨系選修的課程，將於課堂上組成跨領域的學習團隊，鼓勵跨領域的學生從不同的情境模式，連結「資料探勘」之核心課程。「類神經網路」與「深度學習」的進階課程，及「語音辨識與人機互動」的應用課程等相關內容。並同時應用於探討資料科學有關資料蒐集、建構、過濾、品質驗證、分類處理、模式應用、資料視覺化處理、及分析敘事的核心知識。並於課程操作過程中，透過「資料導向敘事(Data-Driven Storytelling)」的方法，呈現跨領域創新學習的成果。

以圖像語言的架構教授分析性繪圖 (Analytical Drawing Process) 的概念與操作，以及分析性繪圖在設計速寫上的應用。課程以課堂講解與實地速寫來進行，主題包括感知與理解層面的三維觀察與紀錄、圖解、與圖像筆記。
教學目標為：
1.介紹分析性繪圖與徒手草寫。
2.訓練以徒手草寫的過程來觀察、分析、與記錄結構、空間、與建成環境的三維特性。
3.熟悉感知與理解的圖學系統與速寫表現手法，能以圖像筆記來記錄設計主題。
description.en:
This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.
The objectives are:
1.Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2.Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3.Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

syllabi.outline:
Seeing is a creative process that involves our eyes and mind to transform what we see into what we know, but sometimes the process is reversed—we rely on what we know to interpret what we are seeing. To draw what we see can, therefore, be a process of the interaction of seeing and understanding. The goal of this course will focus on this seeing, thinking, and drawing interaction while drawing architecture on location. This course introduces the concept of analytical drawing process, and how to utilize it in design sketching.

1. Introduce the concept of analytical drawing process and techniques of freehand sketch. 
2. Develop the ability to see and analyze the three-dimensional characteristics of an observed object and encountered environment through analytical drawing process. 
3. Familiar with both conceptual and perceptual form of representation, and be able to take a visual note to document an investigated subject.

description.zh:
本課程旨在利用電腦模擬與計算工具，深入探討化學工程領域的核心知識，涵蓋化工熱力學與化學反應工程兩大主題。    

在熱力學部分，課程將介紹如何透過化工模擬軟體Aspen Plus及其連結的資料庫，進行物性、化性及物質間相互作用力的分析。並藉由不同熱力學模型，計算混合物的相圖。課程也將運用生成式AI輔助，指導學生撰寫狀態方程式與活性係數模型的電腦程式，以強化理論與實務的結合。

在化學反應工程部分，將透過Aspen Plus的反應式建構功能，介紹動力學模型在實務上的應用。課堂將包含使用Aspen Plus進行不同類型反應器的模擬，並分析與解讀熱力學與動力學數據。

此課程對於化工系學生，將深化熱力學與反應工程基礎，強化單元設計與模擬能力，為頂石課程中的化工程序設計打下堅實基礎。對於非化工專業學生，則能透過電腦模擬與計算，理解化學工程教育的核心概念，為跨領域學習提供起點。
description.en:
This course aims to utilize computer simulation and computational tools to explore fundamental knowledge in the field of chemical engineering, covering two major topics: chemical engineering thermodynamics and chemical reaction engineering.

In the thermodynamics section, the course will introduce how to analyze physical properties, chemical properties, and intermolecular interactions using Aspen Plus, a chemical process simulation software, along with its integrated databases. The course will also explore the calculation of phase diagrams for mixtures using various thermodynamic models. Additionally, generative AI tools will be employed to guide students in writing computer programs for equations of state and activity coefficient models, bridging theory with practical application.

syllabi.outline:
課程定位與適修對象：
本課程歡迎化工系大二至大四學生選修，作為加強核心科目理解與研究所考試複習的實用課程。課程也特別歡迎其他理工科系學生跨域選修，透過電腦模擬的方式，直觀理解化學工程中複雜而抽象的理論與系統概念。

本課程不需任何程式或理論先備知識，所涉及的內容皆會重新以淺顯易懂的方式重新講解。針對數位工具與程式不熟悉的學生，將提供ChatGPT 輔助教學與學習策略，引導學生克服學習障礙，發展數位素養與跨領域問題解決能力。

課程目標：
(1) 以電腦模擬與生成式AI工具（ChatGPT） 為輔助，學習化學工程三大核心領域：熱力學、反應工程、單元操作（含熱整合）。
(2) 結合理論與實務，讓學生能透過程式撰寫、圖像化資料分析與模擬介面，直觀理解參數空間與模型本質。
(3) 使用 Aspen Plus 化工模擬軟體進行實際操作與應用模擬，涵蓋分離、反應、熱交換等程序模組。
syllabi.schedule:
第16週(12/25)及第17週(1/1)為國定假日，不上課。

此課程設計部分保留彈性，會依學生組成與教學節奏調整：

第1週：課程介紹、學習資源說明、Aspen Plus 與 ChatGPT 工具操作導引
第2～3週：化工熱力學入門、物性資料庫介紹、VLE/phase diagram 模擬與理解
第4～5週：狀態方程式（EOS）與活性係數模型說明，使用 ChatGPT 撰寫簡單熱力學模型程式並圖像化參數空間
第6～8週：反應工程基本概念與反應器模擬（PFR、CSTR 等）
第9週：期中模擬任務：指定反應或分離系統，學生以Aspen Plus建模並提出觀察與改良方案
第10～12週：分離程序設計與操作（吸收、萃取、蒸餾）
第13～14週：膜分離與特殊設計單元，進階模組介紹
第15～16週：熱整合與能源再利用模擬，探討單元間能量轉換與回收機制
第17～18週：期末專題簡報與討論，可採個人或小組進行（模擬專題選擇與資料圖像分析）
syllabi.assessment:
(1) 平時練習與操作紀錄：60%
包含 Aspen Plus 模擬操作、ChatGPT 指令撰寫與模型驗證、參數圖像化等課堂指定任務。
(2) 期中模擬任務報告：20%
指定一項化工程序模擬，進行模型建構、結果分析與技術說明。
(3) 期末專題簡報與報告：20%
以小組或個人形式完成模擬應用專題，整合熱力學、反應工程與分離單元，進行簡報與成果展示。

description.zh: 奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
description.en: Nano/micro engineering in bio-medicine applications has become increasingly important. The development and operation of measurement tool for biomedical applications has a close correlation to the actual size of the object. In this course we will explain the principles of devices and discuss the applications based on the school's research laboratories, including sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules, cells, and tissues. Students will be required to do a project about Nano-micron biomedical sensor systems, nano-biomaterials and nano-biomedical areas such as optical and lab-chip. The interim and final report should devote to the topic and plans in the search for the direction of Creative Thinking with a view to the breakthrough of theory or application, and actively promote the integration of advanced interdisciplinary research and technology.

syllabi.outline:
奈微米工程於生物醫學之應用日趨重要，量測與操作工具的開發與實際的生醫應用對象的大小尺寸具有密切的相關性，對於生物系統的充份瞭解是工程表現的重要過程之一。在此課程中將配合本校實驗室目前之相關研究設備進行原理講解與應用討論，包括之項目將由分子、細胞到組織之感測、分析與操縱。選修學生須依下列重點：奈微米生醫感測系統、奈米生醫材料、奈米生醫光電以及實驗室晶片等領域選擇期中期末報告之題目與計畫內容，主要要求在尋求創新思考方向，以求在原理或應用上的突破，積極推動跨領域與技術先進之整合性研究。
The application of nano-micron engineering in biomedicine is becoming more and more important. The development of measurement and operation tools is closely related to the size of actual biomedical application objects. A full understanding of biological systems is one of the important processes of engineering performance. In this course, the principle explanation and application discussion will be carried out with the current research equipment in our laboratory, including the sensing, analysis and manipulation of molecules. Elective students should choose the topics and project content of the mid-term report in the fields of nano-micron biomedical sensing system, nano-biomedical materials, nano-biomedical optoelectronics, and laboratory chips. The main requirement is to seek innovative thinking , In order to seek breakthroughs in principles or applications, and actively promote integrated research across fields and advanced technologies.

Fundamental principles of modern communication will be investigated in depth in this course, with emphasis on analog communications.Basic modulation techniques will be introduced with nosie analysis.Contents include
1.Introduction 
2.Signals and Systems
3.Probability ,Random Process,and Nosie
4.Amplitude Modulations:DSB,AM,SSB,and VSB
5.Angle Modulations:FMand PM
6.Pulse Modulations:PAM,PWM,PPM,PCM,and DM
7.Intorduction to Digital Communication 
Students who want to know more details sbout digital commmunication are encouraged to take the course Digital Communication Systems

name.zh: 顧客關係管理與商業智慧
name.en: Customer Relationship Management and Business Intelligence

description.zh: 顧客關係管理主要目的是了解企業與顧客之關係，促使顧客滿意及忠誠回應而產生終身價值，進而提昇企業獲利，其內容包括顧客關係管理的概念與本質、顧客行為、顧客資料探勘、顧客關係管理系統、顧客關係管理專案之規劃與管理、顧客關係管理的績效衡量、顧客關係管理實務研討。商業智慧(Business Intelligence, BI)，是企業利用現代資訊技術收集、管理和分析結構化與非結構化的企業資料與資訊，創造和累積企業知識與見解，以改善企業決策品質與採取有效的企業行動，進而提升企業各方面績效。由基本現場管理(Shop Floor Control)需求談起，然後介紹製造資訊分類與收集技術（包括RFID），也將包括資料庫與資料倉儲觀念，最後介紹BI於顧客關係管理之應用。課堂中也將輔以目前市面上商用BI套裝軟體，並將其專業上相關資訊在此系統上實際應用，體驗BI對企業之重要性。
description.en: The objectives of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) are to study the relationship between corporation and customer, to increase the profit by customer lifetime value through customer satisfaction and royalty. The topics of this course includes concepts and context of CRM, consumer behavior, customer data mining, CRM system, planning and management of CRM projects, performance measurement of CRM. Business intelligence (BI) systems refer to applications and technologies which gather and analyze data about company operations. It then provides a comprehensive correlation of those factors, such as metrics on sales, production, internal operations, and helps managers to make better business decisions. This course focuses on applications of BI in CRM, with the introduction of shop floor control concepts and data collection techniques such as RFID, along with database and data warehouse concepts. Hands-on experience in BI software implementation is also emphasized.

description.zh: 為加強學生設計實務能力，本課程規劃學生赴家具相關產業，至少為期4.5個月之校外實習，並於期滿後須由接受實習單位提具實習證明及成績考核。次一學期開學後，學生必須繳交書面或經口頭實習成果發表，由指導教師檢核實習單位成績考核，以給予實習學生最後評量成績。
description.en: For the purpose of enhance senior students' practical skill in design, the course is established to encourage students to intern in the industry for no less than 4.5 months. The student will then be evaluated by the industry, and by the lecturer through the examination of a written report and/or an oral presentation to demonstrate his/her effort.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

description.zh: 先修課程:負責教授同意．煞車動力學，煞車性能之極限，液壓煞車系統及元件，鼓式煞車，碟式煞車，駐車煞車，真空輔助動力煞車，液壓輔助動力煞車，電動輔助動力煞車，防鎖死煞車系統．
description.en: Brake Dynamics, LImit of Braking Performance, Hydraulic-Brake-System Components, Drum Brake, Disc Brake, Parking Brake, Vacuum-Assist Power Brake, Hydraulic-Assist Power Brake, Electro-Hydraulic-Assist Power Brake, Antilock Brakes System。

syllabi.outline: 先修課程:負責教授同意。煞車動力學，煞車性能之極限，液壓煞車系統及元件，鼓式煞車，碟式煞車，駐車煞車，動力煞車，輔助煞車，防鎖死煞車系統，穩定控制系統，ADAS系統，商用車輛、Hybrid Car、EV之煞車系統，煞車定期檢驗測試。
syllabi.schedule:
1.課程簡介，成績評量標準。
2.煞車系統功能，煞車能量類型，分迴路煞車系統類型，摩擦式煞車類型。
3.踏板力及踏板行程，人力煞車系統，具有助力器之煞車系統，煞車系統局部失效時性能標準，車輛減速度及停止距離，駕駛反應時間。
4.CNS,ECE及美國聯邦汽車安全標準，煞車系統設計基本原理。
5.鼓式煞車結構應力分析及調整，碟式煞車結構應力分析及調整。
6.停車煞車設計，煞車摩擦襯片材料。
7.煞車防鎖死裝置ABS，BAS煞車輔助系統
8.制動力矩分析，自緊力和自鎖，煞車制動效能因數。
9.期中考
10.煞車溫度及熱應力分析，煞車助力系統分析。車輛定期檢驗之煞車測試。
11.商用車輛之煞車系統介紹，煞車動力學計算範例。
12.輔助煞車，排氣煞車，引擎煞車，液壓緩速器，電子緩速器。
13.煞車管路壓力控制裝置，各種閥比較分析。制動力係數，制動效率分析。
14.車輛電子穩定控制系統EVSC/VSC/ESP，AEB，ADAS系統介紹。
15.Hybrid Car 、EV之 再生式煞車系統Regenerative Brake System。
16.行憲紀念日
17. 元旦
18.期末考

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生實務能力，學生利用整學期至各相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。
description.en: This course, off-campus practice, aims to provide practical training for undergraduate students through working in enterprise environments. During one semester, students go to enterprises or organization related to energy, air-conditioning and refrigerating industries and learn application-oriented skills. After completing the course, the organization for internship will provide training certifications and evaluate the score of students. The intern should write internship report and send the report to department office.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
description.en:
The first objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.

syllabi.outline:
課程旨在帶領學生於全球化多元的商業環境下，思維倫理在複雜的企業決策過程中所扮演之重要角色。引導學生認識企業倫理的內涵，並透過自編教材、教科書內容與個案探討，啟發學生對相關主題的興趣，體認企業倫理確實於日常生活中頻繁出現，而不僅為形而上的哲學觀。本課程擬藉由課堂的情境移轉，培養具有企業倫理的企業經理人。
本課程的目的將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任（如：產品綠化與環境保護），（2）消費者的保護（如：產品的安全性），（3）員工的權益（如：職業健康），（4）員工對公司的責任（如：利益衝突），（5）雇主與員工關係（如：性別平等）。
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate Social Responsibility (e.g., Green product and environmental protection), (2) Consumer protection (e.g., Product safety), (3) Employee's rights and benefits (e.g., Occupational health), (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms (e.g., Conflict of interest), and (5) Employer-employee relations (e.g., Gender equity).

syllabi.outline:
現今企業面臨嚴峻的挑戰，諸如科技變革、市場波動、政治鬥爭、氣候變遷等，變動頻繁的經濟、社會、自然環境，都是對企業永續經營的考驗。近年來，「永續創新」幫助企業永續發展的作用引起學者、經理人和政策制定者的廣泛關注，由於創新是解決經濟、社會和環境問題的關鍵，企業愈來愈傾向於投入永續創新，透過全新或改良的產品、服務、管理流程、系統程序、商業模式等，創造共享的社會和商業價值，減少對環境造成的負面影響。因此，永續創新指的是持續提升產品、流程與人力品質，共同為您的客戶、員工與環境打造一個更光明永續的未來。
Nowadays, firms face severe challenges, such as technological revolutions, market fluctuations, political conflict, and climate change. This swiftly transforming economic, social, and environmental milieu poses rigorous tests to corporate sustainability. In recent years, the concept of "sustainable innovation" has garnered significant attention from academics, executives, and policymakers, acting as a cornerstone in facilitating the sustainable progression of organizations. Innovation stands as an essential tool in grappling with economic, societal, and environmental quandaries, prompting an increasing number of companies to channel resources towards sustainable innovation. Such investment aims to generate shared socio-economic value and curtail adverse environmental impacts by pioneering or refining business products, services, processes, procedures, and methodologies. description.zh: 排程主要在規劃與排定活動執行的優先順序，以使各項資源得到最佳的運用。本課程主要在介紹生產排程的基本理論與方法，使學生奠定排程研究與排程實務問題解決的基礎。
description.en: Scheduling consists of planning and prioritizing activities that need to be performed in an orderly sequence of operation. It is a tool that optimizes use of available resources. This course focuses on the basic concept on scheduling. The purpose of this course is to guide the students to learn the basic methodologies of scheduling, and to understand the scheduling application aspects.

description.zh: 本課程主要是讓學生在畢業之前即獲得車輛產業的職場經驗，此經驗包括有職場倫理外，也讓學生意識到學校教育與現實職場間的差異、產業對人才的選擇標準、自我能力基本要求的考驗、和未來可就業的相關企業。進而檢討自我的未來生涯規劃。學生需每週40小時於企業實習，並於期末繳交實習報告。
description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a vehicle engineering related company. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

name.zh: 計算機概論與程式設計
name.en: Introduction to Computer Science and Programming

description.zh: 計算機系統之基礎觀念介紹及應用。主要內容包括：計算機系統簡介,，資料的表示法、數字系統、邏輯，周邊裝置及儲存體，程式語言與程式設計，作業系統，檔案與資料庫。本課程引入程式設計的觀念與方法，於熟習基本程式語法後，再導入進階程式語言。著重邏輯思考與程式設計能力之訓練，同時輔以程式設計過程所應注意之程式結構、偵錯、可攜性、軟體工程的基本概念，使修習者得以奠定程式設計之基礎。
description.en: This introductory course covers the fundamentals and applications of computers, including: introduction to computer systems, data representation, number systems, and logic, peripherals and storage,  programming languages and programming, operating systems, files and database systems. This course introduces to the students the basic computer programming concepts. Syntax and semantics of the programming language.

description.zh: 財務報表所反映的是企業的經營績效，不同的產業有不同的特質、不同的經營環境，即使在相同的產業中，企業若採行不同的競爭策略，在財務報表上也會有不同的表現。本課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何透過財務報表，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：1) 基本財務報導與特別科目的報導與分析 2) 基本分析理論 3) 償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 5) 探討我國最近發佈的7號、34號及35號會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of this course is to help students evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes 1) financial reports and analysis of special accounting subjects; 2) basic financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別為：從全球化角度認知社會可接受的商業行為，將待人和善深植於良好的企業中，企業形象再造，強化職業倫理以及投資於可持續發展和有社會責任的公司。本課程亦教導學生瞭解今日快速變化工商界，符合企業倫理的公司治理原則與方式。課程的教導將朝下列五個方向進行：（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
description.en:
The first objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: recognizing socially acceptable business conduct from the global perspectives, embedding good business in treating people nice and fair, reengineering corporate image, enhancing professional ethics, and investing in sustainable and socially responsible corporations. This course also discusses with the students the corporate governance that follows business ethics in today's changing business society. Five major categories will be covered: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹企業倫理的意涵及其與一般倫理的差異，並深入探討與臺灣和國際社會相關的倫理議題和案例。透過討論問題和互動交流，學生將培養道德判斷能力和國際視野，以應對企業倫理所面臨的挑戰。

1. 導論
   - 瞭解倫理、道德、企業倫理和一般倫理的基本觀念
   - 探討企業倫理在現代社會中的重要性

2. 倫理教育與道德發展
   - 探究企業倫理教育的推行和道德發展的過程
   - 討論校園倫理教育、倫理意識、決策和判斷等相關議題

3. 倫理判斷與教學操作
   - 探討倫理判斷的教學方法和操作
   - 分析行政倫理、非政府倫理和職場倫理等相關議題

4. 企業社會責任與環境保護
   - 瞭解企業社會責任的概念和實踐
   - 探討環境保護的倫理議題和企業公民責任的重要性

5. 跨國企業的倫理挑戰
   - 分析跨國企業所面臨的倫理議題和挑戰
   - 探討永續發展和社會責任型投資的相關議題

課程結構以對應目次中的章節來進行，並在每個章節中安排相關的倫理案例和討論問題，以促進學生的學習和思考。此外，課程結尾包含選擇題和問題研討，供學生進行自我測驗和答問，以鞏固所學知識。

description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 瞭解計算機之硬体組織與資料結構等基本原理及其應用，並介紹各種程式語言特性，內容包括：1.計算機簡介：介紹計算機之演進及計算機之種類與特性，2.計算機系統簡介：介紹計算機系統的組成及軟硬体系統所含概之內容，3.資料的表示法與數字系統：介紹數系及文數字表示法，4.輸出入裝置及儲存体：介紹各種輸出入設備及資料儲存体，5.程式語言與程式設計：介紹各種程式語言結構，及撰寫之方法，6.資料結構：介紹資料在記憶体內之各種排列方法以節省記憶空間及提高存取效率，7.作業系統：介紹各種管理電腦資源的系統軟体及其作業方式，8.檔案與資料庫：介紹各種檔案的類型及資料庫之基本架構，9.資料通訊與計算機網路：介紹資料通訊之種種特性及電腦網路之結構與類別，10.人工智慧：介紹人工智慧基本概念及基本功能。
description.en: This introductory course covers the fundamentals and applications of computers. Contents include: 1. Introduction to computer 2. Introduction to computer system 3. Data representation and number system 4. Input/Output and storage device 5. Programming language and design 6. Data structure 7. Operating systems 8. File and database systems 9. Data communication and computer networks 10. Artificial intelligence.

description.zh: 探討家具製造之最新技術，側重量產設備及其與產品工程的關係。介紹木材加工原理及最新量產設備之性能，以便依據家具特徵如組件形狀，材料性質，及產量多寡等考量，提出有效率的加工計畫（製造流程）。講授家具製造作業程序（從原料接受、備料、細作、裝配以迄塗裝、包裝、發貨等其間之種種細節），特別是以計量的觀點來看家具製造問題，以避發生瓶頸，製造系統整体概念之培養，尤為重點。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. This course provides students with an understanding of the principles of wood machining processes and the capabilities of modern production woodworking equipment. Students learn to develop efficient process plans (machining sequences) based on product characteristics such as part geometry, material composition, and production volume. Emphasis is on operations, and the integration of many types of equipment into a manufacturing system. This course specially requires the students to view the manufacturing process in quantitative terms.

syllabi.outline:
探討台灣傳統家具產業的歷史脈絡與傳統生產模式，台灣傳統板式家具生產與系統板式家具生產之間的主要差異,並從「生產方式」、「設計流程」、「設備應用」、「標準化程度」與「管理模式」分析產業導入自動化技術後的轉型模式，進而探討AI世代對家具設計與空間製造的影響，激發學生創意思維，提出AI導向的家具創新，綜合所有因素做出家具設計方案
 This study explores the historical development and traditional production models of Taiwan’s furniture industry, focusing on the key differences between conventional panel furniture production and system panel furniture production. It further analyzes the industry’s transformation following the adoption of automation technologies from the perspectives of production methods, design processes, equipment application, degree of standardization, and management models. Additionally, the study examines the impact of the AI era on furniture design and manufacturing, aiming to stimulate students’ creative thinking and promote the development of AI-driven innovative furniture design solutions. By integrating all of these factors, the goal is to formulate comprehensive and forward-thinking design proposals.

description.zh: 1. 瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含： (1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件， (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等， (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應， (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域， (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。 2. 瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路， (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析， (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換， (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數， (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用， (6)Laplace轉換及應用。

Fourier series, Fourier transformation and application, 14. Laplace transformation and application.

syllabi.outline:
本課程內容著重熱力性質、狀態、過程、和循環之說明與應用。並從熱力學第零定律引導，說明各定律之內容與重要性。
應用端將以濕空氣性質、空氣調節、冷凍循環和能源流向計算為主軸，詳細說明熱力學如何應用於能源系統規劃與分析。
This course focuses on the explanation and application of thermodynamic properties, states, processes, and cycles. Starting with the zeroth law of thermodynamics, fully explains the content and importance of each law.
To instruct the application of thermodynamics, the course focuses on the properties of moist air, air conditioning, the refrigeration cycle, and energy balance analysis, detailing how it can be applied to energy system planning and analysis.

quality.

outage.

problems.

syllabi.outline: 本課程為數值分析技術應用課程, 主要針對在職碩士專班以上之學生而設計。電控技術在現代工業應用中扮演著不可或缺的角色，但以往較專注於PLC程式或介面程式撰寫。因此，本課程的目的在使學生了解電控技術背後所需的數學方法與理論背景，其內容包括Matlab/Simulink軟體平台介紹、數值方法、類神經網路分析與設計。

name.zh: 深度學習與類神經網路

description.zh:
深度學習探討如何能利用深層類神經網路，由觀測到的資料中自我學習，自我進化，而能有效進行預測，分類，偵測，辨認與決策，以建立人工智慧。
本課程為進階的機器學習課程，將會花相當多的時間深入探討各種不同的訓練方法不同結構的類神經網路。包括深層類神經網路，卷積類神經網路，遞迴類神經網路等等網路架構，與監督式學習，非監督式學習，強化式學習，對抗式學習等等訓練方法。
本課程並會要求學生實現各種不同類型的類神經網路，將其著應用在解決多種人本人工智慧服務設計問題。包時間序列預測，物體偵測與辨認，語音訊號處理、影像訊號處理、自然語言處理，音訊訊號處理等多種人本資訊處理。
description.en:
Deep learning is a branch of artificial intelligence that focuses on how to use deep neural networks to self-learn and self-evolve from observed data, as well as to effectively predict, classify, detect patterns and make decisions.

This course is an advanced machine learning course that delves into different neural network structures and training methods. Students will be asked to implement different neural networks to solve various human-centered artificial intelligent service design problems (e.g., time series prediction, object detection, image recognition, speech signal processing, video signal processing, natural language processing, audio signal processing, etc.).

description.zh: 本課程主要目標為將數學方法應用在工程問題，課程內容有常微分方程，線性代數，向量微積分，及偏微分方程式等之簡介，訓練同學數學應用於工程計算及研究。內容包括數值方法，機率理論及數學機率等。
description.en: The main target of this course is to intoduce mathematical methods ot engineering applications; the course will cover areas in differential equations and vecto calculus. This course will also train students in applying mathematics to engineering calculations and research, such as unmerical methods and statistical methods.

syllabi.outline:
課程目標:
本課程旨在建立學生於工程與應用科學領域中必備的數學工具能力，涵蓋常微分方程、拉普拉斯轉換與特殊函數等主題。透過對數學理論的講解與實例應用分析，提升學生處理實務工程問題之邏輯推理與數值解法能力，並培養其獨立建模與數值模擬的能力。

教學方法:
課程以「理論說明 + Matlab實作演練」進行，授課教師於黑板上詳述數學公式推導後，搭配電腦實作展示如何利用Matlab工具進行模擬與解題。鼓勵學生攜帶筆記型電腦至課堂，現場操作程式碼，加強理解。課後亦提供程式範例，協助學生進行自主練習與應用延伸。

Course Objectives:
This course aims to build students' ability to use mathematical tools necessary for engineering and applied sciences. It covers ordinary differential equations, Laplace transforms, and special functions. Through explaining mathematical theories and analyzing practical applications, students' logical reasoning and numerical solution abilities in dealing with practical engineering problems are enhanced, and their independent modeling and numerical simulation abilities are cultivated.

Teaching Methods:
The course is conducted as "theoretical explanation + Matlab practical exercises." The instructor explains the derivation of mathematical formulas on the blackboard and then uses practical computer exercises to demonstrate how to use Matlab tools for simulation and problem-solving. Students are encouraged to bring their laptops to class and practice programming on-site to enhance their understanding. After class, programming examples are also provided to help students conduct independent practice and application extension.

第5週	二階非齊次常微分方程	待定係數法與常數變異法
第6週	高階常微分方程與系統建模	Matlab中的ODE求解器應用
第7週	微分方程數值解法（一）	Euler法與改良Euler法程式撰寫
第8週	微分方程數值解法（二）	Runge-Kutta法與應用實例
第9週	期中報告	含理論與Matlab應用學習心得
第10週	拉普拉斯轉換（一）	基本定義、性質與轉換表使用

第14週	特殊函數於物理問題中的應用	Matlab繪圖與工程應用展示
第15週	Fourier分析初步	正交函數與頻域解析概念

syllabi.materials:
1. 自編講義與已發表SCI期刊研究內容說明
2. 基礎理論說明使用 Richard, C. Dorf., Modern Control Systems, ADDISON-WESLEY, 1991.
3. 冷凍空調節能方面，台灣日立空調公司開發AI控制邏輯導入分離式空調節能案例說明，可透過Fuzzy control、Genetic Algorithm-optimized control與Model-based Predictive Control (MPC)，搭配變頻器與電子膨脹閥等底層裝置，進行智慧控制。
4. 儲能與建築智慧能源管理方面，包括AI於建築節能與能源負載削減的應用。本人主導將MPC與Fuzzy Control應用於四棟大型建築與26個非生產性質用電場域（百貨賣場等），平均可達35%即時電力削峰成效，進行相關研討說明。
5. 本人所發展的AI implementation framework是目前產學界導入AI能源應用的重要參考架構，以實際案例說明。
6. 於高耗能工業製程方面，聚焦於AI智慧燃燒控制技術的應用，針對工業鍋爐與垃圾焚化爐等高污染高碳排設備，說明AI空燃比即時調整系統。

name.zh: 教育訓練實施與績效評鑑

description.zh: 為了使訓練資源的更有效運用，本課程希望讓學生了解，企業內部在實施訓練之前，應客觀、嚴謹的加以評估，並追蹤其實施後的成效，以正確評估訓練的效益。
description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

syllabi.outline: 在本課程中，我們將探討教育訓練的各種實施方法，並系統性介紹不同的績效評鑑模型與其理論基礎。學生將學會如何判斷是否需要進行績效評鑑、應該在哪些階段進行評鑑，以及如何將評鑑結果連結至組織的整體策略目標與學習需求。課程強調理論與實務的結合，透過案例分析與實作練習，協助學生建立教育訓練規劃與成效評估的整體觀點。完成本課程後，學生將具備應用教育訓練實施策略與績效評鑑工具於實際工作場域的知識與能力。
syllabi.schedule:
第1週：教育訓練與職場學習的策略導向

第2週：企業常見的教育訓練方式與工作現場應用

第3週：講授、討論與多媒體在內訓中的實務技巧

第4週：數位工具與學習環境在教育訓練中的整合應用

第5週：如何從工作成果看見訓練需求與評估重點

第6週：設計與評估以績效為導向的教育訓練活動

第7週：職場上常見的訓練成效評估模型總覽 (無實體課；以同步遠距課程代替，為的是讓同學體驗以科技為主的教育訓練實施方式。）

第8週：從柯克帕特里克模型理解訓練效果的四層級

第9週：期中考週

第10週：為什麼訓練有效？認識因果邏輯與實證觀點

第11週：反事實思維在教育訓練成效推估上的角色

第12週：隨機分派在教育訓練評估上的應用實例（一）

description.zh:
本課程主要探討高分子在溶液及固態時的物理化學現象及其應用。內容包括輔G熱力學?高分子的微結構及定性。
輔G熱力學探討統計熱力學、晶格理論、Flory-Huggin理論、Flory-Krigbaum理論、相分離、θ-溫度、滲透壓、GPC測分子量、高分子膠體。
?高分子之微結構包括有高分子之形狀、自由旋轉分子鏈距離、光散射、中子散射、排拒體積、碎形、霍氏光譜及核磁共振儀在高分子微結構之分析。
description.en:
The course is to investigate the physical phenomena of macromolecules in the solution and solid state. It includes the solution thermodynamics and chemical microstructure of polymer chains.
The solution thermodynamics is to study lattice theory, statistical thermodynamics, Flory-Huggin theory, Flory-Krigbaum theory, phase separation, θ-temperature, Osmometry, GPC, and polymer gels.
Light scattering and Neutron scattering are used to characterize the polymer microstructure. Polymer radius of gyration, freely rotating chains, excluded volume, fractal, and scaling are also discussed. Finally, spectroscopy methods are used to study polymerization models and microstructure.

description.zh: 本課程包含材料的結構鑑定和材料的性質分析。材料的結構鑑定方法有：元素分析、吸收光譜法、振動光譜法、核磁共振光譜法、質譜法、x-射線光譜法和電子顯微鏡法。材料的性質分析包含：材料熱性質(DSC, TGA, TMA,DMA)和材料機械性質(伸張、壓縮、剪力強度等)。
description.en: The materials of the course include structure identification and property analysis of materials. Methods of structure identification  of materials are : elemental analysis, absorption spectroscopy, vibration spectroscopy, nuclear magnetic resonance spectroscopy, mass spectrometry, x-ray spectroscopy and electron microscopy. Metheds of property analysis of materials are : thermal properties of materials (DSC,TGA,TMA,DMA) and mechanical properties of materials (tensile, compression and shear strengths).

description.zh: 本課程主要探討各種高分子之聚合方法及動力學之研究，如逐步聚合、遊離基連鎖聚合、乳化聚合、離子連鎖聚合、連鎖共聚合反應、開環聚合、立體規則高分子之合成，未終止的游離基聚合方法。從分子量的分佈，結構物性之關係，作高分子聚合之最佳化設計，並且探討這些聚合方法如何應用在最新的科技上，如光電材料、複合材料。
description.en: This course is to elucidate the polymer synthesis and Kinetics studies. The synthesis includes step polymerization, free radical chain polymerization, emulsion polymerization, ionic chain polymerization, chain copolymerization, ring opening polymerization, sterospecific polymerization and living free radical polymerization. The synthesis scheme is optimized with the structure-properties relationship and molecular design. The potential application of these methods in high-tech materials, such as optoelectronics, and composites, will be elucidated.

description.en: The advanced course for inorganic chemistry is designed for graduates who plan to initiate their academic research in the chemical field or work in chemical plants. Organometallics provides not only the powerful tools for chemist in their research but also for chemical engineers in the design of their reactors.  The course covers the following topics: (1) Main-group organometallics (2) Organometallic compounds of the transition elements (3) Organometallics of the boron group (4) Organometallics of Copper, Silver and Gold (5) The 18-Valence-Electron (18-VE) Rule (6) s, p donors and acceptors (7) Organotin

description.en:
This course is mainly to discuss the role of planning as a form of intervention in the development process, and introduce the role of planning in the allocation and management of a sustainable environment. Thus the course including:
    1. Planning, planners and plans
    2. The origins: urban growth from 1800 to 1940
    3. The seers: pioneer thinkers in urban planning, from        1880 to 1945
    4. The creation of the postwar planning machine, from        1940 to 1952
    5. National/regional planning from 1945 to 1990
    6. Planning for cities and city regions from 1945 to        1990

syllabi.outline:
都市計畫是新興的學術，它是就特定地區有關都市生活之經濟、交通、衛生、保安、國防、文教、康樂等重要設施作有計畫的發展，並對土地使用作合理的規劃、開發與管制。其內容涵蓋建築物配置、住宅建設、土地使用分區、公共設施與交通路線規劃、開放空間管理與景觀設計、財務籌措與產業發展等。因此，都市計畫是提供一個都市長遠發展的藍圖，在時空上無論從單棟建築的興建乃至新社區、新市鎮的開發、舊市區的更新及各項公共設施的興闢，均須以都市計畫為藍本，所以都市計畫影響環境品質與居民生活福祉甚鉅。
為因應氣候變遷、保育自然環境與維護人文資產、促進資源與產業合理配置，都市計畫在觀念、作法、行政體制以及實質發展都必須與時俱進。先進國家的都市計畫皆以公共利益為依歸，為從事建築、景觀建築、都市設計、都市計畫、土木、營造、環境規劃與管理工作者必修的學科。
本課程目的在了解最新國際思潮影響與創新做法，檢視國內獨特的社會人文與都市計畫議題，如何參採先進國家制度與經驗，將理論應用在實務，作有系統的介紹與評論。修讀本課程可瞭解都市成長、規劃思想、政策發展、規劃體制變革歷程與經驗、永續理論應用與實務案例、國際與在地都市計畫挑戰、對策與發展。

name.en: Traditional architecture of Taiwan in Special Topics

description.zh: 本課程為台灣傳統建築文化系列課程之一，其主旨在介紹台灣傳統建築的理論與原則，藉由已有的研究案例與成果，使同學能擴展其對台灣傳統建築研究的視界，並就傳統建築中特定建築類型與空間文化議題進行研討，除了經由地方志等文獻的解讀，以了解建築所屬的特殊空間文化意涵外，並由同學進行特定建築的實地調查，以供印證。本課程期使修課同學除了對傳統建築的意義有所瞭解外，亦對特定建築類型的社會文化意義有所體認。
description.en: This course is one of the series of Taiwan traditional architectural culture courses. Its main purpose is to introduce the theories and principles of Taiwanese traditional architecture. With the help of existing research cases and achievements, students can expand their horizons in the study of Taiwanese traditional architecture and learn from traditional architecture. Discussions on specific architectural types and spatial culture issues in architecture, in addition to reading local chronicles and other documents to understand the special spatial cultural meaning of the building, and students conduct field investigations on specific buildings for verification. This course enables students to not only understand the significance of traditional architecture, but also understand the social and cultural significance of specific architectural types.

syllabi.outline: 台灣建築就其文化特質而論，可依族群區分成南島族群文化、閩客移民族群文化及外國殖民族群文化，其內容廣泛地包括前述建築所屬的自然地理環境、社會組織、宗教信仰及象徵體系等議題。本課程即在以傳統建築領域的南島文化及閩客文化為對象進行討論，課程首先就傳統社會、傳統建築議題進行基礎理論探討。其後再以原住民社會所屬的南島建築，及閩客移民所建立的漢人建築和聚落為題，藉由建築反映的自然地理環境、產業經濟、社會組織、匠師體系等建築文化，綜合論述其文化涵構與特色。本課程目的期使修課同學除了對台灣傳統建築、空間有所認識外，亦對其所屬的社會文化意義有所體認。

description.zh: 為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括： 一.健康環境概念：說明何謂「病態建築」，探討室內空氣與健康之關係。 二.建築物污染源：探討來自各建築材料的化學物質逸散及其對人體健康之影響，並提出室內污染物質濃度減低對策。 三.生物性污染源：探討黴菌、蹣、白蟻及寵物等帶來的室內空氣污染。 四.診斷技術：說明室內空氣品質診斷方法及病態建築改善之專業技術，配合案例介紹探討新、舊建築物室內環境品質的設計預防、診斷改善技術。
description.en: The main goal of this class is to pursue sustainable development and human health. In order to enhance the quality of residential and living environment in both existing and new-build dwellings, the course will cover important principles and topics in sick building environment, including medical, regulation, and architecture, chemical and biological. Specific contents include: (1)Conception of healthy environment: To explain the "sick building" and explore the association between indoor air and health.(2)Pollution source from buildings: To investigate the chemicals emission from building materials and their effect on human health, and get the countermeasures on reduce the indoor pollutants.(3)Pollution source from Biological: To investigate the indoor air pollution that cause by the mold, mites, termites, and pets.(4)Diagnostic techniques: To improved indoor air quality and sick building by diagnostic methods, with the case studies to prevent indoor environmental quality on new and old

syllabi.outline: 健康建築環境與設計方式，透過建築設計達成永續發展目標(SDGs)與永續報告書(ESG)之健康福祉。課程包含探討國際發展健康建築認證系統與項目，關鍵影響人員健康之環境因子：空氣、水、熱舒適、光、聲學、水、材料、運動、營養、心靈、互動等項目，從中探討健康建築與人之健康關連，並具體呈現於設計規範策略，作為深度研究議題，滿足學生學習核心能力。

description.zh: 同學們在修過第一年所開的所有的必修課之後，從第三個學期開始，在指導老師的引領下，必須開始著手準備碩士論文的撰寫: 選擇論文題目，收集資料，通過論文大綱審查，開始撰寫論文. . .等等的步驟。從第三個學期開始須修二期之「論文」課程。在論文口試委員們接受該論文並在文件上簽名後，同學們可同時拿到六個學分，完成本碩士課程"論文"這一項的要求。
description.en: After completing all the required courses in the first year, every student is encouraged to initiate the working process toward the completion of his/her MA thesis under the supervision of an advisor. Starting from the third semester, it is required for the student to register for "Thesis" for two semesters.  The "Thesis" courses aim to lead graduate students through the process of preparing, writing and completing an MA thesis.  After the committee members agree on the acceptability of the thesis and sign the official document, the student will get a total of 6 credits for "Thesis," fulfilling part of the requirement for a MA degree.

description.zh: 本課程將使學生熟悉專業筆譯的重要概念與原則。學生將習得翻譯學領域中各種跨學科的理論觀點（例如語言學與功能主義取向、言談與語域分析、翻譯規範、文化轉向、翻譯社會學以及翻譯科技等），並將理論知識運用於中英／英中翻譯實務上。學生將深入探討各種翻譯論點，並以此為基礎進行文本分析、釐清翻譯問題，以及構思合適之翻譯策略與技巧。
description.en: This course will acquaint students with fundamental concepts and principles of professional translation. Students will acquire a solid grounding in a range of ideas within translation studies (e.g. linguistic and functionalist approaches, discourse and register analysis, translation norms, cultural turn, sociology of translation, and translation technologies) and apply the theoretical knowledge to various English and Chinese translation activities. This course will also enable students to critically discuss the basic postulates of translation theories and use them in text analysis, the identification of translation problems, and the formulation of suitable strategies and techniques.

description.zh: 不同文化之間的對話需要故事的講述。了解一種文化的故事有助於人們了解這種文化並與其人民交談。有時，一種文化會借用另一種文化的故事，或者寫一個關於彼此文化碰撞的故事。(例如，關於亞洲的美國故事，或關於美國的亞洲故事)。為了幫助學生與來自其他文化的人們談論重要的思想，本課程研究跨文化共享故事以及一種文化講述其他文化的故事。
description.en: Conversation between different cultures requires the description of stories.  Knowing a culture’s stories helps one to understand that culture and talk with its people. Sometimes a culture borrows a story from another culture or writes a story about its encounter with that other culture.  (For example, American stories about Asia or Asian stories about America).  To help students talk about important ideas with people from other cultures, this course examines stories shared across cultures and stories one culture tells about another.

name.en: Taguchi Method on the Quality Design

description.zh:
(1)「田口方法」介紹
(2)完整的「田口方法」，包含以下三個主題：
(a) S/N比之理論基礎及進階應用；
(b)直交表之理論基礎及進階應用；
(c)變異分析。
(3)應用「田口方法」進行專案研究，並繳交專案主題與報告。
description.en:
(1) The course gives step-by-step to explaining the "Taguchi Method" for the students.
     (2) The course gives the fully "Taguchi Method" for the students during a short time, which including three topical subjects:
  (a) The basic theory of S/N ratio and its advanced applications.
  (b) The basic theory of Orthogonal Arrays and its advanced applications.
  (c) Analysis of Variance (ANOVA)
  (3) Students will use the "Taguchi Method" to proceeding a project study, and hand over their theme and report of project.

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
表面現象, 介面反應等與近代高科技技術, 如鍍膜工程,表面處理, 腐蝕, 磨潤, 微機電, 感測器, 半導體技術等息息相關, 且日益重要。表面分析是原子層次的相關研究, 它包括振動, 電子或離子頻譜分析, 微技術等之應用。主要的項目包含, 表面形貌觀察( SEM, BSEM, AFM ), 成份分析( 光譜分析, 質譜分析, EDX ), 結構分析( XRD, AES, ESCA, XPS ), 鍵結分析( Raman光譜, FTIR ), 表面粗糙度, 膜厚, 附著力, 內應力等膜之特性分析。
description.en:
Surface phenomena and processes occurring at interface are becoming increasingly important in a wide variety of industrial applications including the areas of films coating surface treatments, conclusion, triobology, microelectronics, sensors and semi-conductor technologies.  Accompanying this is an ever-growing need for surface characterization allowing better definition of processes occurring at a microscopic level.
Surface analysis is the use of vibration, electron or ion spectroscopic and microscopic techniques for the study of material at the atomic level, it includesSEM, AFM, XRD, EDX, ESCA, XPS, AES, Raman Spectrum, and FTIR analysis.

description.zh: 本課程之目標為依人力職能需求，參考國內外之先行經驗，整合智能化生產所需之知識與技能訓練，以淬鍊出一套務實之智能化生產課程。本課程將涵蓋工業4.0-智能化生產所需相關基礎技術之教學與實作課程，包括物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。
description.en: The goal of this course is to meet the needs of the manpower function, with reference to the previous experiences from domestic and abroad groups. This course will cover the topics related to the basic technology required for intelligent production, including the basic technology and application examples of the Internet of Things, the cloud service system and information security technology, the huge amount of data management, Intelligent enterprise and factory management systems and applications, automation and robot technology and applications, and so on.

syllabi.outline: 本課程涵蓋廣泛之工業4.0-智能化生產所需相關基礎技術，包括工業革命簡史、人工智慧演算法、物聯網基礎技術與應用實例、雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術、巨量資料管理、分析、及應用實例、智慧化企業與工廠管理系統與應用、自動化與機器人技術及應用等等。
syllabi.schedule:
週次	單元主題
第一週	智能化生產簡介/
四次工業革命簡史與內容，工業四點零概論:互聯網、物聯網、巨量資料(大數據)、雲端運算、人工智慧、自動化與機器人。
第二週	人工智慧的過去與現在:三次人工智慧熱潮、決策樹、專家系統、類神經網路，運用與困境。
第三週	當代人工智慧原理:巨量資料的影響、深度學習、開源程式TensorFlow、Keras簡介。
第四週	物聯網基礎技術與應用:
物聯網基礎架構概論: 物聯網基本詞彙定義/物聯網協定層架構/物聯網功能及技術現況與發展方向。軟硬體設計與整合規劃: 各式感測器與基本原理/網路層技術與相關標準/應用層技術與相關標準
第五週	物聯網基礎技術與應用:
智能化工廠應用實例: 創新生產模式/物聯網導入生產之優劣點與特色分析
第六週	雲端服務系統與資訊安全技術:

syllabi.outline:
本課程將採用理論講授與數據實作並行的方式，協助學生建立對顧客關係管理（Customer Relationship Management, CRM）之完整認識與實務操作能力。

首先將針對CRM之核心理念與在企業經營模式中的角色進行說明，說明CRM如何透過有效的顧客資料管理、客戶價值分析、互動溝通與體驗設計，提升企業營運績效與顧客忠誠度。課程初期將聚焦於顧客資料與行為分析，包含市場區隔、目標客群選擇、客戶價值評估與溝通策略等。藉由實際企業案例（如胖東來）來強化理論與應用連結。

中期課程將帶領學生實作問卷調查與Google表單設計，模擬蒐集顧客意見的流程，並進一步導入SPSS進行統計分析與報表產出，包括：交叉分析表、描述統計、t檢定、變異數分析、迴歸分析與相關性分析等技術，以協助學生從數據中發掘有意義的行銷洞察。

後段課程將實作顧客區隔分析（如RFM模型）、顧客價值預測模型，輔助CRM決策，實踐以數據驅動的精準行銷策略。

本課程將強調實務與資料分析能力的養成，學生將能熟悉從顧客資料蒐集、分析到應用於行銷策略的完整流程，為日後進入精準行銷、顧客關係等領域打下良好基礎。

---
This course combines theoretical lectures with data practice to help students gain a comprehensive understanding of Customer Relationship Management (CRM) and practical skills.

It begins by explaining CRM's core concepts and its role in business models, focusing on how CRM enhances operational performance and customer loyalty through effective data management, customer value analysis, interactive communication, and experience design. Early lessons emphasize customer data and behavior analysis, including market segmentation, target audience selection, customer value assessment, and communication strategies, reinforced by real-world cases like Fat Dong Lai.

In the mid-term, students will design questionnaires and Google Forms to simulate collecting customer feedback, followed by statistical analysis using SPSS, covering cross-tabulation, descriptive statistics, t-tests, ANOVA, regression, and correlation analysis to uncover marketing insights from data.

Later, the course introduces Python’s scipy and sklearn modules for programmatic statistical analysis and machine learning, guiding students through customer segmentation (e.g., RFM model) and value prediction models (e.g., KNN, logistic regression, SVM) to support CRM decisions with AI tools and enable data-driven precision marketing.

The course focuses on building practical and analytical skills, equipping students with the full process of collecting, analyzing, and applying customer data to marketing strategies, laying a strong foundation for careers in marketing, data analysis, and customer relations.

syllabi.outline: 教學大綱:簡介作業研究Systems Analysis中的各式優選工具，並學習混沌理論。以生態族群的Growth and Decay模式為例，初窺混沌世界的奇妙，以提供往後解決問題時有不同的思考方向。混沌理論應用在物理、經濟、生物、數學的領域上，處理數百年來許多無法看透的問題有不錯進展(包括紊流現象)，在環境領域上的應用則尚待開拓。只要處理的系統(問題)具有自我相似性，以混沌來處理是可行的。(課程中將視時間教進階數學軟體Mathematica.)  Explore Chaos Theory from the Models of Growth and Decay (Simple Logistic Model, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity, Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity and Migration).  Introduce important factors of Chaotic Behavior: Dynamics of species, Critical Reproduction Rate, Bifurcation, Butterfly effect.  Examples of Chaotic behavior: Single Species System, Two Species Competition System, Two Species Predator-Prey System.
syllabi.schedule:
1. 優選工具簡介Mathematic tools for system analysis
	線性規劃
	時間序列、啟發式演算法、類神經網路、灰色理論/模糊理論
	賽局理論、小世界理論
2. Models of Growth and Decay 
	Simple Logistic Model
	Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity
	Logistic Model with Carrying Capacity and Migration
3. Chaotic 混沌Behavior (week 3交HW1)
	Dynamics of species
	Critical Reproduction Rate
	Bifurcation
4. Examples of Chaotic behavior
	Single Species System
	Two Species Competition System
	Two Species Predator-Prey System
5. Butterfly effect蝴蝶效應. Deterministic or Random? (week 5交HW2)
6. Final Exam;

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及"納米"對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

name.en: Environmental Economics and Environmental Policies Analysis

description.zh: 政策研究能檢視理論和實務的切合程度。本課程將帶領大家認識環境政策的經濟分析方法，學習經濟的思維觀點，以及如何運用經濟方法瞭解解決環境問題。除此之外上課內容並與法律結合，探討環境法的經濟分析觀點和傳統思維有何不同，尤其是對環境行為上之改變效果。希望學生能夠具體瞭解經濟分析方法幫助政府解決環境問題及規劃環境政策時所扮演的角色。
description.en: There is a significant trade-off between economic growth and environmental quality.  From this course, students will learn fundamental concepts in Environmental Economics and how to analyze environmental policy issues by using economic tools.  In additions, this course combines economic analysis to law, especially shows students how regulations affect people's behavior.  After this class, students not only know how economic approaches help the government deal with environmental issues and the differences between theory and practices.

syllabi.outline:
本課程由微觀經濟學角度出發，分析各種環境問題，並介紹各種經濟誘因行政策工具，以補足傳統環境工程教育偏重工程面之不足。
This course applies theories in micro economics to analyze environmental problems. Policy tools that are often applied in solving environmental problems are further introduced and being evaluated using micro economic principals.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋嵌入式工業視覺系統完整的開發內容，從機器視覺系統流程與演算法設計、嵌入式系統實作、函式庫封裝、人機介面設計、工業相機取像及實際案例分析。其中包含: 1. 嵌入式系統軟體實作：Linux 環境介紹與基本程式設計 2. Qt 人機介面開發 3. 工業用機器視覺演算法/系統開發，並提供相關設計概念 4. 實際應用案例與設計流程介紹。學生需要先有C/C++程式語言及影像處理之基礎。
description.en: The goal of this course is to learn the basic tools and techniques required to implement Machine Vision on small, embedded, portable platforms. The primary focus will be on the design of industrial vision system based on specialized embedded hardware, with a little less focus on machine vision algorithm. The course will involve: (1) Linux embedded software development; (2) Qt GUI development; (3) development of embedded industrial machine vision algorithm; (4) application practice on the embedded platform, with an industrial camera, to demonstrate real time vision processing. The only pre-requisite for the course is to know C/C++ and image processing.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於從科學哲學層次、研究方法層次、與實際操作層次探討設計研究的本質，內容包括界定設計研究問題、選用適當的量化或質性研究方法與特定工具、研究結果詮釋、案例解析、以及論文寫作等，俾使同學具備研究之基礎觀念以及進行創作或理論論文寫作之能力。研究方法一強調量化研究，課程內容包含研究的基本概念、文獻探討、研究問題、研究變項、研究假設、研究設計、資料蒐集與分析、研究工具、研究樣本、研究倫理與研究論文撰寫等。教學以課堂講授與論文研討與發表為主要方式，並以隨堂測驗、報告與分組討論與發表為評量依據。
description.en: The aims of this course are to explore the nature of design research at the three various levels of scientific philosophy, research methods, and pr92tical execution. The contents involve the introduction of defining the design problems, selecting the quantitative or qualitative research methods and specific instruments, interpretation of research results, case studies, as well as writing a thesis. This research methods one focus on quantitative research that content details includes fundamental concept of research, literature review, research problem, research variables, research hypothesis, research design, data collection and analysis, research instruments, research samples, research ethics and writing up. The te92hing methods include lectures, paper discussion and presentation based on the course assessment of assigned project, panel discussion and individual/group presentation.

description.zh: 本課程規劃的目標為以互動設計的理論為基礎，實務導向為原則，使學習者能將學術界的理論與產業界的實務加以結合以充實對於互動設計具有全面性的了解。學習的內容包含互動設計系統構成要素、理論與實務基礎、互動設計方法與技術、科技支援與應用、認知心理、情境設計以及電腦支援協同合作等單元，各單元並包含不同互動設計個案的研討，使理論能與實務進行驗證。課程亦安排至相關領域業界的參訪，以加深對於互動設計實務的印象與了解。
description.en: The course aims to develop broad understanding on interaction design for students, based on theory and practice course structure. Course topics include essential factors of interactive system, interaction design theory and practice, interaction design methods and techniques, technical support and application, cognitive psychology, scenario design and CSCW. Course also incorporates case studies and company visits to enhance the understanding of integrating theory and practice.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
description.en: This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, inter92tive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and pr92tice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct multi-disciplines learning environment which perform a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate an interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by working with the form of case study or design creation.

本課程之目標在於研討互動設計、互動媒體、互動藝術之相關研究專題，以文獻研讀、論文研讀討論以及個案研究為重點，藉由密集討論、書面報告以及設計專題之之研究與實作，學生可以有效率地交換意見，獲得更深入而廣泛的體驗，並具備研究、分析、實作之能力。本所以結合電子資訊、機電、人文、設計與藝術等各領域的學生，以整合培育互動媒體設計專業人才，因此，本課程之另一主要學習目標為建構一多元領域交互學習的環境，以專題導向式為學習模式，可分別組合具設計、藝術、資訊、機電等專長的研究生，協同完成互動媒體設計專題的研究，或是透過互動媒體設計個案研討、互動媒體設計專題創作的方式進行。教學將以課堂講授、論文研討與發表以及專題實作為主，並以報告、分組討論與發表以及實作作品為評量方式。
This course is to explore the fields of interaction design, inter92tive media and interactive art and focus on the literature study, paper discussion and case studies. With panel discussion, research report and design practice, graduate students can be able to learn the ability of research, analysis and pr92tice by effectively exchange opinions and personal experience. The aim of graduate of interactive media design is to integrate different disciplines from computer science, mechatronics, human-culture and design and art so as to foster the professional of interactive media design. Therefore, one of the aims of this course is to construct multi-disciplines learning environment which perform a topic-oriented study model. This study model formulates the graduate students of design, art, information and mechatronic disciplines to collaborate an interactive media design project. It may execute interactive media design by working with the form of case study or design creation.

description.zh: 互動設計可視為三大傳統設計領域：平面設計、工業設計，與建築設計的延伸。在許許多多延伸出來的新設計領域如 UI、UX、響應式網頁、互動產品、智慧空間等等，圖像依舊是所有設計在發想、討論，與實現設計上所仰賴的根本工具。本課程以圖像為設計語言的架構下，介紹由圖像所發展出來的數位生產線，以模組技術介紹互動設計在設計發想、原型製作，以至到設計討論與提案所需要之圖像技術，並鼓勵學生以一設計提案來總結課堂之所學。
description.en: Interaction design can be considered as an extension of the long-established fields of architectural, industrial, and graphical design. Regardless what types of the recent emerging field of interaction design such as UI, UX, responsive website, tangible interaction design, or smart environment, the image remains as the visual language for design ideation to realization. This course introduces the concept of digital pipeline which is mediated on wide range of image related digital technologies. Through those modularized technologies, we can form a working pipeline to create a prototype for an interaction design proposal.

name.en: Advanced Management Practice and Integrated Management Case Studies

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
description.en: This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

第四組Case4 百威英博百威啤酒的全球品牌管理Global Brand Management of Anheuser Busch InBev's Budweiser（9-518-105）
1.百威需要一個全球統一的品牌嗎？Perkins是否可以繼續管理在不同地區的兩個或更多不同的品牌形象？為什麼？
2.當百威準備擴展至非洲，Perkins應該採用哪個品牌形象在肯尼亞、尼日利亞、喀麥隆和南非推出品牌並建立顧客價值主張？為什麼？

5.為百威設計一個2018年世界杯的品牌戰略。你想講述怎樣的故事？你會針對什麼樣的群體講故事？

description.zh: 在管理決策中，要如何做行銷管理才能使得公司的產品賣得出去並增加公司收入。要如何做資金管理才能使得公司可以正常營運並將資金做適當的管理決策配置。透過國內外相關公司案例的討論，讓學生可以瞭解消費者行為、市場區隔、產品策略、通路、數位(含AI)行銷等議題，以及對財管的投資、融資、營運資金、公司理財等議題有進一步的理解，讓高階經理人可以有更全面的策略營運方針。
description.en: In management decisions, how should marketing management be conducted to ensure that a company's products sell and increase company revenue? How should financial management be handled to ensure the company operates smoothly and makes appropriate management decisions regarding the allocation of funds? Through discussions of relevant domestic and international company cases, students can gain an understanding of topics such as consumer behavior, market segmentation, product strategy, distribution channels, and digital (including AI) marketing, as well as develop a deeper understanding of financial management topics like investment, financing, working capital, and corporate finance. This will enable senior managers to develop more comprehensive strategic operational guidelines.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

name.en: Advanced Management Practice and Integrated Management Case Studies

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
description.en: This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

name.en: Advanced Management Practice and Integrated Management Case Studies

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹高階管理的理論與實務。將透過學校老師與企業高階管理者與學生一起探討當前管理重要議題。本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
description.en: This course focuses on the introduction and discussion of theories and practices of contemporary management topics. Besides university professors, renowned top manager will be invited to share the best practice experiences of the workplace in the lecture. The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

description.zh: 本課程旨在深入介紹統計技術和最佳化概念，藉以輔助管理之決策。課程涵蓋統計學及最佳化相關主題，包括描述性統計、相關分析、抽樣和估計、概率分布、假設檢驗、回歸模型、實驗設計和線性規劃。通過課程學生還將獲得統計和最佳化軟件（如LINGO和Excel）的實際操作經驗。修習課程之學生將具備應用統計和最佳化工具處理實務問題之技能和知識，使其能夠基於數量方法之做出決策及管理。
description.en: This course aims to offer an in-depth understanding of statistical techniques and optimization concepts for making informed management decisions. The course provides a comprehensive overview of key topics in statistics, including descriptive statistics, correlation analysis, sampling and estimation, probability distributions, hypothesis testing, regression models, design of experiments, and linear programming. Students will also gain practical experience in statistical and optimization software such as LINGO and Excel through interactive tutorials. On completion of this course, students would be able to equip with the skills and knowledge needed to apply statistical and optimization tools to real-life situations, allowing them to make informed decisions based on quantitative methods.

description.zh:
本課程的目的一，將藉由五個面向了解企業倫理的本質，分別（1）廠商的社會責任，（2）消費者的保護，（3）員工的權益，（4）員工對公司的責任，（5）雇主與員工關係。
目的二，進一步教授ESG及聯合國SDGs指標的基本定義，藉由國、內外的個案討論來深根學生對於企業永續經營的觀念。
最後，透過對於ESG與市場機會、責任投資原則、環境足跡 (碳足跡、水足跡等) 盤點等，來訓練製作永續報告書的基礎能力
description.en:
The objective of this course is to appreciate the essential of Business Ethics through five main faucets: (1) Corporate social responsibility, (2) Consumer protection, (3) Employee's rights and benefits, (4) Responsibility of employee to the firms, and (5) Employer-employee relations.
The second objective is to further explain the definitions of ESG and SDGs, and then to root the concept of sustainable management to students through local and international case studies.
Finally, through ESG market opportunities, principles for responsible investment, inventory of environmental footprint (carbon footprint, water footprint, etc.), we expect to build up students the basic ability to generate the ESG report.

description.en: Emphasizes strategic perspective of modern human resource management theory and practice. Topics include human resource planning, staffing, training and development, compensation, performance appraisal, and labor and employee relations.

description.zh: 國際商務市場行銷管理。包括在國際環境中的市場研究、定價、促銷和分銷。審查市場的問題出現不同程度的外資參與（出口，許可證，外國分公司）。先修課程：MARK5311市場行銷。
description.en: Management of marketing in international business. Includes marketing research, pricing, promotion, and distribution in the international environment. Examines marketing problems arising from various degrees of foreign involvement (exports, licensing, foreign subsidiaries). Prerequisite: MARK 5311 (MARKETING).

description.zh:
戰略管理使用綜合管理視角去解決相關的制定和實施企業和企業級戰略的問題。
該課程包括開發識別問題的能力，評估戰略選擇，並瞭解戰略的形成和執行的組織過程。它建立在功能區課程所獲得的知識，並使用案例研究和項目，以提高學生的分析和決策能力。前提：必須參與上學期的課程或與得到研究生導師的許可。
description.en: Strategic management uses a general management perspective in addressing issues related to the formulation and implementation of corporate and business level strategy. The course involves developing the ability to identify issues, evaluate strategic options and understand the organizational process by which strategies get formed and executed. It builds on the knowledge gained in functional area courses and uses case studies and projects to improve students' analytical and decision-making skills. Prerequisite: Must be taken in last semester or with permission of the Graduate Advisor.

description.zh: 公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
description.en: The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh: 本課程上半學期以R語言為工具，處理分析金融交易資料於股票期貨與選擇權等商品，包含理論模擬與實務分析。
description.en: In this course, we use R language as a tool to deal with the analysis of financial data in the stock, futures and options and other commodities, including theoretical simulation and practical analysis.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠：
1. 學生俱備基礎數據分析能力 
2. 能夠將所學應用於生活中決策問題輔助

syllabi.outline:
本課程以哈佛個案教學方法進行，在每個個案討論當中，同時由行銷管理、財務管理、科技管理、生產管理領域老師教授。可以讓學生在學管理工功能之外，還可以學習這些管理功能的整合，學期末並有分組個案競賽，促進團隊互動與學習。
The Integrated Management Case Studies would be taught by case methods from Havard Business School’s cases. Every case will be taught from Marketing, Financing, Technology Management, and Operation Management areas faculty. This course focus on the integration of management functions. The case contest will be hold on the final week to encourage team building and learning.

description.zh: 策略管理主要是幫助製造業與服務業高階管理者作決策。一般而言，這門課程主要協助學員們具有策略思維與整合能力。學員可在策略管理學習過程活學活用，更能融合所學應用於管理決策中。此門課也採用適當的製造業與服務業個案研討來幫助學員學習、研讀與熟悉策略管理的運作，以達成此門課的目標。授課主題包括研討策略管理的本質與整體架構，瞭解組織所處環境 ， 分析外部環境之時機和危機， 剖析內部組織之優劣勢 ， 探討企業不同層次之應對策略，整合策略的執行與治理等。
description.en: Strategic management deals with the decision making in manufacturing and service industry at the top management level. Generally, this course provides students with strategic thinking and knowledge integration. With case studies in manufacturing and service industry, this course also helps students learn, study, and understand the process of strategic management well to achieve the goals of the course. Topics in this course include the essence and whole framework of strategic management, in what circumstances an organization has been, analyses on the opportunities and threats of external environment, the strengths and weaknesses of internal organization, application strategies of companies at different levels, implantation on integration strategies and so forth.

description.zh: 本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識。
description.en: The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. It provides necessary knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value.

syllabi.outline:
本課程設計為讓初學者了解並能分析在現今市場環境下，企業所面臨的財務問題。課程涵蓋企業資本評價的基本模型，包含企業金融資產的定價模式、實體資產評價與投資專案分析、資本結構分析，以及其他企業在資金管理與財務規劃預測的相關議題。另外，為了讓企業經理人了解衍生性金融商品，本課程亦以深入淺出方式介紹選擇權之基本觀念、交易實務與決策應用。本課程目的在讓參與者對『財務決策對公司表現和價值的影響』有更深刻的認識，培育理論與實務兼備之財務管理人才

The course develops theoretical framework for understanding and analyzing major financial problems of modern company in market environment. The course covers basic models of valuation of corporate capital, including pricing models for primary financial assets, real assets valuation and investment projects analysis, capital structure and various types of corporate capital employed, derivative assets and contingent claims on assets. In addition, in order to let corporate managers understand the derivatives, this course introduces the basic concept of option, transaction practice and decision-making applications. The purpose of this course is to provides knowledge in evaluating different management decisions and its influence on corporate performance and value, so as to cultivate financial management talents with both theoretical knowledge and practical skills.

description.zh: 本課程教導學生對製造業與服務業進行精實化管理的策略與技巧。課程內容包含：造成大型企業倒閉的商務環境改變與組織內的問題；科技提昇與電子化管理對企業的衝擊；精實化企業中有效及具競爭力營運管理的要素；精實化管理的發展策略與技巧。探討競爭優勢與生產服務系統模式、經營模式之關連，包括大量客製化、競爭優勢階段性、 發展競爭優勢作為、 豐富顧客價值。本課程將使學員熟習各項品質管理的理論基礎與發展趨勢，強化理論研究與實務應用能力。首先，課程涵蓋基礎統計使學員具備研究方法與分析技術能力，了解收集、統整和分析資料。其次，討論量化的六標準差管理相關工具及專案推行流程，以系統化思維探討問題並提出有效可行的解決對策，持續提升品質及客戶滿意。最後，介紹制度面及組織管理面的全球品管概念，闡述創造魅力品質之重要理論模型及影響服務品質關鍵因素。
description.en: This course covers the strategies and techniques of managing a lean business in manufacturing and in service. The linkages between competitive advantages and production systems, competitive advantages and business models will be discussed first. Then, topics include mass customization, competitive advantage stages, developing competitive capability and maximize customer value. This class will help students familiarize themselves with the trend of theoretical basis of the quality management and strengthen their ability in both theoretical research and practical application. First, the course covers basic statistics so that students will be acquainted with research methods and analysis techniques. Second, the six sigma management tools will be reviewed and the process for its implementation will also be addressed. Finally, the system- and the organization-level quality as well as the Kano Model for attractive quality will be discussed.

description.zh: 隨著新冠肺炎的疫情，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，經營數位行銷的需求，已經是每個公司所必需的。從新產品的開發、行銷、到售後服務均受影響。網路電子商務已經成為傳統行銷實體通路以外的一個新興通路。使得電子商務明顯的成為未來商業發展的主流。因此，如何經營數位行銷已是現代企業具有競爭力重要課題。這個課程幫助企業在充分瞭解顧客信息的基礎上，針對客戶喜好，針對性地進行產品行銷，幫助企事業單位在激烈的市場競爭中取得競爭優勢。
description.en: Digital marketing is the conducting of business on the internet, not only buying and selling but also servicing customers and collaborating with business partners. This course will introduce the digital marketing by the way of concept, theory and case study. This course will study how to develope the business on the internet.

name.en: Big Data Analytics and Industrial Applications

description.zh: 本課程將介紹大數據分析緣起與理論基礎，大數據分析與企業經營間之獲利關聯，並輔以大數據分析案例讓學員對於大數據應用有更深層的認識與啟發。
description.en: The big data opportunity, extracting insight from an immense volume, variety and velocity of data, in context, beyond what was previously possible, will be addressed in this course. Applications for big data analytics could include smarter healthcare, multi-channel, finance, computer log analysis, homeland security, traffic control, telecom, search quality, manufacturing, trading analytics, fraud and risk, retailing, among others.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在使學生了解各種不同的資訊科技(Information Technology)與管理資訊系統間的關連性，並實際應用所教授的IT技術進行學術研究。藉由IT技術的應用演練，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。提升學生獨立思考與解決問題之能力，培養科學的態度與學術研究的知識。本課程能夠：
1. 學生俱備基礎數據分析能力 
2. 能夠將所學應用於生活中決策問題輔助

name.zh: 永續發展與綠色金融管理
name.en: Sustainable Development and Green Banking Management

description.zh: 這門課程將深入探討ESG概念及其在國際趨勢中的地位，包括CBAM、CCA、TCFD等法規，亦將闡述國際評比、CSRD、IFRS S1/S2等要求，以及國內主管機關的法規，尤其關於公司治理藍圖的要求。透過工作坊形式，我們將聚焦氣候變遷和財務相關揭露的重點，並以案例分享產業實務。從國際法規如SB253、CBAM到國際標準ISO 20400，我們也將討論供應鏈管理和永續採購的趨勢。此外，將涵蓋人權相關議題，如TIFD和DEI，以及永續報告書撰寫注意事項。最後，我們將介紹永續金融和責任投融資，並討論金融業永續法規對企業的影響。
description.en: This course explores ESG concepts and global trends like CBAM, CCA, and TCFD. We'll cover international ratings, CSRD, IFRS S1/S2, and domestic regulatory requirements, focusing on corporate governance. Through workshops and case studies, we'll highlight climate change and financial disclosures. We'll discuss supply chain management trends, ISO 20400, and human rights issues like TIFD and DEI. Additionally, we'll cover sustainability reporting guidelines and introduce sustainable finance and responsible investment, examining their impact on businesses and financial regulations.

name.zh: 全球組織經營策略暨領導決策
name.en: Global Organization's Management Strategies and Leadership Decision

description.zh: 本課程專注在探討全球組織經營策略與領導決策之關鍵議題，聚焦在不同時空的國際經營環境中，企業經營者如何因應政府的政策與財經情勢改變，能夠快速回應與彈性應變的領導思維與決策。透過本課程將能夠理解高階主管面對政經環境的調整能有效因應變化，並且提升領導才能與創造市場優勢之創新能力。
description.en: The course focuses investigate the global organization's management strategies and leadership decision of the key issues. It is focusing in the different time frames and fierce international environment, how changes in policy of governments and situation of economic. Business executives will be able to quick to respond with the elastic strain of the global strategy perspective and leadership thinking. This course will be able to understand top managers can achieve the decision making of leadership, and improve the leadership knowledge and innovation capabilities in market competition.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹人力資源與組織管理的進階理論與實務，內容包括了(但不限於)人才任用、訓練與發展、績效評估、薪酬管理、組織設計、領導、工作激勵、以及工作團隊運作等等重要議題。課堂上並討論上述理論對於管理實務上的意涵。
description.en: This course introduces many advanced topics of human resource management, organization theory, and organization behavior. Topics include (but not limited to) staffing, training and development, performance appraisal, compensation, organization design, leadership, work motivation, workgroup functioning. Implications for managerial practice will be discussed in this class.

name.zh: 經營模式與智慧化企業

description.zh: 由於產業環境辦化及科技創新速度，影響企業之營運模式。本課程旨在針對因應產業/工業4.0調整，課中會針對企業經營模式變革與產業/工業4.0產業生態鏈變革探討。 除了理論解析外，本課程並輔以企業實務個案研討。
description.en: Due to the change of industry environment and the speed of technological innovation, the business models of enterprise are impacted. The purpose of this course will study the transform of business model and the impact of Industry 4.0 on the ecosystem of industry. In the course, besides the theory will be included, the business practices case will be also covered.

syllabi.outline:
由於產業環境變化及科技創新速度高速發展，對於企業之營運模式帶來影響，迫使企業需要在組織與技術上的發展不斷的動態調整。本課程旨在針對因應產業/工業4.0、數位轉型、AI驅動、商業模式創新發展下，企業如何對經營模式與產業/工業4.0、AI產業生態系/鏈變革進行探討。除了理論解析外，本課程並輔以企業實務個案研討。
Due to changes in the industrial environment and the rapid development of technological innovation, these have had an impact on the operating model of enterprises, forcing enterprises to continuously make dynamic adjustments in organizational and technological development. This course aims to discuss how companies can transform their business models, industry/Industry 4.0, and AI industry ecosystems/chains in response to Industry/Industry 4.0, digital transformation, AI-driven, and business model innovation and development. In addition to theoretical analysis, this course is supplemented by corporate practical case studies.
