description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline:
本課程「國語文實務應用」，專為本校科技大學的同學而設計，以未來於職場（生存）與人生（生活、生命）之實務應用為教學標的。
本國語文課程以《世說新語》為主要文本，這部由南朝劉義慶編撰的經典筆記小說，內容涵蓋魏晉南北朝時期的逸聞軼事與人物風貌。通過閱讀、分析和討論，學生將深入了解魏晉風度、清談文化以及個人與社會價值觀的演變，並認識《世說新語》的文學價值及其對後世的影響。

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 瞭解程式語言的基本結構，並以C語言為主要實習對象，其內容包含：1. 程式語言簡介：介紹各種程式語言及其特性，並對C語言之發展沿革架構及持點詳加討論，2. 資料型態：介紹C語言之資料型態及各種運算子，3. 基本輸入：介紹各種輸出入函數及輸出入實習，4. 流程控制：介紹指定指述，選擇敘述及迴圈敘述，並做實習，5. 前置處理：介紹前置處理觀念及程式實作，6. 函式：介紹主副程式及實作，7. 陣列與字串：介紹各種陣列之特性及字串與陣列之關係，並做實習，8. 結構型態：介紹結構，列舉及同位資料型態及應用實習，9. 指標：介紹指標之觀念及應用實習，10. 位元運算：介紹位元運算及應用實習，11. 檔案處理：各種檔案之介紹及檔案輸出入函數，12. 鍵盤與游標控制：介紹鍵盤、游標之控制及字元之特性，並作相關實習，13. 繪圖與音樂：介紹文字模式及繪圖模式函數，並作實習，14. C語言與物件導向：介紹C++與物件導向之關係，及物件與類別之基本定義，並作相關實習。

本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 讓學生瞭解木材機器加工原理及最新工業用木工機器之種類，並使學生熟悉家具製造技術，特別是製造家具需要用到的各種設備之加工能力，及其作業特性和刀具要件等方面之知識與實務。 介紹家具製造過程中所需之各種機器設備之種類及其加工性能。不論及機器本身之設計問題，而側重於機械之應用；不研究一種機器所能做出之各種巧妙的加工方法，而在討論量產作業時，如何利用最合適之機器及加工方法所應採用之標準操作方式。
description.en: Survey of furniture manufacturing technology emphasizing mass production equipment and its relationship to furniture product engineering. The course is directed toward the efficient use of equipment in the production of large lots. In addition, the course does not concern itself with ingenious ways to do a maximum variety of operations on one machine; however, it is interested in presenting the best machine and method for standard production operations.

syllabi.outline:
介紹人體之形態特徵、心理期望、動作行為等人因知識，研究人因資訊應用於工業設計實務上之設計方法或準則以獲得具安全、效率與舒適之產品或環境設計。

This course is for students, researchers, and practitioners who design or evaluate products for their target user. It covers evaluation methodology for supporting human factor design for products, human-machine systems, software applications, games, and specialized appliances intended to be used by people. This field contains a substantial body of knowledge with regard to human factor design and the more narrowly scoped field of usability engineering (UE). Within these areas of practice, and the related research field of HCI, a host of methods are available for evaluating interactive products for user. This course provides an overview of a new and vibrant research field and exposes gaps in current methodologies that future research must address. We also hope it conveys our enthusiasm for this research area, where so much interesting work is taking place and so much still needs to be done.

3. 透過使用者經驗的研究方法，幫助設計者擬定設計策略。
4. 設計過程中運用設計工具進行驗證或改良設計缺失，以達到產品易用性、親切感與愉悅感。
5. 藉由設計未來使用產品的情境與介面，去揣摩與驗證現階段尚未使用的設計產品與操作問題。

課程將習得順應AI設計的時代下，電腦2D影像編輯及繪圖軟體、排版在視覺設計、產品與空間設計等跨領域設計的多元表現技能。

隨著AI技術進步，圖像表現也在不斷演進。如何利用結合AI技術與圖像編輯技法具體呈現AI概念，會是新時代設計師的必備能力。

本課程以Photoshop 為主要表現工具，illustrator 作為輔助工具角色，實現電腦視覺設計在概念溝通、圖像表達、造型發展、情境表現、之於AＩ輔助溝通能力上的設計應用力。

The course will lead students to acquire the multi-expression application skills of computer 2D image editing and drawing software in the fields of visual communication, product and space design.

As the era of AI generation arrives, the techniques for visual representation are continuously evolving. How to concretely present concepts through the collaboration of visual creation tools and AI is a challenge for designers in the new era

Using Photoshop as the main expression software tool, realize the design application force of computer vision-aided design in concept communication, image expression, modeling development, and situational expression.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.en: This course offers a good opportunity for four-year college students in this university to have an easier access to a completely different field of knowledge, in the hope that  students can add their individual professional knowledge and broaden their minds. The students will be furnished with integrated knowledge, discovering a better way towards professional communication, developing more common sense and never losing themselves in this information-explosive age. With a solid basis on humanity and liberal ideology, they are sure to find a more complete picture of human life.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 課程重點：(1)藉由適合其程度的教材加強學生必備的基礎文法觀念和句型結構；(2)使學生確切把握閱讀要領以及充分瞭解寫作的各種技巧，重心在生字、片語、句法的解釋和基本寫作技巧的分析；(3)熟悉英語人士日常生活情境及與學生將來就業環境相關之會話及適當之應對方式；(4)透過練習加強聽、說、讀、寫的知能及表達。
description.en: This course is designed (1) to strengthen students' previously required knowledge in English with basic grammatical ideas and sentence patterns reviewed through reading materials appropriate to their levels; (2) to develop reading skill by giving explanation of difficult words, phrases, and syntax, as well as analysis of basic writing skill; (3)to  familiarize students with useful expressions in conversation and build up their confidence in cross-cultural communication; (4)to reinforce the competence and performance of listening, speaking, reading and writing by practice.

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

description.zh: 依據提供服務準則,工程師們須以誠實公平公正正當和奉獻保護公共健康,安全及幸福。工程師們必須以專業標準的行為履行最高的倫理準則。本課程以（1）工程倫理概述（2）衝突與抉擇（3）守則與解說（4）個案分析，提供學生瞭解及研析。
description.en: Accordingly, the services provided by engineers require honesty, impartiality, fairness, and equity and must be dedicated to protection of the public health, safety and welfare. Engineers must perform under a standard of professional behavior that require adherence to the highest principles of ethical conduct. This course offers (1).Description of engineering ethics (2).Conflict and selection (3).Rule and explanation (4).Case study for student studied.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

syllabi.outline:
主要介紹單變數函數的微分運算，和微分在各領域豐富的應用。內容涵蓋極限與連續的定義，微分技巧，畫函數圖形，和極值問題等。課堂上將講解定義並推導重要定理，以培養學生邏輯推理與分析能力；同時會示範微積分在各領域的應用，幫助學生將微積分與其他專業科目結合。其中作業除不可抗拒因素 原則上不予以補交

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

description.zh: 教授電腦工程繪圖基礎，包括立體三維空間的投影觀念、幾何學製圖方法，訓練繪製草圖、各種物件之三視圖；並能正確標註尺寸，公差與配合，使具備繪製各式管路、鋼架、氣油壓及機械設備之相關標準工程圖的能力。
description.en: Instructing the basis of computer engineering drawing, including the concepts of orthographic projection of 3D space and the methods of geometry graphics. Training the skills to raw sketch, various 3D views. Learning to mark dimensions, tolerance and fittings correctly. This lesson also demands students to able to be familiarized the drawings of steel structures, hydraulic and fluid systems, and related mechanical devices.

description.zh: 內容包括各種能量形式、能源轉換、物質之熱力性質、熱力學第一定律。 冷凍與熱泵系統之熱力循環與實驗。
description.en: Analysis of energy systems, energy forms, energy transformation, properties of substance and first law of thermodynamics. Experiments of refrigeration and heat pump cycles.

description.zh: 管路處理、焊接設備及焊接練習、空氣性質測定、冷媒性質測定、基本冷凍循環實習、冷凍系統處理、基本冷凍機電路實習、基本冷凍系統組件之配置。
description.en: To familiarize students with practice of working with tubing, using with oxyacetylene brazing equipment, air properties measurement, identifying refrigerant by T-P curve, evacuating a system, charging and testing a system, wiring of basic electrical circuit and control circuit.

description.zh: 無塵室的應用、無塵室的基本系統、無塵室的基本設計、無塵室節能技術運用、無塵室廠務系統規劃
description.en: Application of clean room, basic structure of a clean room system, fundamental of clean room design, energy saving techniques for clean rooms, planning of clean room factory affairs.

description.zh: 中央空調系統基本設計理念、空調區之熱舒適理論與應用 、空調負荷計算 、風管系統設計、空調系統節能 、特殊空調系統規劃分析
description.en: Basic design concept for central air conditioning system, theory and application of thermal comfort of air condition zone, capacity calculation of air conditioner, piping system design, energy saving of air conditioning systems, planning and analysis of special air conditioning system.

description.zh: 車床、銑床、刨床、磨床、鉗工、鑄造、鍛造、鈑金、氣焊及電弧焊等實習。
description.en: Machining, Welding, Casting and Forging Shop Practice.

description.zh: 現代控制理論簡介、線性空間分析、狀態方程式及響應、可控制性及可觀測性、穩定性分析、狀態回授及估測、控制器設計及應用、觀測。
description.en: Introduction of Modern Control Theory﹒Linear space Analysis, State equation and Response, Controllability and Observability, Stability Analysis, State Feedback and Estimation, Controller Design and Applications, Observer Design and Applications, Nonlinear systems, Time varying Systems, Applications of Modern Control theory.

name.en: Special Topics on e-Design and e-Development

description.zh: 如何藉由商務模型的分析，建置數位化協同產品設計與開發環境，並說明資料管理、構型管隨著網路時代的來臨，不但造成數位化協同產品設計與開發觀念的興起，也造成數位化協同平台技術逐漸成熟，並且將同步工程觀念的實現更往前邁進一大步。本課程是從數位化協同產品設計與開發概念之介紹開始，使學生明白數位化協同產品設計與開發在現代製造業中的重要性，接著介紹理與工作流程管理等相關實務應用觀念。
description.en: Information and network technologies have promoted the traditional concurrent engineering to the next generation. The collaborative e-design and e-development concept has been more popular in industries. This course is introduced from the concept of collaborative product design and development to help students understanding the importance of collaborative e-design and e-development in modern industries. Furthermore, the business model analysis method is provided to construct the collaborative environment of e-design and e-development. In addition, some real cases of data management, configuration management, and workflow management are mentioned.

name.en: Principle and application of fuel cell

description.zh: 本課程由機械工程的角度出發，結合基礎電化學原理，介紹燃料電池的基本原理及種類，由最新市場發展現況導入，介紹燃料電池的發展歷史及最新現況，同時說明提升燃料電池效率及壽命的關鍵影響因素，結合實作方式深入了解燃料電池特性。
description.en: This course is based on the principle of mechanical engineering and electrochemical theory to introduce the basic principles and types of fuel cells. From the latest development in the global market, the course will introduce the fuel cell history and the latest products of fuel cells. The improvement of fuel cell efficiency and lifetime will be explained through   fundamental theory and experiments.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹綠色科技及其在二十一世紀對人類生活的影響，內容包括現今幾個最重要的「潔能」與「節能」科技，以及一些「環保」相關科技。「潔能科技」包括風力能、太陽能、水力能、地球內部能源、生質能、路面能、聲音能、燃料電池、電動車等；「節能科技」包括節能住宅、變頻空調等；「環保科技」則包括碳回收主題。介紹內容包括各項技術原理介紹及其發展概況。
description.en: This course aims to introduce green technologies and their influences on human life in the 21st century. The contents consist of the most important topics about the clean energy and energy conservation technologies. The clean energy technology consists of wind energy, solar energy, hydraulic energy, earth interior energy, bioenergy, roadway energy, sound energy, fuel cell, electric vehicles, and so on. The energy conservation technology consists energy save buildings, variable frequency air-condition, etc.. The environmental protesting technology includes carbon recapture etc.. This course will talk the technical principles and their general developing situations.

description.zh: 本課程介紹光電半導體的基本原理與應用，幫助同學們了解光電元件如發光二極體的製程、封裝、及測試技術的發展，由市場應用概況導入，含蓋設計研發、製造生產、與特性量測等範疇，說明光電元件的光熱電特性對元件效率的影響，並搭配實驗方式深入了解。
description.en: This course introduces the basic principles and applications of optoelectronic semiconductors such as light emitting diodes to help students understand the fabrication process, packaging, and test technologies This course includes application, design and manufacturing. In addition, the influences of optical, thermal, and electrical properties on the device efficiency will be explained through fundamental theory and experiments.

description.zh: 本課程提供理工學者撰寫科技論文之英文寫作技巧與指導，內容包括：扼要複習英文文法，詳細說明撰寫英文研究報告或論文時常犯的錯誤，深入討論標準英文寫作風格與修辭原則，提供簡易而有效的實作原則以提昇科技論文的可讀性。
description.en:
This course develops a curriculum providing students with an English writing skill and direction focused on technical essays, including the followings : 
1. Concise review of English grammars
2. Frequent writing mistakes of essays or reports
3. Deep discussion concerning standard English writing style and rhetoric principles
4. Offering simple and practical writing principles to increase the readability of technology essays.

syllabi.outline:
本課程提供學生們一個可以改善他們的科技英文寫作技巧的環境，內容將包括：1. 扼要複習英文句型與文法，2. 撰寫論文常發生的錯誤，3. 分享論文審稿的經驗，4. 提供淺顯實用的寫作原則，5. 同儕分享讀論文與寫作的錯誤心得。
This course provides an environment to help students improving their English skill in writing technical paper or thesis. What will be included in the class are: 1. concise review of sentence structure and grammar, 2. frequent writing mistakes of paper or report, 3. share of the experience in paper review, 4. offering simple and practical writing principles, 5. share the experience in reading and writing papers.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1-2: Introduction to Technical Paper Writing
 Understanding the importance of technical paper writing
 Exploring various types of technical papers

Week 3-4: Defining the Research and Establishing Objectives
 Formulating clear research questions and objectives
 Conducting a comprehensive literature review
 Identifying research gaps and contributions

Week 5-6: Writing a Solid Introduction
Developing a clear problem statement
Outlining the paper's structure and organization

Week 7-8: Writing the Methodology Section
Describing research design and methodology
Explaining data collection and analysis methods

Week 9 : Midterm Exams 

Week 10-11: Presenting Results and Analysis
Effectively displaying data using graphs, charts, and tables
Interpreting results logically and objectively


Week 12-13: Writing Discussion 
Summarizing key findings and implications
Addressing limitations and suggesting future work

Week 13-14: Enhancing Clarity and Coherence
Improving sentence structure and word choice
Ensuring logical flow between paragraphs and sections

Week 15: Citations and Referencing

Week 16: Peer Review and Feedback
Exchanging papers for peer review
Providing constructive feedback and suggestions

Week 17: Finalizing and Proofreading
Reviewing and editing the final draft
Ensuring proper formatting and consistency

Week 18: Final Group Presentations

description.zh: 本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
description.en: This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

syllabi.outline: To understand how Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management can solve environmental problems. Life Cycle Assessment (LCA), one of the most essential tools for analyzing and assessing environmental issues, will be taught during the semester. Students will also learn about the popular LCA software SimaPro. Various applications related to LCA, such as circular economy, net zero, carbon footprinting, carbon labeling, waste management, and eco-design, will also be practiced in the class.
syllabi.schedule:
1.	Concept of Systems, Life Cycle, and Life Cycle Management
2.	Introduction of Life Cycle Assessment I: History, Development, and Applications
3.	Introduction of Life Cycle Assessment II: Life Cycle Thinking and Life Cycle Management
4.	Methodology of LCA: I. Goal and Scope Definition and Inventory Analysis
5.	LCA Software SimaPro Tutorial: Introduction and Practices (Make learning groups)
6.	Methodology of LCA-II. Inventory analysis
7.	Methodology of LCA-III. Methodology of Life Cycle Impact Assessment (LCIA)
8.	Methodology of LCA- IV. Uncertainty, Sensitivity Analysis, and Interpretation 
9.	Mid-term Exam
10.	Group report- LCA for one product or service 
11.	LCA Applications(I): Product and Process Ecodesign; Environmental Declarations and Carbon Labeling, etc.
12.	Special Topic: CBAM and Carbon Footprinting, Carbon Labeling, Environmental Footprinting, and Material Flow Cost Accounting (MFCA)
13.	Other Types of LCA (Eco-efficiency, MFCA, Social LCA, and Organizational LCA, etc.), and LCA Applications(II): Environmental Engineering Related Applications
14.	Quantitative Performance Assessment for Circular Economy 
15.	Company Tour Visit (Taiwan Cement)
16.	LCA Outlook and Latest Development: Net Zero and Biodiversity; Natural Capital Accounting
17.	Team Project Presentation
18.	Final Exam

本課程主要在於介紹產品環保化設計的概念與實務做法，將會詳細介紹生命週期評估的內涵與原理做法，並將透過軟體的實際作來學期如何從事產品的生命週期評估。簡化式的生命週期評估之作法也會在課堂中被介紹。
This course focuses on introducing the meaning and principles of designing environmentally sound products. The theories and principles of Life Cycle Assessment (LCA) will be introduced extensively. Several sets of LCA computer software will be utilized in the classes for students to practice. Besides, the streamlined LCA (SLCA) will also be taught in the class.

name.en: Special Topics on Nano- Technology and Environment

description.zh: 這門課著重在探討奈米科技之基本原理與應用範疇，以及環境應用與安全相關主題，內容包含奈米之基本特性、各種量測方法、結構控制、以及"納米"對環境應用與安全問題。此外並包含奈米微粒之產生、收集、測量以及微粒動力學等主題。
description.en: This course will investigate the definition and theories of nanotechnology. Including basic properties, measuring methods, structural control, environmental, and safety issues of "Nano-". Topics about generation, collection, measurement and dynamics of nano-particle will also be covered.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces students to the environmental aspects of nanoscience and nanotechnology. We will study the fundamental physical-chemical properties, synthesis and characterization, environmental implications, health and environmental impact, and environmental applications of nanoparticles and nanomaterials. Topics about the generation, collection, and measurement of nano-particle will also be covered. Case studies from recent publications on engineered carbon nanomaterials and nanomaterials on catalysis will be discussed.

description.zh: 這門課除了複習企業環境管理與企業永續的策略做法外，主要在於深入探究金字塔底層(BOP)與創造共享價值(Creating Shared Value, CSV)之理論及實務做法，以及成為一個真正永續企業的策略。
description.en: In addition to the strategies of corporate environmental management and corporate sustainability, this course will be focusing on the theories and practices of Bottom of the Pyramid (BOP) and Creating Shared Value (CSV), as well as the strategies of being a true sustainable enterprise.

syllabi.outline: 這門課主要是給開給博士生及二年級以上碩士生的課程，主要以課題式(topics)的討論，以及問題解決(problem-solving)為主，探討最新永續發展的新議題，以及可資應用的解決工具，討論將會以最新之期刊論文為主，內容探討的議題將包括(不限)：系統思考與永續發展(Systems Thinking and Sustainability)、企業永續治理(Corporate Sustainable Governance)、綠色與永續創新/競爭力(Green and Sustainable Innovation/Competitiveness)、繁茂昌盛(Flourishing vs. Sustainability)、地球限度(Planetary Boundaries for Sustainability)、B團隊及B計畫(B Team and Plan B)、社會面相之生命週期評估(SLCA)、生命週期永續性評估及為永續發展目標的生命週期評估(LCSA & LCA for SDGs)、金字塔底層及包容性企業(Base of the Pyramid/ Inclusive Business)，其他議題。

description.zh: 本課程主要介紹自動化光學精密檢測相關技術，內容包括如下：前言，精密量測概論，機器視覺原理，二維光學檢測技術及實習，三維光學檢測技術及實習，影像處理與人工智慧技術運用，智慧型量測系統及應用，系統整合之相關技術，產業相關技術應用，及結論。
description.en: This subject is arranged to introduce the principles and techniques required in Automatic Optical Inspection (AOI). The subject includes the following subtopics: introduction to precision metrology and machine vision, the measurement principles and methods used in the 2D AOI, the measurement principles and techniques used in the 3D AOI, image processing and artificial intelligence methods used in automatic inspection, intelligent measurement systems, AOI system integration and conclusion.

This course aims to introduce the concept, methodology, and algorithms of Automatic Optical Inspection and machine vision as well as the hardware and software used by automatic optical inspection. The object is to provide a fundamental understanding upon automatic optical inspection so that the students can quickly apply what they have learned to solve quality inspection problems. The course is particularly suitable for students who are interested in the subject of automatic optical inspection.

description.zh: 人工智慧工具可以提供環境工程與管理領域諸多助益，使用人工智慧工具的主要優勢之一是能夠有效地分析和處理大量數據。環境數據的複雜性是一個具有挑戰性的課題，而人工智慧提供了實現更精確預測、持續監控、風險評估與問題解決方案。本課程將簡要介紹人工智慧技術的發展，以及人工智慧相關物聯網、環境監測、環境品質預測、環境研究等領域應用事例，還有人工智慧工具使用對環境可能的衝擊影響。

人工智慧工具可以提供環境工程與管理領域諸多助益，使用人工智慧工具的主要優勢之一是能夠有效地分析和處理大量數據。環境數據的複雜性是一個具有挑戰性的課題，而人工智慧提供了實現更精確預測、持續監控、風險評估與問題解決方案。本課程將簡要介紹人工智慧技術的發展，以及人工智慧相關物聯網、環境監測、環境品質預測、環境研究等領域應用事例，還有人工智慧工具使用對環境可能的衝擊影響。

description.zh: 本課程主要在研討傳統的結構化語言的編譯技術。課程所所涵蓋的內容包括有： - 語句上的分析、語句分析器的製作 - 由上而下的組譯器製作 - 由下而上的組譯器製作 - 語意分析 - 機器碼之產生與暫存器之配置 - 資料流分析的理論與應用 - 程式碼最佳化處理。課程的實施，將以基本編譯技術為主，作深入的介紹。學習所得的觀念與技術，將利用一個實驗性語言編譯器的實作來貫穿。因此，程式規畫實作，將在這個課程中，佔有相當大的比重。
description.en: This course discusses issues in the compilation of conventional block-structured languages, as listed below. - lexical analysis, scanner generators; - top-down parsing, LL(1) parsers; - bottom-up parsing SLR, LALR, LR(1) parsers, parser generators; - semantic analysis; - code generation and register allocation, code generator generators; - dataflow analysis: theory and practice; - code optimization. There will be a significant programming component to the course

description.zh:
本課程旨在教授學生如何運用創意編程和視覺化電腦圖形技術，將資料及音訊數據轉換為可視化之2D或3D視覺內容，藉以增進資料及音訊之閱聽體驗。課程進行中，學生將習得多種基於演算法之視覺表現方式，以滿足設計層面中富含躍動感、平衡感以及美感之體驗需求，活用創意編程與新媒體技術來創建更生動、更具有影響
力的動靜態視聽影像。
description.en: This course aims to teach students how to utilize the knowledge from data science and computer graphics technology to represent data and audio into visualized 2D/3D representations, which gives rise to enhanced experiences of reading and listening. Students will learn a variety of programming skills to design visual representation based on algorithms to deliver dynamic, balanced and aesthetic experiences. With the help of creative coding and new media technology, more vivid and influential static and dynamic visual and audio experiences will be generated.

本課程旨在教授學生如何運用創意編程和視覺化電腦圖形技術，將資料及音訊數據轉換為可視化之2D或3D視覺內容，藉以增進資料及音訊之閱聽體驗。課程進行中，學生將習得多種基於演算法之視覺表現方式，以滿足設計層面中富含躍動感、平衡感以及美感之體驗需求，活用創意編程與新媒體技術來創建更生動、更具有影響
力的動靜態視聽影像。
This course aims to teach students how to utilize the knowledge from data science and computer graphics technology to represent data and audio into visualized 2D/3D representations, which gives rise to enhanced experiences of reading and listening. Students will learn a variety of programming skills to design visual representation based on algorithms to deliver dynamic, balanced and aesthetic experiences. With the help of creative coding and new media technology, more vivid and influential static and dynamic visual and audio experiences will be generated.

description.zh: 本課程從電化學概念，電極電位，及腐蝕原理中建立學生腐蝕技術，包括DC極化法，AC阻抗法，諧波法，ER測試，ERR敏化測試高溫水溶液，應力腐蝕測試等，另外腐蝕壽命評估，材料腐蝕管理系統，核能電廠材料，地下緊密電位量測，水溶液腐蝕抑制效果，鋼筋混泥土結構防蝕效果評估均在本課程中一一介紹。
description.en: 1.Electrochemical mechanisms 2.Corrosion tendency and Electrode Potentials 3.Polarization and Corrosion Rates 4.Theories of Passivity 5.Corrosion Prevention 6.Eight forms of Corrosion 7.High Temprature Corrosion

syllabi.outline:
1.電化學機構─腐蝕電化學原理，法拉第定律
2.腐蝕趨勢和電極電位─Nernst方程式，電位─pH圖
3.極化和腐蝕速率
4.鈍態理論─氧化膜理論和吸附理論
5.防蝕法─ 陰、陽極防蝕法和抑制劑、鈍態劑防蝕
6.八大類濕式腐蝕形態
7.高溫腐蝕

1. Overview of semiconductor industry and circuit componenet introduction
2. Semiconductor fundamental (materials, device physics and application)  
3. Front End of Line (FEOL) Technology
4. Backend of Line (BEOL)  Technology
5. Crystal growth , basic properties of Silicon Wafer
6. Introduce 7 principle fabrication modules: Photo lithography, film deposiotn, etch, clean, CMP,  Diffution and process integration
7. Introduce device electricl test 
8. Semiconductor packaging

以材料的凝固解析學為主。包括：熱傳導及流動性等基本原理。應
用上包含金屬、非金屬、高分子等其他原材料之鑄造方法、技巧之
介紹。
description.en:
It lectures the fundamental principles, concept and practical applied technique,
basically speaking, it is mainly based on solidification and analytic process, which includes the fundamental principles of heat transfer and flowability. In practice, it covers the introduction of casting method of metal, non-metal, polymer and other
materials.

description.zh: 本課程介紹在數位影像處理領域中會使用到的基本觀念與技術. 數位影像處理有非常多重要的應用, 如: 影像內容改善, 工業檢測, 機器知覺等. 課程內容包括: 1.數位影像處理的基礎 2.影像的轉換 3.影像的加強 4.影像的復原 5.彩色影像的處理6.影像的壓縮 7.影像的分割與特徵抽取 8.影像的表達及描述 9.影像的辨認與解釋
description.en: The goal of this course is to introduce the basic concepts and techniques used in the field of digital image processing (IP). Digital Image Processing has many important applications, for example, image contents improvement, industrial inspection, machine perception. The outline of this course is: 1.Digital image fundamentals 2.Image transforms 3.Image enhancement 4. Image restoration 5. Color image processing 6. Image compression 7. Image segmentation and feature detection 8. Representation and description 9. Recognition and interpretation.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊(及訓練演算法，支援向量機，線性及邏輯回歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等．
description.en: This introductory course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of this course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, this course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optiminizations, random search, decision tree,  random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model (with its training algorithm), support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques (LDA, PCA, ICA, FA), boosting methods, decision

description.zh: 介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括(1)電機工程介紹，(2)電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3)電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4)交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5)暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6)交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。
description.en: Introduce to the principles of electrical, electronic, and electromechanical engineering. The context contains: (1) Introduction to electrical engineering, (2) Fundamentals of electric circuits: electric, current, voltage, power, and Kirchhoff's current and voltage laws, (3)Resistive network analysis: node analysis, mesh analysis, the principle of superposition, Thevenie and Norton equivalent circuits, (4)AC network analysis: energy storage circuit elements and the analysis of AC circuits excited by sinusoidal voltages and currents, (5)Transient analysis: describe the behavior of a voltage or a current between two distinct steady-state conditions, (6)AC power: simple AC power calculations and the generation and distribution of electric power.

syllabi.outline:
隨著材料科技的進步，材料的應用也逐步擴展到微精密電子元件、3C光電元件、生醫電子元件等範疇。因此在從事相關技術的發展前提下， 了解電子及電路的基本原理有助於強化與提升相關技術的應用與開發能力。
本課程介紹電機、電子以及電機機械的基礎概念。內容包括(1)電機工程介紹，(2)電子電路基本原則：電荷、電流、電壓、功率、科希荷夫定律、歐姆定律，(3)電阻性網路分析：節點電壓和網目電流、重疊定理、戴維寧和諾頓等效電路，(4)交流網路分析：介紹儲能元件並分析由正弦電壓及電流所驅動的電路，(5)暫態分析：探討在不同穩態條件下，電壓及電流的行為，(6)交流電源：簡單交流電源的計算，以及電力的產生及分配。

description.zh: 本課程以全球通史為基礎，以「從史前到古代文明」為主軸：探討人類從史前時代到古代文明的生活型態與設計發展。課程將涵蓋原始社會的生存工具、居住環境、裝飾藝術，進而延伸至美索不達米亞、埃及、印度、中國、希臘與羅馬等古代文明的城市規劃、建築風格、手工藝與社會結構。透過對這些歷史階段的分析，學生將理解不同社會如何運用材料、技術與文化價值觀來塑造其生活環境，並探討這些設計遺產對現代社會的影響。此外，課程將引導學生思考古代設計對現代可持續發展與文化復興的啟發，並透過研究與小組討論，發展歷史與設計的跨領域思維。
description.en: This course is based on A Global History and centers on the theme "From Prehistory to Ancient Civilizations," exploring the development of human lifestyles and design from prehistoric times to early civilizations. The course covers survival tools, living environments, and decorative arts of primitive societies, extending to urban planning, architectural styles, craftsmanship, and social structures of ancient civilizations such as Mesopotamia, Egypt, India, China, Greece, and Rome. Through the analysis of these historical periods, students will understand how different societies utilized materials, technologies, and cultural values to shape their living environments and examine the influence of these design legacies on modern society. Additionally, the course will encourage students to consider how ancient design can inspire modern sustainability and cultural revival. Through research and group discussions, students will develop an interdisciplinary perspective on history and design.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以「史前至古典時代」為歷史背景，探討人類初期生活型態的演變與設計的起源。從史前部落的生存環境與手工藝開始，逐步進入古埃及、古希臘、古羅馬等古文明的社會結構、宗教信仰、建築形式與生活器物，了解設計如何根源於生活需求與文化信仰。課程強調從歷史中理解設計思維與物質文化的起點，並訓練學生具備以文化視角分析生活與設計的能力。

教學目標：
1. 了解史前至古典時期的生活環境與社會結構，建立歷史脈絡中的設計觀。
2. 建立學生對史前至古代文明的生活型態與設計系統的整體理解。
3. 分析古代文化如何透過建築、器物、圖像與空間展現其價值與信仰。
4. 培養學生以歷史脈絡詮釋當代設計問題的能力。
5. 帶領學生從歷史資料與物質文化中進行設計觀察與詮釋的能力。
6. 引導學生發展跨文化與跨時代的思維，強化設計與社會責任連結。
7. 發展研究與表達能力，能以口頭與書面方式清楚說明歷史與設計間的關係。
8. 建立學生批判性思維與跨文化理解能力，為後續課程打下基礎。

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Numerical Analysis with MATLAB

Course Objectives:
This course introduces students to the fundamentals and applications of numerical methods to solve various engineering and scientific problems. By the end of the course, students will understand how to formulate mathematical models, analyze errors, solve nonlinear equations, perform matrix-based solutions of linear systems, apply curve fitting and interpolation techniques, and solve differential equations numerically. The course emphasizes practical MATLAB implementation, encouraging students to develop, test, and interpret numerical algorithms and simulations. Emphasis will also be placed on the methods' efficiency, stability, and accuracy. The course prepares students to be competent problem-solvers in real-world situations where analytical solutions are infeasible.

Teaching Methods:
The course employs a combination of lectures, hands-on MATLAB tutorials, problem-solving sessions, and project-based learning. Weekly lectures introduce theoretical foundations and derivations of algorithms, reinforced with illustrative engineering applications. Students will engage in weekly computer labs to implement and test methods in MATLAB, using provided templates or writing their scripts. Regular homework and in-class problem sets enhance analytical thinking and programming proficiency. Open discussions, collaborative projects, and quizzes provide formative feedback, while a final project allows for creative exploration of numerical methods in student-selected topics. Using graphical visualizations and case studies ensures connection to real-world phenomena, fostering theoretical understanding and practical competency.

description.en:
This course aims to cultivate students' computational thinking and problem-solving skills in human-computer interaction design. It primarily targets students without an information technology background and addresses the challenges faced by design-background students in learning programming. Through multi-stage teaching design and tool assistance, the course reduces the barriers to programming learning, promotes cross-disciplinary integration, and enhances students' innovative implementation abilities in the intersection of design and technology. The course specifically covers the following objectives:
1. Promote the development of computational thinking and logical reasoning abilities 
2. Enhance students' motivation and confidence in learning programming 
3. Facilitate cross-disciplinary knowledge integration and application 
4. Boost learning motivation and innovative implementation abilities

syllabi.outline:
Human-Computer Interaction Design: Autumn 2023 - Syllabus
Meeting Times and Location: Wednesday, periods: 2-4, 
Credit Hours: 3.0
Instructors: Ryan Sheng-Ming Wang
Instructor Office Location and Hours: Room 705-2, Design College bldg., 
Wednesday, 1300-1500: and Thursday 1300-1700.
Instructor Contact Information: E-mail: ryan5885@mail.ntut.edu.tw

Course Description: 
"Human-Computer Interaction Design" blends theoretical and practical perspectives in visualization and interactivity into several focused aspects using interactivity for education, entertainment, interactive media design, and industrial design purposes. 
An interface is a link between a user and a design that communicates how a design will be used, creating an experience for the people who will use it. It provides the framework, elements, and resources for a “conversation” between users and design.
This course will explore the fundamentals of interfaces and the human-computer interaction design process. Students will be introduced to and able to practice the fundamental concepts, methods, and human-computer interaction design practices. They will explore the ideas of "User Experience Observation ", "Form Follows Function," and "User Interaction Analysis and Evaluation". They will explore how interactive media create experiences and understand the role that interaction with contents and installment fulfills in human existence. Finally and most importantly, students need to learn how to improve their ability to present their design ideas.
This class is devoted to lectures, discussions, practice activities, design work sessions, and critiques of practical work. 


Course Objectives/Goals: 
At the conclusion of the course, students will be able to: 
1.	Identify how increasingly complex technologies are integrated into designs, services and events. 
2.	Define how digital or physical artifacts behave in response to user-centric interaction. 
3.	Describe, test and evaluate the usability and sustainability of user interfaces. 
4.	Apply iterative cycles of research, testing and development based on the understanding of user needs, goals and experiences. 
5.	Develop solutions and processes to common or known interface problems. 
6.	Build and test rapid prototypes for look and feel and usability. 
7.	Utilize client based concept development to develop the strategy, information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design. 
8.	Demonstrate competency in information architecture, human-computer interaction and interface design.
syllabi.schedule:
This course is focused on introducing the knowledge of human-computer interaction (HCI) design and accompanying design practice. This will allow students to understand the process of user interface design and related applications so as to be capable of practical interface design. The contents include conceptual model, interface usability, HCI process, user requirements, interface prototyping, principles of interface design, and user testing. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, case study, and practical work and evaluated by students' reports, oral presentations and design work
W1.	What is Interaction Design

description.zh: 本課程之目的為訓練學生有關電子設備散熱設計之相關原理與技術。介紹各項電子元件之發熱量、溫度與元件穩定性之關係，熱對流、熱輻射等熱傳原理在電子設備散熱之的應用法則；解說電子設備散熱器之演進與設計原理，如：熱管之原理與演進、小型風散之特性與設計原則等。探討電子設備的熱阻抗分析、溫度計算、熱應力分析，並介紹相關電腦輔助分析軟體。
description.en: This course introduces principles and techniques of thermal management and cooling design of electronic equipments.  Subjects of this course include: thermal and physical properties of electronic components, thermo-fluid phenomena and principles of thermal management for electronic devices, and the evolution of cooling devices such as heat pipes and micro fans, discussion of analysis methodologies and computer software of thermal management problems including thermal resistances, temperature gradient, and thermal stress.

This course introduces principles and techniques of thermal management and cooling design of electronic equipments. Subjects of this course include: thermal and physical properties of electronic components, thermo-fluid phenomena and principles of thermal management for electronic devices, and the evolution of cooling devices such as heat pipes and micro fans, discussion of analysis methodologies and computer software of thermal management problems including thermal resistances, temperature gradient, and thermal stress.

description.zh: 實驗是進行科學與工程研究不可或缺的工具，實驗方法的設計與實驗數據的分析更是決定實驗結果品質優劣的關鍵，本課程將介紹實驗過程所必須具備的各項知識，以數據的量測與分析為開始，並介紹量測各類物理量的感測元件，如壓力、溫度、流量及聲波等，以建立學生具備實驗量測的基礎。課程主要內容包含有基本量測、量測標準、量測單位、訊號讀取、資料簡報、數據的準確性與變異性、類比訊號量測、數位訊號量測、系統響應、感測器。
description.en:
Introduction of Experiment and Measurement Method
Experiment is the essential tool for the research of science and engineering. The design of experiment and the analysis of data are the keys of the high quality of experiment. The course will introduce the materials of experiment and measurement. The procedures of measurement and the analysis method of data will be detailed investigated. And then the sensors to measure the interested physical parameters of pressure, temperature, flow rate and acoustic will be introduced. The technology of measurement and analysis of experiment will be built up in the course. The contents of the course are basic measurement, standards of measurement, dimension of measurement, access data, data presentation, accuracy and uncertainty of data, analog signal measurement, digital signal measurement, system response, and sensors.

description.en: Design methods, forced convection correlations for single phase heat exchange, pressure calculation, condensers and evaporators analysis, shell and tube heat exchanger analysis, compact heat exchanger analysis, wet coil analysis.

syllabi.outline:
Course Outline:
Design methods, forced convection correlations for single phase heat exchange, pressure calculation, condensers and evaporators analysis, shell and tube heat exchanger analysis, compact heat exchanger analysis, wet coil analysis.
課程大綱：
本課程介紹熱能交換原理與熱交換相關之工程技術。使學生熟悉低溫熱交換中之分析熱效率、選擇材料之方法，及選用高效率熱交換器表面形狀之技術。內容包括：流力、熱交換基礎原理；氣冷式散熱鰭片分析、再生式熱交換器、管內與管集之單相熱傳、壓降計算；冷凝器、蒸發器等兩相熱交換器之設計；以及各種幾何變數、殼管式熱交換器之答拉瓦計算法、強化熱傳表面、鰭片管、熱傳表面積垢之問題與對策。

description.zh: 設計領導係指領導設計與透過設計領導事業，環視益形挑戰與機會的設計創新環境，深具前瞻洞察力的願景與策略是贏得設計領導地位之關鍵因素。本課程含蓋相關文獻理論與實務案例，透過個案研討深入探究如何贏得企業設計領導競爭優勢與永續繁榮成功之道。
description.en:
Design leadership means to design and to lead-to lead design and to lead business by design. Today, those responsible for design creation face leadership challenges and opportunities greater than ever before. Who should lead design? Who leads by design? How and why does a company "lead with design?" Design leadership has many interpretations, ranging from inspiration to collaboration and from culture to globalization. Design leadership is a commercial imperative. It creates differentiation, sustains competitive advantage, and enables world-class performance that is sustainable into the future.
This course will provide the insight and interaction essential to utilizing design leadership for business success. Vision and strategy are the critical elements of leadership. It covers the strategy and the effects of inspiring design leadership and the personal characteristics and attributes of great design leaders.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在教授學生，尤其是創業/設計經理，尋找商業案例研究和技術，以快速將創新產品或服務推向市場並收集可操作的客戶見解。它適用於從中小型企業到企業以及一系列工業領域的一系列組織。本課程有助於解決經理面臨的持續壓力，要求他們進行創新並為客戶推出新穎的產品和服務。我們打算引導他們進行整體思維，以推進商業戰略和創業精神。

This course is designed to instruct students, as well as entrepreneurial and design managers, in search of business case studies and techniques for swiftly launching innovative products or services to the market while gathering actionable customer insights. Applicable to a diverse range of organizations, from small to medium-sized enterprises to corporate entities across various industrial segments, the course serves to assist managers in meeting the ongoing demand for innovation and the introduction of novel products and services. Our goal is to guide participants in adopting a holistic approach to advance business strategy and entrepreneurship, addressing the constant need for innovation in their roles.

description.zh: 本課程旨在探討如何整合科技於文化創意產業，透過案例教學，幫助學生結合有效率的資訊科技工具於人文藝術，以發展文化創意產業，並創造高附加價值的效益。當今產、官、學、研都強調跨域整合的重要性，文創與互動科技的結合，能為文化創意作加值，並注入新生命、新體驗，因此，文創遇到科技後，所激盪出的火花與創意，已逐漸受到產、學界的青睞。本課程將探討文化創意的發展脈絡、文創的底蘊與其應用面、互動科技的應用，透過文獻研讀、案例分析等方式，瞭解國外最新研究與趨勢，討論文創與科技的創新應用可行性，引領文化創意產業轉型，規劃未來文創與科技整合的新契機。
description.en: The course intends to explore about how to integrate the technology into the cultural and creative Industries. description.zh: 本課程將討論材料凝固熱力學、材料凝固動力學、平衡及非平衡狀態下材料的凝固現象與凝固界面之溶質濃度分佈情形。課程最後會介紹凝固學在工業界的應用實例：單晶成長與鑄造工程。
description.en: This lecture will first discuss the Thermodynamics and Dynamics for Solidification in Materials under equilibrium and non-equilibrium states. Second, we will discuss the Solidification behavior and solutes distribution at the interface between solid and liquid. Finally, we will briefly introduce the applications of Solidification in industry cases: Single Crystal Growth and Casting engineering.

description.zh: 本課程中包含下列主題：1.簡介；2.電子商店的行銷策略；3.電子商店的建 置；4. 電子商店的經營與管理；5. 電子商店的法律問題；6.案例介紹；7.結論。

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹和探討電子商務的基本概念、原理和實踐。學生將瞭解電子商務的發展背景、關鍵技術、商業模式和相關法律法規等方面的知識。課程內容包括電子商務的基礎概念、網站設計與開發、電子支付系統、網絡營銷、電子商務安全和隱私保護、供應鏈管理以及電子商務的社會和經濟影響等主題。透過案例分析和小組討論，學生將學習如何在電子商務環境中建立和管理成功的網上業務。此外，學生還將進行電商平台的實務操作，瞭解電子商務系統的建置和運營。同時，學生也將探討未來電子商務趨勢和創新。通過本課程的學習，學生將獲得在數字時代運營和成功利用電子商務的能力和知識。


This course aims to introduce and explore the fundamental concepts, principles, and practices of e-commerce. Students will gain an understanding of the development background, key technologies, business models, and relevant laws and regulations in e-commerce. The course covers topics such as the basics of e-commerce, website design and development, electronic payment systems, internet marketing, e-commerce security and privacy protection, supply chain management, and the social and economic impacts of e-commerce. Through case studies and group discussions, students will learn how to establish and manage successful online businesses in the e-commerce environment. Additionally, students will engage in practical exercises on e-commerce platforms to understand the setup and operation of e-commerce systems. Furthermore, students will explore future trends and innovations in e-commerce. By the end of this course, students will acquire the knowledge and skills to operate and leverage e-commerce effectively in the digital era.

Week 2:電子商務基本概念與發展背景 (Fundamental concepts and development background of e-commerce)

Week 4:網站設計與開發 (Website design and development)
Week 5:電子支付系統 (Electronic payment systems)
Week 6:網絡營銷與推廣 (Internet marketing and promotion)
Week 7:電子商務安全與隱私保護 (E-commerce security and privacy protection)
Week 8:供應鏈管理與物流 (Supply chain management and logistics)
Week 9:期中考周 (midterm exam)
Week 10:電子商務與社會影響 (E-commerce and its social impacts)
Week 11:電子商務法律法規 (Legal regulations in e-commerce)
Week 12:電子商務個案探討 (Case studies in e-commerce)
Week 13:電商平台實務操作 (Practical operation of e-commerce platforms)
Week 14:電子商務創新與趨勢 (E-commerce innovations and trends)
Week 15:跨境電子商務 (Cross-border e-commerce)
Week 16:電子商務市場分析與策略 (Market analysis and strategies in e-commerce)
Week 17:電子商務數據分析與決策 (Data analytics and decision-making in e-commerce)
Week 18:期末考周 (final exam)

description.zh: 本課程內容包括通風系統基礎，工業通風，排煙設計，空氣過濾、送風系統設計及安裝與測試，以系統設計為重點。
description.en: The contents of this course include the fundamentals of ventilation system, industrial ventilation, exhaust design, air filtration, air moving system design, construction and testing, the focus of this course is on the system design.

syllabi.outline:
本課程內容：
1.風量計算、風壓降計算與風車軸動力計算
2.風管尺寸之選定（包括風管尺寸選定之方法、選定風管尺寸之工具、風管布置與尺寸選定與風管布置圖之繪製等）
3.風管之製作與安裝（包括圓形金屬風管之製作與安裝、方形金屬風管之製作與安裝、酚醛複合風管之製作與安裝、風管之穿牆與穿樓板等）
4.風口與百葉（包括送風口之選用、回風口之選用、百葉之樣式與構造、風口之壓降、風口之安裝）
5.風管之轉彎、分歧與變管（包括形狀、特性、製作與選用等）
6.管件之選用與安裝（包括風門、氣密風門、消防排煙閘門與防火閘門等）
7.風車之特性與接管（包括風車之型式、風車系統效應與風車之接管等）
8.風管系統之噪音處理（包括聲音之大小、噪音之來源、環境噪音之管制、風管系統之音能估算、音源之擴散、消音元件之選用、噪音估算與檢討等）
9.風管壓降計算實務

name.en: The Social and Cutural Characters in Taiwan

description.zh: 本課程的主要內容是涵括台灣社會與台灣文化兩大部份，台灣社會部份可分為早期台灣原住民社會，十七世紀以後漢人社會的建立，十九世紀從移民社會到定居社會，近代工商業社會的建立等幾部份；文化方面則以原住民文化，漢人文化及近代文化為教授重點，希望在一學期的課程中使學生對台灣的社會與文化有一概括性的了解。
description.en: This course primarily includes two major sections: Taiwan's society and Taiwan's culture.  Taiwan's society is made up of early aboriginal society, Han immigrant society after 17th century, the society of settlement in 19th century and the establishment of industrial/commercial society after 1930.  Taiwan's culture focuses on aboriginal culture, Han culture, and contemporary culture.  This one-semester course provides students with the basic knowledge about the Taiwan's society and culture in the hope that the students would have a comprehensive understanding of the culture and society in Taiwan.

syllabi.outline: This course is specifically designed for international students with Chinese proficiency at the A1 level. Centered around everyday life situations, it introduces Taiwanese society, culture, and related topics through text reading and thematic discussions, providing students with a basic understanding of these areas. The course includes assignments and in-class activities that offer ample opportunities to practice listening, speaking, reading, and writing in Chinese, aiming to enhance students’ overall language proficiency.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration.

description.zh: 本校之普通物理課程專為工程科系背景之同學設計，主要的目的是鼓勵同學參與大自然運行奧秘、法則之探索，並供給爾後修習專業課程之堅實基礎。本課程之內容包含力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學及近代物理。教授者可按每週三小時、二個學期的時間設計、再參酌各系不同之需求、加強或節略某些章節。
description.en: The course is designed for the students with engineering background. The theme of this course is to encourage students to participate in the discovery of laws and wonder of nature, and to solidate the foundation for the particular courses of study for different departments. The contents of this course include mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, electromagnetics, optics, and foundation of modern physics, etc.. The lecturers will emphasize or abridge certain contents based on the individual needs of departments. For this course, there will be 3 credits for each of two semesters,  and 3 lecture hours per week.

syllabi.outline:
此課程旨在使學生理解自然界中常見的物理現象，進而領會物理-生活-科技之關聯。教學以工程背景學生所需要的物理基礎搭配實務探討來進行。主題涵蓋力學、熱力學、聲學、電磁學、光學等物理相關的觀念與應用。
This course aims to enable students to understand common physical phenomena in nature and then understand the connection between physics, life and technology. The teaching is based on the physical foundation required by students with engineering background and practical discussions. Topics cover physics-related concepts and applications such as mechanics, thermodynamics, acoustics, electromagnetism, and optics.

description.zh: 本課程的目的是為了：1.驗證物理理論之真實性，2.培養同學認真的科學態度與方法，3.培養同學數據處理的能力，4.啟發同學自行設計解決量度問題的方法。課程之施行分為上下兩學期，每一學期為一學分三小時。上學期的內容偏重力學、波動、熱力、流力之實驗，下學期的內容則偏重電磁、光學、近物之實驗。
description.en: In this course there will be 1 credit for each of two semesters, and 3 laboraborial hours per week. The first semester experiments involve mechanics, dynamics, thermodynamics, and waves, etc.. The second semester experiments contains electromagnetics, optics, and modern physics, etc.. The purposes of this course are 1: to identify the physical laws, 2:to cultivate the ability of data reduction of students, 4: to instruct the students solving the problems of measurements of measurements by self-designments.

name.en: Introduction to Artificial Intelligence and Internet of Things Applications

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於人工智慧（AI）與物聯網（IoT）的整合應用，並以Arduino作為核心開發平台，培養學生在智慧物聯網（AIoT）領域的基礎應用觀念，重點包括嵌入式系統、AIoT 架構、即時數據處理、物聯網及資訊安全性。課程從Arduino硬體架構與感測器技術出發，介紹各類通訊介面（如Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、LoRa），學習如何進行資料收集、分析與遠端控制。同時，課程將涵蓋人工智慧基礎，並探討如何透過AI技術提升IoT設備的智能決策能力。學生將透過觀念理解、案例介紹與理論基礎，了解完整的AIoT開發流程。
description.en: This course focuses on the integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI) and the Internet of Things (IoT), with Arduino as the core development platform. It aims to equip students with fundamental knowledge in the field of Artificial Intelligence of Things (AIoT), covering key topics such as embedded systems, AIoT architecture, real-time data processing, IoT communication, and cybersecurity. The course begins with an introduction to Arduino hardware architecture and sensor technologies, followed by an exploration of various communication interfaces, including Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and LoRa. Students will learn how to collect, analyze, and remotely manage data. Additionally, the course covers the fundamentals of AI and examines how AI technologies can enhance the intelligent decision-making capabilities of IoT devices. Through conceptual understanding, case studies, and theoretical foundations, students will gain a comprehensive understanding of the AIoT development process.

syllabi.outline:
隨著人工智慧、5G通訊網路與感測技術的迅速發展，智慧物聯網應用已成為現代產業關注的核心領域。這些技術正加速整合，廣泛應用於智慧家庭、智慧醫療、工業自動化、軌道(台鐵、高鐵、捷運)系統及環境監測等多個場域，推動系統朝向智慧化、自動化與自我調適的方向發展。本課程旨在培養學生具備人工智慧與物聯網的基礎知識與實作能力，並透過專題與實驗導向的學習模式，深入理解智慧系統、資料處理的核心技術。課程內容涵蓋物聯網架構、感測器整合、資料傳輸模組、場域應用(軌道機電整合、軌道系統應用)、等主題，學生將學習如何使用Arduino等嵌入式平台設計與建置實體系統。除了傳統人工智慧的應用外，本課程亦有生成式人工智慧的潛在應用。學生將了解大型語言模型或圖像生成模型，進行資料合成、異常偵測、自然語言介面設計、影像識別以及智慧決策支援…等簡介，拓展物聯網應用的智能層次。為使學生具備設計與實作智慧物聯網系統的能力，並能將生成式AI融入創新應用中，為未來跨領域的技術整合與產業發展打下堅實基礎。
With the rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI), 5G communication networks, and sensing technologies, smart Internet of Things (IoT) applications have become a key focus in modern industries. These technologies are increasingly being integrated and widely applied in areas such as smart homes, healthcare, industrial automation, railway systems (Taiwan Railways, High Speed Rail, MRT) and environmental monitoring, driving systems toward greater intelligence, automation, and adaptability. This course is designed to equip students with fundamental knowledge and practical skills in both AI and IoT, adopting a project-based and hands-on learning approach to help them gain a deep understanding of core technologies in intelligent systems and data analysis. Course topics include IoT architecture, sensor integration, data transmission modules and field applications (railway electromechanical integration, rail system applications). Students will learn how to design and build physical systems using embedded platforms such as Arduino. In addition to conventional AI applications, the course also explores the potential of Generative Artificial Intelligence (Generative AI). Students will be introduced to large language models and image generation models, and how they can be applied in data synthesis, anomaly detection, natural language interface design, image recognition and intelligent decision support, further enhancing the intelligence level of IoT applications. The ultimate goal of this course is to enable students to design and implement smart IoT systems and to integrate generative AI into innovative applications, laying a solid foundation for future interdisciplinary technology integration and industry development.

Much attention will be focused on the newly developed technology, referred to as multiple-inputmultiple-output (MIMO) transmission.

4.MIMO I: Spatial Multiplexing 
5.MIMO II: Capacity and Multiplexing Architectures
6.MIMO III: Diversity-Multiplexing Tradeoff

Much attention will be focused on the newly developed technology, referred to as multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) transmission.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督/非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估(Accuracy Assessments)及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。

description.zh: 全球化製造體系的形成，使得合約製造商必須以更積極的態度，從策略面出發，藉由各種電腦與網路的技術，整合內部與外部的流程與資訊，打造數位化工廠。數位化製造的目的，是希望藉由資訊透明化，提升整個製造體系的競爭優勢。課程的設計，是以概念介紹的方式，說明數位製造的應用現況與相關技術。本課程的內容包括：數位化製造概論、數位化製造實例說明、商業模型分析、知識管理、企業知識入口網站、產品資料管理、交易系統、資料倉儲、企業資訊入口網站、工作流程管理、最新數位化相關技術介紹。
description.en: Globalization has lead contract manufactures more active on seeking new strategies to survive. To increase competition, new technologies, such as computer and network technology, have applied. Computer and network technology can integrate internal and external information to establish a so-called "e-factory." This course covers different issues related to e-Manufacturing, such as Concept of e-Manufacturing, Case Study, Business Model Analysis, Knowledge Management, Enterprise Knowledge Portal (EKP), Product Data Management (PDM), Concept of Trading Systems, Concept of Data Warehousing, Enterprise Information Portal (EIP), Workflow Management, State of the Art Technologies, etc.

description.zh: C語言為開發作業系統、嵌入式系統、通訊協定等程式最常使用的程式語言，本課程主要教導C程式語言於實務上之應用，課程內容主要包括：進階指標使用、指標與陣列、指標與資料結構、Pointer-to-pointer、指標函式、Callback function、Bitwise operation應用等，除了於PC上撰寫程式練習之外，亦會有case study來輔助教學以及了解C語言的使用技巧，期末亦會要求學生利用所學習到之技巧來模擬CPU排程與記憶體管理等相關作業系統底層程式。
description.en: The C programming language is commonly used to implement operation systems, embedded systems, and communication protocols. The object of this course is to teach how to apply the C programming language to develop real application systems. The contents of this course include advanced pointer usage, pointer and array, pointer and data structure, pointer-to-pointer, function pointer, callback functions, bitwise operations, and so on. In addition to practice on PC, this course also offers case studies for better understanding. Students will also be required to implement emulators to simulate OS lower level operations, e.g., CPU scheduling and memory management.

syllabi.outline:
C/C++語言是廣泛能與硬體溝通的高階程式語言，無論是在傳統UNIX系統、3D影像虛擬視覺化設計、中介語言等應用上，是新一代程式語言開發的基石。C/C++語言的跨平台的通用性和深層的記憶體管理機制，透過進階的C/C++語言的學習，使其更靈活地發揮在各項專案設計中。本課程會以基礎C/C++語言的回顧為開始，並將C/C++語言帶入位元操作與物件化內容，最後導入電腦圖學與高效能平行化計算等應用。
The C/C++ language is a high-level programming language that can communicate with a wide range of hardware, and is the basis for the next generation of programming language development, whether in traditional UNIX systems, 3D image virtualization design, intermediary languages, etc. The cross-platform versatility and deep memory management mechanism of the C/C++ language make it more flexible for various project designs through advanced C/C++ language learning. This course will begin with a review of the basic C/C++ language, move on to bit manipulation and object-based content, and finally lead to applications such as computer graphics and high-performance parallel computing.

description.zh: 本課程以講授工業用計算機網路中實體層、媒體存取控制與邏輯連結層為主。在實體層中，將討論到目前廣泛於工業上使用的實體媒介。在媒體存取控制上，則討論乙太網路，記號匯流排與記號環網路為主。媒體存取控制也包含目前廣泛於各類控制器上使用的控制區域網路 (CAN Bus)。在邏輯連結層上，主要討論路由器使用的路由協定與路由演算法。
description.en: The main subjects of this course include physical layer, media access control and logic link layer. Popular physical layer medium are discussed first. Media access control sub-layer that includes Ether-Net, Token Bus and Token Ring are the main subjects in the second portion. The contents of the media access control also include CAN bus which is widely used in various controllers. Routing protocol used by routers are discussed in third portion of this course.

syllabi.outline:
This course presents analytic concepts in computer network analysis. It is designed for the beginning graduate students who are interesting in computer networks. Students should have a mathematical maturity typical of undergraduate curricula in science and engineering, including calculus and discrete mathematics, as well as a course in operating systems and a course in computer architecture.

The teaching approach in this course emphasizes modeling, analysis and design principles used in modern computer networks, including the Internet of today. The subject material includes reference models, queuing systems, graph theory, routing algorithms and resource management systems. Case studies include Internet foundation protocols, such as IP and TCP, as well as Internet multicasting and differentiated service principles.

description.en:
Graduate students need to integrate information and innovative insights to successfully achieve a master or Ph.D degree. The course includes:
1. Characteristics of good researchers. 
2. Research planning. 
3. Learning method. 
4. Innovative thinking.
5. Writing method. 
6. Present method.
7. Research design practice

syllabi.outline:
本課程教導研究生完成論文所需具備五種基本能力。
1. 學習力：搜集、閱讀力、整理力、記憶力、心智圖、ChatGPT。
2. 思考力：解釋力、批判力、議論力、創新力、TRIZ
3. 寫作力：傳達力、科技論文寫作。
4. 計畫力：訂定計畫、時間管理、執行力、SOP、資料歸檔。
5. 永續力：研究態度、價值觀。

syllabi.outline: This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles, methods, and applications of power system reliability assessment. It covers component reliability, system reliability indices, probabilistic methods, reliability modeling of generation, transmission, and distribution systems, as well as reliability-centered maintenance and planning.
syllabi.schedule:
Wk1: Course Introduction and Rules.
Wk2~Wk3: Basic Probability and Statistics Review.
Wk4~Wk5: Component Reliability Modeling & System Reliability.
Wk6~Wk7: Reliability Indices for Generation Systems and Adequacy Evaluation Methods. 
Wk8: Reliability of Interconnected Systems.
Wk9: Midterm Close Book Exam.
Wk10~Wk11: Transmission System Reliability Evaluation.
Wk12~Wk13: Distribution System Reliability Evaluation.
Wk14: Reliability of Protection Systems
Wk15: Reliability-Centered Maintenance (RCM).
Wk16~Wk17: Reliability Economics & Integration of Renewable Energy.
Wk18: Final Close Book Exam.

description.zh: 奈米科技在近年來有極快的進展，因此在本課程將介紹最新的奈米材料，包含有量子點、奈米碳材(富勒烯、奈米碳管、石墨烯)、二維奈米材料(二硫化鉬與金屬化)等，對於這些奈米材料的物理、化學與光電特性以及製程方法做進一步的介紹，以期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與科技知識。
description.en: Nanotechnology has a great progress in recent years. This class will introduce the latest information about nanomaterials and their applications. The nanomaterials include quantum dots, fullerene, carbon nanotube, graphene and molybdenum disulfide (MoS2). Their physical, chemical and optoelectronic properties will be comprehensively introduced. We expect to bring the knowledge of newest nanomaterials and technologies to students.

syllabi.outline:
奈米科技與半導體製程技術在近年來受到極大的重視，因此在本課程將介紹半導體基礎與最新的奈米技術，內容包含有基礎電子電路學與半導體製程，以及奈米材料(如奈米碳管、石墨烯、二維奈米材料等)，期許可以帶給同學當今最新的奈米化技術與半導體相關之科技知識。

Nanotechnology and semiconductor manufacturing processes have received significant attention in recent years. Therefore, this course will introduce the fundamentals of semiconductors and the latest nanotechnology. The content includes basic electronic circuitry and semiconductor manufacturing processes, as well as nanomaterials such as carbon nanotubes, graphene, and two-dimensional nanomaterials. The aim is to provide students with the latest knowledge in nanotechnology and semiconductor-related technologies.

name.zh: 計算生物學及醫學資訊

description.zh: 本課程主要教授與計算生物學及醫學資訊學相關之重要主題。 學生能夠了解如何正確分析生物和醫學數據所衍伸的問題及應用。 希望透過課程協助同學了解和學習如何組裝基因體資料和醫學數據分析中經常使用的演算法技術內容，閱讀最新相關生醫技術論文及使用開放工具，增進實際操作之經驗或自行建構分析生醫相關資料之應用系統。
description.en: This course is designed to provide important topics in computational biology and medical informatics. Students are able to learn about problems involved in the generation and analysis of biological and medical data. The course intends to provide good understanding of the commonly used algorithms and public tools in the analysis of genomic and medical data, to read updated scientific reports, and to increase hands-on experiences with accessing and using relevant databases.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主旨在介紹計算生物學及醫學資訊學相關之重要主題，目的在於提供學生漸進式的介紹，理解當代最新之各項生醫分析技術。本課程主要為有志於跨領域學習之學生所設計，內容包含基礎生物學的核心知識與基礎Linux操作，以及生醫領域的序列比對工具和介紹微陣列晶片技術。在奠定基礎後開始進入次世代分析技術的應用，主題將包含DNA定序、RNA定序與總體基因體學分析。希望透過這些內容讓學生在分析各種基因資料並了解不同生物學問題時，具備選擇合適工具與詮釋結果的能力。接著，透過研究實例和分析操作，讓學生接觸到實際實驗測量產生的數據，體會真實研究的過程。藉由實際操作相關分析工具，使學生體會基因資料在實務上的重要性，達到將生物理論與實務應用緊密結合的目標。此外，課程也將邀請計算生物學領域的專家親臨授課，透過專題演講與實作操作，帶領學生深入探索前沿技術，拓展知識與實做技能。
This course aims to introduce important topics related to computational biology and medical informatics. The objective is to provide students with a gradual introduction to understanding the latest contemporary biomedical analysis techniques. This course is primarily designed for students interested in interdisciplinary learning. The content includes concept knowledge of basic biology, fundamental Linux operations, sequencing alignment in the biomedical field, and introductions to microarray technologies. After establishing this foundation, the course will progress to the application of next-generation sequencing technology, covering topics such as DNA sequencing, RNA sequencing, and metagenomics analysis. Through this content, students will develop the ability to select appropriate tools and interpret results when analyzing various types of genetic data and addressing different biological questions. Following this, research case studies and hands-on analytical exercises will allow students to engage with real data generated from experimental measurements, providing insight into the actual research process. By directly working with relevant analytical tools, students will gain an appreciation for the practical significance of genetic data, achieving the goal of closely integrating biological theory with real-world applications. In addition, the course will feature guest lectures and hands-on workshops by experts in computational biology, guiding students in exploring cutting-edge technologies and expanding both their theoretical knowledge and practical skills.

name.en: Practices and applications of TRIZ innovative thinking

description.zh: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。
description.en: The aim of this course is to show how to implement TRIZ to resolve conflicts in Product R&D, engineering, and management tactic in a innovative thinking manner. TRIZ has been well-known as a creative and innovative thinking theory in solving engineering and technology contradictions in the last two decades. However, few studies and practical usage were proposed in Product R&D, management area. Nearly 30 real cases are discussed to demonstrate the ideas guided by TRIZ in product R&D management, engineering technology, Project management, Service industry management, and Production management. This course is able to pre-train a lot of students creative way and solve contradiction for further applications in real career.

description.zh: 本課程將以近期著作權法著名案例的評析，培養學生關鍵的基礎能力，再導入若該著作為人工智慧自行創作或人類以人工智慧為輔具所創作之法律爭議，鼓勵學生從比較法考察及跨域科法整合之觀點，剖析立法、司法或行政所面臨的問題，並探求可能解決問題的具體措施或建議方案。
description.en: This course will analyze recent well-known copyright cases, expecting that relevant fundamental capability of students can be built.  Further, legal issues will be introduced in dealing with the copyright work created by AI itself, or created by human beings who are aided by AI.  Besides, efforts will be made to encourage students to analyze the problems encountered in legislative, judiciary, and administrative sectors, with considerations on comparative law and with viewpoints from integration of law and technology, and to propose concrete measures and suggestions that may help to solve the problems.

syllabi.outline: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. This course introduces the main meanings, concepts and contents of the Copyright Law. Including the scope for copyright protection, the kinds of works that qualify for copyright protection, the rights granted to copyright owners, the management of copyright, and remedies for right infringement. In particular, what are copyright protections applied with AI? The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding the exchanges between copyright protections and AI for the students.

name.en: Economic Analyses of Intellectual Property Rights

description.zh: 本課程將介紹經濟分析之研究方法，不僅探討為何經濟分析之研究方法受到重視外，還會討論以經濟分析之研究方法，來具體檢視著作權、專利權、商標權、營業秘密等相關之智慧財產權，以達成理論與實際並重之教學目的。
description.en: This course will be introductions regarding research methods of economic analyses. This course not only why this research methods of economic analyses are important, but also discusses copyright, patent, trademark, and trade secrets, etc. Purpose of this course is both to put emphasis on theories and practices for teaching.

syllabi.outline: This online course will introduce theories of economic analyses and research methods. Not only does this course introduce why economic analyses are important in recent years, but also does how economic analyze all types of intellectual property rights. Contents of this course are started to discuss basic economic theories and research methods of economic analyses to further examine all fields of intellectual property rights, including copyright, patent, trademark, and trade secrets. Thus, these will achieve teaching purposes for balancing theories and practices. Students who do not have economic backgrounds are welcome to enroll this class. In fact, the class lectures will be in English 30% and in Chinese 70%, and the class materials are in Chinese.
