name.zh: 國際貿易與智財專題研究
name.en: Seminar on Intellectual Property and International Trade

description.zh: 智慧財產是國際貿易中的重要一環，近20年來，由於知識經濟的發展與國際多邊條約的興起，國際架構下的智財法制愈形重要。各國無不苦思如何在保護主義與自由貿易之間取得平衡，此時研究國際貿易角力下的智財發展，具有相當意義。本課程即在提供學生對重要國際組織與條約下所形成的智財法制的基本了解，並由實務案例的討論中，帶領同學分析國際智財法制對國家經濟、法規面的影響。
description.en: Intellectual Property has played an important role as an integral part of the international trade, and its significance has been increasing over the past two decades contributed by the burgeoning international treaties and knowledge-driven economic models.  While individual nations struggle to achieve national prosperity by striking a balance between protectionism and free trade, the changes in intellectual property law and policy under the tussle of international trade are worth of our close attention.  This course intends to provide students with a general understanding on both the theories and practice of intellectual property legal regimes within the context of international trade. Students will learn how the frameworks of intellectual property law and policy affect the societies and economies of individual member states of international treaties. By drawing selected cases for discussion, students will further be equipped with abilities to analyze the impact of international treati

syllabi.outline:

This course focuses on important and emerging issues in international intellectual property. Through case-based discussions, students will acquire knowledge of comparative law and transnational intellectual property law.

name.zh: 文化產業與智慧財產權
name.en: Cultural Industry and Intellectual Property Rights

description.zh: 本課程所定義的文化產業包括音樂產業、電視產業、電影產業、劇場產業和其他表演藝術有關的產業。這些產業區塊都存在相關的智慧財產權議題，例如所有權、權利轉讓、合理使用、侵權行為、契約爭議等等。本課程將透過法院判決的選讀與產業案例研究來讓學生認識文化產業的智慧財產權議題。學生將被要求參與討論。評分方式包括課堂參與和報告。
description.en: The scope of the cultural industry covered by this course includes the music industry, film industry, television industry, theatre industry, and other industries related to performing arts. Intellectual property issues do exist in these industrial sectors. The issues include ownership, title transfer, fair use, infringement, contract dispute, and so on. This course is intended to expose students to various IP issues in the cultural industry through studying court decisions and discussing industrial case studies. Students are required to participate in discussion. The grading policy is based on class participation and essay paper.

name.zh: 創新思維執行力實務應用
name.en: Practices and applications of TRIZ innovative thinking

description.zh: 在現今產業激烈競爭與利潤微薄之階段，落實執行"突破創新"以增加競爭力之唯一生存之道，但鮮少有企業真正瞭解與實際地徹底執行它。不僅工程或服務技術要創新，管理思維更要突破創新，以有效迅速解?錯綜複雜的研發、工程與管理之諸多矛盾問題。本課程以創新構思問題解?法(TRIZ)為基礎，詳細介紹工程技術如何落實創新與管理實務創新如何執行。本課程適用於自有品牌業者、ODM或OEM製造業者、服務業者與學術單位教學研究，特點如下:完整詳實闡述TRIZ理論並輔以大量簡單案例說明TRIZ概念、工程TRIZ實務案例10餘個與TRIZ工程與管理之參數與創新原則說明簡例約800餘個，管理實務案例20餘個，包含研發管理、服務業管理、專案管理與生產管理等。案例與簡例最多，創新執行力可快速上手與實施應用。本課程TRIZ研發、工程與管理兼顧，製造業與服務業高層、中層與基層員工皆符合讀者條件，使"突破創新"輕易實務執行並成為企業文化，亦適用於大學與研究所之工管、企管(經營管理)、工商管與工程相關科系，可自行按需求選擇性深入教授講解某些章節，也替產業界事先磨練一群創新思維之活力新血，可長久伴隨您在職場(或未來進入職場)解決研發、工程與管理之困難矛盾問題。
description.en: The aim of this course is to show how to implement TRIZ to resolve conflicts in Product R&D, engineering, and management tactic in a innovative thinking manner. TRIZ has been well-known as a creative and innovative thinking theory in solving engineering and technology contradictions in the last two decades. However, few studies and practical usage were proposed in Product R&D, management area. Nearly 30 real cases are discussed to demonstrate the ideas guided by TRIZ in product R&D management, engineering technology, Project management, Service industry management, and Production management. This course is able to pre-train a lot of students creative way and solve contradiction for further applications in real career.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹經濟分析之研究方法，不僅探討為何經濟分析之研究方法受到重視外，還會討論以經濟分析之研究方法，來具體檢視著作權、專利權、商標權、營業秘密等相關之智慧財產權，以達成理論與實際並重之教學目的。
description.en: This course will be introductions regarding research methods of economic analyses. This course not only why this research methods of economic analyses are important, but also discusses copyright, patent, trademark, and trade secrets, etc. Purpose of this course is both to put emphasis on theories and practices for teaching.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將介紹經濟分析的理論與研究方法，除了探討近年來為何經濟分析的研究方法如此受到重視外，還會討論到該如何從經濟之角度，來分析各類型之智慧財產權。而課程之內容則從基礎之經濟學理論開始談起，更以經濟分析之研究方法，來具體檢視各領域之智慧財產權，包括：著作權、專利權、商標權、營業秘密，藉以達到理論與實際並重之教學目的。

description.zh: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。本課程將從專利範圍解讀開始，熟悉專利的權利範圍，然後介紹專利策略以及佈局的方向，提供專利佈局與專利策略理論及實務經驗。本課程的綱要如下： 1.專利權利項解讀 2.專利侵權分析流程 3.專利迴避設計要件 4.專利策略分析 5.專利佈局實務 6.案例研究
description.en: Patent litigation, either initiation or defense, has become one of the industrial strategies, and more and more patent suit cases have forced the manufacturers to undertake patent design around. In fact, the industrial fields in Taiwan, theoretically, do not feel strange on design around and patent strategies. However, in practice, they perform much less. That is the reason why Taiwan still has to pay more than five billion US dollars each year for royalty. This course will start from patent claim interpretation, getting patent claims well known, then following with introduction on orientation of patent strategies, and providing theory and practice on patent strategies. The outline of this course is given as follows: Patent claim interpretation; Process of patent infringement analysis; Requirements of patent design around; Patent strategy analysis; Practice on patent strategies; and Study on patent cases.

syllabi.outline: 專利攻防已變成產業策略之一，越來越多的訴訟案件逼使廠商進行專利迴避設計。事實上台灣的產業界對於迴避設計、專利策略與專利佈局理論上並不陌生，但在實務上卻很少實際執行，所以每年仍然付出五十億美金的權利金。因此本課程主要強調專利策略與專利布局分析在企業界的運用；值得強調的是，本課程內容完全與國考無關，係針對『專利技術分析』、『專利佈局』、『專利策略』與『科技管理』等主題作討論，故課程的設計會閱讀相關外文文獻，所以份量頗重，預期每星期均會花很多時間閱讀paper與課堂討論，所以較適合未來擬以相關主題作為論文研究方向之同學修習。

name.zh: 文化產業與智慧財產權
name.en: Cultural Industry and Intellectual Property Rights

description.zh: 本課程所定義的文化產業包括音樂產業、電視產業、電影產業、劇場產業和其他表演藝術有關的產業。這些產業區塊都存在相關的智慧財產權議題，例如所有權、權利轉讓、合理使用、侵權行為、契約爭議等等。本課程將透過法院判決的選讀與產業案例研究來讓學生認識文化產業的智慧財產權議題。學生將被要求參與討論。評分方式包括課堂參與和報告。
description.en: The scope of the cultural industry covered by this course includes the music industry, film industry, television industry, theatre industry, and other industries related to performing arts. Intellectual property issues do exist in these industrial sectors. The issues include ownership, title transfer, fair use, infringement, contract dispute, and so on. This course is intended to expose students to various IP issues in the cultural industry through studying court decisions and discussing industrial case studies. Students are required to participate in discussion. The grading policy is based on class participation and essay paper.

name.zh: 深度學習與太空科技應用

description.zh: 太空科技應用課程旨在介紹太空技術在各種應用領域的應用，並探討太空科技如何影響人類生活和科學研究。課程涵蓋的主題包括：太空探索，地球觀測，通訊和衛星導航，太空工程和材料科學，太空生物學和醫學，太空經濟和商業。通過這些主題的介紹，學生將了解太空科技在各個領域的應用和未來發展方向，並能夠掌握相關技術和知識。
description.en: The Space Technology Application Course aims to introduce the application of space technology in various fields, and explore how space technology impacts human life and scientific research. The course covers topics including space exploration, Earth observation, communication and satellite navigation, space engineering and materials science, space biology and medicine, and space economy and business. Through the introduction of these topics, students will understand the application of space technology in various fields and future development directions, and be able to master relevant technologies and knowledge.

description.zh: 「太空軟體系統設計」課程旨在培養學生在太空任務中設計、開發和操作軟體系統的專業能力。學生將深入了解太空環境對軟體系統的特殊要求，包括真空、輻射、溫度等因素對系統性能的影響。課程將探討飛行軟體的設計和架構，學生將學習如何設計出能夠在極端條件下穩定運行的飛行軟體系統，確保太空任務的順利執行。此外，課程將涵蓋軟體驗證和確認技術，學生將學習如何確保軟體系統的功能性和安全性，並掌握各種測試方法和工具的應用。課程還將關注容錯和自我修復能力的設計，學生將學習如何設計具有容錯和自我修復功能的軟體系統，以應對可能的故障情況。最後，課程將介紹太空軟體系統的專案管理和實施，學生將學習如何有效地管理軟體開發專案，確保項目按時交付並符合品質標準。此外，課程還將包括深度學習在太空軟體系統中的應用，學生將探索如何利用深度學習技術來改進太空任務中的軟體系統設計和性能，以及酬載資料處理軟體的設計和開發，以支援太空任務中的資料收集和分析。通過本課程的學習，學生將具備設計和開發太空軟體系統所需的技能和知識，為未來在太空工程或相關領域的工作做好準備。
description.en: The course "Space Software System Design" aims to cultivate students' professional abilities in designing, developing, and operating software systems for space missions. Students will gain in-depth understanding of the special requirements that the space environment imposes on software systems, including the impact of factors such as vacuum, radiation, and temperature on system performance. The course will explore the design and architecture of flight software, teaching students how to design flight software systems that can operate stably under extreme conditions, ensuring the smooth execution of space missions. Additionally, the course will cover software verification and validation techniques, enabling students to ensure the functionality and safety of software systems and master various testing methods and tools.

syllabi.outline:
本課程聚焦於太空載具與任務控制系統的嵌入式軟體設計，強調高可靠、容錯、與低功耗需求下的軟體架構規劃與測試驗證流程，涵蓋飛控軟體開發、地面任務支援軟體、人因介面設計、安全性與資安防護，以及人工智慧於任務自動化之應用。

This course focuses on the design of embedded software systems for space vehicles and mission control. Emphasis is placed on fault tolerance, reliability, low-power operations, and rigorous validation. Topics include flight control software, ground support systems, human-machine interface, cybersecurity, and the use of AI in space mission automation.

description.zh: 材料科學為工程教育的重要科技，材料的性質與特性，為現代工程設計中佔有相當重要的地位，金屬材料的各種性質，都基於其內部構造的變化，其內部原子聚集成規則的結晶構造，亦或聚集成非結晶構造，其所形成的各種物理特性，由最基本的結晶構造開始了解。電子顯微鏡，破壞力學，超導性，電傳導，超塑性，動態回復，動態時效應變。差排理論、結晶核的形成與成長，合金相理論，晶界自由度，鑄造物的成核與均質化，硬化現象，固體擴散現象，破壞現象及理論，潛變的形成與原因等，充分了解金屬材料特性上的理論基礎與變化軌跡。
description.en: Properties and characteristics of materials play important role in modern engineering design.Each property of materials is based on its transformation at inner structure, its atoms inside converge either a regulated crystal structure or a noncrystal structure, their physical property should be understood from the most fundamental crystalline structure, such as electronic microscope, destructive dynamics, super-conductivity, electronic conductivity, super-plasticity, dynamic recovery, dynamic aging strain , dislocation theory, the formation and growth of nucleus, alloy phase theory, degree of freedom of crystal boundary , nucleation and homogenization of casting product, hardening phenomenon, solid diffusion phenomenon, destructive phenomenon and theory, creep formation and its reason, all of these make student fully understand the theory basis and change record of the metallic material characteristics.

syllabi.outline: 物理冶金學乃是材料科學導論的延伸, 課程內容設計主要是讓學生能夠更深入地瞭解任何材料所呈現出來的最後性質/現象, 都是在材料的微觀結構中就已經決定, 在物理冶金(一)中, 我們主要會討論我們生活上最常面對到的(金屬), 金屬的機械性質好壞與否, 深深地影響了金屬的應用範圍,在討論材料機械性質之前, 我們需要從材料的微觀結構切入, 包含化學鍵結/原子堆積結構/缺陷等, 接著才開始藉由多方面的角度切入, 宏觀地討論材料最後所呈現出來的(機械)性質, 其中, 我們將會從物理冶金裡面最重要的差排理論出發, 從微觀的角度去探討宏觀實驗觀察到現象
syllabi.schedule:

2.材料機械性質 (Mechanical properties for materials)
3.破壞學 (Failure of metals)

description.zh: 導論及AI之工業應用、類神經網路及專家系統搜尋法則、敘述邏輯、驗證、機器學習。
description.en: Introduction of AI in industrial applications, Neural Networks, Searching algorithm of expert systems, Statement logic, Testing, Machine learning.

syllabi.outline: 人工智慧已在各個領域中影響人類生活，特別是在機器學習與深度學習技術的發展。本課程為人工智慧領域的入門課程，旨在提供學生關於機器學習與深度學習的基本概念，其中包含了資料處理、分類以及迴歸類演算法、強化學習、捲積神經網路、遞迴神經網路、深度學習於影像辨識的應用、自然語言處理以及生成式AI及其相關演算法介紹(例如:Transformer、生成對抗網路模型等)。課程亦提供Python程式，並運用實例進行實作練習，如:紅酒品質分類、房價預測、鐵道領域之軌道檢測等等。透過理論以及實作的訓練，本課程最終目標則是希望學生能夠將人工智慧技術應用在當前的工程以及工業問題中。
syllabi.schedule:
週次   單元主題
1. 人工智慧介紹 
2. Python程式語言基本介紹
3-4. 機器學習基本概念
5-6. 分類(classification)模型演算法 
7-8. 迴歸(regression)模型演算法
9. 期中考
10-14. 深度學習介紹與應用(含實作競賽)
15-16. 自然語言處理與生成式AI
17. 期末考
18. 期末實作發表

作業(含課堂參與): 10% 
期中測驗(筆試，概念題): 30%
期末測驗(筆試，概念題): 30%
期末分組競賽成績(含書面報告): 30%

description.zh:
1. 授課目的：  現代都市計劃及都市設計作業內容中，必須考量都市永續環境生態之議題。本課程之目的即在於傳述都市之生態概念在規劃實務上之應用，並探討其作業技術內容及其行政程序，以培養學生永續都市及敷地計畫規劃能力。

2. 授課內容：  由基本永續都市中，思考生態環境、人類生活環境及建築之間的相互關係。綠建築、永續都市之內容。引介各項生態技術原理及其指標講授，進而指導實證操作技術實驗並撰寫論文，再而論證其都計管制規範。

3. 作業練習：  本學期藉由實驗操作、論文報告撰寫，特別著重研討式論辯，訓練學術思辯及技術應用規劃能力，以利學生認識都市生態技術及都計行政作業之整體關聯性，進而建立其全方位規劃思辯能力。

name.en: The earthquake-proof performance principle and the character

description.zh: 本課程將介紹現今用各種結構系統〔耐震、免震（隔震）、制震（減震）〕的特性及耐震性能原理，由基礎力學理論配合應用實務設計做一統括整理解說。並從地震中建築物實際破壞狀況的解說到耐震診斷及耐震補強技術做一現況的解說與說明。
description.en: The earthquake-proof performance principle and the characteristic of the structural system (1.General structure 2.Base isolation structure 3.Virbration control,Damper) being used well now are introduced at this course, and lectures from the mechanics theory of the base to a aactual design. In addition, the destruction situation and the earthquake-proof diagnosis reinforcement in the building are explained due to the earquake.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將介紹現今各種振動控制結構系統〔耐震、震（隔震）、制震（減震）〕的特性及耐震性能原理，由基礎力學理論配合應用實務設計做一統括整理解說。並從地震中建築物實際破壞狀況的解說到耐震診斷及耐震補強技術做一現況的解說與說明。

description.zh: 聯合國教科文組織於1972年通過了《世界遺產公約》，旨在保護世界文化和自然遺產，並將保護和保存文化財產的概念連結起來。五十年來，世界遺產經歷多次變革，觀念與行動與時俱進，1992年，文化景觀概念正式確立，承認人與環境的相互作用和共生關係，縫合了長街以來自然和文化的割裂。2001年，全球文化多樣性宣言的通過，文化在不同時代和不同地方具有各種不同的表現形式，這種多樣性的具體表現，構成人類各群體和各社會具有的獨特性和多樣化。受此影響，文化景觀、無形遺產、水下遺產、產業遺產、文化路徑、聖山遺產、天文遺產紛紛出現。本課程屬建築保存應用課程，將介紹不同主題的世界遺產案例，其目的除了引領同學認識世界遺產觀念及思潮變遷外，亦對國內文化資產保存的學習有所啟發與反省。
description.en: UNESCO adopted the World Heritage Convention in 1972 to protect world cultural and natural heritage and link the concepts of protection and preservation of cultural property. Over the past fifty years, World Heritage has undergone many changes, and concepts and actions have kept pace with the times. In 1992, the concept of cultural landscape was formally established, recognizing the interaction and symbiotic relationship between people and the environment, and sewing up the separation between nature and culture since the Long Street. In 2001, the Global Declaration on Cultural Diversity was adopted. Culture has different forms of expression in different times and places. The specific manifestations of this diversity constitute the uniqueness and diversity of various human groups and societies. 聯合國教科文組織於1972年通過了《世界遺產公約》，旨在保護世界文化和自然遺產，並將保護和保存文化財產的概念連結起來。五十年來，世界遺產經歷多次變革，觀念與行動與時俱進，1992年，文化景觀概念正式確立，承認人與環境的相互作用和共生關係，縫合了長街以來自然和文化的割裂。2001年，全球文化多樣性宣言的通過，文化在不同時代和不同地方具有各種不同的表現形式，這種多樣性的具體表現，構成人類各群體和各社會具有的獨特性和多樣化。受此影響，文化景觀、無形遺產、水下遺產、產業遺產、文化路徑、聖山遺產、天文遺產紛紛出現。本課程屬建築保存應用課程，將介紹不同主題的世界遺產案例，其目的除了引領同學認識世界遺產觀念及思潮變遷外，亦對國內文化資產保存的學習有所啟發與反省。
Heritage is our legacy from the past, what we live with today, and what we pass on to future generations. Our cultural and natural heritage are both irreplaceable sources of life and inspiration. UNESCO adopted the World Heritage Convention in 1972 to protect world cultural and natural heritage and link the concepts of protection and preservation of cultural property. Over the past fifty years, World Heritage has undergone many changes, and concepts and actions have kept pace with the times. In 1992, the concept of cultural landscape was formally established, recognizing the interaction and symbiotic relationship between people and the environment, and sewing up the separation between nature and culture since the Long Street. In 2001, the Global Declaration on Cultural Diversity was adopted. Culture has different forms of expression in different times and places. The specific manifestations of this diversity constitute the uniqueness and diversity of various human groups and societies.

cycle. Through standardized and transparent building

description.zh:
本課程旨在培養學生成為能夠熟練運用生成式AI技術的新時代設計師。通過深入學習生成式AI的基本原理與應用，學生將掌握各種AI輔助設計工具，如ChatGPT、Midjourney等。課程重點培養學生的提示工程技能，使其能夠有效引導AI工具產生所需的設計成果。課程致力於幫助學生將AI 技術整合到傳統設計流程中，同時AI輔助程式設計和網頁開發等實踐培養跨領域能力。課程鼓勵創新思維，激發學生探索AI技術在設計領域的創新應用。通過小組專案，學生將培養團隊合作精神和專案管理能力。另一方面，注重培養學生對AI技術應用的倫理意識，以及持續學習的能力，使其能夠在快速發展的AI技術領域中保持競爭力。總體而言，本課程旨在全面提升學生在AI時代的設計能力，為他們在數位化轉型的職場中做好充分準備。
學生將學習：
1. AI素養
2. 運用生成式AI工具進行設計創作
3. 編寫有效的提示以引導AI生成所需內容
4. 利用AI技術進行圖像和3D生成
5. 將AI工具整合到現有設計工作流程中
6. 使用AI輔助程式設計並完成小專案
7. 評估和應對AI應用中的道德和法律問題
description.en: This course trains new-generation designers to proficiently use generative AI technologies. Students will explore the fundamentals and applications of tools like ChatGPT and Midjourney while developing strong prompt engineering skills to guide AI in producing desired design outcomes. The course emphasizes integrating AI into traditional design workflows and building cross-disciplinary abilities through practices like AI-assisted programming and web development. It also fosters innovative thinking, teamwork, project management, and ethical awareness in applying AI within the design field.

syllabi.outline:

1. 培養學生對生成式 AI 技術的理解、批判思考並具備評估未來工具適用性的能力
2. 掌握「提示工程」技巧，能有效運用 AI 工具進行設計創作
3. 學會整合傳統設計方法與 AI 技術，提升設計效率與創新性
4. 培養運算思考能力、任務分析溝通能力與自動化流程
5. 建立 AI 素養與設計倫理觀念
6. 完成具有實際應用價值的「設計專案」
7. 建構 iPAS「AI 應用規劃師」初級證照核心知識

description.zh: 本課程探討體驗設計的基本概念與理論基礎，涵蓋感知與情感設計(Perception & Emotion Design)、使用者行為(User Behavior)、身體經驗(Embodied Experience)、文化脈絡(Cultural Context)等主題。學生將學習如何分析人類的感官、情緒與互動方式，理解不同文化、環境與社會因素對體驗的影響，並透過案例研究與實地觀察，探索如何透過設計創造有意義且具影響力的體驗。
description.en: This course explores the fundamental concepts and theories of experience design, covering topics such as perception and emotion design, user behavior, embodied experience, and cultural context. Students will learn to analyze human sensory perception, emotions, and interaction patterns while understanding how cultural, environmental, and social factors influence experiences. Through case studies and field observations, students will investigate how design can create meaningful and impactful experiences.

syllabi.outline: 本課程系列旨在培養學生以體驗設計（Experience Design）為核心，探究醫療與照護場域中使用者身心歷程，並透過實地觀察、使用者研究、概念發展與原型測試，提出具社會關懷與實踐力的設計解方。學生將與醫療單位、病友團體合作，聚焦癌症病人、家屬、醫護人員的身心支持需求，實踐USR理念，建立長期設計介入與合作可能性。

name.zh: 設計學研究方法與實踐策略
name.en: Design Science Research Methods & Practical Strategies

description.zh:
設計科學研究重視創造與解決現實世界問題相關且實用的成品或服務。目標是開發具有實用價值並可在實務中實施的解決方案或進一步進行設計驗證。課堂進行方式，除了方法講解，將於課堂採用方法卡與結構化的課堂互動模式，深化學生對設計學在學術研究方法的認識與應用。學生將學會：
1.理解設計學的範疇與趨勢
2.理解如何擬定研究命題與設計研究方法
3.理解量化與質性研究方法
4.理解研究結果的詮釋與視覺化
5.擬定研究命題、研究框架、研究流程與方法
description.en:
Design science research values the creation of finished products or service that are relevant and useful in solving real-world problems. The goal is to develop solutions that have practical value and can be implemented in practice or for further design verification. In addition to method explanations, method cards and a structured classroom interaction mode will be used in class to deepen students' understanding and application of design methods in academic research. Students will learn:
1.Understand the scope and trends of design
2.Understand how to formulate research propositions and design research methods
3.Understand quantitative and qualitative research methods
4.Understand the interpretation and visualization of research results
5.Formulate research propositions, research framework, research processes and methods

description.zh: 產品系統研發的過程漫長，為確保其設計產出貼近市場脈動，具有創新性及競爭力，必須透過大量閱讀、即時掌握新興科技發展趨勢、蒐集分析國際知名實際案例。本課程旨在培養學生對國際趨勢的敏銳度，整合跨領域專業的洞察力，了解不同世代的獨特需求脈絡，如何延伸到產品設計應用與跨國團隊合作，進而發掘有影響力的設計研究議題。
description.en: The ever-changing design trends are influenced by many factors that lead to increasingly complex challenges for people, society and the environment. To keep up with the state-of-the-art research and emerging technologies, designers need to acquire a rich body of knowledge and transfer integrated insights from various disciplines to the new product development. This course focuses on the cultivation of students’ critical thinking ability through analyzing the global design case studies and literature. Students will be asked to take a very active role to contribute to discussions and presentations.

description.zh: 講授設計相關學術研究的基本特質與科學方法的傳統。本課程之目標在於呈現各種研究方法的特質與限制，進而引導初學者以策略性的思考進行文獻探討並架構適當的設計研究策略，最後得以研擬具可行性的研究計劃。上述設計研究策略包括：文獻探討的方法與策略，蒐集研究資料的方法與策略，抽樣的效用與策略，及資料分析的策略等。
description.en: Lecture on theories of academic research and characteristic of science approaches in design research. This course aims to present learners with a variety of research methods and conduct individuals through the process of (1) strategic literature research, (2) constructing proper research strategies and finally (3) organize feasible research plans.

syllabi.outline:
傳說中的研究方法回來了！。本課程旨在教導學生一個簡潔、廣泛又清楚的工業設計研究方法的知識及技能架構，課程包括二部份；第一、探討工業設計研究計畫的準備及撰擬，第二、比較分析主要的工業設計研究方法，並探討其中一種研究方法在工業設計專業領域的應用實例。
This course is a survey of research methodology that is relevant to the Industrial Design field. It focuses on conducting an industrial design research, collect, and report the data. This course also highlights the difference among that mainstream research methodology in Industrial Design field.

確定最終設計解決方案

name.en: The theory and practice of 3D Printing

description.zh: 3D列印（英語：3D printing），又稱加法製造、積層製造（Additive Manufacturing，AM），可指任何列印三維物體的過程。3D列印主要是一個不斷添加的過程，在電腦控制下層疊原材料。3D列印的內容可以來源於三維模型或其他電子資料，其列印出的三維物體可以擁有任何形狀和幾何特徵。本課程將介紹其原理及配合實機操作，使學生能對3D列印技術有正確的認識。(本課程鼓勵學生參加經濟部iPas的3D列印工程師考試)
description.en: 3D printing, also known as additive manufacturing (AM), refers to processes used to create a three-dimensional object in which successive layers of material are formed under computer control to create an object. Objects can be of almost any shape or geometry and are produced using digital model data from a 3D model or another electronic data. This course will introduce the principle knowledge of 3D printing and giving the opportunity to practice the use of 3D Printing.

description.en: ASTM Committee F42 on Additive Manufacturing Technologies was formed in 2009. The myriad process names into seven standardized terms. In this course, the principle of the additive manufacturing technology in terms of its opto-electro-mechanical-system will be discussed. The application and the system development of additive manufacturing are the major topics of this course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程將說明積層製造(3D列印)的加工原理、積層製造系統的七大分類、每一種類的3D列印參數與3D列印結果的分析方法。對於每一種製程的設備設計思維與優缺點進行比較。提供業界的應用案例共同討論其中的關鍵技術與應用門檻。最後，進行期刊論文的閱讀與口語報告。
This course will cover the fundamental principles of additive manufacturing (3D printing), including the seven major categories of additive manufacturing systems, the printing parameters associated with each category, and methods for analyzing the resulting printed components. It will compare the design concepts, advantages, and limitations of equipment used in each process. Industry application cases will be introduced to facilitate discussion on key technologies and practical implementation challenges. The course will conclude with journal article reviews and oral presentations.

syllabi.outline:
重要公告，全英語授課及課程要求 (All English Instruction & Course Expectations):
本課程所有教學內容（包括授課、教材、討論及評量）均以英語進行。英語程度不佳，上課聽不懂，或僅想輕鬆取學分的同學，請鄭重考慮後再選修。本課程為高等進階課程，具一定難度，預期及格率設定於 60% 至 80% 之間。
This course is conducted entirely in English (including lectures, materials, discussions, and assessments). Students with insufficient English proficiency, who may have difficulty understanding lectures delivered in English, or those merely seeking easy credits are strongly advised to reconsider before enrolling. This is an advanced-level course with a significant degree of difficulty; the anticipated pass rate is set between 60% and 80%.




This course provides a comprehensive introduction to advanced manufacturing processes, with a special focus on Creep Age Forming (CAF) and Hot Stamping. Students will gain a theoretical understanding of the underlying principles, including the development and application of constitutive equations. A significant portion of the course involves hands-on laboratory work focusing on SEM analysis, creep aging experiments, and sample preparation (Weeks 3, 7, 9, 12, 15). Students will also practically implement constitutive equations using MATLAB and Finite Element (FE) software through subroutine coding. The course also includes open-book examinations (Weeks 5, 10, 14) requiring library research, with findings discussed in class. Selected weeks (4, 8, 13) will be delivered via online teaching.

Important Course Notes

1. International Student Friendly: This course is designed to be welcoming and supportive for international students.

2. Language of Instruction and Assessment: For all students (domestic and international), all questions, presentations, and examinations must be completed in English.

3. Laboratory Requirement: In addition to scheduled class hours, this course requires frequent participation in laboratory experiments involving SEM analysis, creep aging, and sample preparation. The results from these experiments will be discussed in class and will contribute significantly to your continuous assessment grade.

4. Open-Book Exam Procedure: For open-book exams, students must come to the classroom to collect the exam paper, then proceed to the library to research and answer the questions. Answers and findings will be discussed collectively at the end of the relevant class session.

5. Online Teaching Weeks: Weeks 4, 8, and 13 will be conducted online. Please check [LMS/Email/Course Website] for access details and materials.


本課程旨在全面介紹高等製造製程，特別著重於潛變時效成形 (Creep Age Forming, CAF) 與熱沖壓 (Hot Stamping)。學生將學習相關理論基礎，包含構成方程式 (Constitutive Equations) 的建立與應用。課程的重要組成部分為實作實驗，聚焦於 掃描式電子顯微鏡 (SEM) 分析、潛變時效實驗及試片準備（第3、7、9、12、15週）。學生亦將透過撰寫副程式 (Subroutine)，運用 MATLAB 及有限元素 (Finite Element, FE) 軟體實際應用這些構成方程式。本課程亦包含開書考試 (Open-Book Exams)（第5、10、14週），學生需至圖書館搜集資料，並於課堂上進行研討。特定教學週（第4、8、13週）將採線上教學方式進行。

課程重要事項

1.國際學生友善課程： 本課程致力於為國際學生營造一個友善且具支持性的學習環境。

description.zh:
先修課程：負責教授同意
材料機械性質是強調材料巨觀性質與材料微觀結構, 鍵結及晶體結構之間的關係, 是一門實務性,基本且重要的課程。它包括彈性, 塑性行為, 差排理論, 單晶與聚晶材料之塑性變形, 複合材料, 高溫聚晶材料之變形, 非晶質材料之永久變形, 材料強化機構, 材料破壞, 潛變與氫脆性等問題之討論。
description.en: This course deals with the mechanical behavior of materials. It emphasizes the relationship among macroscopic properties, material microstructure, and fundamental concepts of bonding and crystal structure. Contents of this course include the elastic and elastic behavior , dislocation , plastic deformation in single and polycrystalline materials ,strengthening mechanism of crystalline materials, composite materials, high temperature of crystalline materials ,fracture , fatigue and embrittlement.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to provide an in-depth understanding of the various mechanical properties of engineering materials. Content covers the behavior of materials under different loading and environmental conditions, including elastic deformation, plastic deformation, hardness, impact toughness, fatigue, and creep. Students will learn the principles and methods for testing these properties and will gain hands-on experience through laboratory sessions. The course emphasizes the integration of theory and practice, enabling students to apply knowledge of material mechanical properties to engineering design and material selection. Specific teaching weeks will include laboratory sessions, online teaching, and open-book exams, requiring active student participation, data collection, and discussion.

Important Course Notes

International Student Friendly: This course is designed to be welcoming and supportive for international students.

Language of Instruction and Assessment: For all students (domestic and international), all questions, presentations, and examinations must be completed in English.

Laboratory Requirement: This course includes several laboratory sessions. Experimental results and reports will be discussed in class and will form an important basis for continuous assessment.

Open-Book Exam Procedure: For open-book exams, students must come to the classroom to collect the exam paper, then may proceed to the library to research and answer the questions. Answers and findings will be discussed collectively at the end of the relevant class session.

Online Teaching Weeks: Specific teaching weeks will be conducted online. Please check the Microsoft Teams for access details and materials.


本課程旨在深入探討工程材料的各種機械性質。內容涵蓋材料在不同負載與環境條件下的行為，包括彈性變形、塑性變形、硬度、衝擊韌性、疲勞與潛變等。學生將學習這些性質的測試原理與方法，並透過實驗課實際操作相關測試。課程強調理論與實務結合，使學生能將材料機械性質的知識應用於工程設計與材料選用。特定教學週將包含實驗課程、線上教學及開書考試，要求學生主動參與並進行資料搜集與研討。

國際學生友善課程： 本課程致力於為國際學生營造一個友善且具支持性的學習環境。

實驗課程要求： 本課程包含多次實驗課。實驗結果與報告將於課堂中討論，並作為平時考核之重要依據。

開書考試程序： 開書考試時，學生須至教室領取試題，隨後可至圖書館查詢資料以完成作答。答案及研討成果將於該次課程結束前進行討論。

Weekly Plan (English) — Front-loaded for Week 9 deadline

Week 1 — Intro & SEYI Cup Kickoff
Syllabus; safety; team formation (3–4); topic & KPI draft; toolchain (MATLAB/Python/FE I/O).

Week 2 — Servo Stamping Fundamentals
Mechanics/controls; motion profiles (dwell/pendulum/trapezoid); energy & tonnage; Project M1: Problem statement + KPI + data needs.

Week 3 — Computer Coding Class #1
Motion-profile scripting; load–stroke data structures; plotting; In-Class Assignment #1: baseline motion set + visualization.

Week 4 (Online) — Forming Basics w/ Servo Motion
Yield criteria, FLD, tribology; Deliverable: literature review outline + baseline plan.

Week 5 — Open-Book Exam #1 & In-Class Assignment #2
Open-book (short). Assignment #2: parameter sweep (5 profiles) with energy/peak-tonnage estimates; critique session.

Week 6 — Data & Quick Simulation Sprint
Signal processing; quick load–stroke sim; pre/post templates; M2 Checkpoint: methods draft + initial results (2–3 figures).

Week 7 — In-Class Assignment #3 (Optimization Mini-Sprint)
Tune profiles vs thinning/energy; prepare 5-slide interim deck; peer review.

Week 8 (Online) — Submission Rehearsal
Full report/code/slides peer review; freeze list; compliance check; M3: near-final package.

Week 9 — SEYI Cup Submission & Demo (HARD DEADLINE)
Submit final package; in-class dry demo if required by organizer.

Midterm moved to Week 10 (was Week 9).

Week 10 — Midterm Examination (moved)
Reflection on competition outcomes; gap analysis.

Week 11 — Process Modeling for Stamping (On-line teaching線上教學)
Plane-stress plasticity; constitutive laws; contact/friction/heat; FE setup for servo motion.

Week 12 — In-Class Assignment #4
Case analysis (cup drawing): compare motion profiles using provided results; draw-in/thinning/wrinkle risks; recommendation memo.

Week 13 (Online) — Coding Workflows
Batch runs; FLD checks; parameter studies; reporting templates.

Week 14 — Open-Book Exam #2 & Optimization Loops
Multi-objective trade-offs; simple optimizers.

Week 15 — Advanced Subroutine Validation
Predicted vs measured tonnage; friction calibration; uncertainty notes.

Week 16 — Advanced Subroutines & Digital Twin
Implementation + alignment.

Week 17 — Course Summary & Review
Patterns, checklists, code hygiene.

Week 18 — Final Examination

syllabi.outline:
課程重要警示 (Critical Course Warning):

全英語授課 – 選課門檻提醒 (All English Instruction – Enrollment Threshold Warning): 本課程採全英語授課。若您的英語能力不足以流暢聽懂課程內容、參與討論，或僅為取得學分而無心學習者，請勿選修。 This course is conducted entirely in English. If your English proficiency is insufficient to fluently understand lectures and participate in discussions, or if you are enrolling merely to obtain credits without a genuine commitment to learning, DO NOT ENROLL in this course.
高等課程 – 難度與預期及格率 (Advanced Course – Difficulty & Anticipated Pass Rate): 此為高等進階課程，內容具相當難度，對學生的投入程度要求較高。本課程預期及格率設定於 60% 至 80% 之間，請確實評估自身學術能力、學習意願及時間投入。


This course, "Advanced Mechanics of Materials," delves into the sophisticated mechanical behavior of materials, with a primary focus on composite materials.
本課程「高等材料力學」旨在深入探討材料的精密力學行為，並重點專研複合材料。
While building upon fundamental mechanics of materials principles, the curriculum is specifically tailored to explore the unique characteristics of composites.
在既有材料力學基礎上，本課程將針對複合材料的獨特性質進行深入教學。
Topics include the introduction to constituent materials (fibers, matrices, and emerging sustainable components like biochar), micromechanics, macromechanical behavior of a lamina, classical lamination theory, stiffness and strength analysis, stress-strain transformations, fatigue failure, and damage mechanisms in composites.
內容包括組成材料介紹（纖維、基材，以及如生物炭等新興永續性組分）、微觀力學、單層板的宏觀力學行為、古典層板理論、勁度與強度分析、應力應變轉換、複合材料的疲勞破壞與損傷機制。
A significant emphasis will be placed on understanding and utilizing biochar-enhanced composites.
課程將特別強調對生物炭增強複合材料的理解與應用。
The course structure incorporates laboratory sessions for hands-on experience and online teaching weeks for flexible learning.
課程結構包含實驗課程以獲取實作經驗，及線上教學週以促進彈性學習。
The course will also investigate the application of advanced composite materials, including those incorporating biochar, particularly in areas like railway systems, sustainable construction, and lightweight structural design.
課程亦將探討高等複合材料的應用，包含那些整合生物炭的材料，尤其是在鐵道系統、永續建築及輕量化結構設計等領域。

課程重要事項 (Important Course Notes)

Bilingual Instruction (雙語教學): This course will be conducted with materials and explanations provided in both English and Chinese to support diverse learning needs. 本課程將以中英文雙語提供教材與解說，以支持多元學習需求。
Language of Assessment (評量語言): Major assignments, presentations, and examinations are required to be completed in English. 主要作業、報告及考試需以英文完成。
Laboratory Requirement (實驗課程要求): This course includes several hands-on laboratory sessions. 本課程包含數次實作實驗課程。 Active participation and completion of lab-related tasks are mandatory. 學生必須積極參與並完成實驗相關任務。
Online Teaching Weeks (線上教學週): Specific weeks will be conducted online. 特定教學週將採線上教學。 Students are expected to engage with materials and activities as directed on the Microsoft Teams. 學生應依循Microsoft Teams之指示參與課程材料與活動。
Attendance Policy (出席規定): Students who are absent three (3) or more times (including labs and online sessions where applicable) during the semester will automatically receive a failing grade for the course. 一學期內缺席三（3）次（含以上，適用於實驗課與線上課程應參與部分）者，該課程成績以不及格計。(缺席三次不及格)
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1-2 (第一至二週):
Introduction to Composite Material Components, Emphasis on Biochar
複合材料元件介紹，強調生物炭材料
Learn about the fundamental components (fibers, matrices, interfaces) and structure of composite materials, including an introduction to anisotropic behavior and a special focus on biochar as a sustainable filler/reinforcement.
學習複合材料的基本單元（纖維、基材、界面）與結構，初步介紹異向性行為，並特別關注生物炭作為一種永續性填充劑/增強劑。
Competency Indicator: C401
能力指標: C401

Week 3 (第三週): (Lab Session / 實驗課)
Lab #1: Composite Constituents & Microstructure
實驗 #1：複合材料組分與微觀結構
Hands-on session: Introduction to composite material constituents (fibers, matrices, biochar), sample preparation basics, and microstructural observation. Introduction to micromechanical models.
實作課程：介紹複合材料組分（纖維、基材、生物炭）、試片製備基礎及微觀結構觀察。微觀力學模型簡介。
Competency Indicator: C402 (Partial)
能力指標: C402 (部分)

Week 4 (第四週): (Online Teaching / 線上教學)
Macromechanical Analysis of a Lamina / Composite Material Properties (considering effects of fillers like biochar)
單層板之宏觀力學分析 / 複合材料特性分析 (考量如生物炭等填充劑之影響)
Online lecture and exercises on analyzing the physical and mechanical properties of a single lamina based on constituent properties, including basic models for particulate composites (e.g., with biochar). Macromechanical stress-strain relations.
線上授課與練習：根據組成材料特性分析單一疊層的物理與機械性質，包含顆粒型複合材料（例如含生物炭者）之基礎模型。宏觀力學之應力-應變關係。
Competency Indicator: C402 (Continued)
能力指標: C402 (續)

Week 5-6 (第五至六週):
Mechanical Behavior of Composite Materials / Classical Lamination Theory
複合材料力學行為 / 古典層板理論
Explore the mechanical behavior of composite laminates under different stress and strain conditions using classical lamination theory.
運用古典層板理論，探討複合材料層板在不同應力與應變條件下的力學行為。
Competency Indicator: C403
能力指標: C403

Week 7 (第七週): (Lab Session / 實驗課)
Lab #2: Laminate Behavior & Testing Introduction
實驗 #2：層板行為與測試方法簡介
Experimental investigation/demonstration of mechanical behavior of simple laminates; Introduction to mechanical testing methods for composite materials.
簡易層板力學行為之實驗研究/演示；複合材料機械測試方法簡介。
Competency Indicator: C403 (Practical Application / 實務應用)

Week 8 (第八週): (Online Teaching / 線上教學)
Stiffness of Unidirectional Composite Materials & Laminates
單向性複合材料與層板勁度
Online module on calculating the stiffness (engineering constants, A, B, D matrices) of unidirectional composite materials and symmetric/asymmetric laminates and their applications.
線上單元：學習計算單向性複合材料及對稱/非對稱層板的勁度（工程常數、A, B, D 矩陣）及其應用。
Competency Indicator: C404

Week 9 (第九週): (Midterm Exam & Lab Session / 期中考試 & 實驗課)

期中考試 ；實驗 #3：期中複習與問題研討
Midterm exam covering Weeks 1-8. The lab session will focus on a review of lamination theory, micromechanics, and problem-solving.

Competency Indicator: C401-C404 Assessment

Week 10 (第十週):
Stress and Strain Transformation in a Lamina
單層板之應力與應變轉換
Study the transformation equations for stress and strain in an arbitrarily oriented lamina and their applications in predicting off-axis properties.
學習任意方向單層板的應力與應變轉換方程式及其在預測離軸性質上之應用。

description.en: The laser is one of the three major items invented in 20th century.  Medical laser applications have been widely used in many fields.  This lecture will cover: 1. Laser Physics; 2. Safety Standards; 3. Laser-Tissue-Interaction; 4. Laser in Medical Applications; 5. Laser in Periodontology; 6. Laser in Oral Surgery; 7. Laser Assisted Bleaching; 8. Low Level Laser Therapy; 9. Practical Hands-on and Live Patient Demonstration.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description:
The laser is one of the most groundbreaking inventions of the 20th century, revolutionizing numerous fields, especially medicine. This course provides a comprehensive introduction to the principles and practical applications of lasers in medical and dental settings.

Students will explore both theoretical foundations and real-world use cases of medical lasers, with emphasis on laser-tissue interaction, safety protocols, and clinical procedures. The course also includes hands-on training and live demonstrations to reinforce practical skills.

Key Topics Include:

Fundamentals of Laser Physics
Laser Safety Standards and Regulations
Laser-Tissue Interaction Mechanisms
Medical and Dental Laser Applications
Laser Use in Periodontology
Surgical Applications in Oral and Maxillofacial Procedures
Laser-Assisted Teeth Whitening (Bleaching)
Low-Level Laser Therapy (LLLT) and Photobiomodulation
Practical Hands-on Sessions and Live Clinical Demonstrations

Industry 4.0 intelligent factory because of the heavy use of computer information flow for intelligent control to achieve the production line unmanned situation, cloud database technology is the core technology of intelligent factory, from smart single to web control, to achieve intelligent networking and control. This course to the landing industry application technology-based, imported into the German University of Technology task-oriented learning model, the course teaches students from the construction of a cloud database server to write a three-machine integrated web control program for factory CPS production and marketing information management system, series factory man-machine materials and production lines and quality control, and then use human-machine control PLC to achieve machine networking, factory-wide factory connection.

description.zh: 伴隨著台灣經濟高度發展， 地下水資源在民生、工業及民生用水所扮演的角色日益重要。地下水學科的領域涵蓋水量、水質及防災三方面。修習此課程，學生可以了解地下水文及水井水力學之基本原理，推估區域性地下水蘊藏量及安全出水量，以作為規劃與管理地下水資源之依據。
description.en: As the economy in Taiwan develops, groundwater resources play an increasingly important role in both industry and domestic water supply. The discipline of groundwater covers three aspects: water quantity, water quality and disaster prevention. This course mainly introduces the basic principles of groundwater hydrology and well hydraulics, and tackles how to estimate the amount of regional groundwater resources and determine their safe yield, as a basis for planning and managing groundwater resources.

syllabi.outline: 隨著台灣農工社會、經濟型態的轉變以及對水資源安全供應之要求日益增加情況下，地下水與地表水聯合運用成為整體水資源經營管理不可或缺之一環。而超抽地下水造成之各項災害也與氣候變遷下複合型災害相連結。對地下水文進行更深入之探討，將裨益於解決各項地下水資源應用與防災相關問題。地下水的領域涵蓋水量,水質及防災三方面,修習此一學科，可以了解地下水水文及水力學之基本原理，進而掌握地下水水理與污染傳輸之特性,以作為規劃與管理地下水資源及防災之依據。

name.en: Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering

description.zh: 衛星科技與工程導論的課程將介紹衛星系統及次系統基礎知識，以培養具有從事衛星任務設計之基礎能力。課程內容包括：衛星基本原理，衛星設計與製造，衛星運行與維護，衛星通訊與遙測應用，衛星發展趨勢。
description.en: The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" will introduce the basic knowledge of satellite systems and subsystems to cultivate the fundamental abilities needed for designing satellite missions. The course content includes: the basic principles of satellites, satellite design and manufacturing, satellite operation and maintenance, satellite communication and remote sensing applications, and satellite development trends.

syllabi.outline:
衛星科技與工程導論課程將介紹衛星系統及主要次系統的基礎知識，培養學生具備衛星任務設計與初步工程分析的能力。課程內容涵蓋：衛星基本原理、軌道力學、衛星結構與熱控設計、電源系統、遙測追蹤與控制（TT&C）系統、姿態決定與控制系統（ADCS）、小型衛星發展及未來衛星科技趨勢。
The course "Introduction to Satellite Technology and Engineering" introduces the basic knowledge of satellite systems and key subsystems to develop students' abilities in satellite mission design and preliminary engineering analysis. Course topics include: fundamental principles of satellites, orbital mechanics, satellite structure and thermal control design, power systems, Telemetry, Tracking, and Command (TT&C) systems, Attitude Determination and Control Systems (ADCS), small satellite development, and future trends in satellite technology.

description.zh: 科學視算指的是將大量的運算資料、監測結果或實驗數據，結合電腦繪圖以視覺化的方式呈現出來，幫助研究者進一步瞭解大量數據背後所代表的工程意義，在本課程中將介紹科學視算的原理，教導所使用的軟體工具和繪圖函式庫，讓學生有機會瞭解科學視算在土木工程上的應用，並以案例介紹科學視算的用途，如結構物的地震振動反應、震波在地層中的傳遞狀況、地形特徵和GPS資料的視覺化模擬、以及板塊運動的模擬情形等。本課程先修課程為程式設計，並且最好具備有限元素法的概念，建議研究所同學選修。
description.en: Scientific visualization is the use of computer graphics to visually represent the composite meaning of the large amount of data obtained by scientific computation, extensive monitoring, or engineering experiments. It could help researchers quickly grasp the engineering implications in their field of interest. This course will introduce the basic theory of scientific visualization, teach the relevant programming skills, and demonstrate how to apply the principles of scientific visualization to civil engineering problems. Examples include the seismic response of engineering structures, the propagation of seismic waves in the ground, and the movement of tectonic plates. The prerequisite of this course is computer programming. It is suitable for graduate students to choose as an elective.

syllabi.outline:
This course covers the theory and practice of scientific visualization, which is the graphical process of creating effective visual representations of 2D and 3D scientific data sets. The course will teach students the techniques and tools for generating, manipulating, analyzing and displaying various types of data, such as scalar fields, vector fields, and images. The course will also introduce some topics related to machine learning and graphical processing unit (GPU). 

Due to AI technology, the way of writing programs is changing significantly. This course teaches students how to develop programs using AI technology and how to use techniques to effectively communicate with AI to complete multi-file project-based program development.
By the end of this course, students should be able to:

1. Use AI tool(s) to develop software. Learn skills to efficiently communicate with AI for generating programming code and multi-file software projects.
2. Apply appropriate visualization techniques for different types of data 
3. Use existing visualization software packages and libraries, including Python Matplotlib and Matlab.
4. Describe the current technical relationship between GPU, image processing, and machine learning.

name.en: Special Topics on Geographical Information System

description.zh: 政府近年積極推動行政資訊化，應用資訊技術提昇行政的效率與品質，以達到便民及創新的效益。地理資訊系統(Geographical Information System，簡稱GIs)之開發與應用，即是提供各使用單位在處理大量圖籍與相關文字資料之管理與查詢的最佳解決方案；配合完整中文介面與印表技術，更可提高效率資訊服務。國內各重大工程在規劃設計時，正逐漸引用地理資訊系統。以其強大之資訊處理、整合、分析、及展示等功能輔助，如圖籍疊合與環框分析等，使工程規劃設計更為準確客觀，發揮工程最大效益。
description.en: To provide public service with better quality, the administration of government with information-based is widely established by adopting newly developed information technology.  Geographic Information System is one of the technology especially applicable when massive maps and attribute data are involved in management affairs.  It offers users a solution for information management and data query under a graphic environment with Chinese interface as well as output printing specification.  The planning and design of major construction projects in Taiwan were increasingly referred to GIS for the reason that efficiency can be maximized by the powerful data organization, integration, and display capability along with GIS.

syllabi.outline:
地理資訊系統（Geographical Information System，簡稱GIS）之開發與應用，即是提供各使用單位，對於大量空間資訊存取、管理、查詢、與分析的最佳解決方案。隨著網際網路的普遍，空間資訊的分享，更擴充了服務內涵。國內各重大工程在規劃設計時，正引用地理資訊系統。以其強大之資訊處理、整合、分析、及展示等功能輔助，如圖籍疊合與環框分析等，使工程規劃設計更為準確客觀，發揮工程最大效益。
  本課程學習目標在於建立學員能夠具備空間資訊處理的基礎概念與獨立操作能力，並且可以應用於各項討論中。整體課程可分為三個部份：
  1. 基礎操作能力；
  2. 遙感探測與地理資訊系統整合； 
  3. WEB GIS。
  透過實務作業與群體討論，來加強對於抽象學理概念的理解與應用。

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹地工合成材料之種類、功能及其於工程領域之應用，並以土壤加勁為核心主題，培養學生具備設計、分析與評估加勁構造物(含擋土牆與邊坡)之理論與實務能力。課程內容亦涵蓋相關之施工技術、監測與維護方法、國內外實務案例，並進一步探討加勁構造物於天然災害防治上之應用與最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The overall objective of this course is to introduce the types, and functions, of geosynthetics and their engineering applications. Specifically, this course focuses on the soil reinforcement and provide students the fundamentals and tools needed for design, analysis, and performance evaluation of geosynthetic-reinforced soil (GRS) structures including both walls and slopes. Class also discusses construction, monitoring, maintenance, case histories as well as current state-of-art applications of GRS structures against various natural disasters.

syllabi.outline: The overall objective of this course is to introduce the types and functions of geosynthetics, along with their engineering applications. Specifically, the course focuses on soil reinforcement and provides students with the fundamental knowledge and analytical tools necessary for the design, analysis, and performance evaluation of geosynthetic-reinforced soil (GRS) structures, including both walls and slopes. The course also covers topics such as construction, monitoring, maintenance, case histories, and the current state-of-the-art applications of GRS structures in mitigating various natural disasters.

name.zh: 計算智慧於營建管理之應用
name.en: Application of Computational Intelligence in Construction Management

description.zh: 在當代營建產業中，項目日益複雜且數據量龐大，傳統管理方法已難以應對高效率、低成本和永續發展的需求。計算智慧作為人工智慧的重要分支，能有效處理不確定性、非線性和高維度問題，為營建管理帶來突破性變革。本課程系統性介紹計算智慧技術（涵蓋機器學習、深度學習、模糊系統、進化計算等）如何應用於營建管理各環節。本課程旨在培養同學理解各類演算法的基本原理與適用場景，並透過專案練習及軟體操作讓同學具備計算智慧技術的應用能力。
description.en: In today's construction industry, projects are becoming increasingly complex with massive volumes of data, making traditional management approaches inadequate to meet the demands for high efficiency, cost-effectiveness, and sustainable development. Computational intelligence, as a crucial branch of artificial intelligence, can effectively address uncertainties, nonlinearities, and high-dimensional problems, bringing transformative changes to construction management. This course systematically introduces how computational intelligence technologies—including machine learning, deep learning, fuzzy systems, evolutionary computation, and more—can be applied across various aspects of construction management. The course aims to equip students with an understanding of the fundamental principles and practical applications of multiple algorithms while also developing their skills in applying computational intelligence techniques through hands-on projects and software implementation.

description.zh: 環境生態學主要講述基本生態學之原理原則，進而應用於土木建設工程的方式主要內容包含：(1)環境生態系統、(2)生態學之基本法則、(3)質與能傳遞、(4)汙染物對生態之影響、(5)台灣地區之生態保育、(6)工程開發生態系統造成之影響、(7)環境影響評估、(8)交通及營建工程之環境問題、(9)全球環境變遷、(10)環境品質與法規。
description.en: How to use the national sources in a way to have sustainable development is the main purpose of this study. Improper usage of resources will bring a serious disaster from the natural feed back. Construction should take care of the ecology system and the methods of carefulness would be studied in this course.

syllabi.outline:
Course Description 
Elements of ecosystems, biogeochemical cycling, environmental factor interactions, population dynamics, and community development. 

Course Goals 
This course is intended for students and will examine structure and function of ecological systems, including populations, communities, and ecosystems, role of evolution in structure and function of systems, and influence of society on the biosphere. By the end of the semester, students who complete all necessary assignments will be able to: 
1.	Understand major concepts and terminology in the field of ecology. 
2.	Identify reputable sources for ecological information. 
3.	Comprehend the methods and application of ecological research. 
4.	Evaluate human interactions with nature and effects on natural systems.

syllabi.outline:
生態系統為環境永續的根本。生態系統提供之自然資源與生態服務，也是人類社會中不可或缺的來源。本課程將使同學了解生態系統的運作，以及生態系統的各個組成，透過對生態系統的了解，未來在環境中所建構的各種設施，才能因應環境變化，且不破壞環境。本課程主要目的為在工程中學習與環境的互動，將環境生態因子納入工程建設設計與施作中，使未來硬體建設能更適應環境變異，提高韌性，成為環境所接受的工程。
Ecosystem is the foundation of the environmental sustainability. Ecosystem provides natural resources and ecological service, which are the major supplies for human system. This course is focus on the operation of ecosystem and the components. The understanding of ecosystem would be helpful to build the constructions that is resilient to variable environment and not bring damage to environment. The purpose of this course is to learn the interactions between engineering and environment, and to know how to incorporate ecological factors into engineering design and construction. The hard constructions with environmental considerations are expected to be accepted by the natural environment.

description.zh: 隨著生成式AI與大型語言模型迅速融入設計流程與數位產品開發，互動設計者需具備整合AI技術與人機介面設計的跨域素養。本課程旨在探討人工智慧技術於人機互動設計中的應用，培養學生設計與開發智慧互動系統的核心能力。課程內容涵蓋人機互動及互動設計之基本概念、語意理解與回應機制、以及AI驅動之使用者體驗創新。教學上將透過講述法和工作坊建立基礎觀念，搭配上機實作強化技術操作能力，並以專題導向學習形式，引導學生完成從構思到原型開發之完整設計流程。
description.en: As generative AI and large language models (LLMs) reshape design processes, interaction designers must integrate AI technologies with human-computer interface design to enhance the user experience. This course explores the application of AI in human-computer interaction (HCI), focusing on essential skills for developing intelligent interactive systems. Topics include HCI fundamentals, semantic understanding and response mechanisms, and AI-driven innovations in user experience. Lectures build theoretical foundations, hands-on practice strengthens technical skills, and project-based learning guides students from ideation to prototyping.

name.en: Course in English language Proficiency Tests

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

description.zh: 為增進本校工程相關科系學生之基礎數學能力，本課程希望在18小時中，能使學生對基礎數學有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習微積分之數學基礎。課程內容包括：1. 數與式、2. 不等式、3. 直角坐標系、4. 直線、5. 圓錐曲線、6. 指數與對數、7. 三角函數、8. 向量。
description.en: With the purpose for improving the comprehension in fundamental mathematics for students who major in Engineering, and for building up solid background of Calculus for students' future training, it is planned to have this course. This 18 hours course aims at developing comprehension of basic mathematics、activating capabilities of Logic、strengthening the abilities of computing with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1. Numbers、Functions and Equations, 2. Inequalities, 3. Rectangular Coordinates, 4. Lines, 5. Quadratic Equations, 6. Exponents and Logarithms, 7. Trigonometric Functions , 8. Vectors.

This course will focus on the application of GIS functionality and analyze its main architecture and theory. It will also use relevant GIS software to help students develop their overall planning capabilities."

name.en: Principles and Practices of  Cloud Computing

description.zh: 課程介紹雲端資訊計算與運用相關技術，使學生對雲端平台、架構、服務有全面性瞭解。課程內容包括： 1.雲端運算發展近況及基本概念2.資源虛擬化之基本概念與技術，3.雲端運算相關技術、效能與安全，4.虛擬化資料中心建置-虛擬計算、儲存、網路與應用，6.雲端服務規劃，7.雲端之基礎設施服務、平台服務、軟體服務介紹，8.專題討論。
description.en:
Cloud Computing, either private, public or hybrid, is dramatically transforming every aspect of IT. Now it has become ubiquitous these days, and is the key foundation for developing technologies of Big Data and Internet of Things (IoT). Its deployment starts delivering applications with more benefits than the existing legacy infrastructure.

Because the terms are broadly quoted and adopted, then by this course, the Cloud Computing core technologies and the associated below will be well introduced:
1.Cloud Computing Basic Concept 
2.Resources Virtualization & Software Defined Data Center (SDDC)
3.Cloud Computing Security 
4.Cloud Technologies
5.Cloud Service Planning and Deployment 
6.Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS)
7.Platform as a Service (PaaS)
8.Software as a Services (SaaS)
9.Cloud Service Operations 
10.Case Studies and presentation

description.zh:
本校科技大學的國文課程，以能力及素養之培植為導向，
並以精深致用為授課標的，方能不負大學國文課程之名，
並符合本校重視實務應用的優良傳統。
依授課教師之取擇，課程可概分為兩大類。
一、文學類：著重在文學品味力、語文敏感力、文學創意力與實作創造力等能力的深化。
二、思想類：著重在批判思辨力、邏輯推演力、決斷力、組織整合力、論述力與品格實踐力等能力的提升。
期盼藉由這兩大方面的磨礪，為學「生」未來的「生」存、「生」活與「生」命，開展出璀璨的「三生」有幸。
description.en:
The Chinese language curriculum of the University of Science and Technology of this university is oriented to the cultivation of ability and literacy, and is taught with intensive application. Only then can it live up to the name of the university's Chinese language curriculum and conform to the school's fine tradition of emphasizing practical application.

Depending on the choice of the instructor, the courses can be divided into two categories.
1. Literature: Focus on the deepening of literary taste, language sensitivity, literary creativity and practical creativity.
2. Thinking category: Focus on the improvement of critical thinking ability, logical deduction ability, decision ability, organizational integration ability, discussion ability and character practice ability.

It is hoped that through the cultivation and training of these two aspects, we will develop a brilliant three lives for the future survival, life and life of students.

syllabi.outline: This course is specifically designed for international students with no prior knowledge of Chinese. It aims to enhance students' listening, speaking, reading, and writing abilities in Chinese, enabling them to meet basic communication needs in daily life. The course begins with the Pinyin and Zhuyin systems to help students learn accurate pronunciation, gradually building practical vocabulary and sentence patterns for use in various conversational contexts. Additionally, the course incorporates a variety of activities to strengthen Chinese language skills, foster an understanding of and interest in Chinese culture, and lay a solid foundation for further Chinese learning.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.zh: 注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的ESG原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實ESG原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。 本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。本課程也會讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
description.en: ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

syllabi.outline:
公司治理已成為廿一世紀企業組織架構調整之重大議題，如何經由管理策略及法制設計使台灣企業經營回歸股東長期價值及利益，為政府、交易所與公會等自律機關、及企業經營者必須面對之問題。在法制上，獨立董事監察人、審計委員會之設置、公司自律守則之擬議、股東會之運作，均衝擊我國公司法、證券交易法及交易所規則現行管理架構及規範；在實務上，上市櫃公司如何順利接受公司治理之理念及管理規範，以提昇公司營運的外在評價與體質。
The corporate governance had been the enterprise framework adjustment of the main issue of the 21 century. How do the manage the corporate strategy and system of the law to make the profit for the shareholder, government and enterprise. The main purpose of the course to help the learner to understand the law of corporate and the practice of the enterprise.

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹領導與組織管理的理論與實務。課程目的有四個：(1)了解組織領導與管理的內涵；(2)討論領導與組織管理的理論與實證發現之間的差異；(3)對實務界人士提供具體建議；(4)將領導與管理的技巧應用到生活面。
description.en: This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

syllabi.outline:
EMBA 最重要核心精神為領導力與團隊合作能力，本課程希望培養在企業競爭激烈的環境之下，如何領導企業轉型，並以團隊合作模式加以執行的能力。課程設計為兩天的內容：包括創新與創業的精神、跨領域團隊建立、藉由活動達成團隊學習與互動、團隊凝聚力建立、領導力的訓練與培養、EMBA應具備的四到(學到、交到、做到、玩到)。
The core value of Taipei Tech’s EMBA program is leadership and teamwork. This course is to develop the ability to lead business transformation and team building in the dynamic economic environment. There are six parts in this course: 1. Entrepreneurship 2. Team building with cross-fields 3. Team learning and interactions 4. Leadership 5. Four must-do in EMBA( to Learn, Make friends, play, and make it)

This course focuses on the theory and practice of leadership and management in organization. Its purpose is threefold: (1) To gain an understanding of what the content of organizational leadership and management is; (2) to effectively combine the basic concepts of leadership and organization management and empirical findings and discuss the discrepancies and implications; (3) to discuss practical implications for business management and (4) to apply the basic ideas of leadership and management in daily life.

description.zh: 注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的ESG原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實ESG原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。 本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。本課程也會讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
description.en: ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

description.zh: 新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en: Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。 新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。 課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously. The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

description.zh: 注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的ESG原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實ESG原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。 本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。本課程也會讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
description.en: ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

name.zh: 生成式人工智慧於企業實務之應用
name.en: Application of Generative Artificial Intelligence in Enterprise Practice

description.zh: 隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
description.en: This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.outline:
注重環境永續、社會責任與公司治理的ESG原則，已成全球風潮，更是決定企業未來是否能順利接到訂單之關鍵，也是維繫企業在產業鏈永續發展之命脈。換言之，落實ESG原則，將帶動企業高成長、創造更多的社會福祉。 本課程介紹環境永續、社會責任與公司治理面向的理論與實務及其實踐的能力，結合國內企業推動ESG之相關做法與成功發展經驗，進而發掘、陳述、分析ESG如何促使企業創造出新的商業經營模式？推動 ESG 創造企業新價值與股東財富以及公司利潤間如何求取平衡？並進而提供解決問題之能力。本課程也會讓學生藉由規劃與實施一項公益活動，以實踐企業倫理與社會責任，並藉以思考在推展企業倫理、企業社會責任與公司治理等理念時，如何能落實於企業的體制之中，以建立一個永續發展的企業價值體系。
ESG principles focusing on environmental sustainability, social responsibility and corporate governance have become a global trend. It is also the key to determining whether a corporation can successfully receive orders in the future, and it is also the lifeblood of maintaining the sustainable development of the company in the industry supply-chain. In other words, the implementation of ESG principles will drive high growth of corporation and create more social well-being. This course introduces the theory and practice of environmental sustainability. This course is also designed to enable students to implement corporate ethics and social responsibility by planning and implementing a public welfare activity. The students should think about how to implement corporate ethics, corporate social responsibility, and corporate governance concepts. In order to establish a sustainable enterprise value system.

syllabi.outline:
隨著科技不斷進步，人工智慧技術逐漸成熟，無論在生產流程、企業管理及分析決策等方面都陸續開始導入生成式AI工具，應用場景橫跨企業營運、數據應用以及產品與服務創新等。本課程將介紹生成式人工智慧原理並結合實作方式，透過實際案例和演練來教授生成式AI技術和應用。課程內容包括人工智慧的基礎知識，如深度學習、自然語言處理、圖像處理、推薦系統、預測分析等，並導入人工智慧在企業管理和決策、金融、數據分析、智慧製造等領域等應用案例。課程中將結合Azure OpenAI雲端服務資源，並以人工智慧跨域應用學習模式來跨域應用至數據分析、智慧運算、智慧製造及物流、商情預測、經營管理、金融等領域，以培育學生具備領先同儕之人工智慧跨域應用專業能力。
This course introduces the principles of generative artificial intelligence and combines practical exercises regarding the technology and applications of generative AI through real case studies and drills. The course covers fundamental knowledge of AI, such as deep learning, natural language processing, image processing, recommendation systems, predictive analytics, and introduces the application cases of AI in enterprise management and decision-making, finance, data analysis, intelligent manufacturing, among others. The course will also utilize Azure OpenAI cloud service resources and cross-domain application learning mode to cultivate students’ technical abilities in AI cross-domain applications, spanning across data analytics, intelligent computing, intelligent manufacturing and logistics, business forecasting, management, finance, etc., leading them to stand out among their peers.

syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to Statistics and Probability – role of statistics, population vs. sample, data types, graphical representation of data.
Week 2: Measures of Central Tendency – mean, median, mode, interpretation, and comparison.
Week 3: Measures of Dispersion – variance, standard deviation, mean absolute deviation.
Week 4: Skewness and Kurtosis – Pearson’s coefficient of skewness, moment coefficients, interpretation.
Week 5: Fundamentals of Probability – events, probability functions, axioms of probability.
Week 6: Conditional Probability and Independence – multiplication rule, independent events.
Week 7: Random Variables – discrete and continuous variables, probability mass/density functions, expectation, variance.
Week 8: Joint and Marginal Distributions – joint probability tables, marginal probability, conditional distributions.
Week 9: Special Discrete Distributions I – Bernoulli, Binomial, Poisson distributions.
Week 10: Special Discrete Distributions II – Hypergeometric distribution and applications.
Week 11: Normal Distribution – empirical rule, Chebyshev’s inequality, z-scores, standard normal tables.
Week 12: Sampling Distributions – sampling distribution of the mean, central limit theorem.
Week 13: Chi-square Distribution – variance testing, independence tests.
Week 14: t-Distribution – mean estimation, hypothesis testing.
Week 15: F-Distribution – variance ratio tests, introduction to ANOVA.
Week 16: Gamma Distribution – relationship to exponential and chi-square distributions.
Week 17: Linear Transformations and Subscores – standardization, scaling, effects on mean and variance.
Week 18: Review and Applications – integrated exercises, project presentations, exam preparation.

description.zh: 本課程希望在一學年中，能使學生對微分及積分有充分的瞭解、培養邏輯推理、啟發思考創造、強化計算演繹並注重應用與作圖，以建立同學未來學習工程數學及相關專業課程之數學基礎，充分達到學以致用的目的。課程內容包括：1.極限與連續，2.導數及其應用，3.不定積分與定積分，4.超越函數及其反函數，5.積分法則，6.不定型與瑕積分，7.定積分的應用，8.空間幾何與向量微積分，9.偏導數，10.重積分，11.級數。
description.en: This course aims at developing comprehension of Derivation and Integral、activating capabilities of Logic Inference and Induction、enlightening confidence and independence、strengthening calculating abilities with an emphasis on its application and diagram、furnishing a sound basis for future specialty. The content includes: 1.Limits and Continuity, 2.Derivative and Application, 3.Indefinite and Definite Integral, 4.Transcendental Functions and their Inverses, 5.Techniques of Integration, 6.Indeterminate Forms and Improper Integral, 7.Application of Integration, 8.Basic Vector Analysis, 9.Partial Derivative, 10.Multiple Integration, 11.Infinite Series.

description.zh:
本課程將介紹國內外的房屋生產系統和裝修技術案例。
該課程將在以下主題中進行。
A.規劃審查施工生產的總體方向，包括施工合同，項目預算，生命週期，
  風險管理和資金分配方法。
B.設計物流和裝貨的程度，施工方法。 設計系統，建築設計智能，建築材
  料和性能。 建築生產對社會的影響。
C.施工現場調查，施工計劃，施工前時間表，施工管理，方法及其演變。
D.裝修建築拆除或裝修的評估標準，裝修計劃，設計，項目，法令和系統。
E.拆除：建築拆除的機械和方法，以及建築廢料的再利用。
description.en:
This course will introduce the domestic and foreign housing production system and renovation technology cases.
The course will be conducted in the following topics.
A.	Planning A review of the overall direction of construction production, including construction contract, project budget,life cycle, risk management and method of fund dispatch.
B.	Design The degree of logistics and loading, construction method. Design system, building design intelligence,building materials and performance. The influence of construction production to society.
C.	Construction The site investigation, construction plan, time schedule before construction, construction management,methods and their evolutions.
D.	Renovation The assessment criteria of building demolition or renovation, the renovation plan, design, project, decree and system.
E.	Demolition：The building demolition machinery and methods, and the reuse of building waste materials.

syllabi.outline: This course provides a comprehensive examination of the processes and practices of real estate throughout its entire life cycle, with a focus on Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) perspectives in the building industry. Students will explore international frameworks, practical methodologies, and innovative approaches that shape sustainable real estate development, construction, operation, renovation, and demolition.

syllabi.outline:
本門課程旨在提供給博士生熟悉並掌握最先進的資料分析技術，以具備與國際頂尖研究型大學博士生相當甚至超越的資料分析能力。課程的第一部分將介紹準實驗設計，幫助博士生掌握因果關係的理念與技術，第二部分將介紹自然語言處理，幫助博士生掌握文字等非結構性資料，並從中獲得寶貴訊息，第三部分將介紹公開資料取得的技術，以掌握全世界的數位足跡以作為研究素材之用，第四部份將介紹人工智慧在數據分析技術上的應用，熟悉並掌握人機協同合作的數據科學家的日常工作，第五部分將介紹LLM在模擬社會科學上的潛力，包括代理人模型等。本課程最終將打開本所博士生的視野，奠定日後在數據科學以及人工智慧時代成為第一流社會科學研究人員的堅實基礎。
This course is designed to provide doctoral students with the opportunity to become familiar with and master cutting-edge data analysis techniques, enabling them to acquire data analysis capabilities comparable to, or even surpassing, those of doctoral students at leading international research universities. The first part of the course introduces quasi-experimental designs, helping doctoral students grasp the concepts and techniques of causal inference. The second part covers natural language processing, equipping students with the skills to analyze unstructured data such as text and extract valuable insights. The third part focuses on techniques for accessing open data, enabling students to harness global digital footprints as research materials. The fourth part explores the application of artificial intelligence in data analysis, training students to understand and master the daily practices of data scientists working in human–AI collaboration. The fifth part introduces the potential of large language models (LLMs) in simulating social sciences, including applications such as agent-based modeling. Ultimately, this course aims to broaden the horizons of doctoral students, laying a solid foundation for them to become first-rate social science researchers in the era of data science and artificial intelligence.

description.zh: 本華語課程規劃為三年制教學，共分三個階段。第一年以基礎華語教學為主，重點包括：發音訓練、基礎字彙、句型與語法，以及日常生活會話。第二年在延續第一年內容的基礎上，強化段落閱讀與書寫能力，並擴展識字量。第三年則著重提升學生的聽力理解、口語表達與語境掌握能力，並融入華人社會與文化的相關內容。
description.en: This Chinese language courde is designed as a three-year curriculum, structured into three progressive stages. In the first year, the focus is on foundational Chinese instruction, including pronunciation training, basic vocabulary, sentence patterns and grammar, as well as daily conversational skills. The second year builds upon the first by strengthening paragraph reading and writing skills, and expanding character recognition. In the third year, the emphasis shifts to enhancing students’ listening comprehension, oral communication, and contextual understanding, while integrating topics related to Chinese society and culture.

This course contains the properties of signals, systems, LTI systems, and basis linear transforms. This is a basic course in the field of communication and control.
The course introduces the properties of signals and systems, and is a fundamental course for those who are interested in communications, signal processing, control systems, and electronic circuits. The student will learn about the basic concepts of continuous-time and discrete-time signal processing. The covered topics are:

1. Signals and systems
2. Linear time-invariant systems
3. Fourier series representation of periodic signals
4. The continuous-time Fourier transform
5. The discrete-time Fourier transform
6. Sampling
7. Time and frequency characterization of signals and systems 
8. The Z-transform (optional)
9. The Laplace-transform (optional)

description.en: This course is concerned with the mixed-signal integrated circuit design. Its purpose is to deal with the analysis and design of mixed-signal CMOS integrated circuits, emphasizing fundamentals as well as new paradigms that students need to master in today's industry. The course covers the following topics. 1.Introduction to mixed-signal design 2.Continuous-time filters 3.Switched-capacitor filters 4.witched-current filters 5.D/A converters 6.A/D conerters 7.Oversampled Sigma-Delta A/D coverters 8.Pipelined A/D converter 9.Layout for mixed-signal integrated circuit

syllabi.outline: This course offers an in-depth exploration into the analysis and design of mixed-signal integrated circuits (ICs), with a particular emphasis on signal conversion and system modeling. The curriculum is structured around four main pillars (MLDS) : (1) Modeling - the development of mixed-signal circuits, (2) Language - proficiency in programming languages such as Verilog-A, Verilog-D, Python, C, and Matlab, (3) Data/Signal - thorough analysis of circuit performance and signal quality, and (4) System - mastery in adaptive optimization algorithms. Practical examples, including voltage regulators, Phase-Locked Loops (PLLs), and Successive Approximation Register (SAR) Analog-to-Digital Converters (ADCs), will be used to reinforce learning.

name.zh: 地面站網路切片與服務品質保證
name.en: Network Slicing and Quality of Service Technology for Ground Stations

description.zh: 本課程探討地面站網路切片技術及其在實際應用中的服務品質保證方法。課程將涵蓋地面站網路的基本概念，包括結構、架構，以及與通訊系統相關的各種技術。學生將透過深入理論學習和實務案例，瞭解地面站網路切片的原理及其在提供不同服務的情境中的優勢。在課程中，學生將學習如何實施地面站網路切片，包括網路資源分配、優先權設定，以及切片之間的隔離。透過實作專案，學生將有機會實際設計、配置和管理地面站網路切片，以應對不同應用場景下的需求。此外，課程將探討服務品質保證技術，包括流量管理、延遲優化、及網路監控等方面。學生將學習如何測量、分析和改進地面站網路切片的服務品質，以確保滿足各種應用的需求。最後，課程也將討論地面站網路切片的未來趨勢，包括與新興技術的整合、標準化發展，以及面臨的挑戰。透過該課程，學生將具備地面站網路切片及服務品質保證的專業知識和實作技能。
description.en: This course introduces ground station network slicing, focusing on practical use and service quality. Students learn slicing concepts, resource allocation, and isolation through case studies and hands-on projects. The course also covers QoS techniques like traffic control and latency management, along with future trends and emerging technology integration.

This course explores practical applications and methods of network slicing for ground stations, emphasizing service quality assurance. It covers fundamental concepts, implementation techniques, and hands-on projects related to ground station network slicing. The course also addresses Quality of Service (QoS) technologies and discusses future trends in ground station network slicing.
