name.en: Multimedia Service in Heterogeneous Network Environment

description.zh: 本課程介紹異質多網多媒體的特性與架構，包含：有線及無線網路的內容介紹，以及整合有線及無線網路成為異質網路的概念，其中將針對IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH)教導學生針對異質網路垂直切換的原理及技術。最後，對於多媒體服務技術及原理做介紹，包含：VoIP服務以及視訊串流服務的介紹，以及如何針對 多種異質網路整合多媒體服務的介紹，藉此提升學生對於新世代異質多網多媒體服務之認識。
description.en: This course introduces the characteristics and architecture of multimedia service in heterogeneous network environment. First, wired and wireless networks, e.g., 3G/3.5G/4G, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth and other popular wireless access techniques, would be introduced one by one. Then, by describing the theory and technology of IEEE 802.21 Media Independent Handover (MIH), this course would show how to integrate multiple different networks into heterogeneous network environments and how to handoff among them. Finally, regarding multimedia service, VoIP and video streaming services would be taken into consideration. This course would introduce how to provide multimedia services over heterogeneous network environment. Therefore, students can learn the next-generation techniques about multimedia services in heterogeneous network environment from this course.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹異質多網多媒體的特性與架構，在多媒體部分，介紹多媒體基本組成、編解碼(Codec)原理、串流(Streaming)協定；在網路部分，介紹常用之有線(Ethernet)及無線網路(Wi-Fi、Bluetooth、Cellular/Mobile)，以及針對多媒體設計之網路機制，最後，配合研究所性質，透過論文導讀方式介紹當下視訊串流(Video Streaming)的最新發展，藉此提升學生對於新世代異質多網多媒體服務之認識。

1. 修課學生可從本課程學習視訊串流(Video Streaming)。
2. 修課學生可從本課程學習異質化網路(Heterogeneous Networks)。
3. 修課學生可從本課程練習相關軟體實作(Software Implementation)技巧。

description.en:
Research and development in bioengineering and medical technology, conducted during recent decades, have led to spectacular progress in clinical medicine and healthcare. These achievements have triggered an enormous increase in the number courses offered in the areas of bioengineering, clinical technology and medical informatics; nowadays, most major universities offer curricula oriented towards these fields. The majority of participants however come from engineering background and so modules dealing with basic biological and medical sciences have been included, to the detriments of scientific exchanges between engineers and medical doctors.

syllabi.outline:
In recent decades, biomedical engineering and medical technology have driven major advances in clinical medicine and healthcare. This growth has spurred the development of related academic programs, now widely offered at universities and graduate institutions. However, most students come from engineering backgrounds, making it essential to bridge the gap between engineering and medical sciences.

This course provides engineering and materials science students with foundational knowledge of human anatomy, tissue structure, and physiological systems. While it does not cover all aspects of biomedical engineering, it focuses on key areas such as biotechnology, tissue engineering, and medical applications.

Acting as a bridge between medicine and engineering, the course promotes interdisciplinary communication and collaboration. Students will gain biological and medical insights relevant to engineering, helping them transition into biomedical fields or better understand clinical technologies. By integrating expertise from both engineering and medical faculty, the course supports innovation and cross-disciplinary development.

syllabi.outline:
什麼是人體結構和功能？
人體結構與功能是一門非必修主要課程，旨在探索人體形式和功能之間的基本關係。解剖學和生理學是生命科學中兩個最基本的術語和研究領域。解剖學是指身體的內部和外部結構及其物理關係，而生理學是指研究這些結構的功能。本課程旨在定義瞭解剖學和生理學，並解釋了為什麼它們對生物醫學工程很重要。主要器官系統的解剖學和生理學將在正常和疾病狀態的背景下進行研究。學生將學習關鍵的生物過程，如中心教條，膜擴散和運輸，細胞信號傳導，氣體交換，血流，營養吸收，血液pH平衡以及動作電位的產生和傳播。然後，學生將應用這些知識來瞭解器官如何對維持體內平衡的各種輸入做出反應。

課程將納入實踐演示，為課程中提供的資訊提供實用框架：
1.根據位置，功能，關鍵成分和解剖命名法確定主要的人體系統。  
2.展示對代謝功能和每個主要器官系統的生理控制的理解。
3.認識並綜合體內平衡的原理，即主要器官系統在生理上如何相互關聯以維持人類健康。

在學期階段，學生將廣泛瞭解身體系統如何在細胞，組織和器官系統水平上發揮作用，並能夠將簡單的生理過程聯繫起來，以更好地了解社會中高度流行的疾病和對生物醫學工程重要實用框架。

人體結構和功能的課程目標：
1.人體是一個實用的結構，它由四種主要類型的數十億個較小的結構組成：細胞，組織，器官和系統。
2.器官是幾種不同種類的組織，如此排列，以至於它們可以一起執行特殊功能。
3.系統是一個由不同數量和種類的器官組成的組織，它們如此排列，以至於它們可以一起為身體執行複雜的功能。
4.十個主要系統包括骨骼，肌肉，神經，內分泌，心血管，淋巴，呼吸，消化，泌尿和生殖系統。
5.身體功能是身體系統的生理或心理功能。身體的生存取決於身體維持或恢復其內部環境的體內平衡，這是一種相對恆定的狀態。
6.人類的生命過程包括組織、新陳代謝、反應性、運動、繁殖、生長、分化、呼吸、消化和排泄。所有這些過程在微調的平衡中協同工作，以維護個人的健康和維持生活。 
7.生命依賴於環境中的某些物理因素，包括水，氧氣，營養物質，熱量和壓力。
人體的結構和功能的課程實踐體驗 
如果人體解剖學和生理學的想法看起來很可怕，請不要擔心。本課程將通過以平易近人且相關的格式涵蓋這些主題來減輕您可能有的任何恐懼。本課程將使您對人體所有複雜的功能和系統如何協同工作更加自信，並將您從解剖學和生理學方面學到的知識與您已經瞭解的身體聯繫起來。將此視為人體使用者指南。有些人可能會說你不能沒有它！

本課程還將涵蓋身體的主要系統，並解釋它們是如何工作的，為什麼它們有時不起作用。此外，它還將檢查不同的疾病和紊亂，醫學的最新進展以及照顧身體的方法。課程包括現實生活中的例子和互動練習，讓你批判性地思考自己的經歷，並與課程建立聯繫。在整個課程中都使用全面綜合知識和理解，為您提供必要的學習材料，以便在您繼續接受教育或職業生涯時保留本課程及以後的內容。在本課程結束時，你將對人體的奇妙複雜性有更大的欣賞和理解。

description.zh: 可穿戴式應用已成了全球科技產業的新寵兒之一。因此，漸漸地，穿戴式裝置已成為人們生活用品的一部分。本課程討論可穿戴式系統導論、無線感測網路導論、生醫資訊模組設計、可穿戴式教學平台之設計、情境感知遠距監控與定位救援手仗之設計、非視覺型之不穩步態偵測分析設計、自行車玩家生醫資訊守護神設計、遠距醫療照護系統設計、與客製化谷歌智慧型眼鏡設計。本課程主要達成跨領域的高度整合應用訓練課程。
description.en: Wearable applications have been become one new darling of the global technology industries. Hence, gradually, the wearable devices have become part of people's daily necessities. This course will discuss the topics of “Introduction of wearable system, Introduction of wireless sensor network, Design of Bio-information module, Design of wearable teaching platform, Design of Context-Aware Tele-monitor and Position-rescue Staff, Detection Analysis and Design for Unstable Gait with Non-vision Base, Bicycler-Player Bio-information Guardian, Design of Tele-Medicine care system, and Design of customized Google Smart-glass”. This course is highly integrated applications to achieve interdisciplinary training.

description.zh:
本課程主要係介紹資料壓縮的原理以及當前幾項重要的壓縮標準。
本課程內容將涵蓋以下主題
01. 霍夫曼編碼
02. 算數編碼
03. 純量量化與向量量化
04. 線性預測與預測編碼法（DPCM，ADPCM，JPEG-LS）
05. 轉換編碼（KLT，DFT，DCT，DST以及Walsh-Hadamard轉換）
06. 分頻編碼法（G.722 Speech coding，MPEG audio coding）
07. 小波編碼法（SPIHT，JPEG2000）
08. 字典模式編碼法
09. 跑長編碼法
10. 主題探討
description.en:
This course is mainly focused on the principles of data compression techniques as well as the state-of-the-art compression standards. The course content includes
01. Huffman codes
02. Arithmetic codes
03. Scalar quantization and Vector quantization
04. Linear prediction and Predictive coding（DPCM，ADPCM，JPEG-LS）
05. Transform coding（KLT, DFT, DCT, DST, and WHT）
06. Subband coding（G.722 Speech coding，MPEG audio coding）
07. Wavelet-Based Compression（SPIHT, JPEG2000）
08. Dictionary techniques
09. Runlength coding
10. Selected topics

name.zh: 地面站網路切片與服務品質保證
name.en: Network Slicing and Quality of Service Technology for Ground Stations

description.zh: 本課程探討地面站網路切片技術及其在實際應用中的服務品質保證方法。課程將涵蓋地面站網路的基本概念，包括結構、架構，以及與通訊系統相關的各種技術。學生將透過深入理論學習和實務案例，瞭解地面站網路切片的原理及其在提供不同服務的情境中的優勢。在課程中，學生將學習如何實施地面站網路切片，包括網路資源分配、優先權設定，以及切片之間的隔離。透過實作專案，學生將有機會實際設計、配置和管理地面站網路切片，以應對不同應用場景下的需求。此外，課程將探討服務品質保證技術，包括流量管理、延遲優化、及網路監控等方面。學生將學習如何測量、分析和改進地面站網路切片的服務品質，以確保滿足各種應用的需求。最後，課程也將討論地面站網路切片的未來趨勢，包括與新興技術的整合、標準化發展，以及面臨的挑戰。透過該課程，學生將具備地面站網路切片及服務品質保證的專業知識和實作技能。
description.en: This course introduces ground station network slicing, focusing on practical use and service quality. Students learn slicing concepts, resource allocation, and isolation through case studies and hands-on projects. The course also covers QoS techniques like traffic control and latency management, along with future trends and emerging technology integration.

This course explores practical applications and methods of network slicing for ground stations, emphasizing service quality assurance. It covers fundamental concepts, implementation techniques, and hands-on projects related to ground station network slicing. Students learn to design, configure, and manage slices, ensuring effective communication for various applications. The course also addresses Quality of Service (QoS) technologies and discusses future trends in ground station network slicing.

description.zh: 電腦數值控制技術的主要目標是實現機械系統的精密運動控制。本課程因此教授實現機械系統高精度運動所需的關鍵方法。涵蓋的主題包括：位置與軌跡控制的插補方法；應用於系統運動學與動力學的數值分析技術；以及精密運動控制系統的分析與設計。本課程結合實際應用案例以闡明這些方法。藉由本課程，學生將瞭解精密運動控制的設計與分析方法，並且能夠利用現有的軟體與硬體技術對機械系統進行精密控制。
description.en: The primary objective of computer numerical control technology is to enable precise motion control within mechanical systems. Accordingly, this course teaches key methodologies essential for achieving the high-precision motions of mechanical systems. Topics covered include: interpolation methods for position and trajectory control; numerical analysis techniques applied to system kinematics and dynamics; and the analysis and design of precision motion control systems. The course incorporates practical application cases to illustrate these methodologies. Through this course, students can understand the design and analysis methods of precision motion control, and be able to use existing software and hardware technologies to precisely control mechanical systems.

syllabi.outline: 先修課程：負責教授同意。電腦數值控制技術主要目標是實現機械系統之精密運動控制。本課程因此教授實現機械系統高精度運動所需之關鍵方法，涵蓋主題包括：位置與軌跡控制插補方法、運動學與動力學數值分析、以及精密運動控制分析與設計，並且本課程結合實際應用案例以闡明該些課程主題。藉由本課程，同學們將瞭解精密運動控制之設計、分析、與模擬，並且能夠應用既有之軟體與硬體技術對機械系統進行精密運動控制。

description.zh: 西藥及中草藥是中華民族的傳統藥，也是中國藥學寶庫的重組成成分，中草藥包括中藥、草藥（即民間藥）以及少數民族地區使用的民族藥，在中國，使用中草藥防病治病已有數千年之歷史，寶鑑證明，中草藥療效確切，副作用較合成中藥少，力來深受群眾喜愛。當前，人類健康需要傳統醫藥之觀點正為越來越多之國家和人民接受，開發傳統要已成為當今藥物發展的潮流。同時，近年來科學研究成果表明，從中草藥發展出療效好，毒性低的新藥是一條成功的捷徑。因此，學習中草藥之人員日漸增加。本課程共分：西藥概論、中草藥概論、內科中草藥、兒科中草藥、男科中草藥、婦科中草藥、美容養生中草藥等。
description.en: The Drugs on Life is a two credit hours course and design especially for technology students. This curriculum emphasizes on the clinical applications and action mechanisms of various western and Chinese drugs. The curriculum trends will start from more details and bring a completely concepts. The subjects include neuropharmacology, autacoids, cardiovascular drugs, analgesics, anaethesia and drugs actiong on the central nervous system, chemotherapy of microbial disease and neoplastic disease, hormones and hormone antagonists, drugs acting on the blood and some Chinese drugs.

syllabi.outline:
在西藥使用之前，人類對疾病的治療均使用天然藥物。而在西藥盛行的今日，天然藥物並未示微，反而是養生保健的最佳良方，對於體質改善、慢性病的控制、延年益壽甚至美容美髮方面都遠較西藥為佳。

在課程內容方面，包括中草藥、西洋草藥、植物精油與香料等在養生保健的應用，均有所著墨。課程中搭配生活實作DIY，以加深同學的學習體驗。

description.zh: 這e世紀時代的資訊交流是一個廣泛、多樣化與複雜的；究竟人們如何透過溝通表達意識與行為，卻變成非常重要。有效的溝通程度常視為學習溝通的指標，須視事實、竟見、感覺、嗜好和經驗進行徹底地交融與分享的結果。因此，本課程重視現代社會學習「溝通管理」的二項關鍵技術包括：有效溝通結合自我學習技巧和方法：商業知識與科技結合促成人的系統互動能力，配合多媒體傳輸工具完成學習個人與團體溝通效益。課程涵概主題:1.溝通管理定義與本質元素。2.溝通管理內涵分析。3.學習個人溝通能力。4.學習溝通程序。5.e化自我學習技巧、方法與表達能力。6.學習全球化溝通科技工具。7.團隊溝通的策略與協同戰術。8.塑造整體溝通文化。
description.en: The information exchange is wide, variety, and complicated in the e-era; how do people express their consciousness and behavior turn to become very important. Effective communication degrees usually are seen as the index of learning communication. It depends on thoroughly melting and sharing with fact, opinion, feeling, interesting and experience. Therefore, "Communication Management," in this course we emphasize on two key techniques of modern society learning including: effective communication with self-learning skill and method; Business knowledge and technology with interactive ability of human system. By using multimedia transmitting tools to complete self and group learning communication and get benefit.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。

The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

description.zh: 環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize it's importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand: 1. the connection between our environment and our living condition; 2.the cause of environmental problems and their classification; 3.the cause of environmental problems in Taiwan; and 4.the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems.

syllabi.outline: 課程旨在讓學生了解環境問題的來源與影響，探索氣候變遷、能源使用、水資源管理及廢棄物處理等議題，並學習相關政策與技術如循環經濟、再生能源與綠色技術。課程涵蓋全球與在地環保議題，強調永續發展與企業社會責任，結合案例討論與分享，幫助學生培養環保意識與意願，成為面對永續未來的推動力量。

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
生命科學是一門綜合知識探討什麼是科學，以科學方法瞭解地球上生命的來源，演化與特徵,與生命活動的環境。地球上存在各式各樣的生命，多樣性的物種，包括類生命的病毒，單細胞(生命的基本單元) 或多細胞生物。人類(異營生物)生活於其中與週遭的物種密切關聯，從環境取得能量(營養攝取)，代謝生長，繁殖，最終死亡。從宏觀看，人類位居生物鏈最頂端，但在微觀環境仍不斷與微生物做競爭。從基礎研究讓我們了解生命的過程(中心準則: DNA-> RNA-> Protein)，疫系統與細菌病毒間的運作，細胞生長發育與疾病的發生，利用動物模式幫助醫學與藥物科技的研發，讓人類更健康更長壽。同時，人類的過度活動也製造龐大的廢棄物造成環境汙染與生態傷害，這些最後將反撲於自己，如現在所面對的物種大量減少，環境賀爾蒙入侵食物鏈，新興病毒崛起。這些課題都是生命科學研究中的一環。現代生命科學不僅研究單獨生物體生命活動的過程，還研究眾多生物個體之間的相互關係（生物演化與多樣性問題），生物個體與環境的關係（生態問題）。這些基本知識都是現代大學生應該具備的。也為未來跨領域合作準備。課程將對每一課題從生命科學歷史到現在發展作敘述來引發同學興趣。
Life science is discussing all aspects of knowledge about biology to which we human could not get away. In this course, you will learn how life is started and study evolution, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, immunology and disease, microbiology, environmental toxicology and physiology. I will also introduce you the newly developed biotechnology and how importance of environmental protection to human life. All of the information included in these classes is so important that modern college students should not missed.

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

syllabi.outline:
林懷民說：「不管看的懂，看不懂，只要是看了可以讓你感動、喜愛的，對你而言，就是好的藝術」。這句話聽起來雖然很簡單，但提到「藝術」兩個字，對非藝術科系的同學而言，似乎還是很高深，很難懂 ! 所以這門課在課程設計上，主要就是針對非藝術科系同學們的學習需要，以深入淺出的方式來介紹藝術，讓同學們能夠在沒有壓力和負擔的狀態下，輕輕鬆鬆的接觸藝術、欣賞藝術、甚至喜歡上藝術。
在十八週的課程中，我們會從藝術史上的第一幅畫開始介紹，接著，再依序介紹世界上最有名的畫家如 : 達文西、米開蘭基羅、米勒、莫內、梵谷、馬諦斯、畢卡索…等等畫家生活中和藝術作品背後的有趣故事，並欣賞相關的藝術電影。
衷心希望這樣的課程安排，能夠讓同學們輕鬆學藝術，體會欣賞藝術的樂趣，敬請期待。

第8週、第12至第17週課程主題：
將透過介紹歷史上多位偉大藝術家的生命歷程與藝術創作，包括達文西、米開朗基羅、拉斐爾、米勒、莫內、梵谷、畢卡索、達利、米羅、安迪?沃荷…等，帶領學生認識藝術家如何在各自的時代中探索生命意義，突破困境，創造經典作品。課程設計符合「創新品德教育6E教學法」理念：
•  1E 典範學習（Example）：以藝術家的生命故事為典範，引導學生思考人生志業與價值。
•  2E 啟發思辯（Enlightenment）：透過作品賞析與討論，啟發學生反思創作背後的理念與社會意義。
•  3E 勸勉激勵（Encouragement）：藉由藝術家的奮鬥歷程與創新精神，激勵學生勇於追求理想與自我實現。

description.zh: 投資是有報酬和風險的，不同金融產品有不同的報酬率和風險，例如：存款報酬低風險低，期貨報酬高風險高。如何將資金做一個妥善分配，選擇合適的一組金融商品，就能避不必要的風險而得到不錯的報酬率。投資學課程可以使學習者了解如何以投資學理論評估各種金融商品的可能風險和報酬率，再依投資者經濟能力選擇合適的金融商品進行投資。對於理工科系人員，了解投資學課程是增強理工科系人員理財素養的重要課程之一。
description.en: Investment has its rewards and risks; different financial products have different rates of return and risk. For example: deposits have low rewards with low risks; futures have high rewards with high risks. With making a proper allocation of funds and choosing the right set of financial products, one can avoid unnecessary risks and get a good rate of return. Investment courses make students understand how to apply financial instruments theory to assess possible risks and returns in various financial instruments, and then invest the suitable financial products according to the economic capacity of investors. For science and engineering personnel, understanding the investment in science and engineering courses is one of the important programs to enhance financial literacy personnel.

description.zh: 新經濟與舊經濟的分野不是在有『e』還是沒有『e』，而是在有『i』還是沒有『i』，而『i』就是『Innovation，創新』。二十一世紀的『腦力經濟』最重要的戲規則就是『智慧財產權』，同時也是WTO會員國必須遵守的重要規範之一。課程內容主要包括三個最基本的智慧財產權課題：專利權，商標權，以及著作權；而為配合本校學生學科背景，本課程將較著重於『專利』方面的實務知識，並且講授『如何激發創意，以培養學生日後能好好應用『智慧財產權』的保護。
description.en: The difference between New-economy and Old-economy is not caused by having "e" or not having "e", but caused by owining "i" or not owning "i". where "I" means "Innovation:.  Intellectual Property is not only the most importance business rule of the :Brain economy era:, but also one of the most important agreements among WTO members.  This course includes the basic three subjects of Intellectual Property:Patent, Trademark, and Copyright.  In order to accommodate the learning background for most of NTUT students, the contents of this course will focus more on the practical practice of the Patennt.  In addition, it also includes the subject of "how to activate your creativeness:so as to make students can use what they learn, "Intellectual Property:, to protect their intellectual work.

syllabi.outline:
一、智慧財產權（IPR）近年來，為世界各國所重視。我國自從加入WTO以來，更與世界各國的智慧財產權之保護與取締，產生非常密切的連動，我國甚至為特別設立智慧財產權法院，專責處理智慧財產權的相關案件，其重要性可見一斑。
二、智慧財產權之法律，包括：著作權法、專利法、商標法營業秘密法、植物品種及種苗法、公平交易法等。上開法律雖有各別獨特的法理，我國採各別獨立立法，但相關法律間卻又關係密切，是以全盤整體的了解，有其必要性。
三、智慧財產權法的了解，為現代公民所必備，更是日後職場生涯應具備的法律知識，期能透過本課程讓同學一窺法律的不同面貌，並增進相關基礎能力。

description.zh: 電腦軟體專利授予已歷經多年，然而不同於其它技術領域，於我國有一特定的審查標準。而近年來人工智慧技術飛猛進，雖奠基於電腦軟體，但其生成又牽涉到不同的概念與技術。人工智慧專利權的授予，如何適用電腦軟體發明的審查標準、或須另行適用一套新的標準，將是本課程之重點。本課程將提供學生相關近年來的專利審查趨勢與標準，以了解電腦軟體發明與人工智慧發明，其特定的專利審查標準，以及其間之異同。
description.en: For years, computer software has been eligible for patent protection, but it faces unique rules and standards compared to other technical fields. The rise of artificial intelligence (AI) has added new challenges, as AI technologies, while built on software, involve innovative concepts like machine learning and data-driven systems. This course explores how patents are granted for computer software and AI inventions, examining whether traditional software patent rules apply to AI or if new standards are needed. Students will gain a clear understanding of patent examination trends, learn the specific requirements for software and AI patents, and analyze the similarities and differences between them.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以國外設計競賽為主要目標，根據設計思考法及問題導向學習(Problem-based Learning)的模式，以同理心分析、問題發想與定義、創意發想、雛型發展與驗證評估，透過課堂講授、移地教學及設計思考工作坊之操作，期望培養學生問題解決能力，並撰寫創新企劃案、參與設計競賽或募資平台。
This course aims to focus on international design competitions,  According to the design thinking method, the problem-based learning (Problem-based Learning) model, empathy analysis, problem thinking with definition, creative thinking, Through the operation of classroom lectures, ex-situ teaching, and design thinking workshops, it is expected to cultivate students' problem-solving ability, and participate in relevant design competitions or fund-raising platforms through innovative proposals.
課程大綱有四大重點
1.講述介紹SDGs、循環設計、ESG、CSR、USR及社會設計的案例，讓學生了解現有趨勢性政策，並引導各組專案朝該方向執行設計。
2.移地觀展，至松菸文化園區觀展增廣視野，目的在透過觀展，可在小組提案之前吸收不同的觀點及培養觀察力。
3.邀請業師演講-分享永續產品開發設計的歷程，讓學生能夠從實際案例中參考學習。
4.後續課程以(Problem-based Learning)為主軸，透過師生互動定義SDG、解決在地社會問題相關主題，並提出創新設計解方，報名SDGs、永續循環、科技應用相關主題之競賽、展覽或募資平台，創造影響力。

本課程主要在教導學生探討基本室內環境品質與人體健康間的關係，使學生具備創造健康室內環境的相關知識及操作能力，主要授課要點如下：
1.以各種類型的建築室內環境為主題；
2.探討人為環境與人體健康之關係；
3.探討建築材料、構造與設備對室內環境各項因子之影響；
4.學習室內環境品質量測儀器之操作與判讀能力；
5.具備診斷與改善一般室內環境議題之相關專業知識及操作能力。
description.en:
The purpose of this course is to discuss the relationship between Indoor Environment Quality and human healthy, and make sure our students can realize the knowledge of healthy environment and manage it.
Contents：
1. The indoor environment of different types of building.
2. The relationship between the artificial environment and human health.
3. Discuss the influence of the building material, construction and equipment on indoor environment.
4. Learn to use the instrument to measure indoor environment quality.
5. Learn to diagnose and improve indoor environment quality.

syllabi.outline: 為追求「永續發展與人本健康」之目的，使既有與新建的居住環境，配合我國「室內空氣品質管理法」規範下運作，提昇民眾居住環境健康品質效益，針對病態建築之環境問題，其涵蓋醫療、法律、建築、化學、生物等領域，綜合診斷以進行改善。本課程為第一階段之系列課程，其內容包括： 一.健康環境概念：說明何謂「病態建築」，探討室內空氣與健康之關係。 二.建築物污染源：探討來自各建築材料的化學物質逸散及其對人體健康之影響，並提出室內污染物質濃度減低對策。 三.生物性污染源：探討黴菌、蹣、白蟻及寵物等帶來的室內空氣污染。 四.診斷技術：說明室內空氣品質診斷方法及病態建築改善之專業技術，配合案例介紹探討新、舊建築物室內環境品質的設計預防、診斷改善技術。

description.zh:
資訊都市主義（informatical urbanism或informational urbanism）為一跨領域學科，旨在透過資訊環境與流程之輔助，推動政策、規劃、發展、策略行動、設計之都市與社區進程。
本課程主要在協助學生，以都市與社區問題為基本導向，建立資訊環境與流程之規劃能力。
授課主要涵蓋面向：1.資訊與知識基礎設施 2.經濟面向 3.都市治理與公共行政 4.都市空間之資訊化 5.地點因子 6.使用者行為 7.特殊議題。
description.en:
Informatical urbanism (or informational urbanism) is an interdisciplinary area of knowledge, and it mainly utilize the facilitation of informatical environments and procedures for the progression of policy, planning, development, strategic initiative, and design within cities and communities.
During this course, student will acquire the planning capability of establish such applicable informatical environments and procedures, based upon explorations of urban and community issues.
Main contents of this course: 1. Information and knowledge infrastructures, 2. Economic aspects, 3. Urban governance and administration, 4. Informaticalization of urban space, 5. Location factors, 6. User behavior, 7. Focus area of problem.

description.zh: 本課程之目標在於介紹使用者經驗設計之理論與研究方法。藉由本課程的學習，學生能習得互動設計過程中所需要之關鍵概念 - 以使用者經驗為中心之設計。課程以人-機-境之架構為基礎進行相關知識之講授，並透過相關研究案例之研討、方法之操作以及設計研究之進行了解其原理。課程內容包含人物誌、使用者經驗與需求、互動環境、使用者研究以及認知心理基礎等。教學將以課堂講授、文獻閱讀以及研究方法操作等方式進行，並以報告繳交、分組討論與發表為評量方式。
description.en: This course is focused on introducing the theories and research methods of User Experience Design (UXD). In this course, students can understand the key element, UX, of interactive design. This course is set up under the structure of Human-Machine-Scenario theory, and executed through research case studies, method simulation and design research. The contents include personas, user experience and requirements, interactive scenario, user research and cognitive psychology. The course is preceded by means of lecturing, literature review and research conducting. Students are evaluated by reports, group discussion and presentation.

description.zh: 本課程為財務會計領域之進階課程，針對已具初級會計學之學生深入講授財務會計之理論、觀念、方法及程序。本課程全面納入國際財務報導準則(IFRS)，內容包括：介紹財務報導觀念架構、主要財務報表編製、講解資產負債表中有關資產、負債、股東權益以及現金流量表與租賃會計等，修習本課程可使學生對IFRS有全面整體了解及運用之能力。亦有助於將來參加會計乙級、記帳士及公務人員高考等證照考試。
description.en: This course is an advanced course for financial accounting. It is to teach the financial accounting theory, concept, method and procedure for students with some basic accounting knowledge. The course covers all the materials to understand financial accounting based on IFRS. The course will help students for preparing advanced license examinations for accounting.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹和探討電子商務的基本概念、原理和實踐。學生將瞭解電子商務的發展背景、關鍵技術、商業模式和相關法律法規等方面的知識。課程內容包括電子商務的基礎概念、網站設計與開發、電子支付系統、網絡營銷、電子商務安全和隱私保護、供應鏈管理以及電子商務的社會和經濟影響等主題。透過案例分析和小組討論，學生將學習如何在電子商務環境中建立和管理成功的網上業務。此外，學生還將進行電商平台的實務操作，瞭解電子商務系統的建置和運營。同時，學生也將探討未來電子商務趨勢和創新。通過本課程的學習，學生將獲得在數字時代運營和成功利用電子商務的能力和知識。


This course aims to introduce and explore the fundamental concepts, principles, and practices of e-commerce. Students will gain an understanding of the development background, key technologies, business models, and relevant laws and regulations in e-commerce. The course covers topics such as the basics of e-commerce, website design and development, electronic payment systems, internet marketing, e-commerce security and privacy protection, supply chain management, and the social and economic impacts of e-commerce. Through case studies and group discussions, students will learn how to establish and manage successful online businesses in the e-commerce environment. Additionally, students will engage in practical exercises on e-commerce platforms to understand the setup and operation of e-commerce systems. Furthermore, students will explore future trends and innovations in e-commerce. By the end of this course, students will acquire the knowledge and skills to operate and leverage e-commerce effectively in the digital era.

At last, students can summarize research conclusions and model validation. Thus, students can improve their independent thinking and problem-solving ability, and further cultivate their scientific attitude and academic research knowledge.

description.zh: 「金融科技個案與實務」課程旨在透過實務導向的個案分析，結合來自銀行、證券、保險及金融科技產業第一線專家的深度交流，協助學生即時掌握產業脈動與政策變化，並全面理解金融科技於現代金融體系中的應用場景與策略挑戰。課程內容將聚焦於國內外金融科技新創企業的創新商業模式、產品設計及市場推進策略，搭配數位支付平台、虛擬銀行、區塊鏈金融應用等實際案例，深入剖析其營運機制與關鍵成功因素。透過系統化的個案研討與產業互動，學生將培養批判性思維、問題解決與策略分析能力，並深化對金融科技創新與傳統金融機構間合作與競爭關係的理解。課程最終目標為強化學生對金融科技產業之實務掌握與就業競爭力，為其未來投入金融科技或相關領域奠定堅實基礎。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a practice-driven understanding of FinTech through case-based learning. By integrating industry insights and practitioner experiences from the banking, securities, insurance, and FinTech sectors, students will stay informed about fast-changing market trends and regulatory developments and gain a deeper understanding of the challenges of implementing FinTech in today’s financial systems. The course focuses on the innovative business models, product architectures, and market entry strategies of leading FinTech ventures across both domestic and global markets. Selected topics include digital payment ecosystems, virtual banking, blockchain-enabled financial applications, and other emerging technological innovations. Through case analysis, students will critically evaluate the operational structures and key success drivers of these technologies, preparing them to address complex issues at the intersection of finance, technology, and regulation.

syllabi.outline:
「金融科技個案與實務」課程旨在透過實務導向的個案分析，結合來自銀行、證券、保險及金融科技產業第一線專家的深度交流，協助學生即時掌握產業脈動與政策變化，並全面理解金融科技於現代金融體系中的應用場景與策略挑戰。課程內容將聚焦於國內外金融科技新創企業的創新商業模式、產品設計及市場推進策略，搭配數位支付平台、虛擬銀行、區塊鏈金融應用等實際案例，深入剖析其營運機制與關鍵成功因素。透過系統化的個案研討與產業互動，學生將培養批判性思維、問題解決與策略分析能力，並深化對金融科技創新與傳統金融機構間合作與競爭關係的理解。課程最終目標為強化學生對金融科技產業之實務掌握與就業競爭力，為其未來投入金融科技或相關領域奠定堅實基礎。
This course aims to provide students with a practice-driven understanding of FinTech through case-based learning. By integrating industry insights and practitioner experiences from the banking, securities, insurance, and FinTech sectors, students will stay informed about fast-changing market trends and regulatory developments and gain a deeper understanding of the challenges of implementing FinTech in today’s financial systems. The course focuses on the innovative business models, product architectures, and market entry strategies of leading FinTech ventures across both domestic and global markets. Selected topics include digital payment ecosystems, virtual banking, blockchain-enabled financial applications, and other emerging technological innovations. Through case analysis, students will critically evaluate the operational structures and key success drivers of these technologies, preparing them to address complex issues at the intersection of finance, technology, and regulation.

description.zh: 本課程主要是在於介紹一些駭客常用的攻擊方法和可能使用工具，並藉由這些技術的解說讓學生瞭解實際駭客的攻擊行為與思維模式，進而習得如何保護所管理的網路或資訊系統免於被攻擊成功。課程中將輔以實機操作，教導您如何利用現有電腦資源掃描及測試系統的安全問題，藉以保護系統安全，課程中將加強實際的上機操作，藉由上課所模擬的網路環境中，讓同學能夠實際感受攻擊的可能實況
description.en: This course is mainly to introduce network and system attack methods and security assessment tools used by hackers, and to explain the attack behavior and thinking strategy of hackers through the explanation of these technologies. In addition, this course teaches students learn how to protect the managed network or information system to against from being compromised successfully. The course will be supplemented by practices, and teaching students how to use the existing tools to scan and test the security of the system. In order to protect the security of the system, the course will focus on the system and network practices, which can let the students feel the possible network and system attacks.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生深入理解並掌握生成式人工智慧（Generative AI）的基本概念與實務應用。內容涵蓋GenAI介紹、提示工程（Prompt Engineering）、大規模語言模型（LLM）技術原理，以及設計思考專案，應用於金融或管理相關議題，並探討相關道德議題。課程強調實務應用，結合行銷理論和金融數據分析，邀請業界專家分享最新行業動態和實務經驗。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding and mastery of the fundamental concepts and practical applications of Generative AI. The content covers an introduction to GenAI, Prompt Engineering, the technical principles of Large Language Models (LLM), and a design thinking project applied to finance or management-related issues, as well as discussions on relevant ethical topics. Emphasizing practical application, the course integrates marketing theories and financial data analysis, inviting industry experts to share the latest industry trends and practical insights.

name.en: Artificial Intelligence of Things and Applications

description.zh: 人工智慧物聯網課程將物聯網的感測器與感測網路、邊緣閘道、雲端服務與存取裝置，結合機器學習、深度學習及智慧分析技術，協同建構從端到端的智慧應用，涵蓋無人商店與智慧支付、遠距醫療與照護、智慧製造與智慧家庭等多元場景。本課程著重於人工智慧在裝置與服務設計中的關鍵角色，並透過實務案例與專題討論，培養學生規劃並開發創新智慧物聯網解決方案的能力。
description.en: The AIoT course integrates sensors and sensor networks, edge gateways, cloud services, and user access devices with machine learning, deep learning, and intelligent analytics to jointly build end-to-end smart applications. These applications cover a variety of domains such as Unmanned stores and smart payment, remote healthcare and telemedicine, smart manufacturing, and smart home systems. This course emphasizes the pivotal role of AI in device and service design, and through practical case studies and project discussions, aims to equip students with the ability to plan and develop innovative intelligent IoT solutions.

It is recommended to have the ability to write basic programs, and have taken courses such as algorithmic trading and money management in advance.

name.zh: 人工智慧物聯網與應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence of Things and Applications

description.zh: 人工智慧物聯網課程將物聯網的感測器與感測網路、邊緣閘道、雲端服務與存取裝置，結合機器學習、深度學習及智慧分析技術，協同建構從端到端的智慧應用，涵蓋無人商店與智慧支付、遠距醫療與照護、智慧製造與智慧家庭等多元場景。本課程著重於人工智慧在裝置與服務設計中的關鍵角色，並透過實務案例與專題討論，培養學生規劃並開發創新智慧物聯網解決方案的能力。
description.en: The AIoT course integrates sensors and sensor networks, edge gateways, cloud services, and user access devices with machine learning, deep learning, and intelligent analytics to jointly build end-to-end smart applications. These applications cover a variety of domains such as Unmanned stores and smart payment, remote healthcare and telemedicine, smart manufacturing, and smart home systems. This course emphasizes the pivotal role of AI in device and service design, and through practical case studies and project discussions, aims to equip students with the ability to plan and develop innovative intelligent IoT solutions.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生深入理解並掌握生成式人工智慧（Generative AI）的基本概念與實務應用。內容涵蓋GenAI介紹、提示工程（Prompt Engineering）、大規模語言模型（LLM）技術原理，以及設計思考專案，應用於金融或管理相關議題，並探討相關道德議題。課程強調實務應用，結合行銷理論和金融數據分析，邀請業界專家分享最新行業動態和實務經驗。
description.en: This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding and mastery of the fundamental concepts and practical applications of Generative AI. The content covers an introduction to GenAI, Prompt Engineering, the technical principles of Large Language Models (LLM), and a design thinking project applied to finance or management-related issues, as well as discussions on relevant ethical topics. Emphasizing practical application, the course integrates marketing theories and financial data analysis, inviting industry experts to share the latest industry trends and practical insights.

name.zh: 網路系統程式開發與安全

description.zh: 隨著金融交易、機器人應用等網路應用快速成長，系統需同時具備高擴展性、可靠性與安全性。為因應此趨勢，本課程培養學生具備從應用層到作業系統核心的程式開發實力，並強調 TCP/IP 通訊與系統架構整合。
description.en: With the rapid growth of internet services—such as financial transactions and robotic applications—modern systems must be scalable, reliable, and secure. This course addresses these needs by training students in programming skills from the application layer to the OS kernel, emphasizing TCP/IP networking and system architecture.

description.zh: 臺灣對於「文化資產」的認定，主要來自於〈文化資產保存法〉的確立，本課程介紹臺灣文化資產保存法的發展脈絡，以及各項有形與無形文化資產的類別和價值，使學生對於文化資產有概略性的了解，並能對於臺灣當代文化資產相關議題有所涉略，並進行案例觀察與分析。
description.en: This course aims to introduce the concept of hertiage in Taiwan, both the tangible and intangible hertiage. The development of Cultural Heritage Preservation Act in Taiwan is taught in this class, and further, different case studies of heritage preservation, conservation and restoration are also examined. By taking this class, students will be able to observe and analyse hertiage issues from cultral, social, economical and aesthetics perspectives.

description.zh: 課程著重於彩瓷陶瓷專業人才的系統化培力，探討彩繪陶瓷的多元工藝表現，並深入其歷史脈絡與發展體系中加以分析，研究其繪製技法、工序流程、內容形態及美學樣貌的演變。透過理論探討與實作並重的教學模式，培育新世代工藝人才，致力於傳統技藝的保存與創新。
description.en: This course focuses on the structured training of skilled professionals in colored porcelain craftsmanship. It examines diverse artistic expressions of painted ceramics within their historical and developmental contexts, analyzing the evolution of painting techniques, processes, content forms, and aesthetic paradigms. By integrating theoretical discourse with hands-on practice, the course aims to cultivate a new generation of artisans committed to the preservation and innovation of this traditional craft.

description.zh: 本課程旨在訓練學生開拓新的視野，蒐集、分析口述歷史資料並進行一份口述作品。課程將採實作練習與理論兼顧，全面分析整理台灣學界與非學界口述訪談之成果，檢視口述歷史訪談方法、口述紀錄出版品與各種延伸加值運用：紀錄片、電影、漫畫、文史書籍以及其他形式的智慧財產（IP）。
description.en: This course aims to broaden students' perspectives and equip them with the skills to collect and analyze oral history recordings, and produce an oral history project. It will combine practical exercises with theoretical learning and provide a comprehensive analysis of oral interviews conducted by both academic and non-academic institutions in Taiwan. The course will examine oral history interview methods, oral record transcriptions/recordings, and various extended applications of oral history materials, including documentaries, films, comics, literary and historical books, and other intellectual property (IP) projects.

description.zh: 本課程分為兩部分：（1）英文文法觀念的溫故知新，並引導學生將正確的文法觀念運用在閱讀與寫作上，學生可加強基本句型練習、句子改正及句型修正。相關討論包括直述句、引述句、句型變化與修飾;（2）英語修辭法：聽講溝通的有效原理原則。課堂討論主題包括：指稱、一致、倒裝等修辭觀念。修習本課後，學生對出現在相同邏輯意義語境中， 利用不同表達方式以凸顯各種語意的方式與內涵，當有更進一步的體認。
description.en: This course is divided into two parts: (a) The first part is designed for the students to  familiarize themselves with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing. A review of grammatical ideas at high level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors, and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures. The main subjects include English sentence structures, verbal usages, conjunctions, and sequences. Related topics for class discussion cover direct and indirect speech, sentence transformation and modification of sentences; (b) The second half of the course focuses on English rhetoric--principles of effective written and spoken communication. Topics for class discussion include reference, coherence, reverse structures and some related rhetorical concepts. It is hoped that the students will know better the significance brought about by the variations of different expressions that occur in the similar linguistic contexts.

syllabi.outline: This course aims (1) to familiarize students with English grammatical framework in relation to reading and writing, and (2) to develop students’ rhetorical awareness. A review of grammatical ideas at the advanced level is reinforced by correcting sentence errors and revising awkward usage of words or sentence structures as well as by doing lively grammar practice exercises. The main topics covered include various parts of speech, tense, clauses, reporting, conjunction, punctuation, and the relationship between grammar and context.

description.en: This course is designed to increase vocabulary power and develop listening skills in English through up-to-date news. Current events, in-depth reports as well as global issues from radio, newspapers and T.V are provided to enrich the student's English knowledge. Effective listening skills are reinforced to enhance the student's listening comprehension.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to engage students in understanding current issues and events taking place in the world that are redefining our global reality and restructuring the world order. A greater goal of such studies of global issues and activities is to urge students to participate in the dialogues and actions to change and to make better of the world. The course content centers on listening, reading, discussing and debating on selected reports and news to uphold all that matters for the aforementioned pursuits.

description.zh: 本課程強調全方位的國際商用英語溝通。現今各領域上之商業活動多以英語進行，因此本課程注重發展學生以英語文進行流暢之溝通的關鍵能力，特別強調商業組織內外部常見的正式溝通之形式，包括商用英語寫作、簡報與會議技巧。課時也納入非正式溝通技巧，指導學生學習應對職場情境，因應相關之溝通需求。
description.en: This current course emphasizes a holistic view of business communication in a global context.  Given that business communication across from fields of business activities is now made possible by the English language, the course thus aims to develop the ability to use critical skills essential to successful communication in English, with particular emphases on forms of formal communications that are highly visible within and outside business organizations, including writing of business correspondence and reports, presentations and meetings. Informal communication skills are also incorporated to address workplace situations to identify the relevant communication needs.

name.en: Studies in English and American Fiction

description.zh: 本課程旨在引導學生如何以批評的角度閱讀小說。課程討論有兩個重點：（一）小說的技巧：如情節、結構、人物塑造、敘事者與敘事策略、背景鋪陳、象徵與意象等。（二）小說與文學理論的關係：如何將文學理論運用到小說的閱讀與分析。
description.en: This course will introduce students to critical approaches and principles in the study of fiction.  We will discuss such features as plot, structure, characterization, narrator, narrative strategy, setting, symbol, image, etc..  We will also examine various theoretical approaches that can be brought to bear on the study of fiction.  There will be a particular emphasis on the application of theories to hone students' critical reading skills.

syllabi.outline: This course aims to enhance students’ speaking skills with a particular focus on listening comprehension, critical analysis of certain issues, organization of ideas, and lucid delivery of a speech. The course is designed thematically and divided into 6 teaching sections. Each section contains two weeks. In the first week, we will approach a specific issue by watching an introductory video clip, doing listening exercises and understanding key terms. And then students will be divided into groups to discuss and present their opinions regarding the issue. In the second week, we will further explore the issue by watching selected scenes from a relevant film. Each group will be asked to answer critical questions by analyzing the scenes, formulate and organize their ideas, and deliver a short speech at the end of the class.

description.zh: 本課程旨在讓學生具備國際新聞編譯之相關知識，並透過實務演練培養新聞編譯之能力。課程內容主要含括(一)國際新聞編譯之介紹（如新聞編譯現況、製作流程、專業條件與譯者相關知能）；（二）新聞編譯之策略與技巧（如刪除、重組、整合新聞訊息）；（三）新聞編譯之模擬與實務練習。
description.en: This course aims to help students build up the basic knowledge of news trans-editing and develop students’ trans-editing skills through practical training. The course covers the following areas: (1) an introduction to news trans-editing (e.g. the current state of the news trans-editing field, the production workflow, professional qualifications and personal traits of news translators); (2) strategies and skills of news trans-editing (e.g. the strategies of deletion, restructuring, abridgement and synthesis); (3) practical training of news trans-editing in a simulated or real environment.

syllabi.outline:
一、教學目標（Teaching Objectives）
本課程旨在讓學生具備國際新聞編譯之相關知識，並透過實務演練培養新聞編譯之能力。課程內容主要含括(一)國際新聞編譯之介紹（如新聞編譯現況、製作流程、專業條件與譯者相關知能）；（二）新聞編譯之策略與技巧（如刪除、重組、整合新聞訊息）；（三）新聞編譯之模擬與實務練習。
本課程提供閱讀新聞英語的練習機會，藉著閱讀報紙、雜誌英文新聞報導、評論、專欄、社論等，了解其中新聞字彙、文體，訓練閱讀新聞。
促使學生透過媒體識讀教學過程、瞭解新聞編採實務、國際現勢、配合原本的英文能力利基，強化國際觀，落實並活用英文。
本課程重要目標並包含著重加強應用英文系學生對國際新聞編譯實務的能力，培養學生敏銳的觀察力及組織力、並訓練學生對國際時事的新聞陳述與課堂討論，達到不同觀點的看法。有系統引導學生閱讀國際新聞，述說新國際聞編譯之寫作方式與要點，以及編譯技巧，培養未來可能於新聞職場服務的專業能力。

I. Teaching Objectives

This course is designed to equip students with foundational knowledge and practical skills in the translation and adaptation of international news. Through both theoretical instruction and hands-on practice, students will develop competencies essential to news translation. The course content includes:

An introduction to international news translation, covering current practices, production processes, required professional qualifications, and the essential knowledge and skills of translators;

Strategies and techniques for news translation, such as omission, restructuring, and the integration of news information;

Simulated translation exercises and practical training.

Students will engage in extensive reading of English-language news content from newspapers, magazines, commentaries, columns, and editorials to become familiar with journalistic vocabulary and styles, thereby enhancing their news reading comprehension.

The course further aims to strengthen students’ global awareness by integrating media literacy, an understanding of newsroom practices, and current international affairs, leveraging their existing English proficiency to actively apply the language in real-world contexts.

A key objective is to enhance the practical capabilities of English majors in international news translation, fostering sharp observation, organizational skills, and the ability to articulate and discuss global news issues. The course will systematically guide students in reading and analyzing international news, introducing key writing approaches, translation methods, and editorial techniques—ultimately preparing them for potential careers in the media industry.

description.en: Drawing upon modern literary criticism and cultural theory, this course aims to examine the difference between works of literature and the distinctive medium of the cinema. Students will be offered a variety of discussion which stimulates the kinds of critical thinking that lead to a better understanding of the process of transposition from literature to film.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以當代文學批評和文化理論為基礎，探討小說與戲劇改編成電影的過程中，文字轉化成視覺意象之間的差異，期能提升多元化的思辯及表達能力。
Drawing upon modern literary criticism and cultural theory, this course aims to examine the difference between works of literature and the distinctive medium of the cinema. Students will be offered a variety of discussion which stimulates the kinds of critical thinking that lead to a better understanding of the process of transposition from literature to film.

The course follows the history of Western literature, approaching representative literary works from Classical antiquity, Renaissance, the Enlightenment, the Romantic Period and the nineteenth century, to the modern time. Students will watch films related to or adapted from the literary texts, after which the instructor will give a lecture and conduct in-class discussion. By the end of the semester, the students will be familiarized with the key ideas of each important literary era or movement and formulate their own critical interpretations of literature and its visualization.

Course Title:		Public Speaking and Debates
Credit Hours:		2
Instructor’s Name:	Dr. Yun-Hua Yang
Contact E-Mail:	yhyang@ntut.edu.tw
Term Offered:		Fall, 2025
Course Description
This course is designed to advance English-major students' communication competence through public speaking and debating in English. While most students at this level demonstrate fluency in English, many struggle to structure their ideas and thoughts in a logical and persuasive manner. This course teaches students to organize information and materials, analyze critically, and restructure ideas to engage in effective communication that delivers meaningful results. The topics and issues adopted for speeches are thought-provoking and require critical thinking that reflects intellectual value transcending subject matter through multiple perspectives. In addition, it is important to note that the purpose of learning activities designed is to practice constructing a persuasive, evidence-based argument for a proposed solution to an issue of concern. All speeches must be grounded in academic rigor and supported by verifiable data, not personal or political bias, as this is solely for training in critical debate and social awareness.
1. Attendance
	Attendance will be recorded by the Teaching Assistant (TA).
	Students are required to attend all class sessions.
	Each absence results in a 10% deduction from the final semester grade (based on a 100% scale).
	Tardiness incurs a 5% deduction.
	Exceptions will only be made in cases of extreme circumstances.
2. Speech and Debate Assignments
Each student is expected to deliver three individual speeches and participate in one policy debate using a hybrid Cross-Examination (CX) / congressional format. Students will work in groups for debates.
Speech Requirements:
	All speeches must be 4-6 minutes in duration (ideal range).
	Speeches shorter than 3 minutes or longer than 6 minutes will result in zero points.
	All speech sessions must be video-recorded.
	Make-up speeches are allowed only for official leave permission or extreme circumstances.
	It is essential to comply with prescriptive requirements for each speech type. Failure to follow requirements will result in disqualification and receive zero points.
3. Required in-Class Submissions
For each speech, students must submit to the instructor:
•	Speech outline following the specified format (see Appendix 3)
•	Complete speech script with proper citations and references
•	Instructor evaluation sheet (see Appendix 1)
•	Students who do not have these materials ready or fail to comply with outline format requirements forfeit the right to deliver their speech and receive zero points.
4. Digital Submissions of Speech and Debate Materials 
Student speakers are required to upload the following materials to the designated assignment section on Google Classroom, with each file clearly labeled according to the specified naming convention as instructed.
All files must be uploaded by the specified deadline. Failure to follow t or submit incomplete materials will result in point deductions.
5. Video Portfolio
Students will use their own recording devices for in-class speeches. A complete portfolio including all recordings is required for submission at semester's end.
6. Delivery Requirements
	No scripts or notes are permitted during speech delivery
	Outlines may be displayed via poster or screen
	Using a full script during delivery will result in zero points

Originality: Students are required to develop their own original, individualized speech topics based on the assigned topic areas.

description.zh: 本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
description.en: This course aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers.  Its main purpose is to familiarize students with methods, procedures, and techniques that are applicable to quantitative and qualitative research as well as to improve their ability to write research papers.  The main topics for instruction include: the research process; major research methods; and the structure of a research paper.  The research methods primarily studied include the experimental method, descriptive research, ethnography, case study, observation, survey research (questionnaire and interviews), content analysis/documentary analysis, and critical approaches to literature.

syllabi.outline:
本課程介紹研究方法和論文寫作知識，期能培養學生獨立研究和撰寫學術報告、論文的基本能力。主要分為三部份：（一）研究內涵與步驟,（二）主要的研究方法,（三）如何撰寫英文論文及報告。涵蓋主題包括：運用圖書館資源選擇研究主題、研究計劃的撰寫、問卷調查法、訪問法、觀察法、田野工作研究方法、文獻資料分析法（內容分析法）、個案研究法、相關研究法、實驗法、文學研究法，研究報告論文格式與寫作要領，如何撰寫文獻探討，參考書目寫法等。
This course is primarily designed for students interested in working on a senior project in literature, film, popular culture, or cultural studies, but most of the material can be generally applied, so students who are uncertain whether their final project will be in literature/cultural studies or linguistics can benefit from the course. It aims at providing students with the fundamental knowledge and competence that they will need in doing research and writing research papers. The main topics for instruction include the research process, major research methods, approaches to literary and cultural studies criticism, and the structure of a research paper. Students will learn how to come up with a high-quality research question, best practices for evaluating source material, how to make use of the electronic and hard-copy sources that are available (including subscription and open-access sources), AI uses and pitfalls, and how to carry out a long-term research project, with the goal of avoiding the pitfalls that first-time research project students and writers may fall into. Students will also learn the circumstances under which MLA style is the best style to use, to use it correctly, and to distinguish it from APA style. This course is designed for English majors: while students from other disciplines may sign up, they must be prepared to do assignments designed for English majors preparing for their senior projects and to meet the same expectations.

description.zh: 此進階翻譯課程旨在培養學生整合AI工具至翻譯流程的能力。透過結合線上翻譯計畫與先進AI科技，學生將於實際翻譯計畫中，學習如何運用科技來提升翻譯能力與效率。本課程著重三大主軸：（1）發展後設認知技能；（2）增強工具使用能力；（3）提升機器翻譯譯後編輯技巧。學生將參與翻譯計畫（包括維基百科、全球之聲、TED），並運用ChatGPT和Claude等AI工具進行批判性思考，以分析並解決翻譯過程所遇到之問題。本課程還將運用AI驅動工具（例如柏拉圖譜系統），來增強學生搜尋和整合翻譯資源的能力，並訓練學生如何對AI生成之譯文進行人工譯後編輯，以提高翻譯質量。
description.en: This advanced translation course aims to equip students with the skills necessary to integrate AI tools into their translation workflows. Through merging online translation projects with cutting-edge AI technologies, students will gain hands-on experience in using technology to improve their translation proficiency and efficiency. The course focuses on three main areas: (1) developing metacognitive skills, (2) enhancing instrumental competence, and (3) refining machine translation post-editing techniques. By engaging in online translation projects, including Wikipedia, Global Voices Lingua, and TED, students will employ AI tools, such as ChatGPT and Claude, to critically evaluate and enhance their problem-solving and decision-making capabilities. Additionally, this course will bolster students’ resource-searching abilities through AI-driven tools (e.g., Platograph) and train them in manually editing AI-generated translations to enhance quality.

description.zh: 世界經濟論壇2025年《就業未來報告》指出，AI的趨勢正改變就業市場並加速轉型。人工智慧(AI)作為一種能表現智慧的技術，已深刻改變了人類與科技產品的互動方式。隨著科技的日新月異，AI從基本的數據運算逐步發展為具備創造力的工具，其中「生成式人工智慧」(Generative AI)尤為矚目。 本課程旨在培養學生對圖像生成式AI的素養與實務應用。透過多種AI繪圖工具的學習與應用，引導學生創作出具視覺吸引力的作品，並幫助設計流程的發展。同時，課程將提供最新的趨勢資訊與實作教學，讓學生能完成具體的創意項目與設計專案。
description.en: The World Economic Forum's 2025 "Future of Jobs Report" indicates that the trend of AI is transforming the job market and accelerating its evolution. Artificial Intelligence (AI), as a technology capable of exhibiting intelligence, has profoundly changed the way humans interact with technological products. With the rapid advancement of technology, AI has evolved from basic data computation to a tool with creative capabilities, with "Generative AI" being particularly noteworthy. This course aims to cultivate students' literacy and practical application of image-generative AI. Through the learning and application of various AI drawing tools, students will be guided to create visually appealing works and assist in the development of design processes. Additionally, the course will provide the latest trend information and practical teaching, enabling students to complete specific creative projects and design assignments.

description.zh:
本課程包含「職業教育與訓練」及「生涯規劃」兩大主題。在「職業教育與訓練」部份，針對職業教育與訓練做整體性介紹，促使學生瞭解我國技職教育重要政策與特色、認識我國技職教育之設置群科、建立學生從事技職教育教學之基礎。在「生涯規劃」部份，針對除了加強學生自我覺察與職涯規劃，也增進學生未來任教時，協助自己的學生進行職涯探索與規劃的能力。
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
This course involves "Vocational Education and Training" and "Career Planning" two main topics. The "Vocational Education and Training" topic offers an introduction about vocational education and training, such as (a) flexible adjustment the system of vocational education and training in Taiwan; (b) emphasizing vocation education and training system; (c) establish solid theoretical foundation of the vocational education and training. The "Career Planning" topic offers an introduction to the concept of career to not only enhance students' self-awareness and the skills of career planning, but also use those skills to assist their future students to prepare their career planning.
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

本課程的目標在提供有志從事教育工作的學生有關教育心理學的系統知識使其在未來從事教職時，具最有效的方法瞭解，敘述，預測及其學生的行為並從而採用最佳的教學方式，以達成教育目標。

description.en:
The object of this course is to introduce the educational psychology to the students who are receiving teacher education. It presents the students with the basic psychology theories of instructional process; mental-physical development; the principles of learning and instruction; cultivating of thinking and creative; motivation and interest in instructing process; the measurement of individual difference; proper instructions against differently mental students; teacher-student relationship and students behaviors; instruction evaluation. After finishing this course, students will have better understanding regarding the factors shaping the students’ behaviors, as well as can choose the best instructional ways for the teaching.
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link: https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

description.zh:
「輔導工作是所有教育工作者的責任」。任何人都會遭遇問題，成長中的學生尤其有各式各樣的問題。身為人師，在教學過程中應輔導學生解決問題，以培養健康進取，有能力解決問題，適應環境的學生為己任。在本課程的目標即在透過對青春期挫折徵候的了瞭以及學者心理分析輔導法、個體心理輔導法、存在主義輔導法、理情輔導法、認知輔導法、溝通分析輔導法、行為輔導法等輔導理論，並配合實例分析使未來之教育工作人員獲得工作時的輔導知能以及培養輔導工作的志趣。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The teachers should keep in mind the duty to guide students to overcome the frustration or to solve difficult problems as to nurture students to be healthy, positive, with their own abilities to overcome difficulties and to be apt to the environment. The object of this subject is to help students with the willingness to be teachers get the knowledge and abilities of guidance on their teaching in the future, and develop willingness and interests of guidance. This course presents students with the units including  understanding the symptom of adolescent frustration, the method of person-center approach, the method of rational-emotive therapy, the method of cognitive therapy, the method of behavior therapy. In addition, this course also introduces many practical cases so that students can  effectively study the relevant theories.

syllabi.outline: 「輔導工作是所有教育工作者的責任」。任何人都會遭遇問題，成長中的學生尤其有各式各樣的問題。身為人師，在教學過程中應輔導學生解決問題，以培養健康進取，有能力解決問題，適應環境的學生為己任。在本課程的目標即在透過對青春期挫折徵候的了瞭以及學者心理分析輔導法、個體心理輔導法、存在主義輔導法、理情輔導法、認知輔導法、溝通分析輔導法、行為輔導法等輔導理論，並配合實例分析使未來之教育工作人員獲得工作時的輔導知能以及培養輔導工作的志趣。 本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標： 2-1了解並尊重學生身心發展、社經及文化背景的差異，以作為教學與輔導的依據。3-5應用多元教學策略、教學媒材與學習科技，以促進學生有效學習。4-2應用輔導原理與技巧進行學生輔導，以促進適性發展。(各項指標內容請點連結詳閱了解)

syllabi.outline:
一、學習敏銳覺察社會環境對學生的學習影響，以利教育機會均等。
二、瞭解特殊需求學生的特質與鑑定歷程，以提供適切的教育與支持。
三、瞭解我國特殊教育的發展與趨勢，以及特殊教育相關法規。
四、能依據特殊需求學生學習特質，調整與設計課程教學內容。
五、能依據特殊需求學生學習特質，調整學生學習評量的方式。
六、能依據不同類型之特殊需求學生，提供適當的支持與輔導。
七、能遵照性別平等教育之教育原則，提供特殊需求學生適當課程內容。

授課方式：
一、課堂講授：講述基礎理論，並佐以教學現況的實例說明，增進理論理解。
二、課堂討論與分享：以問題導向學習法為教學方式，將實際教學的情況為主題，請學生以理論基礎設法提出解決方法。
三、分組報告與討論：以小組方式報告各組分配內容，報告後，由老師再詳加說明並請學生討論。
評量標準：
平時成績(含出缺席狀況)30%、分組報告30%、期末個人報告40%。

description.zh:
本課程的目標在培養學生瞭解教育與社會關係，從而能自教育的社會基礎理論觀點來從事教育決策，分析教育制度，探求教學原則，解決教育問題。 
教育專業課程與教師專業素養指標，請參閱連結:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw
description.en:
The object of this course is to introduce the students the understanding of the relationship between education and society. It presents the students with the relation between education and the main sociological theories, such as socialization, social structure, social change. It also offers students with the social condition of schools, the teacher's role, the teacher groups and the teacher's social status. After finishing this course, the students can use the knowledge learned from this course to make educational decision, analyze educational systems, study the instructional principles and solve educational problems in view of the basic theories of sociology of education, and thus lead to achieve the educational goal.
Indicators of Teacher’s professional competencies in professional education, please visit the link:
https://tec.ntut.edu.tw/p/412-1022-10857.php?Lang=zh-tw

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在協助學生探究教育社會學的理論與實務，探討主題包含:社會化、社會階層、教育機會均等、技職教育與社會發展等，並期學生運用相關論點對當前技職教育問題提出建議。

本課程擬培養之教師專業素養指標： 
1-2敏銳覺察社會環境對學生學習影響，以利教育機會均等。
2-1了解並尊重學生身心發展、社經及文化背景的差異，以作為教學與輔導的依據。
syllabi.schedule:
一、導論
二、教育社會學的起源
三、教育社會學主要理論
四、教育的功能
五、社會階層化
六、教育機會均等
七、學校文化
八、課程社會學
九、班級社會學
syllabi.assessment:
1.平時小考、課堂討論成績佔40﹪
2.教育社會學分組主題口頭及書面報告，佔60﹪。
3.依本校學則規定，未達出席次數不予通過。
syllabi.materials:
1.跨國灰姑娘：當東南亞幫傭遇上臺灣新富家庭。藍佩嘉，行人出版社。
2.窮忙族：新貧階級時代的來臨。門倉貴史，聯經。
3.發明疾病的人- 現代醫療產業如何賣掉我們的健康。Jorg Blech著。左岸。
4.三代同堂:迷思與陷阱。胡幼慧。高雄復文。
5.社區如何動起來？：黑珍珠之鄉的派系、在地師傅與社區總體營造。楊弘任，左岸文化。
6.有閒階級論。Thorstein Veblen箸。左岸文化。
7.嘉年華的誕生：慶典、舞會、演唱會、運動會如何翻轉全世界。左岸文化。
8.如果房子會說話：家居生活如何改變世界。左岸文化。
9.我在底層的生活：當專欄作家化身為女服務生。左岸文化。
10.失控的正向思考。左岸文化。
11.學校敢勇於建立新的社會秩序嗎？聯經。

syllabi.outline:
This course integrates foundational training in object-oriented programming with practical applications relevant to smart living technologies (Course No. 350096).  
Students will develop essential programming skills through exercises and projects, with a strong emphasis on OOP principles such as encapsulation, inheritance, and polymorphism. In addition to foundational OOP topics, the course explores real-world applications, including recent advancements in vision-language models and their integration into autonomous driving systems. 
Students will engage in critical reading and discussion of cutting-edge research papers to understand how OOP techniques support complex AI systems.
Some parts of the course will be co-taught by a doctoral teaching assistant providing additional support and insights into advanced topics.

description.en: Introduction to the finite element method and its application to engineering problems.  Topics include Variational Formulation and Finite Element Formulations, 1-D, 2-D and 3-D Element Shapes, Numerical Integration, Applications to dynamic problem and Introduction to Commercial Finite Element Programs.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Finite Element Analysis (有限元素分析)
This course introduces the basic principles of the finite element method and its applications in various engineering problems. Topics include fundamental concepts of finite element analysis, establishing finite element models using variational principles, shape functions, and iso-parametric elements. It covers one-dimensional problems such as rods, trusses, beams, and frames; two-dimensional problems including plane stress, plane strain, and plate-shell problems; and three-dimensional problems involving general solids. Practical exercises and case studies using finite element analysis software are included for practice and research analysis.
This semester, the course integrates USR (University Social Responsibility) into the curriculum, guiding students to apply finite element analysis to the USR project. Students who heavily participate in the USR project can utilize finite analysis in their USR electrical vehicle designs and/or for systematic improvements.

Additionally, the demarcation of vehicle industry is introduced, including the structure, responsibility, function and its mission. Finally, the future trend, international uniting cooperation for domestic vehicle industry is discussed.

description.en: This course aims to train students to be capable of transportation design practice. Transportation design is a cross-discipline engineering which integrates advanced technology and knowledge. This practice based course allows students to learn and execute all the tasks involved in the professional to meet the international standard, through creative concept development, blueprint drawing, clay modeling and mold making.

description.zh: 介紹汽機車上各控制系統之硬體及控制策略，包含引擎系統之空燃比、怠速、冷起動、爆震、廢氣，傳動系統之變速、傳動，煞車系統之ABS、TCS、SRS，懸吊系統之半主動及主動式懸吊，智慧型道路系統之頭燈、環境、巡航、跟隨、夜視等控制系統。
description.en: This course introduces hardware and control strategies used in each control systems in a vehicle.  These control systems include engine system (AF ratio, idle speed, cold start, knocking, exhaust), transmission system, brake system (ABS, TCS, SRS), suspension system (semi-active and active), intelligent transportation system (headlight, environment, cruise, following, night vision) etc..

syllabi.outline:
本課程針對車輛控制系統的理論與實務相關內容進行介紹，並聚焦在自動駕駛車輛的發展技術，課程內容包括雷達及視覺感測、導航與定位技術、運動控制與控制決策以及自動駕駛車輛的能源動力系統。此外課程內容也會探討車聯網技術、自駕車產業化以及從自駕車對智慧交通的轉變與影響。
This course introduces the theories and practical aspects related to vehicle control systems, focusing on the development technologies of autonomous vehicles. The course content includes radar and vision sensing, navigation and positioning technologies, motion control and decision-making, and the energy power systems of autonomous vehicles. Additionally, the course will explore vehicle-to-vehicle communication technology, the industrialization of autonomous vehicles, and the transition and impact of autonomous vehicles on e-mobility in smart cities.

syllabi.outline:
無刷直流及永磁同步電動機具有高效率、高功率-質量比，在家電、工業設備、及電動車輛產業都已被廣泛的應用，為目前最主要的動力馬達。本課程從基本的磁路分析及永久磁鐵開始，首先介紹無刷直流的運轉原理及控制方法，然後探討永磁同步電動機之控制理論，及驅動電路技術，最後說明控制系統實現及無轉軸位置感測器控制的方法。
Brushless dc and permanent-magnet synchronous motor have higher efficiency and energy to mass ratio in comparison to the other motors. They are gradually replacing induction motor and widely used in industry. This course begins with the theory of basic electromagnetic energy conversion, followed by the modeling and vector control theory for permanent-magnet synchronous motor, design and control of brushless dc motors, and the driving circuit design for these motors. Finally, sensorless PM machine control techniques are introduced.

description.zh: 此課涵蓋計算機處理器之基本結構原理及設計，包括: 指令集、組合語言、算術單元、暫存器、中央處理器、記憶體管理、匯流排、輸入及輸出、速度與效能、多核心處理器等。透過此課程，學生可學習到計算機處理器原理、設計與基本架構。
description.en: This course covers the fundamental principles and design of computer processors, including instruction sets, assembly language, arithmetic units, registers, central processing units, memory management, buses, input and output, speed and performance, and multi-core processors. Through this course, students will learn the principles, design, and basic architecture of computer processors.

name.zh: 教育訓練實施與績效評鑑

description.zh: 為了使訓練資源的更有效運用，本課程希望讓學生了解，企業內部在實施訓練之前，應客觀、嚴謹的加以評估，並追蹤其實施後的成效，以正確評估訓練的效益。
description.en: To make better use of the training resources, the curriculum expects to make students understand that any enterprise should objectively and carefully evaluate the training program before its employment, and keep track of its effect after its employment to make sure the effectiveness of the training program.

syllabi.outline: In this course, students will gain a conceptual understanding of ways to implement a training program, different models of evaluation, and the rationale for evaluating a program or the objectives and intent of the organization. Students will identify whether and where evaluation is needed, and how the evaluation contributes to the overall goals of the organization as well as the learning identified as necessary. Students will gain practical experience with the notion of evaluation as well as what is to be done with the evaluation’s findings.

This course is designed to expose students to the latest developments and cutting-edge research in the field of organic materials through a series of weekly expert seminars. Each session will feature invited talks primarily delivered by distinguished scholars, industry leaders, and external experts, providing students with insights into advanced technologies, innovative applications, and emerging trends in organic material science and engineering.

name.en: Special Topics on Surface Analysis for Materials

description.zh: 本課程介紹各種分析材料表面性質的方法。藉著利用光子、電子、原子、或離子與材料表面的物理或化學作用，來獲得有關材料表面的組成、結構、化學鍵結、電子組態於表面形貌等訊息。所要介紹的表面分析儀器包括；X光電子光譜儀(XPS)、歐傑電子光譜儀（AES）、低能電子繞射儀(LEED)、電子穿隧掃描儀(STM)、表面振動光譜儀(surface vibrational spectroscopy)、程式控溫脫附法(TPD)及真空技術。
description.en: The course introduces various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD. From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

syllabi.outline: The purpose of this course is to elucidate the gas-solid interfacial phenomena, principles and techniques of surface science and its application to meet the increasing demand for analysis of solid surfaces in both the “academic” and “technological” fields.

description.zh: 本課程主要著重於讓學生瞭解在日常生活中，食衣住行育樂等活動與化學之相互關係。尤其對在生活中所接觸之食品、衣著、環境與用品應有所認識，並以化學觀點了解其與人體之關係。此課程主要內容包括(1)食品化學(Food Chemistry)，(2)衣著化學 (Cloth Chemistry)，(3)環境化學(Environmental Chemistry)，(4)核化學(Nuclear Chemistry)，(5)水化學 (Hydrochemistry)，(6)界面化學 (Interface Chemistry)，(7)家庭用化學品 (Household Chemicals)，(8)化粧品學(Cosmetic Chemistry)，(9)電化學 (Electrochemistry)
description.en: This course focuses on chemistry related to People`s Livelihood, including: Food Chemistry, Cloth Chemistry, Environmental Chemistry, Nuclear Chemistry, Hydrochemistry, Interface Chemistry, Household Chemicals, Cosmetic Chemistry, and Electrochemistry. Topics concerning about the manufacturing processes, application principles and recent developments of People`s Livelihood chemicals are also discussed in this course.

description.zh: 本課程係探討纖維製品在非衣著終端領域之應用，例如電子電機，土木，材料，生醫，航空與車輛工程等之應用。其內容包括功能性與機能性纖維、複合紗、複合織物、編帶、非織物、纖維系複合材料與電線電纜、光纖電纜等之製造方法、原理與其終端應用領域。最後將討論微細加工技術與微細粉末在纖維與高科技工業上之應用。
description.en: The course is to interpret the application of the non-apparel textiles at the different end uses, such as application in electrical and electronic, civil, material, biomedical, aerospace, and vehicle engineering etc.  It includes fabrication methods, principles, and end application fields of the performance and functional fibers, composite yarns, composite fabrics, braid, nonwoven, textile composites, and cables and optical cables etc. Finally, the micro processing technology and powder in textile and high-tech industries will be discussed.

syllabi.outline:
本課程在讓學生全面了解技術紡織品及其在各行業的專業應用。課程首先介紹該領域，然後探討高性能纖維及其結構和功能特性，然後深入研究紡織增強複合材料及其機械優勢。它還涵蓋了過濾、土工布、防護裝備、醫用紡織品和汽車用途等關鍵應用領域。透過講座和案例討論，學生將深入了解材料選擇、設計考慮和性能評估。課程以學生主導的口頭陳述結束，培養有效傳達技術內容的能力。
This course aims to provide students with a comprehensive understanding of technical textiles and their specialized applications across various industries. Beginning with an introduction to the field, the course explores high-performance fibers and their structural and functional characteristics, followed by an in-depth examination of textile-reinforced composites and their mechanical advantages. It further covers key application areas such as filtration, geotextiles, protective gear, medical textiles, and automotive uses. Through lectures and case discussions, students will gain insights into material selection, design considerations, and performance evaluation. The course culminates in student-led oral presentations, fostering the ability to communicate technical content effectively.

description.zh: 本課程探討人工智慧（AI）如何整合並提升語言學習與教學。學生將學習第二語言習得理論，如互動理論與社會文化理論，並連結這些理論與AI輔助語言學習工具。透過實作與專題討論，學生將實際操作AI工具，並從學習者與教師的角度設計有效且具倫理意識的AI語言學習任務。課程旨在培養學生的AI素養，使其能夠批判性地評估與應用AI技術，以因應課堂內外多元的語言學習與教學需求。
description.en: This course explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can be integrated and enhance language learning and teaching. Students will examine key SLA theories—such as interactionist and sociocultural approaches—and connect them to AI-supported learning tools. Through hands-on practice and discussion, students will explore AI tools and have opportunities to design effective, ethical AI-integrated language tasks from both learner and teacher perspectives. The course aims to build students’ AI literacy, enabling them to critically evaluate and apply AI technologies to support diverse language learning needs in both classroom and self-directed contexts.

syllabi.outline:
本課程探討人工智慧（AI）如何整合並提升語言學習與教學。學生將學習第二語言習得理論，如互動理論與社會文化理論，並連結這些理論與AI輔助語言學習工具。透過實作與專題討論，學生將實際操作AI工具，並從學習者與教師的角度設計有效且具倫理意識的AI語言學習任務。課程旨在培養學生的AI素養，使其能夠批判性地評估與應用AI技術，以因應課堂內外多元的語言學習與教學需求。
This course explores how artificial intelligence (AI) can be integrated and enhance language learning and teaching. Students will examine key SLA theories—such as interactionist and sociocultural approaches—and connect them to AI-supported learning tools. Through hands-on practice and discussion, students will explore AI tools and have opportunities to design effective, ethical AI-integrated language tasks from both learner and teacher perspectives. The course aims to build students’ AI literacy, enabling them to critically evaluate and apply AI technologies to support diverse language learning needs in both classroom and self-directed contexts.

description.en: Organizational behavior (OB) is a field of research that investigates the impact that individuals, groups, and structure have on behavior within an organization, and then it applies that knowledge to make organizations work more effectively.  Specifically, OB focuses on how to improve productivity, reduce absenteeism and turnover, and increase employee citizenship and job satisfaction.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹互動媒體設計所需之故事腳本設計相關知識與其應用。在以使用者情境設計導向的基礎架構下，本課程的內如包含敘事性方法、創意思考方法、互動腳本企劃以及互動腳本撰寫等。修習此課程之學生可學習互動情境劇本設計之原理與實作模擬，並具備業界所需之互動媒體設計實務之企劃與分析能力。在以實務操作、課堂腦力激盪與討論的方式下，學生的評量採報告與作業的繳交以及課堂討論成績為主。
description.en: The course aims to introduce knowledge and application relevant to storytelling and script planning. Under the structure of user oriented scenario design, this course includes narrative methods, creative thinking methods, interactive script planning and writing. Students will be capable of interactive scenario script design, planning and analyzing for interactive media practice. By means of practical work, in-course brainstorming and discussion, students are evaluated by reports, assignment and course discusstion.

In class participation including brainstorming and discussion are evaluated.

description.zh:
隨著網際網路的盛行，電子商務迅速地蓬勃發展，使得傳統的商店與行銷環境受到衝擊。資訊科技改變了消費習慣與行銷通路，電子商務的效應已經開始影響商業活動的每個層面，從新產品的開發、銷售、到售後服務均受影響，為企業帶來了無限商機。根據資策會的報告顯示，網際購物市場目前正進入高成長期。網際網路的消費觀念逐漸普及，消費者端的網路交易市集，亦成為未來重要的網路商機。不僅B2C市場（企業對消費者）極具潛力，網友個體戶的開店創業風潮（C2C）更是在蓬勃發中。
面對網路商業的來臨，有著大量的網路商業的人才需求。只要有正確的網路商業經營獲利模式，網路是一個可以賺到大錢的管道，尤其低門檻、低成本的網路拍賣場更是最佳踏板。本課程講授網路創業及網路商業的必要實務經營能力，讓同學在本課程裡學得如何快速的以最少成本來DIY速成個人事業及就業的能力。
description.en: Following the prevailing of the internet, the vigorous development e-commerce has given great impacts on traditional tangible stores and the whole marketing environments. Information Technology has not only changed our lives, but also changed consumers' behavior and marketing channels; and the e-commerce effect has already started to permeate into every stratum of business activities, including the exploitation, marketing, and after-sales service of new products, brings the industries infinite business chances. According to the reports of Institute for Information Industry, the market of internet shopping is going into its high development period, and there are a lot of chances to establish a new enterprise on the internet. So this course will teach about the internet entrepreneurial management.

description.zh: 「鐵道車輛設計分析」課程，乃為培養具有鐵路車輛分析設計能力之人員，本課程初期將從規範面瞭解車輛設計要求，進而從結構面進行車輛設計與分析，過程中將引導學生採用主流分析軟體進行車輛穩定性與行車舒適度探討。最後將探討與台灣既有鐵道系統的相容性，進行駕駛室與機電設備配置等設計。期望透過本課程，能培植鐵道車輛設計分析人才，厚植本土鐵道車輛設計能力。
description.en: This aim of the course of "Railway Vehicle Design and Analysis" is to cultivate personnel on railway vehicle field. At the beginning of this course, the design requirement and criteria will be given as basic knowledge. Then students will be ask to perform structural design and analysis for railway vehicles. Passenger comfortable index and vehicle dynamic response will be taken into consideration during the process of design and analysis. Finally, the compatibility of the new design with the existing railway system will be discussed.

name.en: Special Topics on Regional Geology of Taiwan

description.zh:
臺灣島位於西太平洋，就板塊構造運動而言，臺灣上新－更新世的造山運動代表歐亞大陸板塊的前緣和其東側以西北方向前進的菲律賓海洋板塊間的衝撞聚合運動。東臺灣花蓮和臺東間的縱谷，已被認為是兩個板塊間的縫合帶和板塊聚合的邊緣。在臺灣的北部，大陸和島弧的碰撞型式可能是菲律賓海板塊向北傾沒到位於歐亞大陸板塊上的琉球島弧系統之下。但是向南沿東臺灣縱谷，在北緯二十四度以南，板塊隱沒方向發生改變，歐亞大陸板塊於此向東隱沒進入菲律賓海板塊之下。此一特殊的板塊背景造就了臺灣多樣的地質現象‧
本課程之內容主要探討台灣地區(包括海域)自中生代至現代的大地構造演變及其地體構造運動、盆地演化、岩石圈的結構及性質、造山運動機制等各種地質現象。希望能藉由瞭解臺灣區域地質，從而作為探討臺灣地質工程與環境領域之基礎‧
description.en:
Taiwan island is located on the weastern Pacific Ocean. The plate tectonic setting of Taiwan is the convergence and collision between the western Eurasian plate and the easterly impinging Philippine Sea plate on the Pli-Pleistocene. The Longitudinal Valley between Hualien and Taitung in eastern Taiwan has been recognized as the suture zone between these two plates. In northeastern Taiwan, convergence is marked by northward subduction of the Philippine Sea plate beneath the Ryukyu Arc System on the Eurasian plate along the Ryukyu Trench. The subduction polarity changes at 24°N near Hualien in eastern Taiwan. There plate convergence is marked by eastward subduction of the Eurasian plate underneath the Luzon Arc System on the Philippine Sea plate along the Eastern Longitudinal Valley. This distinctive tectonic setting bas brought up various special geologic phenomena on Taiwan

syllabi.outline:
臺灣島位於西太平洋，就板塊構造運動而言，臺灣上新－更新世的造山運動代表歐亞大陸板塊的前緣和其東側以西北方向前進的菲律賓海洋板塊間的衝撞聚合運動。東臺灣花蓮和臺東間的縱谷，已被認為是兩個板塊間的縫合帶和板塊聚合的邊緣。在臺灣的北部，大陸和島弧的碰撞型式可能是菲律賓海板塊向北傾沒到位於歐亞大陸板塊上的琉球島弧系統之下。但是向南沿東臺灣縱谷，在北緯二十四度以南，板塊隱沒方向發生改變，歐亞大陸板塊於此向東隱沒進入菲律賓海板塊之下。此一特殊的板塊背景造就了臺灣多樣的地質現象‧
本課程之內容主要探討台灣地區(包括海域)自中生代至現代的大地構造演變及其地體構造運動、盆地演化、岩石圈的結構及性質、造山運動機制等各種地質現象。希望能藉由瞭解臺灣區域地質，從而作為探討臺灣地質工程與環境領域之基礎‧

name.zh: 正念與藝術體驗教案設計
name.en: Mindfulness-Based Art Experience and Lesson Plan Design

description.zh:
本課程旨在引導學生透過正念實踐與藝術創作的結合，提升自我覺察與情緒調節能力，促進身心的平衡。課程會先帶領學生認識正念的理論與方法，內容涵蓋正念呼吸、正念行走、正念飲食、感恩練習與身體掃描冥想，幫助學生建立穩定的內在覺察能力。隨後進入藝術體驗單元，學生將透過繪畫、小書製作、黏土操作等多元媒材，進行自由創作與情感表達，學習如何以藝術作為自我探索與溝通的工具。
課程後半段著重於實作與應用，學生將整合所學，設計出融合正念與藝術的體驗活動，並實際應用於兒童醫院等教育或關懷場域。藉由實地帶領活動，學生不僅能強化設計與引導能力，也能培養同理心與創意表達的素養。整體課程將理論學習、藝術實作與教育應用相結合，為學生未來進行教學設計與社會參與奠定基礎。
description.en:
This course is designed to guide students in integrating mindfulness practice with artistic creation to enhance self-awareness and emotional regulation, promoting a balanced body and mind state. The course begins with an introduction to the theories and methods of mindfulness, covering practices such as mindful breathing, walking, eating, gratitude exercises, and body scan meditation. These practices aim to help students build a stable foundation of inner awareness.
The latter part of the course emphasizes practical application. Students will synthesize their learning by designing experiential activities that combine mindfulness and art, and they will implement these activities in educational or caregiving settings such as children’s hospitals. Through facilitating these activities in real-world contexts, students will not only strengthen their skills in activity design and guidance but also develop empathy and creative expression. name.zh: 文化轉譯策略與跨域創新
name.en: Strategic Cultural Transcreation and cross-disciplinary Innovation

description.zh:
本課程聚焦文化轉譯在當代文化事業中的策略應用，探討如何將文化內容轉化為可被理解、感知，並具再創造潛力的創意資源，透過將文化、知識、符號轉化為新載體，作為推動跨域創新的基礎。課程強調文化轉譯作為連結文化價值與創意應用的重要機制，並引導學生理解其在不同產業語境中的實作可能。
本課程同時關注跨域創新的行動實踐，透過多元個案的探討，讓學生學習如何在文化內容、產業需求與社會語境之間展開對話，設計具策略性與文化敏感度的創新提案。學生將從實務導向的練習中，發展將文化內容轉譯為創意與應用性高的專案能力。課程內容涵蓋文化轉譯的理論基礎、語境共融策略、跨文化再現倫理，並延伸至創意商品開發、展覽設計、跨界合作模式與公共參與實踐等領域。
description.en:
This course focuses on the strategic application of cultural transcreation within the contemporary creative industries. It explores how cultural content can be transformed into creative resources that are understandable, perceptible, and capable of inspiring new forms of creation. Through the transformation of culture, knowledge, and symbols into new carriers, cultural transcreation is positioned as a foundational mechanism for driving cross-disciplinary innovation.
Emphasizing the role of cultural translation as a bridge between cultural values and creative applications, the course guides students to understand how such processes can be practiced across diverse industry contexts. In addition to theoretical exploration, the course highlights the practical dimension of cross-disciplinary innovation.
