name.en: Behavioral decision in games & cultural strategy

description.zh: 「賽局行為與文化策略」旨在針對賽局中的行為決策與其文化策略進行探討，並以課程講授與實際操作交替進行。學習者將了解賽局的構成要素、它的性質、各種模型，和人際互動時的應對之方。除了傳統議題如「納許均衡」、「囚徒困境」、「優勢策略」之外，我們還會探討「文化策略」、「無限賽局」、「企業策略」，與「分餅」等時興議題。
description.en: The course investigates behavioral decision making in terms of the perspective of game theory and cultural strategies, and is conducted by discussion and practice activities. The participants shall understand the constituent elements, essence, models of games, along with a variety of strategies adopted between individuals in real life. In addition to traditional issues such as “Nash equilibrium,” “prisoner’s dilemma,” “dominant strategy,” etc., the course will also deal with trendy topics and ideas such as “cultural strategy,” “split the pie,” “the infinite game,” “business strategy” and the like.

description.zh: 染顏料(色料)雖已發展百餘年，唯部分現象與實驗結果仍須進一步的研究以獲得完整正確的解釋。本課程主要探討染料的吸收光譜與其分子結構式的關係，是為具有色料化學與有機化學基礎的同學所設計的。
description.en:
Although studies on synthetic colourants have been performed for more than 100 years, their detailed elucidation requires further extensive research.
This course reviews the absorption features of organic dyes and recent progress in their explanation in terms of molecular structure. This course is mainly intended for organic chemists and colour chemists which are interested in the spectral characteristics of dyes and their conceptual understanding.

description.zh: 本課程介紹各種分析材料表面性質的方法。藉著利用光子、電子、原子、或離子與材料表面的物理或化學作用，來獲得有關材料表面的組成、結構、化學鍵結、電子組態於表面形貌等訊息。所要介紹的表面分析儀器包括；X光電子光譜儀(XPS)、歐傑電子光譜儀（AES）、低能電子繞射儀(LEED)、電子穿隧掃描儀(STM)、表面振動光譜儀(surface vibrational spectroscopy)、程式控溫脫附法(TPD)及真空技術。
description.en: The course introduces various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD.  From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

syllabi.outline: The course introduces fundamentals of surface property and various surface analysis methods, including XPS, AES, LEED, STM, surface vibrational spectroscopy, and TPD. From the physical and chemical interaction between photons、electrons、atoms and ions with surfaces, the surface properties, including surface composition, surface structure, surface topography, electronic structure, and chemical bonding will be probed.

description.zh: C語言為開發作業系統、嵌入式系統、通訊協定等程式最常使用的程式語言，本課程主要教導C程式語言於實務上之應用，課程內容主要包括：進階指標使用、指標與陣列、指標與資料結構、Pointer-to-pointer、指標函式、Callback function、Bitwise operation應用等，除了於PC上撰寫程式練習之外，亦會有case study來輔助教學以及了解C語言的使用技巧，期末亦會要求學生利用所學習到之技巧來模擬CPU排程與記憶體管理等相關作業系統底層程式。
description.en: The C programming language is commonly used to implement operation systems, embedded systems, and communication protocols. The object of this course is to teach how to apply the C programming language to develop real application systems. The contents of this course include advanced pointer usage, pointer and array, pointer and data structure, pointer-to-pointer, function pointer, callback functions, bitwise operations, and so on. In addition to practice on PC, this course also offers case studies for better understanding. Students will also be required to implement emulators to simulate OS lower level operations, e.g., CPU scheduling and memory management.

description.zh: 此課程旨在以使用者為中心的觀點，說明產品與服務之開發與設計相關概念，並以實作方式應用使用者研究的方法，收集、分析與呈現研究資料與成果，使學生具備使用者研究的執行與發表能力。
description.en: From the human-centered perspective, this course explains concepts about the development and design of products and services. By practicing user research methods, students will learn how to collect and analyze the data, and present the findings of user research.

syllabi.outline: 此課程旨在以使用者為中心作為出發點，透過實際召募受試者、建構模擬實驗等，真實的應用使用者研究中的數據採集方法，進行數據搜集與分析，最終以真實的使用者需求進行某特定產品、服務、流程、手工具、設備等進行改善建議與設計，進而提高使用者的舒適、安全與效率。在實際場域上，常常會有出現產品、設備未考慮到男女先天在生理或心理的差異，導致某一族群對產品產生抱怨或感到操作上的不便，若能夠在設計初期將這一因素納入考量，分別設計出符合各族群需求的產品，將能夠有效提升工作效率。本次課程將重點放在偏鄉族群中的男女性別差異，讓學生透在課程當中學習相關採集使用者需求的方法、問卷調查、3D足部掃描、產品分析等知識，搭配實際參與使用者實驗與儀器操作，讓學生在校培養具有相關能力後，將至實際場域進行數據採集與訪談。在完成數據採集後，後半段課程將進行數據分析、討論與找出以使用者為中心的改善建議與方案，進而提升以使用者為中心的應用來提昇用戶滿意度、舒適度。除此之外，也介紹使用者產品設計相關應用案例、國際論文分享，培養學生對使用者研究的興趣與能量。整個課程透過小組實作方式，每一組提案不同的議題，進行深入的使用者需求採集，以做中學來提升學生的相關專業知識。

syllabi.outline: This course offers an in-depth introduction to Partial Least Squares Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM), a powerful and flexible technique for analyzing complex relationships among observed and latent variables in applied research. The course is grounded in the use of the SEMinR package in R, providing students with a hands-on, code-based learning experience that emphasizes practical application over mathematical derivation. Throughout the semester, students will develop a strong conceptual and analytical foundation in PLS-SEM, beginning with the distinction between reflective and formative measurement models, and advancing through the evaluation of structural models and the interpretation of model outputs. Particular emphasis will be placed on the following topics: model specification, measurement validation, structural path estimation, bootstrapping for significance testing, predictive relevance assessment, and advanced modeling techniques such as mediation, moderation, and higher-order constructs.
syllabi.schedule:
Week 1: Introduction to PLS-SEM and Review Hayes's Conditional Process Analysis

Week 2: Getting Started with R, RStudio, and SEMinR

Week 3: Building Basic Path Models in SEMinR

Week 4: Reflective Measurement Models: Specification

Week 5: Reflective Measurement Models: Assessment

Week 6: Formative Measurement Models: Specification

Week 7: Formative Measurement Models: Assessment

Week 8: Structural Model Evaluation

Week 9: Midterm

Week 10: Bootstrapping and Significance Testing

Week 11: Predictive Power and PLSpredict

Week 12: Mediation Analysis

Week 13: Moderation Analysis

Week 14: Moderated Mediation (Conditional Process Modeling)

Week 15: Higher-Order Constructs

Week 16: Multi-Group Analysis and Measurement Invariance

Week 17: Preparation for the final report (no in-person class)

Week 18: Final

Attendance 20%
Final presentation and report 80%

description.zh: 公共藝術涉題人文、藝術、空間、社會、設計等領域，本課程藉由介紹台灣及世界各地之公共藝術發展，推廣公共藝術的整體概念，使學子了解公共藝術的重要性，也藉此培養學生的專業知能、人文素養及藝術鑑賞能力。
description.en: The public art involves the humanities, arts, spatial, social, and design fields, this course introduces the development of the public art in Taiwan and the world to promote the whole concept of public art, so that students can understand the importance of the public art, but also to take this training the student's professional knowledge, humanities, and arts appreciation.

syllabi.outline: 本課程以「公共藝術×環境美學」為核心，結合理論、法規與實務操作，帶領學生從公共藝術的歷史沿革、基礎概念與當代美學論述為啟始，聚焦臺灣《文化藝術獎助及促進條例》與《公共藝術設置辦法》等法制框架，逐步掌握可行性評估、計畫書撰寫、採購審議與社群參與技巧。課程採講授、案例導讀、校外參訪與實作練習並行，培養學生對於藝術介入公共領域的分析能力。學生將理解公共藝術於地方文化治理與永續發展的價值，並能熟悉且正確引用臺灣公共藝術等治理框架，為未來進入藝文行政、場域策展或城市設計領域奠定專業基礎。

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋以下主題： 1.數字的進制轉換以及二進制表示方式 2.布林代數式與函數 3.數位電路化簡技巧，如卡諾圖與製表法 4.組合邏輯電路，如：加法器/減法器、比較器、多工器、邊/解碼器 5.可編程邏輯電路，如：唯讀記憶體/可編程唯讀記憶體（ROM / PROM）、可編程邏輯電路（PLD）、可編程邏輯陣列（PLA） 6.順序邏輯電路，如：狀態機
description.en: This course covers the following topics: 1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes 2. Boolean algebra and functions, canonical forms 3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method 4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexors, and decoders/encoders 5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA) 6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

syllabi.outline:
Introduce the principles of digital logic. Topics include:
1. Number representation, number bases and base conversions, and binary codes
2. Boolean algebra and functions
3. Combinational design techniques: K-maps, tabulation method
4. Combinational logic circuits: adders/subtractors, comparators, multiplexors/demultiplexers, and decoders/encoders
5. Programmable logic circuits: read-only memory/programmable read-only memory (ROM/PROM), programmable logic devices (PLD), and programmable logic arrays (PLA)
6. Sequential logic circuits: state machine

description.zh: 程式設計已成為各領域基礎且關鍵的能力之一，具備基本的程式能力，不僅能提升問題解決的邏輯思維能力，更是理解現代科技的入門門檻。本課程以 Python 為主要教學語言，從零開始，帶領學生學習變數、條件判斷、迴圈、函式、資料結構等基礎概念，並透過實作練習，加強學生對程式邏輯與結構的理解。此外，課程將安排簡介AI應用的單元，讓學生了解如何運用基礎程式技巧操作簡單的人工智慧工具，啟發其對未來應用的興趣與想像。無論未來是否從事程式相關工作，本課程都將奠定學生跨領域運用數位能力的基礎。
description.en: Programming has become one of the most fundamental and essential skills across all fields. Having basic programming knowledge not only enhances logical thinking and problem-solving abilities, but also serves as an entry point to understanding modern technology. This course uses Python as the primary teaching language and starts from the ground up, guiding students through core concepts such as variables, conditional statements, loops, functions, and data structures. Through hands-on exercises, students will strengthen their understanding of programming logic and structure. In addition, the course includes an introductory module on AI applications, allowing students to explore how basic programming skills can be used to operate simple artificial intelligence tools, sparking their interest and imagination for future applications. Regardless of whether students pursue a programming-related career, this course provides a solid foundation for applying digital skills across disciplines.

description.zh: 這門課程涵蓋三個部分：(I) 解一階、二階以及高階線性微分方程，並理解如何以常微分方程（ODEs）建構物理問題的數學模型；(II) 使用拉普拉斯轉換解常微分方程；(III) 矩陣代數、行列式、特徵值與特徵向量的相關理論與應用。
description.en: This course covers three sections: (I) solving first-order, second-order and higher-order linear differential equations, and understanding modeling physics problems with ODSs; (II) solving ODEs using Laplace transforms; (III) matrix algebra, determinants, eigenvalues and eigenvectors.

syllabi.outline: This course includes two main parts: (1) Introduction of first-order ordinary differential equations, second-order and higher-order linear differential equations, including physics problems or other problems to derive differential equations, and solve them in a practical importance simple method. (2) Linear algebra, matrix, vector, determinant and linear equations can be applied in the optimized calculation process of circuits and mechanics.

description.zh: 1.瞭解電路元件之基本特性及其組合電路之分析方法，內容包含：(1)電路元件：電壓及電流源，主動元件 (2)電路特性：歐姆定律，柯希荷夫電壓與電流定律等 (3)一階及二階電路：電路之微分方程描述及各種輸入信號之響應 (4)穩態分析與頻率響應：分析電路之頻域 (5)電腦輔助電路分析：如使用 SPICE 工具。2.瞭解線性與非線性電路的組成與分析法，內容包含： (1)交流激勵電路：交流穩態分析，功率計算及相電路 (2)三相電路：Ｙ與△型轉換及功率分析 (3)變壓器電路：互感應及電壓電流的變換 (4)頻率響應分析：極點與零點，轉移函數 (5)Fourier 級數，轉換及應用 (6)Laplace轉換及應用。

description.zh: 本課程主要針對各種材料（金屬、陶瓷、高分子、複合材料）之基本原理，性質及應用，做概要性的介紹。內容包括材料之晶體結構與晶體缺陷，固體材料之原子擴散，相圖與相變化，材料製程及應用，材料之物理性質（光性質、電性質、磁性質及熱性質），材料之機械性質（強度、延展性、硬度、韌性、疲勞、潛變），材料之強化機構與方法。
description.en: This course provides an overview of the fundamental principles, properties, and applications of various materials, including metals, ceramics, polymers, and composites. Topics covered encompass crystal structures and defects, atomic diffusion in solids, phase diagrams and transformations, materials processing and applications, physical properties (optical, electrical, magnetic, and thermal), mechanical properties (strength, ductility, hardness, toughness, fatigue, and creep), as well as mechanisms and methods for material strengthening.

name.zh: 文化觸媒介入都市設計
name.en: Cultural Medium Intervening into Urban Design

description.zh: 「媒介與環境」作為近年逐漸開始發展的學術領域，其論述原點通常可追溯自1960年代，藉由Marshall McLuhan對於媒體（Media）與媒介（Medium）的哲學性討論與實驗性創作，首先打開後世電影與媒體學者對於相關學術主題的探討。但這個概念卻要一直到近年，伴隨著科技的進步與媒體研究的發展，例如Anne Friedberg針對當代可以出現在各種人造與非人造環境中的螢幕（Screen）的分析，才被廣泛地作為媒介（Medium）與環境（environment）研究仰賴的分析架構，並奠定後續此學術領域的發展方向。此課程將於都市文化研究的固有知識基礎上，引入媒介與環境領域的新興論述，探究各類「觸媒」對於當代文化發展與都市設計的影響。探討子題包含有數位全球化、文創嘉年華、智慧城市、網飛經濟等當前重要都市發展議題，並透過課堂討論、方法學作業，與期末短論培養學生連結理論與實務、深度反思、和獨立探索新興學術領域的能力。
description.en: The scholarship of “Medium and Environment” was first explored by Marshall McLuhan in the 1960s with a series of academic and practical works. However, this field was not gaining much attention until the past decade when technology has brought novel challenges and scholars in film and media have been shifting their focuses to this aspect. syllabi.outline: The scholarship of “Medium and Environment” was first explored by Marshall McLuhan in the 1960s with a series of academic and practical works. However, this field was not gaining much attention until the past decade when technology has brought novel challenges. Scholars in both urban studies and media studies have been shifting their focuses to this aspect. Because of this, the studies of medium and environment has recently been an emerging field that intends to examine the phenomena intertwining the two aspects through interdisciplinary approach. Based on this background, this course will introduce cutting-edge scholarships of medium and environment studies to the traditional field of urban cultural studies, pursuing effective perspectives to unfold today’s critical urban issues, for instance globalization in digital era, the popularity of carnival and creative industries, smart and resilient city, Netflix economy/urbanism (Harvey, 2020), and so forth. Student will be expected to learn how to bridge theories and practices, to develop ability of critical thinking, and to learn corresponding methodologies.

description.zh: 本課程適用於一般大專之決策分析課程。其目的在說明決策理論之基本觀念，及其在真實世界裡相關決策問題之分析。本課程授課主題包括：不考慮機率之決策問題、與機率有關之決策問題、獲取額外資訊之決策分析、效益分析、遊戲理論。相關之授課內容包括：機率分配、期望值方法、貝氏分析、完全資訊與額外資訊之期望值。
description.en:

name.zh: 現代X光技術與材料分析
name.en: Modern X-Ray Techniques and Materials Analysis

description.zh: 課程旨在讓學生了解 X 射線繞射(XRD)與 X 射線吸收光譜(XAS)的基本理論與實際應用。這兩項X光技術已經成為近代材料結構鑑定的重要方法。在XRD部分，學生將學到分析粉末繞射圖數據，並計算晶體結構參數，如晶面間距(d-spacing)與結構因子(Structure factor)，以及結構精算(refinement)。X光近吸收邊緣光譜(XANES)與延伸X光吸收精細結構(EXAFS)將會在X 射線吸收光譜中介紹。此外課程中，將教導學生使用 Matlab與相關費軟體進行數據處理與結構解析，藉此提升學生理論與實驗數據分析能力。
description.en: This course is to teach students the fundamental theory and applications of x-ray diffraction (XRD) and x-ray absorption spectroscopy (XAS). These two x-ray techniques have become very important methods for structural characterizations on modern science. In the XRD part, students will learn how to analyze the powder XRD pattern from d-spacing, structure factor and Rietveld refinement. The illustration of XAS will include x-ray absorption near edge spectroscopy (XANES) and extended x-ray absorption fine structure (EXAFS). Meanwhile, the Matlab and relative free softwares will be used to do data analysis. Hope such combinations will enhance the capability of data analysis on students.

This course of Engineering Geology is designed as an upper-division course for undergraduate geology majors and graduate students, with an emphasis on construction or environmental concerns. Also enrolled are civil engineers with a background in geology and those who are interested in geologic applications to construction. The course builds on a basic knowledge of geology by relating geology to engineering fundamentals and construction concepts. The topics of this course include 1.Origin and development of the earth, 2.Introduction to the Engineering Geology, 3.Elements of Rock and Soil Mechanics, 4.Engineering properties of rocks, 5.The environmental factors of the Engineering Geology, 6.The weak planes in the rock body, 7.The environmental factors of the Engineering Geology, 6.Geologic hazards, 7.The rock mass classification and rating, 8.Landslides, subsidence, and slope stability, 9.Site investigation, 10.Case study in the Engineering Geology

description.zh:
本課程將介紹人工智慧在各種商情預測的技應用，做好商情預測有利於確保企業發展方向的正確性，也能讓企業更能抓住市場脈動而滿足消費者的需求不會造成太多的庫存堆積，保持市場供需的動態平衡。
本課程規劃所欲培育人才所需之教學目標包括：
（1）學生有能力使用python寫各種商業智能程式，包括使用pandas模組裡進行商業數據分析與視覺化。使用numpy，sklearn機器學習模組來處理迴歸分析問題。使用keras模組來進行深度學習的商業預測應用。
（2）實作多種商情預測專題。
description.en:
This course will introduce the technological application of artificial intelligence in various business forecasts to help students understand the current status of various applications of AI in business forecasts.
The teaching objectives required for cultivating talents in this course planning include:
(1) Students are able to use python to write various business intelligence programs, including using pandas modules for business data analysis and visualization. Use numpy, sklearn machine learning module to handle regression analysis problems. Use keras modules for business forecasting applications of deep learning.
(2) Implement a variety of business forecast topics.

建立『決策樹，隨機森林，支持向量機算法』來預測二元分類問題

第11週：非監督式學習應用
集群分析/分群分析，建立『K-means分群』模型來把『自動分群』
降維簡化分析(dimension reductoin)，建立『主成份分析PCA』降維模型，來把特徵參數簡化降維

第12週：高階商業分類模型與視覺化

第13週：深度學習基礎（Keras框架）

第15週：數據預處理自動化
資料預處理，標準化(Standardization), 特徵縮放scaler

第16週：特徵選取策略
8種特徵選取feature selection方法
用管道器封裝中間的全部流程：(x-->【管道器pipeline】-->y)

第17週：專案實作：消費者需求分析，用戶流失預測，銷售預測、庫存預測

第18週：期末考

這門課全程寫程式，請同學們上課要繫帶筆記本電腦
-----------------

Weekly Schedule
Week 1: Cross-Domain AI Applications in Business Forecasting

Current practices: Market demand/supply/dynamic equilibrium forecasting, market share prediction, and price trend analysis.

Week 2: AI Step 1 – Data Acquisition & Query (Pandas-1)

Data extraction from CSV/Excel, conditional filtering (df.query()).

Week 3: Data Processing Fundamentals

Three data structures: DataFrame (tabular), Array (matrix), and List (sequential).

Week 4: Mathematical Foundations of AI

Key concepts: Loss functions, gradient descent, and feature engineering.

Week 5: AI Step 2 – Machine Learning with NumPy

Simplified 3-step regression modeling (13 basic exercises).

Week 6: Linear/Nonlinear Regression with Scikit-learn

Enhanced 6-step workflow: Model evaluation, overfitting validation, and feature correlation.

Week 7: Multivariate Regression & Data Visualization

Three visualization methods: Pandas built-in, Matplotlib, and Seaborn.

Week 8: Midterm Exam

Week 9: Classification Models for Business Problems

Binary classification: Logistic Regression and K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN).

Week 10: Advanced Binary Classification

Decision Trees, Random Forest, and SVM for customer value prediction.

Week 11: Unsupervised Learning Applications

Clustering: K-means for automated segmentation.

Dimensionality reduction: PCA for feature simplification.

Week 12: Advanced Classification & Visualization

Model interpretation with SHAP values and confusion matrices.

Week 13: Deep Learning Basics (Keras Framework)

Neural network architecture design.

Week 14: Deep Learning for Classification

Case studies: Diabetes prediction and Iris species classification (One-Hot Encoding).

Week 15: Automated Data Preprocessing

Standardization, feature scaling (MinMaxScaler), and pipeline construction.

Week 16: Feature Selection Strategies

8 methods: Filter/Wrapper/Embedded approaches.

End-to-end pipeline encapsulation: sklearn.pipeline.

Week 17: Capstone Project

Options: Consumer demand analysis, churn prediction, sales/inventory forecasting.

Week 18: Final Exam

name.en: Ergonomics evaluation and redesign in products

description.zh: 本課程期望學生能夠能有獨立思考的能力，對產品建構出合理的實驗設計架構，透過採集人的生理與心理數據對產品進行人因工程評估，最後將實驗發現應用於產品的重新設計上，讓產品能夠更符合使用者的需求與認知。
description.en: In this course, students are expected to demonstrate independent thinking, develop a reasonable experimental design, conduct ergonomics evaluations on products by collecting both physiological and psychological data, and ultimately apply the findings to redesign products. This ensures that the products align more effectively with the needs and perceptions of users.

syllabi.outline:

In this course, students are expected to demonstrate independent thinking, develop a reasonable experimental design, conduct ergonomics evaluations on products by collecting both physiological and psychological data, and ultimately apply the findings to redesign products. This ensures that the products align more effectively with the needs and perceptions of users.

name.en: The introduction and practical works of cultural and creative industry.

description.zh: 本課程希望透過媒體與文創相關產業主管之帶領，訓練修課學生投入文創工作時所具備之眼界與執行力，並利用上學期所學，鼓勵學生試圖設計屬於自己的文創產品概念。除了產業之介紹與培訓課程，我們也注重同學對於新媒體與移動裝置之掌握與運用，建立在數位時代踏入文創產業之不可或缺之素養。
description.en: The students in the class will be conducted and taught by the managers of media, cultural and creative industry to learn the insight and execution in the relative works. We will ask the students to design their own prototypes of cultural and creative product based on the concept and vision they’ve learned last semester. Except the introduction and lecture of the industry, we will also focus on students’ ability of coordination with new media or mobile devices, which are the important accomplishments for cultural and creative industries in digital era.

syllabi.outline: 聚焦「文化科技融合」與「生成式AI應用」交叉領域，結合數位典藏、語意理解、3D建模、沉浸互動與教育應用技術，打造具文化知識深度、可互動學習、具展示與推廣價值的AI治理對話平台。結合「文化內容科技（C-content Tech）」、「教育科技（EdTech）」、「生成式AI（AIGC）」等產業趨勢，亦有助於推動文化永續、數位轉型與在地AI人才培育。建構一個具備「治理知識深度」、「場域展示實感」與「教學應用擴散」之台灣文化AI創新應用示範平台，突破文化展示與教育推廣之技術瓶頸。

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline:
期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

Students are expected to understand the concept of labor education through campus environment maintenance and cleaning activities. Through hands-on courses, students will develop an entrepreneurial spirit of not fearing hardship, difficulty, or dirt. Additionally, the activities aim to instill the values of diligent work, care for belongings, and the simultaneous use of both hands and mind. These experiences will help cultivate well-rounded character, correct values, and a strong work ethic in students.

由授課教師於課堂上講述勞作教育的意義及學期課程內容。
第二階段：實作體驗及反思

第三階段：期末成果分享
學期末彙整學期課程剪影，並回顧反思學習成果。

Students are expected to understand the concept of labor education through campus environment maintenance and cleaning activities. Through hands-on courses, students will develop an entrepreneurial spirit of not fearing hardship, difficulty, or dirt. Additionally, the activities aim to instill the values of diligent work, care for belongings, and the simultaneous use of both hands and mind. These experiences will help cultivate well-rounded character, correct values, and a strong work ethic in students.

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline: 期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段：勞作教育理念介紹
由授課教師於課堂上講述勞作教育的意義及學期課程內容。
第二階段：實作體驗及反思
透過校園及外圍環境整理，讓同學們體驗不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的精神，並於體驗後進行討論及撰寫反思單，啟發同學多元思考。
第三階段：期末成果分享
學期末彙整學期課程剪影，並回顧反思學習成果。

第1節：課程說明
第2、3節：期初保管教室大掃除
第4~9節：校(內)外實掃或服務
第10、11節：品德文藝活動
第12~16節：保管教室打掃
第17、18節：期末保管教室大掃除
syllabi.assessment:
出席:30%
活動參與及學習態度:30%
心得報告:40%

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline:
本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。
課程內容：包含四大階段
（一）勞作教育理念介紹：選取勞作教育相關主題，由授課教師於課堂上講述。可包含勞作教育意義、勞作教育前測作業說明
（二）勞作教育實作階段：勞作課程分三項不同情境施作。
（三）課堂討論與反思：學生必須於各實作階段課程進行討論與反思，並撰寫心得報告、完成後測作業。
（四）期末成果分享：勞作教育期末成果分享，並辦理獎勵工作。
The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.
syllabi.schedule:
第1節：課程說明與人員分組
第2節：期初保管教室大掃除
第3節：課程意義討論與校(內)外活動選擇
第4節：團隊合作、物品分類管理與商品展示技巧
第5、6、7節：第一組校外實掃或服務
第8、9節：品德文藝活動
第10節：期中保管教室大掃除
第11、12、13節：第二組校外實掃或服務
第14、15、16節：第三組校外實掃或服務
第17節：期未心得報告
第18節：期末保管教室大掃除
syllabi.assessment:
平時(保管教室)成績：20％
校(內)外實掃：60％
期未報告(心得)：20％。
☆期未報告(心得)須包含校(內)外實掃或服務、保管教室打掃及品德文藝活動之參與心得。

description.zh: 本課程目標是協助學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，從勞作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，使學生透過實際的勞作課程，培養學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格、良好品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。課程內容包含（一）勞作教育理念介紹。（二）勞作教育實作。（三）課堂討論與反思。（四）期末成果分享。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to introduce the idea of labor service to students. Students who take this course have to participate in the campus cleaning activities. This is to help students building up: (i) the team-work abilities; (ii) the concepts of ethics; (iii) the abilities of concerning the society. In addition, the course would help students to develop the accurate attitudes in the daily life and the healthy personalities. Furthermore, this course would also help students to enrich the sense of humanities. Four stages are included in this course: (i) the introduction of the labor service, (ii) the field work studies, (iii) the class discussions, and (iv) sharing of the experiences of the labor service.

syllabi.outline:
期望學生透過校園環境整理及打掃體驗活動，認識勞作教育之理念，並從實作課程中養成同學不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的企業家精神，同時建立學生手腦並用，勤勞愛物的觀念，培養學生健全的人格品德、正確的價值觀及刻苦耐勞的工作態度。

Students are expected to understand the concept of labor education through campus environment maintenance and cleaning activities. Through hands-on courses, students will develop an entrepreneurial spirit of not fearing hardship, difficulty, or dirt. Additionally, the activities aim to instill the values of diligent work, care for belongings, and the simultaneous use of both hands and mind. These experiences will help cultivate well-rounded character, correct values, and a strong work ethic in students.
syllabi.schedule:
第一階段：勞作教育理念介紹
由授課教師於課堂上講述勞作教育的意義及學期課程內容。
第二階段：實作體驗及反思
透過校園及外圍環境整理，讓同學們體驗不怕苦、不怕難與不怕髒的精神，並於體驗後進行討論及撰寫反思單，啟發同學多元思考。
第三階段：期末成果分享
學期末彙整學期課程剪影，並回顧反思學習成果。

1.課程說明：1節課
2.心得寫作：1節課
3.校內(外)實掃或服務：6節課
4.品德文藝活動：4節課
5.北聯大活動：4節課
6.期中考、期末考：2節課

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh: 本課程目標為提升社會關懷及批判思考能力，以「 PSRC模式」為課程主軸，包含：（一）P（Preparation－準備階段）：以自發、互動及共好為理念，透過公共議題研討，認識多元群體的現況及困境，培養自主行動、溝通互動、社會參與等核心素養。（二）Ｓ（Service－服務階段）：與弱勢社福單位或組織連結，藉由有意義的活動，體驗服務的意義。（三）R（Reflection－反思階段）：分享服務、學習與成長經驗，深化學習的領域、擴大自己的生活範疇與生命歷練。（四）C（Celebration－慶賀階段）：肯定參與貢獻，並發揮自身影響力，以追求社會的公平、合理、合法與正義，建立關懷文化。
description.en: The goal of this course is to enhance social care and critical thinking skills. It takes the "PSRC model" as the main axis of the course and includes: (1) P (Preparation): Based on the concepts of spontaneity, interaction and common good, through discussions on public issues, we understand the current situation and dilemma of diverse groups, and cultivate core competencies such as independent action, communication and interaction, and social participation. (2) S (Service): Connect with disadvantaged social welfare units or organizations and experience the meaning of service through meaningful activities. (3) R (Reflection-Reflection stage): Share service, learning and growth experiences, deepen the field of learning, expand your life scope and life experience. (4) C (Celebration stage): Affirm participation and contribution, and exert their own influence to pursue social fairness, reasonableness, legality and justice, and establish a caring culture.

syllabi.outline: 服務學習(SERVICE-LEARNING)為一種將「服務」與「學習」相互結合的一門課程，強調服務與學習目標同等重要，以達「互惠」之功效，是一種「從做中學」(Learning by doing)的學習經歷！透過事先規劃的社會服務過程中得到啟發及省思，並藉由反思引導學生獨立思考與關注社會議題，讓學生運用課堂所學服務他人與貢獻社區，並在過程中不斷地自我成長，學習課堂中學不到的知識、經驗與價值觀，所以服務學習是學校教育中非常重要的一環！臺北科大為發揮誠樸精勤之校訓，養成學生主動積極、負責自律、勤勞服務、互助合作之美德，鍛鍊周詳規劃、領導統馭之能力，精進服務學習課程之效果，達到關懷弱勢、縮短貧富差距、落實社會正義及完成學生、家庭、學校、社區、與社福單位五贏之目標。

description.zh: 本課程以論文研討方式學習 "機器學習" 理論之基本概念與應用及各種演算法。課程內容包含概念式學習、決策樹、圖型理論、神經網路、貝氏網路、案例式學習及支持向量機等方法。經由這門課，學生能對現代機器學習技術及其應用有基本的了解。
description.en: This is a graduate seminar-based course that provides an overview of many algorithms in machine learning and its applications. In this course, we will take an interdisciplinary look at current research topics in machine learning covering Concept Learning, Decision Tree, Graphical Model, Neural Network, Bayesian Network, Instance-based Learning, and Support Vector Machine. Through the course, students can have the basic ideas and intuition behind modern machine learning methods.

This course covers important concepts and topics of Artificial Neural Networks (ANN) that can be developed and used to solve classification or function approximation problems. The outline of this course is given as follows. (1) Introduction, (2) ANN, (3) ANN applied in classification, (4) ANN applied in function approximation, (5) ANN applied in time-series data forecasting, and (6) Applications.

description.zh: 本課程將深入探討比特幣作為一種加密貨幣的獨特經濟特性。我們將從貨幣的基礎概念開始，接著介紹比特幣，探討其背後的區塊鏈技術以及去中心化的運作方式。然後，我們將探討比特幣的價值形成機制、供需動態、市場波動等相關議題，並探討其對傳統金融體系的影響，以及可能的未來發展趨勢。此外，再針對比特幣逐漸成為全球大南方新興市場國家的普惠金融方案之一的現象探討其原因與未來發展。
description.en: This course delves into the unique economic characteristics of Bitcoin as a cryptocurrency. We Start from the fundamental concepts of money, fiat currency, and then discuss the Bitcoin. We explore the underlying blockchain technology and decentralized operations. We then examine Bitcoin's value proposition, supply-demand dynamics, market volatility, and its impact on traditional financial systems, along with potential future trends. On top of that, Bitcoin is also gaining traction to become one of the financial inclusion solution in global south emerging countries, we also examine the reasoning and future development of this phenomena.

name.zh: 前瞻材料光學量測與應用
name.en: Optical Measurement and Applications of Emerging Materials

description.zh: 本課程聚焦於具應用潛力之前瞻光電材料之性質、製程技術，以及其於光學檢測與雷射應用中的角色。涵蓋之材料類型包括光電半導體材料（如 III-V 族、鈣鈦礦）、液晶、有機高分子材料、奈米材料（如金屬奈米粒子）與二維材料（如石墨烯、MXene 等）。學生將深入了解這些材料的光電特性，並探討其在雷射、感測器、顯示器、可撓式電子與生醫檢測元件等領域的實際應用。課程內容亦介紹多種光學與雷射相關的量測技術，包括光學吸收、螢光、光致發光（PL）、拉曼光譜、表面增強拉曼散射（SERS），以及雷射激發之光學檢測方法。透過應用導向的案例分析與實作設計，強化學生於材料、雷射與光學系統整合方面的跨領域實務能力。
description.en: This course focuses on the properties and fabrication techniques of advanced optoelectronic materials, as well as their roles in optical detection and laser-related applications.Covered material categories include optoelectronic semiconductors,liquid crystals, organic polymers and biocompatible materials.Students will gain in-depth understanding of the optoelectronic properties of these materials and explore their practical applications in laser systems,sensors,displays,flexible electronics,and biomedical diagnostic devices.The course also introduces a variety of optical and laser-based characterization techniques,including optical absorption,fluorescence,photoluminescence,Raman spectroscopy,surface-enhanced Raman scattering,and laser-excited optical detection methods.Through application-oriented case studies and hands-on project design, students will develop interdisciplinary practical skills in integrating materials, lasers, and optical systems.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在介紹先進光學材料(包含光電半導體、奈米晶體、二維材料、有機光電材料與液晶等)的特性及其在雷射技術中的應用，包括相關材料的性能與製備、光學量測設備以及相關雷射應用的案例。透過此課程，學生將學習新的光學材料之光電物理特性，掌握雷射技術的基本原理並評估不同光學材料在雷射應用中的可能性。
This course provides a systematic introduction to the properties of advanced optical materials, such as optoelectronic semiconductors, nanocrystals, two-dimensional materials, organic optoelectronic materials, and liquid crystals, as well as their applications in laser technology. The course covers the performance analysis and fabrication methods of these materials, the operating principles of optical measurement instruments, and real-world applications through various laser technology case studies. Through this course, students will gain a solid understanding of the optoelectronic properties of advanced optical materials, comprehend the fundamental principles and mechanisms of laser technology, and develop the ability to evaluate the potential of different optical materials for laser applications.

description.zh: 本課程涵蓋太空系統工程的進階課題，包括當前研究和新興技術。本課程將深入理解太空系統的設計、開發、測試和實施，著重於子系統的整合和系統性能的最佳化。主題將包括先進的材料和結構、推進系統、航電系統、控制系統、人因因素等。學生將通過案例研究、設計專案和模擬實例進行學習。
description.en: This course covers advanced topics in space systems engineering, including current research and emerging technologies. The course will provide an in-depth understanding of the design, development, testing, and implementation of space systems, with a focus on the integration of subsystems and the optimization of system performance. Topics will include advanced materials and structures, propulsion systems, avionics, control systems, human factors, and more. This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

description.zh: 刑法是規定犯罪與刑罰之法律，例如「殺人」是犯罪，「處死刑、無期徒刑或10年以上有期徒刑」是刑罰。刑法總則是規定各種犯罪與刑罰之共通原理，例如故意或過失。刑法分則是規定各種不同的犯罪與刑罰，例如（故意）殺人或過失致死。透過刑法分則課程之修習，希望使同學能夠認識刑法常見而重要的犯罪類型之規定。
description.en: Criminal law is a law that stipulates crime and punishment. For example, "homicide" is a crime, and "punishment for death, life imprisonment or more than 10 years in prison" is a punishment. The general rule of criminal law is to stipulate the common principles of various crimes and penalties, such as intentional or negligent. The criminal law is to stipulate various crimes and penalties, such as (intentional) murder or negligence. Through the training of the Criminal Law Sub-Course, I hope that students can understand the provisions of the common and important types of crimes in criminal law.

description.zh: 本課程旨在向修課同學作刑法之概括介紹，包括刑法總則及刑法分則。再者，此一介紹包含下列四個重點：一、刑法之背景及理論；二、刑法之解釋；三、刑法於案例事實之適用；四、刑法與刑事訴訟法之結合。參與本課程乃理解刑法之關鍵一步，修課同學將受益匪淺。
description.en: This course aims to give participants a general introduction to "Criminal Law", including "General Provisions" and "Specific Offenses". Furthermore, the introduction contains the following four points: 1. Background and theories of Criminal Law. 2. Interpretation of Criminal Law. 3. Application of Criminal Law to the facts. 4. Combination of Criminal Law and Criminal Procedure Law. Attending this course is the critical step to understanding Criminal Law, and it benefits participants a lot.

description.zh: 民法總則介紹民法中的共通概念與基本原則，為整部民法以及所有法律的學習基礎。透過民法總則之學習，同學可以熟悉法律的思考模式及規範架構。本課程將以理論與實務並重方式協助同學學習。
description.en: The General Principle of the Civil Law serves to introduce the common concept and fundamental principle of the Civil Law.  In short, the General Principle of the Civil Law predominates as a learning basis for the whole Civil Law and all legal study.  Through learning on the General Principle of the Civil Law, students can be familiar with the model of legal thought and the framework of norm.  This course aims to assist students learning from both theory and practice.

This course aims to assist students learning from both theory and practice.

description.zh: 本課程將深入我國專利法，同時簡介美國及大陸專利法。本課程內容主要涵蓋：專利申請、可專利標的、專利要件及要求、專利審查流程、專利權之實施、專利侵害判斷、專利檢索及專利說明書之撰寫。其他內容尚包括簡介專利訴訟流程、專利行政救濟流程、法院及智慧財產局之角色以及專利法與其他智慧財產權法之關係。
description.en: This course will go through R.O.C. (Taiwan) patent law in detail, and introduce to the U.S. and China patent laws. Topics will mainly include patent filing, patentable subject matter, patent conditions and requirements, patent examination procedure, patent enforcement, patent infringement assessment, patent search, and patent drafting. Other topics include introduce to patent litigation procedure, patent administrative suit procedure, the roles of the court and the Intellectual Property Office and the relationship between patent law and other Intellectual Property laws.

description.zh: 著作權法係為保障著作人著作權益，調和社會公共利益，促進國家文化發展，所特別制定之法律。該法所稱著作包括：語文著作、音樂著作、戲劇、舞蹈著作、美術著作、攝影著作、圖形著作、視聽著作、錄音著作、建築著作、電腦程式著作等。著作權的保障內涵則包含因著作完成所生之著作人格權及著作財產權。本課程將兼顧實例與理論進行探討，來深化同學對於著作權的瞭解。
description.en: Copyright Act is specifically enacted for the purposes of protecting the rights and interests of authors with respect to their works, balancing different interests for the common good of society, and promoting the development of national culture. "Works" of this act, include the following:1.Oral and literary works.2.Musical works.3.Dramatic and choreographic works.4.Artistic works.5.Photographic works.6.Pictorial and graphical works.7.Audiovisual works.8.Sound recordings.9.Architectural works.10.Computer programs. "Copyright" means the moral rights and economic rights subsisting in a completed work. The discussion in the course covers theory and examples, to enhance a deeper understanding of Copyright for the students.

name.zh: 科技產品市場定位與策略
name.en: Technology Products Market Positioning and Strategy

description.zh: 本課程在使學生藉由瞭解市場定位與策略跟科技產品發展與運用的領域有著密不可分的關係。課程內容主要藉由當前科技產品發展的相關課題，以及整體環境的概述，讓同學對於產業或企業之科技產品市場定位與策略有一基本的認知，提供同學從科技產品、市場定位、管理策略的不同角度瞭解科技產品於市場上定位及推動發展策略。
description.en: This course is closely related to the field of technology product development and application through understanding market positioning and strategies. The course content mainly provides students with a basic understanding of the market positioning and strategies of technology products in industries or enterprises through the current topics related to the development of technology products and an overview of the overall environment, and provides students with different perspectives on technology products, market positioning, and management strategies. Understand the positioning of technology products in the market and promote development strategies.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要讓同學能理論與實務兼具，了解科技產品及服務在市場定位及策略，並快速在工作上即時運用課程設計。首先以全球化的市場觀點，及新科技的運用及發展，接著以企業自身之定位，去了解如何提供消費者及客戶之需求。課程內容注重理論與實務，會以演練及個案研究為主要教學內容，讓同學學習後，即時在工作上運用。
This course mainly enables students to have both theory and practice, understand the market positioning and strategies of technology products and services, and quickly apply course design at work. First of all, from the perspective of the global market, and the application and development of new technologies, and then from the positioning of the company itself, to understand how to meet the needs of consumers and customers. The course content focuses on theory and practice, with exercises and case studies as the main teaching content, so that students can apply them at work immediately after learning.

封裝技術論及相關技術方法，如施力、軟焊、或熔接等用來將兩個或多個微電子、微機械、微光學或其他相關元件結合的技術原理及製程。內容也涉及被封裝的元件的材料及封裝可靠度有關的特性如力學、熱傳、電磁干擾等。案例包括黏晶、打線、覆晶、黏著技術及軟焊技術等。
description.en: The lecture describes packaging technology as a summary of those technological methods, which use joining of two or more electronic, micro-mechanic micro-optic or other components like this by force, soldering or welding processes. Besides the presentation of these processes, the parts, i.e. thin film circuit elements, thick film components, including their material and technology relevant properties such as mechanical, heat transfer, electromagnetic interference,  which influence the packaging reliability are described. Examples such as die bonding, wire bonding, flip-chip bonding adhesive technology and soldering technology are chosen to show joining technology for semiconductor, MEM components, hybrid CKTs, packages and modules.

syllabi.outline:
This course will teach the fundamentals for packaging, including phase diagrams of solders, bonding technology, metallurgical reactions, and reliabilities, as well as the state-of-the-art Cu-Cu hybrid bonding. It will also cover bonding technology of microelectronic packaging: Die Attach/Chip Bond, Wire Bond, Tape automatic bonding, Flip Chip Technology, Pb-based and Pb-free Solders, Microbumps, 3D IC packaging, Cu-Cu bonding, and Cu hybrid bonding. 
Metallurgical reactions include Cu-Sn, Ni-Sn, Sn-Au, Ag-Sn, Pd-Sn, and In-Sn. The following reliability issues will be taught: multiple reflow, electromigration, thermomigration, Stress, temperature cycling tests, solid state aging, Sn whisker, and Mean-time-to-failure measurement.

syllabi.outline: This course provides a comprehensive study of convective heat transfer, focusing on the fundamentals of fluid flow, energy transport, and boundary layer theory. Both forced and natural convection are examined in detail, with emphasis on governing equations, similarity analysis, and engineering correlations. Applications to internal and external flows are highlighted to prepare students for solving real-world thermal problems.

description.zh: 本門課之目的是讓學生熟悉質與量研究方法的設計。主題涵蓋研究計劃之準備及撰擬 ;主要研究方法，如調查研究法、相關研究法、實驗研究法、行動研究法；質性和量化資料之搜集與分析；敘述統計和推論統計。
description.en: This course familiarizes students with qualitative and quantitative research procedures and the statistical design involved in education and applied linguistics research. Topics will include the nature and process of research; survey research; experimental research; correlational research; action research; data collection and data analysis; descriptive statistics; and sampling and inferential statistics.

syllabi.outline:
This course aims to introduce the foundational principles of qualitative and quantitative research methodologies. It provides learners with a conceptual and practical grounding in research design, enabling them to conduct methodologically sound explorations and investigations across both paradigms. Furthermore, the course examines the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) tools in the research process—highlighting their applications in data collection, transcription, coding, and analysis—to enhance research efficiency, accuracy, and depth.
本課程旨在介紹質性與量化研究方法的基本原理，並為學習者提供研究設計的概念基礎與實務能力，使其能夠在兩種研究範式中進行方法嚴謹的研究。此外，課程亦將探討人工智慧（AI）工具於研究歷程中的應用，包括在資料蒐集、轉錄、編碼與分析等階段的整合運用，藉此提升研究的效率、準確性與深度。

description.en: This aim of the course of "Railway Vehicle Design and Analysis" is to cultivate personnel on railway vehicle field. At the beginning of this course, the design requirement and criteria will be given as basic knowledge. Then students will be ask to perform structural design and analysis for railway vehicles. Passenger comfortable index and vehicle dynamic response will be taken into consideration during the process of design and analysis. Finally, the compatibility of the new design with the existing railway system will be discussed.

description.en: Introduction to the finite element method and its application to engineering problems.  Topics include Variational Formulation and Finite Element Formulations, 1-D, 2-D and 3-D Element Shapes, Numerical Integration, Applications to dynamic problem and Introduction to Commercial Finite Element Programs.

syllabi.outline:
Course Title: Finite Element Analysis (有限元素分析)
This course introduces the basic principles of the finite element method and its applications in various engineering problems. Topics include fundamental concepts of finite element analysis, establishing finite element models using variational principles, shape functions, and iso-parametric elements. It covers one-dimensional problems such as rods, trusses, beams, and frames; two-dimensional problems including plane stress, plane strain, and plate-shell problems; and three-dimensional problems involving general solids. Practical exercises and case studies using finite element analysis software are included for practice and research analysis.
This semester, the course integrates USR (University Social Responsibility) into the curriculum, guiding students to apply finite element analysis to the USR project. Students who heavily participate in the USR project can utilize finite analysis in their USR electrical vehicle designs and/or for systematic improvements.

description.zh: 本課程針對幼稚園、國小、與國中階段的英語師資而設計，在教材與教法的搭配上提供學理的引介與實務上的訓練。本課程設計考量這些階段學生之身心發展程度與興趣，將屬於兒童與青少年文學範疇的文本（例如：希臘神話、哈利波特系列、波西傑克森系列等等）作創意運用，幫助老師們擷取並改編合宜的教材，經由活潑的教學活動（包括：改編戲劇演出、繪本製作、歌唱舞蹈等等），提高學生的英語能力，也在培養他們體察文化差異的深層素養。
description.en: Designed for kindergarten, elementary school, and junior high school English teacher, this course aims to provide practical training and theories in teaching materials and pedagogy. Students of this course will also learn to adapt children and teenager literary works such as Greek mythology, the Harry Potter series, and the Posey Jackson series into materials suitable for students at the above-specified age groups. Possible learning activities such as role-play, picture books, dancing/singing will also be explored as methods to both develop students' English proficiency and cultural awareness.

syllabi.outline:
While this course is designed for kindergarten, elementary school, junior high, and high school English teachers, non-teachers are also very welcome to join. If you like reading children’s literature and wish to improve your cultural knowledge and public speaking skills, this will be a useful course for you. Students will read engaging children’s and young adult literature, including picture books, classics, popular fiction, and multicultural stories, and learn to adapt these stories into materials suitable for students of a particular age group (or, for non-teachers, into materials suitable for office book clubs or volunteer activities). Creative learning activities will also be explored as methods to develop students' English proficiency and cultural awareness.

syllabi.schedule:
Each week, students will read a portion of a children's chapter book or YA novel. Texts chosen may include the following (though I will adapt the week-by-week syllabus over the break and may cut or add a text--contact me with any concerns):

Alice's Adventures in Wonderland (Lewis Carroll)
Dumpling Days (Grace Lin)
The Voyage of the Dawn Treader (C. S. Lewis)
Project Mulberry (Linda Sue Park) 
Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban (or another Harry Potter text)
Percy Jackson and the Sea of Monsters (Rick Riordan) 
A Wrinkle in Time (Madeleine L'Engle)
The Devil's Arithmetic (Jane Yolen) 

Every week we will additionally explore one or more picture books (pre-K to grade 2--though, in foreign language classes, picture books are appropriate at any level). Some of the picture books we may explore include Hair Love, Trombone Shorty, the Poppleton series, the Frog and Toad series, The Name Jar, Elephant and Piggie, If the S in Moose gets Loose, and Llamaphones. We will also read some children's poetry, including Edward Lear poems, Ogden Nash poetry, and Hillaire Belloc. (Picture books will be read in class and will not usually require advance preparation.)

Students may also read short, useful articles on pedagogy and teaching methods.
syllabi.assessment:
Students will be evaluated based on reading quizzes, informal lesson plan ideas, presentations/teaching demonstrations, and a final paper in which the students describe their hypothetical literature curriculum for an English club or class. 

Again, while this course is especially designed for teachers, you certainly do not have to be a teacher to take this course, and non-teachers are very welcome.

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

description.zh: 本課程旨在透過各種英語新聞媒體如電視新聞（如CNN, BBC, NBC）、英文雜誌（如The Economist, Scientific American ）、英文報紙（New York Times, Washington Post, the Guardian等）等，來培養學生的批判性閱讀能力．並同時提升其宏觀視野與多元知識。課堂中將藉由分析英語新聞的用字遣詞、報導角度的取捨、標題與議題的呈現方式等，使學生學習如何思考報導背後之立場，從而進行批判性閱讀。此外，亦將剖析英語新聞中所含括之英美文學典故與文化傳統，帶領學生瞭解新聞英文的豐富意涵。
description.en: This course aims to (1) develop students’ critical reading abilities, (2) expand their global horizons and (3) broaden their knowledge by using diverse English news reports provided by news channels (e.g. CNN, BBC and NBC), news magazines (e.g. The Economist and Scientific American) and newspapers (e.g. New York Times, Washington Post and The Guardian). Students will learn how to read critically by analyzing word choice, reporting angles and the selection and presentation of headlines or quotations. This course will also explore literary allusions and cultural references contained in English news in order to further enhance students’ English language competence.

description.zh: 每天許多人規律運動、觀賞及討論賽事，若具備暢談體育以及運動相關俚語的英文能力，將十分有益於與英語人士交流。本課程將介紹學生適用於體育以及其他社交場合的英語單字（包含許多用於職場專業場合、不同於字面意思的運動俚語）。本課程能幫助學生更清楚地理解英語體育新聞、更周全地與英語人士談論體育、用更加批判性的思維來思考運動在英語世界的文化、語言、日常生活中扮演著怎樣重要的角色。
description.en: Because many people play, watch, and discuss sports every day, being able to talk about sports and to understand sports idioms is very helpful when interacting with English speakers. This course introduces students to English vocabulary that is useful for talking about sports, but also useful in other social situations. (For example, many sports idioms -- such as “to play hardball” and “to strike out” -- are used by businessmen in professional situations not directly related to sports).  The class helps students to understand more clearly English news about sports, to talk more thoughtfully with English speakers about sports, and to think more critically about the important role that sports play in the culture, language, and everyday life of people in the English-speaking world.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

歡迎同學加入本課程，若遇疫情嚴重，以學校公布遠距教學規則為準。原則上會以Google Meet進行遠距教學模式（北科同學們的學校帳號都會連結ㄧ個gmail帳號，有此帳號即可到上課時間時，依據老師於此處，或者同步於班級LINE群組公布的代碼連結加入課程）。

作業跟測驗方式(亦會隨疫情狀況調整)：
1. 平時作業會採取限時完成線上繳交（通過北科i學園網頁發布及收取作業項目）的方式。
2. 額外講義老師會通過北科i學園網頁及Line群組(若遇疫情或其他不可抗力因素需實行遠距教學會創建群組)讓同學能及時溝通，下載並完成練習。
3. 若遇口說練習等測驗，則會請同學錄音，接著（通過北科i學園網頁）上傳錄音檔案繳交測驗內容。或者老師會設定Google Meet，線上ㄧ對一口說測驗時間。
4. 期末報告會視期末狀況，透過北科i學園網頁繳交線上報告方式進行。

description.zh: 本課程旨在提升學生資訊領域的英語文能力，加強學生於該領域課堂學習與未來職業所需的閱讀與口說技巧。本課程中，學生將經由研讀資訊領域相關文章以及針對相關主題的討論，增加資訊領域的字彙，並加強英語能力與溝通技巧。
description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

name.en: English for Science, Technology, and Engineering I

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生閱讀理解、字彙建構、以及語言解析能力。教材著重於科學、科技以及工程方面的文章，並藉由課堂延展活動增進學生於科學、科技以及工程領域的英語能力。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit, skill-based instruction in learning how to process and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skill development, vocabulary building, and language analysis. Selected readings will be centered around science, technology, and engineering. Extension activities are designed to improve students’ technical English skills to be used in the fields of science, technology, and engineering.

description.zh: 本課程提供學生及職前專業人士必備之英語文語言技巧，強調工程專業領域之英文溝通能力之訓練。課程內容依學院專業內容區分並整合英語文之聽說讀寫之能力為未來全球化移動及以英語專業溝通人才培育為目標。
description.en: This course aims to provide pre-service engineering students/professionals with the adequate skills of the English language and communicative competence to facilitate their current academic and future career pursuits. Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在帶領學生閱讀、理解並分析文章結構,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型，學術用語等，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升閱讀理解、寫作與口說能力。
This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality reading and listening material including journals, and speech podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key academic English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, science & technology, business and health. Students learn to listen, read, write, and discuss different subjects through diverse forms of activities.

description.zh: 本課程旨在帶領學生讀、理解並分析國際時事,提高學生之英文能力，透過對多元主體之解析，讓學生了解單字用法，句型結構，特殊術語和慣用俚語等，提升閱讀能力，另外配合聽力技巧學習，提升理解能力。本課程著重英文閱讀，聽力與口說能力，鼓勵學生以英文討論國際時事，發表見解，拓展對世界的認識。
description.en: This course intends to enhance students’ reading, speaking and listening abilities by using quality newspapers, journals, interviews and podcast. It will help students enrich their vocabulary and acquire key English expressions and sentence patterns used in different realms like politics, arts, entertainment, science & technology, sports, business and health. Students learn to read, discuss and debate global issues through diverse forms of activities. This course familiarizes students with world affairs and broadens their perspective of the world.

syllabi.outline: 本課程係以提高學生新聞英文閱聽能力為主， 使得學生能廣泛熟悉各類新聞媒介的文章專論. 學生將建立各領域的常用/專用字彙, 了解分析寫作風格與技巧, 並增強聽力能力.  透過日日變化更新的世界時事, 學習英文將是切身相關, 生動活潑的經驗.  除了英語能力提升或知識增長豐富之外, 更可以奠定未來繼續獨立學習的基礎. 教學材料來源取材自China Post, Time, Newsweek, CNN, 民視英語新聞等新聞媒體。

description.zh: 本課程教授商業領域知識以及實務應用。修習本課程之學生，將習得中高階英語素養以及商務溝通基本知識。課程內容包含: 基礎商業概念、重點時事商業議題、基本商業字彙，和廣泛商業實務用語。
description.en: The course is designed for students who wish to strengthen English competence as well as increase their knowledge in business-related issues and expertise in future business practice. All students enrolled in this course are expected to be equipped with high-intermediate level of English proficiency as well as basic knowledge of effective business communication. This course covers rudimentary business concepts, important current business events, essential business terms, and English use in business practice.

description.zh: 本課程著重教導學生閱讀文章，並藉由文章訓練學生字彙建構、語言解析及聽力會話、思維啟發能力。課中延展活動將閱讀內容與聽力、會話、寫作做進一步的連結，並引導學生將所學做有效的應用。
description.en: The course provides students with explicit skills-based instruction in learning how to process, and decipher the readings that serve as springboards for reading skills development, vocabulary building, language analysis, and thought-provoking discussions. The readings include a variety of viewpoints on global topics centered around social issues, the environment, psychology, business, and technology. Extension activities are designed to encourage students to go beyond the reading text, and to put what they acquire from the readings into listening, speaking and writing practices.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

description.en: In order to cultivate the students’ comprehensive capabilities to use English, especially the listening comprehension and oral expression ability, different multimedia materials, including movies, songs, TV series, online interactional games, online aiding software, etc., are used to help students understand when and how to use language appropriately in various situations. Different activities (listening practice, role-play, group discussion, and oral presentation) are designed to facilitate students’ English learning.

description.en: This course is designed for students who are interested in improving English skills in the field of information technology. It aims to increase students’ reading fluency and improve their speaking skills needed to function and succeed in classroom settings and in future career. In this course, authentic reading texts related to information technology will be used. Students will discuss topics, such as artificial intelligence and the World Wide Web, in order to expand vocabulary and language skills.

syllabi.schedule:
Topic and Tentative Schedule: This class aims to have a balance between improving your professional speaking, writing, and grammar *in general* and providing you with particular vocabulary that will be useful to you. The units from American Headway, listed below, are advisory. I will assign additional homework in class. All listed assignments are due on the day they are listed. 

Course Introduction
Week 1: Unit One—American Headway: What makes us Human?
Please buy the American Headway 5 textbook before next week. Also, please make sure to have bought (and brought) your other class supplies. (See p. 1) Bring them each class each day.

Week 2: Unit One (cont.)
(As always, make sure to finish any listed assignments before you come to class.) 
Read “Why Clay Shirky Banned Laptops, Tablets and Phones from His Classroom” and do the related vocab homework (both are on MS Teams). Choose ten words from the vocabulary that you really want to learn and put a start next to them. Prepare, if time allows, “The Stages of Your Major” presentation.

Week 3: Unit One (cont.)
Present “The Stages of Your Major,” with costumes/props.

Week 4: First Reading/Viewing Groups (about something related to your major that you spend time on on your own—not in class) (Later presentations scheduled throughout the semester)

Week 5: Unit 2: In So Many Words (Accents and Grammar)

Week 6: Unit 2 (cont.)
Halloween Dialogs due

Week 7: Unit 3: Enough is Enough? (Sustainability) 

Week 8: Unit 3 (cont.)
Start-up company projects (in-class work).

Week 9: Midterm exam and Proficiency Test, Tuesday at 10:10 a.m. Please remember that you must bring your NTUT ID to the exam. Please remember that you cannot take the exam if you are more than twenty minutes late.

Week 10: Start-up company presentations 

Week 11: Start-up company interviews. 
Resume due. 
(An exam on units 1–3 may be given anytime between now and 12/7. I will keep you posted.) 

Week 12: Unit 4: Not All it Seems
Unit 4, cont./Sherlock Holmes/Deductions

Week 13: Unit 5 (Culture Clashes) and 6 (Fruits of War--things that have been designed during wars)

Week 14: Unit 5 continued/Unit 6: Fruits of War

Week 15: Unit 5/6 continued

Week 16: Start-up company interviews. 
Resume due. 

Week 17: Unit 5/6 continued and review

syllabi.outline: This course is designed for undergraduate students in the College of Electrical Engineering and Computer Science to develop their English language skills for specific academic and professional purposes. The curriculum focuses on topics relevant to electrical engineering and modern technology. Through a series of themed lessons, students will enhance their abilities in technical reading, vocabulary acquisition, and professional communication. Activities include reading articles, participating in group discussions, and completing practical writing assignments. The course aims to prepare students for success in English-medium coursework and future workplace environments.

syllabi.outline:
ECA 課程專為大一非英語母語的學生設計，加強英語語言技能，特別強調溝通能力和社會、文化、及專業實務應用。 通過整合四種語言技巧能力（閱讀、聽力、口語和寫作），將課堂英語文教學連結至與實務溝通情境之英語文使用。以下為課程設計及教學法之主軸：溝通語言教學（CLT）、任務型導向（TBL）和內容導向教學（CBI），培養學生的英語語言能力為進階專業英文之基礎。
The ECA courses are designed for the first-year (freshman), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English language skills, with particular emphasis on communicative competence and practical application in social, cultural and professional contexts. By integrating the four skills (reading, listening, speaking and writing), the primary objective is to connect the classroom ELT with the real-life communicative situations. To that end, the courses adopt the following approaches: communicative language teaching (CLT), task-based learning (TBL), and content-based instruction (CBI), building a holistic pedagogy to English instruction and developing students’ English language proficiency for the next level ESP courses.

name.zh: 品牌領導公司整合型產品開發

description.zh: 課程藉由公司的實務經驗，來協助同學了解業界實際的產品開發流程與公司運作實務，課程內容將包括市場定位、市場分析、產品規劃、產品設計、專案進行、製造、行銷、銷售、客戶服務等。本課程將提供同學對於產品開發過程與產品生命週期的全盤學習過程，同學亦可藉此了解一個跨國企業的實際運作情形。授課內容並搭配實案例的分享與專案演練，來引導學生結合學術理論基礎及業界實務操作，以協助同學未來於職場工作無縫銜接。
description.en: This lecture will try to help students learn more about technology product development and actual enterprise operating processes through Advantech's vast industrial experience which includes market research & analysis, product planning & design, manufacturing, and customer services. From this lecture students will not only get a better understanding of how a global enterprise operates, but also gain a clearer idea of how a newly developed product is developed by looking at its product life cycle. Practical cases will also be shared so as to describe and compare the methodology with the real experience. Through a better understanding of a global enterprise's operation, it is hoped this knowledge will enlighten participants and speed up their progress in their future career path.

description.zh:
本課程將以車輛之傳動系統設計與分析為主要內容，傳動系統之定義為從動力源至驅動輪間之各項組合，其中包括離合器、加力箱、變速箱、差速箱、傳動軸與最終傳動等組合，由於每種車輛行車特性之不同，因此前述之各項組合有不同之排列方式，傳動系統設計之優劣往往影響到車輛之行車性能。
本課程將從車輛行駛阻力推演出傳統系統設計之理念及方法，並針對如何發揮動力源之最佳特性，搭配良好之傳動系統設計以達到較佳之行車性能為主要教學之目的。
description.en: Introduction to the vehicle drive-train design and analysis. Topics include definition for drive-train system、clutches、transfer case、manual transmission、automatic transmission、differential gear、transmission shaft  and final driver.  Fundamentals of vehicle tractive resistance will deduce the methodology of drive-train design.  The good drive-train design will result in optimal vehicle tractive performance.

syllabi.schedule:
Research Methodology for the Cultural and Literary Studies
With Prof. Ju-ying Vinia Huang 
E-mail: vinia@mail.ntut.edu.tw

I.	Objective:
The purpose of this course is, first, to clarify key concepts in the understanding and interpretation of literary/cultural texts, and secondly, to demonstrate the ways in which important steps and maneuvers should be undertaken in order to compose a piece of promising academic writing. All the research and academic writing in this field follows MLA Style, which then becomes a focus of study and practice in this course.

II. Textbooks:  
(1) MLA HANDBOOK (9th edition, 2022) for MLA Style in academic writing
(2) The Little Seagull Handbook with Exercises (Norton 2021)
(3) Digitalized reading materials selected from our reference books 

III. Syllabus
1.Week One and Week Two:
(1) Introduction of MLA style for academic writing; preparation  and organization of class activities
(2) Reading of pieces of prose  to grasp the topic sentence, the main idea, the supporting details, the conclusion, and the right vocabulary. 
(3) Reading of a series of picture books by Leo Leonni to capture the main idea of each story and formulate its topic sentence

2. Week Three: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 1-21
Practicum of MLA style: (1) research question (2) main theme (3) outline (4) abstract (5) summary
3. Week Four: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 22-40
Practicum of MLA style: (1) argument and support (2) chapter arrangement (3) conclusion (4) citation and bibliography

The 1st task: the key words related to the structure of stories, including plot development, rising action, conflict, (anti)climax, and the turning point.
4. Week Five: MLA HANDBOOK, pp.41-61
(1) Three-act structure: Setup, conflict, and resolution
(2) The hero's journey: Departure, adventure, and return

The 2nd task: Forms of narrative
5. Week Six: MLA HANDBOOK, pp.62-81
(1) linear, nonlinear, and interactive
6. Week Seven: MLA HANDBOOK, pp.82-100
(2) foreshadow, flashback, and warped time/space 
 
The 3rd task: Modes of narration
7. Week Eight: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 101-20
(1) the first, second, and third person point of view
8. Week Nine: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 121-44
(2) omnipresent and limited point of view 

9. Week Nine (Midterm exam week)

The 4th task: Analyzing the narrator and main character
10. Week Ten: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 145-65
(1) reliable and unreliable narrators
11. Week Eleven: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 166-86
(2) tragic flaw, inner conflict, psyche, double
12. Week Twelve: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 187-207
(3) shadow, ego, superego

The 5th task: Interpreting Culture and ideology
13. Week Thirteen: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 208-26
(1) Dominant, recondite, and residual culture; cultural text and cultural practice; cultural hegemony; colonization
14. Week Fourteen: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 227-47
(2) class, race, gender, ethnicity, colonization, and ecological awareness

The 6th task: Writing on different genres of literature
15. Week Fifteen: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 248-69
(1) novel and prose
16. Week Sixteen: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 270-92
(2) poetry and drama

The 7th task: Writing on arts and multi-media texts
17. Week Seventeen: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 293-302
(1) painting and sculpture
18. Week Eighteen: MLA HANDBOOK, pp. 303-46
(2) TV drama and film 

IV. Percentile distribution of final grades
1.Presentations in the class: 20%
2.Final written report: 10 %
3.Participation in classroom discussion and attendance: 70%

V. Selections from the following reference books:
(1) A Glossary of Literary Terms by M.H.Abrams
(2) Critical Terms for Literary Study, eds. by Frank Lentricchia and Thomas McLaughlin
(3) The Literature Student's Survival Kit by Ian Littlewood
(4) On Writing Well: The Classic Guide to Writing Nonfiction by William Zinsser
(6) A Short Guide to Writing about Art by Sylvan Barnet

description.en: This course pinpoints on various aspects of landscape architecture from the 20th century onwards. Social, artistic, environmental, philosophical, and cultural viewpoints involved along the flow of contemporary landscape architecture are to be included. Contents consists of:   1 The germs, predecessors and trends of contemporary landscape architecture.   2 Contemporary interpret on landscape architecture.   3 Critics and Seminars on landscape architects and works of contemporary significance.
