description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

第十三週：群眾募資
第十四週：外賓分享（第二節）
第十五週：精采的創業說明會
第十六週：期末專題報告

description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh: 病毒可說是介於無生命和有生命之間的物質。它小至用光學顯微鏡看不見除非在電子顯微鏡下。儘管看不見卻無所不在，與人類關係異常密切。人類基因體約8%是從病毒來的。目前最難解決的傳染病問題也是由病毒引起。病毒結構看來似乎很簡單，但為了生存也進化出非凡的策略。人類從研究病毒得到非常多重要的知識和研究工具。讓我們能夠對分子、細胞和生物體的結構和功能得到更深地了解，進而對疾病問題得到解決。本課程將以深入簡出的方式讓同學認識病毒: 從病毒的起源，病毒如何進入宿主細胞與複製，並在宿主群體間存活和傳播所必須具備的機制。通過一系列較具代表性的人類病毒為例子進行介紹病毒複製的基礎、人類與病毒的相互作用以及如何導致疾病。同時認識人體4006的疫系統如何對抗病毒。了解為什麼新興病毒的出現並造成疫情。人類應如何應對。最後介紹兩種不尋常的傳染因子- 類病毒和狂牛病蛋白。它們與病毒似乎都是在生命起源中在化學演化時期殘留下來的分子。
description.en: This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host, and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

Virus is between life and no-life substances. It is Invisible to the naked eye unless under an electron microscope. However, virus is existed everywhere and has a very close relationship with humans. 8% of the human genome comes from viruses. At present, the most difficult to solve infectious disease problem is caused by virus. Although the structure and composition seems simple, virus has evolved an extraordinary strategy for survival. Virology enable us to insight the structure and function of molecules, cells, and organisms. From studying virus, people has gained a lot of important knowledge and research tools, which help people solving disease problems. This course will emphasize the mechanisms necessary for the virus to successfully enter and reproduce in the host cell, and survive and spread in the host population. Through a series of representative examples of human viruses, I will introduce the general basis of virus replication, the interaction between the virus and the host,and how these factors cause diseases and our immune system against virus. Finally, I will briefly introduce two unusual infectious agents- viroid and prion.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.schedule:
第一週：課程導論、欣賞音樂的角度與方法 
第二週：中世紀音樂 - 音樂織體、教會調式、大小調性、葛利果聖歌、複音聖歌
第三週：文藝復興時期音樂 - 複音音樂、模仿對位、對位法概論；Lute Song 介紹（Green Sleeves 欣賞)；巴洛克早期 - Monterverdi（歌劇的誕生 Orfeo）
第四週：巴洛克早期音樂 - Lully 作品（La Roi Danse 電影介紹）
第五週：巴洛克時期音樂 - Henry Purcell (Dido und Aneas 歌劇介紹）、Bach
第六週：巴洛克時期音樂 - Handel （Farinelli 電影介紹）
第七週：古典時期音樂 - 功能和聲概論、Haydn, 單主題奏鳴曲
第八週：Mozart、非原調再現的奏鳴曲式 (Amadeus 電影介紹）
第九週：期中報告
第十週：Beethoven、動機發展、奏鳴曲式之材料運用、
第十一週：浪漫樂派 - Schubert、Chopin（Chopin - Desire for Love 電影介紹)
第十二週：浪漫樂派 - Schumann、Brahms（Beloved Clara 電影介紹）
第十三週：浪漫樂派 - Liszt（Song without End 電影介紹）, Wagner、Puccini （La Boheme 歌劇介紹） 
第十四週：印象樂派 - Debussy, Ravel
第十五週：現代音樂 - Schoenberg, Webern, Berg、電子音樂、頻譜主義 
第十六週：美國當代音樂劇 - 百老匯名曲賞析、變身怪醫、版本比較
第十七週：跨界音樂作曲家、歌手、歌曲介紹 - 李泰祥、齊豫（古典、民歌）、Sara Brightmen、迪瑪希、鄭雲龍、阿云嘎 （音樂劇、古典、流行歌）Úyanga Bold、薩頂頂 （民族音樂、流行歌）。期末報告。
第十八週：期末報告
syllabi.assessment:
期中報告、期末報告（60%）、課堂參與（40%）

報告方式：8 分鐘的音樂作品解析口頭報告與書面報告（每組至多 5 人），包含「期中前期企劃報告」，以及「期末口頭與書面報告」，期中、期末皆需需製作投影片。報告的焦點可以包含：作曲家簡介、作品靈感來源或創作背景、作品的曲式、作品風格、樂器使用、個人心得、演奏版本比較、靜態或動態之音樂視覺化呈現（例如：https://youtu.be/71hNl_skTZQ) 等。

description.zh: 以攝影來進行社會介入的創作作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成在社會學領域中越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。本課程主要分為兩大部分，第一部分將從攝影史發展脈絡，來談攝影的社會使用，第二部分則是探討在當代藝術中，如何將攝影作為一種社會實踐的方式。除課堂講解和集體討論外，本課程也將透過實作討論同學的攝影計畫和作品，期使讓同學對於攝影，可以產生新的社會性思考，並開始進行影像與社會介入的嘗試。
description.en: In the field of contemporary art, photography has been developing into a way of social intervention. This trend also contributes to triggering more dialogues concerning “photography and society” in the discipline of sociology. The course mainly includes two parts: photography history and the photography as a social practice. In the first section, along with the history of photography, the social usages of photography will be introduced. In the second section, how photography art can be a social practice and what kinds of practice have been explored will be . In addition to class lectures and group discussions, the course requires all students to complete their individual photo project in the end of semester and their works will be presented in class.

description.zh: 本門課程旨在提供給尚未具有基礎統計基礎的學生，熟悉並能夠應用統計分析技術在解決現實世界中所出現的各種研究問題。課程的第一部份將從了解統計的基本概念開始，包括抽樣、樣本分配、集中位置量數、變異量數等統計上的意義，接著介紹變項尺度的性質以及如何選擇對應的統計模型。在學生了解統計的基本概念後，經由介紹T考驗、F考驗，以及相關係數等統計分析方法讓學生熟悉教育研究的情境。課程的第二部份以迴歸分析做為分析技術的主軸，本課程以計量經濟領域最常用的統計分析軟體作為工作環境，教授學生進行程式語言編程，利用現有的社會科學及教育領域數據資料庫，依照數據結構與研究問題的特性，選擇合適模型執行各項數據分析工作。課程的第三部份將介紹因素分析與集群分析等。讓學生得以更進一步認識除了行政數據之外，同時熟悉統計領域中潛在變項的觀念以及應用。完成本門課程的學生將能熟悉數據科學領域中主要與最新進的統計分析技術，並同時掌握透過編寫程式的方式執行數據分析的能力。
description.en:
This course aims to give students the opportunity to study statistics and its application on the field. The first section would introduce basic statistical concepts including sampling, distribution, measurement, among others. The second section would introduce regression methods. Students would also learn how to conduct data analysis using Statistics software, the most powerful software in econometrics. The third section would introduce multivariate statistics, including factor analysis and cluster analysis. In addition to handling administrative data, students would also learn the concept of latent variable and its application. 
After finishing this course, students would not only know the most advanced data analytics techniques but also have the ability to do programing for data analysis tasks.

本課程開設的目的即是因應我國教育部當前以循證治理作為提升整體教育品質改善學校運作效能的策略方針，積極培養跨領域的數據科學人才投入於包括教育領域的真實世界，藉由科學性與系統化分析我國各級學生學習上的弱點，集中有效資源進行適性輔導。本課程的課程目標之一：熟悉統計模型並能正確應用數據分析技術以提升我國學校教育品質。即是培養本校學生未來具備此項知識與技能。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
一、課程簡述：
民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，且因民法涉及所有私人間之財產關係（如買賣契約、贈與契約、租約等）及身份關係（如結婚、離婚、親子關係、繼承等），若另從時間軸來看，人從出生、活著到死亡，民法均參與其中，可說是最重要的法律之一。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。又民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
二、課程目標及授課方式：
?讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
?從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
?建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
?培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
?培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
?法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
?	上課時老師不會點名同學回答問題，不用擔心。但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論。
?因法律乃一門非常實用的學科，人的一生均會與法律產生關係，法律的學習對同學的人生應有相當的助益。
惟法律學難有生澀難懂之處，如前所述，老師會盡量以生動的案例（如新聞事件、歷史事件，以及老師打過的官司來進行教學），以提高同學的學習興趣。
故本課程對於法律有興趣者，或者過去對法律很陌生也沒關係，若聽過老的課而對法律產生興趣的話，都非常歡迎來修本門課。惟若僅抱持勉強應付的心態、只為取得學分的同學，請勿選修本堂課。
?同學均非法律本科，故老師不會吝於給分，最大的期望是同學能於本課堂上有所得！

This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

第三週：法律的種類：?公法與私法?普通法及特別法?實體法與程序法?強行法與任意法?固有法與繼受法?國內法與國際法。

description.zh: 本課程主要在介紹中華民國憲法、探討憲政體制的運作、人民權利義務的規範及相關法律的適用等問題。期能使學生認知國家民主法治的實施狀況，維護社會秩序與個人基本權利，進而體現人性尊嚴的價值。
description.en: This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

This course focuses the discussions on the Constitution of the Republic of China,constitutional mechanism, the rights and obligations for the people and legitimate operations of the society. It is our hope that the students may have a better understanding on how the democracy is performed in our country as well as on how to preserve social security and basic human rights of the individuals-with the realization of human dignity as our extreme goal.

syllabi.notes:
*課程對應SDGs指標：
本課程將涉及廣義的SDG 5：性別平等，SDG 10：減少不平等，以及SDG 16：和平與正義制度。
*指標對應授課內容：
在總論部分，第一～八週，著重在立憲主義的基本理解，其中，第六週～第七週的「現代憲法的基本特性」，以及第八週的「憲法與增修條文」，將涉及廣義的SDG 5：性別平等中的「通過多元管道對民眾傳播性別平等觀念」，SDG 10：減少不平等中的「強化性別平等、消除就業歧視」，以及SDG 16：和平與正義制度的核心目標「確保司法平等」。
在各論部分，第十～十五週，聚焦在人權保障的關鍵議題，其中，第十二週的「自由權的理論與實務」，將涉及廣義的SDG 16：和平與正義制度的核心目標「確保司法平等」；第十三週的「平等權的理論與實務」，將涉及廣義的SDG 5：性別平等中的「通過多元管道對民眾傳播性別平等觀念」，與SDG 10：減少不平等中的「強化性別平等」。
*本課程融入問題導向精神，著重師生互動，善誘學習動機，教學進程中將涉及憲法與人權相關議題之啟發思辨（Explanation）項目。

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 新創公司財務規劃良窳往往決定一家公司能否走得長遠，公司財務管理制度不健全導致週轉不靈倒閉的案例比比皆是，其中更是不乏資質良好的公司。本課程首先介紹創新商業模式，再教授創業應注意之基本知識，最後指導同學新創企業財務管理。

description.zh: 生態與環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解生態環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境污染問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Ecology and Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize its importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand the connection between our ecological environment and our living condition, the environmental pollution problems and their classification, the environmental problems in Taiwan, and the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems after the situation introduction.

植物與人類生活息息相關，人類選擇植物加以栽培生產，用來提供食、衣、行、及健康所需，而農耕的發達則與人類文化及社會的演變互相影響。本課程將由各種不同角度介紹，包括植物特性、栽培管理技術、自然環境、地理、人文、社會、政治、經濟等方面，與植物生產

Hope students can concern and respect the mutuality between plants and human.

description.zh:
所有人際圈都有倫理問題。家庭有家庭倫理，學校有學習倫理，在職場中則存在著職場倫理關係，有待個人學習理解、奉行。職場倫理是人與工作(生產)組織之間的關係，也可以?就是在職場中的人際關係，其牽涉幾個層面，包括正確的工作態度、正確的價值觀念以及正確的人際關係。
職場倫理牽涉到職場中個體或群體對於人際互動判定對錯是非的?為觀?，若不具備或不健全的職場倫理觀念將會導致職場人際圈秩序混亂或被破壞，引來觸犯法律規定底限之懲處不利後果。因此，企業懲戒法律案例形同職場倫理負面教材，可藉之推演人際互動規則、體會個案經驗，來思考合宜的人際往來互動的拿捏取捨。
職場倫理議題牽涉禮貌、法律與溝通技巧等多元問題面向。本課程除從理論面演繹職場倫理內涵，亦採企業懲戒個案探討方式，來協助學生習得適應融入職場生活所需之人際相處知識。
description.en: All kinds of relationship involve ethic issue. Ethic of workplace is the relationship between individuals and organizations, meaning a social relationship of workplace. It involves several aspects, including correct work attitudes, values, and personal relationships. Workplace ethic involves ideas individuals and groups hold in workplace to judge right or wrong about behavior. Without correct or sound ethic in workplace may result in chaos or destruction of order among social networks, or offend the legal baseline. Thus, enterprise punishment cases equal negative examples for workplace ethic. Workplace ethic involves topics of manners, laws and communication skills. This course provides not only theoretical perspective to reason nature of workplace ethic, but also raises cases of enterprise punishment for discussions to help students learn knowledge of interactions in workplace to adapt career life.

description.zh: 介紹日常生活中所經常遭遇到的案例使學生認識法律上之常識，培養學生珍惜法律上所賦予之權利，並及時行使庶免讓權利睡著了，致蒙受意外損害。並督促學生善盡法律上之責任，蔚為人人知法，人人守法的風尚，導致社會祥和。授課內容：按民法總則、債篇、物權、親屬、繼承各篇之順序，選擇與日常生活關係最密切之案例，逐一介紹，並對解決之道詳加說明。有觸及民間權益者，例如民間互助會，使用票據之常識，海峽兩岸婚姻，汽車肇事與保險責任及軍人及其家屬優待條例等均一併介紹。
description.en: This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.outline:
一、課程簡述：
民法乃所有法律修習的基礎，且因民法涉及所有私人間之財產關係（如買賣契約、贈與契約、租約等）及身份關係（如結婚、離婚、親子關係、繼承等），若另從時間軸來看，人從出生、活著到死亡，民法均參與其中，可說是最重要的法律之一。民法除了與每個人的生活息息相關，更是所有法律思維的出發點，是一門理論及實用兼俱的法律。又民法的體系龐大，正統法律系學生必需從大一開始修課，一直到大三、大四為止。本課程專為非法律系的同學所開設，期能在一個學期中，將整個民法體系有個全觀及實用的了解。
二、課程目標及授課方式：
?讓同學以鳥瞰的角度一窺整個民法法律的架構內容。
?從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來觀察民法面貌。
?建立法律學的嚴謹思維。
?培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
?培養同學面對生活法律問題的了解及解決能力。
?法律學是一門理論與實務並重的科學，本課程除了介紹民法的重要理論外，並相當側重實務案例及新聞時事法律的介紹與分析，分享老師數十年來法庭上的律師執業經驗，以提供同學參考。每堂課開始約會有十到二十分鐘針對當週的法律時事問題進行討論，以期能上課生動活潑，增加學習效果。
?	上課時老師不會點名同學回答問題，不用擔心。但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論。
?因法律乃一門非常實用的學科，人的一生均會與法律產生關係，法律的學習對同學的人生應有相當的助益。
惟法律學難有生澀難懂之處，如前所述，老師會盡量以生動的案例（如新聞事件、歷史事件，以及老師打過的官司來進行教學），以提高同學的學習興趣。
故本課程對於法律有興趣者，或者過去對法律很陌生也沒關係，若聽過老的課而對法律產生興趣的話，都非常歡迎來修本門課。惟若僅抱持勉強應付的心態、只為取得學分的同學，請勿選修本堂課。
?同學均非法律本科，故老師不會吝於給分，最大的期望是同學能於本課堂上有所得！

This course-through carefully examining individual cases that often happen-helps understand more about legal knowledge so that they would cherish their endowed rights and protect themselves from being hurt. This course also encourages the students to serve the duty of laws in the hope that "All People Know The Laws and All People Follow The Laws." Thecontents: Introduction to General Principles, Provisions of Obligations, Family and Succession. Cases that have much to do with the daily life are picked up for discussion. Other topics like the mutual self-help funds, the use of checks, cross-strait marriages, vehicle accidents, insurance, bonus regulations on the military servicemen and their family are also included.

syllabi.schedule:
第一週：導論：?民法課程基本介紹?學習本課程之態度?老師學經歷介紹。
第二週：民法之基本觀念：?什麼是法律/什麼是民法?現代民法的起源—民法的形成與發展?民法在整個法律體系中的位置?民法的繼受法性質。
第三週：法律的種類：?公法與私法?普通法及特別法?實體法與程序法?強行法與任意法?固有法與繼受法?國內法與國際法。
第四週：民法與其他法律的關係（1）：?民法與憲法（大法官會議解釋）?民法與刑法?民法與行政法/勞基法?民法與經濟法?民法與智慧財產權法/著作權法。
第五週：民法與其他法律間的關係（２）-案例分享
第六週：普通民法介紹：?民法總則?債篇總論?債篇各論?物權篇?親屬繼承篇。
第七週：特別民法介紹：?土地法?勞基法?公寓大廈管理條例?家庭暴力防治法?智慧財產權法。
第八週：民法與民事訴訟法。
第九週：證據法（1）-民法之證據法則與刑法證據法則之不同。
第十週：證據法（2）-實務證據法之運用-證據能力/證明力。
第十一週：期中考（應會用報告取代考試）。
第十二週：民法總則（1）-現在民法三大原則。
第十三週：民法總則（2）-兼論法律經濟學。
第十四週：債總篇（1）。
第十五週：債總篇（2）
第十六週：債篇各論。
第十七週：物權篇（1）
第十八週：物權篇（2）。
第十九週：親屬篇-結婚、離婚、親子關係。
第二十週：繼承篇-如何寫遺囑。

description.zh: 環境保護是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解環境與生活素質的關係，並了解環境問題的產生及其分類，再就台灣環境問題之所在分析其根源，最後了解台灣環境實施之現況後，並共同研究解決之道。
description.en: Introduction to Environmental Protection is a brand new issue of the 20th century; also, it is the biggest challenge of all human beings and our offspring. Because environmental protection is an international issue, everyone got to realize it's importance and take some action. This lesson is designed to help students understand: 1. the connection between our environment and our living condition; 2.the cause of environmental problems and their classification; 3.the cause of environmental problems in Taiwan; and 4.the solution to Taiwan's environmental problems.

syllabi.outline: 課程旨在讓學生了解環境問題的來源與影響，探索氣候變遷、能源使用、水資源管理及廢棄物處理等議題，並學習相關政策與技術如循環經濟、再生能源與綠色技術。課程涵蓋全球與在地環保議題，強調永續發展與企業社會責任，結合案例討論與分享，幫助學生培養環保意識與意願，成為面對永續未來的推動力量。

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline: 新創公司財務規劃良窳往往決定一家公司能否走得長遠，公司財務管理制度不健全導致週轉不靈倒閉的案例比比皆是，其中更是不乏資質良好的公司。本課程首先介紹創新商業模式，再教授創業應注意之基本知識，最後指導同學新創企業財務管理。

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

本課程，擬引領修課同學們徜徉古今愛情文學作品；內容含括詩、詞、散文、小說、戲曲、視聽影像等，並以主題單元方式進行之。從中，仔細咀嚼或清澀曖昧、或清新動人、或可歌可泣、或刻骨銘心、或纏綿悱惻、或黯然銷魂的愛情文學作品；從中，與作品中所傳達的心情、心事、心聲產生共鳴，由此來發現：在塵世的繁華裡，情感的傳遞是沒有時空隔閡，是可以心心相映。
鑑於修課同學正值青春年華、正將展翅翱翔，因此本課程除了鑑賞、品味古今愛情文學作品，並欲與吾人現實人生作一連結，由此思考愛情、婚姻、兩性、家國、社會、政治等議題，由此尋求愛情的本質與真諦。

syllabi.schedule:
1.Intro_當我們談論愛情，我們在談論什麼？——瑞蒙．卡佛，〈新手〉
2.「生無悔，死無懼，不需經濟基礎，對離異無挫折感」——徵婚（/友）啟事書寫與討論 （閱讀：陳玉慧，《徵婚啟事》）
3. 理想的相遇、場景與對話——村上春樹，〈遇見100%女孩〉
4. 教師節補假
5. 中秋節
6. AI能幫我們找到真愛嗎？——劉宇昆，〈完美配對〉
7.「在靈魂黝黑的深夜，時時刻刻都是凌晨三點」——暈王能有多暈，海后能有多海？（費茲傑羅，〈冬之夢〉）
8.「你是不會看見過的」——冰山之下的情感風暴（海明威，〈白象般的群山〉、〈雨中的貓〉）
9. 期中考週
10. 那些無疾而終或前途未卜的愛情——契訶夫，〈小玩笑〉、〈某某小姐的故事〉、〈帶小狗的女士〉）
11.「生在這世上，沒有一樣感情不是千瘡百孔的」——俗世的愛情（閱讀：張愛玲，〈留情〉、〈傾城之戀〉）
12.感情中的「輸家」與「贏家」——決絕的愛情與現實的愛情（閱讀：蘇偉貞，〈陪她一段〉；蔣曉雲，〈掉傘天〉 ）
13.「火車一定要在這裡轉一個彎」——愛情作為一種成長體驗（閱讀：吳明益，〈強尼．河流們〉、〈金魚〉 ）
14. 壞掉的血——另類的愛情（一）（閱讀：胡淑雯 〈墮胎者〉、〈與男友的前女友密談〉 ）
15. 「生為冰山，就該淡淡地愛海流、愛風，並且在偶然接觸時，全心全意地愛另一塊冰山」——另類的愛情（二）（閱讀：王小波 〈柔情似水〉 ）
16. 期末主題寫作A：愛情的樣子（閱讀：毛尖，〈一寸灰〉）
17. 期末主題寫作B：暗戀與錯過（閱讀：蘇美，〈暗戀〉、柯裕棻，〈流雲〉）
18. 綜合討論

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

description.zh: 歷史相關研究蓬勃發展迄今，不論是史料或新舊的研究著作重新被重視、翻譯與詮釋，這些可稱之為史學著作的經典。這些書籍既有趣味又有意義，捧而讀之，中西歷史、古往今來的風物民情、地貌變遷等流轉仿彿躍於紙上。本課程將介紹這些經典的、趣味的、有意義的歷史名著，藉由數本好書，進而瞭解人類的歷史。
description.en: Since the study of the history has been in prosperity, a large number of historical texts have been newly translated and interpreted, thus gaining more importance. These texts can be categorized as classical volumes of history . There have been existent a lot of other written resources interesting and meaningful exhibiting the vivid image of the people, geography, folk stories and the transition of time available in history. This course focuses on these particular materials concerning the human history through the discussion of which, the history of mankind can be better understood.

syllabi.outline:
課程概述：
本課程以台灣酒業發展史為主軸，兼述同時代的主要釀酒物產及消費文化，歷史背景參閱張炎憲教授策劃《典藏台灣史》7冊，該套書以台灣主體性前提全面性論述史前到當代台灣。
This course traces the historical development of Taiwan’s liquor industry, while also exploring contemporaneous brewing products and consumer culture.

漢人移民台灣四百年，台灣酒業形成迄今不過百年。從農村副業成長為民間新興產業，1922年被收編為國家專賣事業，2002年又從國家專賣事業回歸到民間自由產銷。開放短短幾十年間，民間酒莊如雨後春筍般林立，各國進口酒類口味豐富多樣。本課程以台灣酒業發展史為主軸，兼述同時代的主要釀酒物產及消費文化，歷史背景參閱張炎憲教授策劃《典藏台灣史》7冊，該套書以台灣主體性前提全面性論述史前到當代台灣。本課程希望啟發學生深入瞭解並思考不同面向的台灣史，關懷當代農業物產與社會飲食文化的歷史脈絡。
Han Chinese migration to Taiwan have been over four centries, the history of Taiwan’s liquor industry spans barely a hundred years.  Evolving from a rural sideline business into a burgeoning private industry, it was incorporated into the state monopoly system in 1922, then return to free production and distribution in 2002.  Within just a few decades of liberalization, local wineries flourished boomingly, while imported liquors from around the world added to the diversity of tastes.  This course traces the historical development of Taiwan’s liquor industry, while also exploring contemporaneous brewing products and consumer culture. Participants are encouraged to gain a deeper understanding of the historical trajectory of Taiwan’s liquor production across different periods, and to reflect on contemporary agricultural products and food-and-drink culture in our society.

description.zh: 這e世紀時代的資訊交流是一個廣泛、多樣化與複雜的；究竟人們如何透過溝通表達意識與行為，卻變成非常重要。有效的溝通程度常視為學習溝通的指標，須視事實、竟見、感覺、嗜好和經驗進行徹底地交融與分享的結果。因此，本課程重視現代社會學習「溝通管理」的二項關鍵技術包括：有效溝通結合自我學習技巧和方法：商業知識與科技結合促成人的系統互動能力，配合多媒體傳輸工具完成學習個人與團體溝通效益。課程涵概主題:1.溝通管理定義與本質元素。2.溝通管理內涵分析。3.學習個人溝通能力。4.學習溝通程序。5.e化自我學習技巧、方法與表達能力。6.學習全球化溝通科技工具。7.團隊溝通的策略與協同戰術。8.塑造整體溝通文化。
description.en: The information exchange is wide, variety, and complicated in the e-era; how do people express their consciousness and behavior turn to become very important. Effective communication degrees usually are seen as the index of learning communication. It depends on thoroughly melting and sharing with fact, opinion, feeling, interesting and experience. Therefore, "Communication Management," in this course we emphasize on two key techniques of modern society learning including: effective communication with self-learning skill and method; Business knowledge and technology with interactive ability of human system. By using multimedia transmitting tools to complete self and group learning communication and get benefit.

syllabi.outline:
本課程結合理論講授與實務操作，旨在幫助學生掌握生成式AI應用與人工智慧程式實作的核心技能，培養AI技術在行銷與創意領域的應用能力。

課程分為兩大部分：首先聚焦生成式AI應用，學生將學習使用多種AI工具（如Vidu、Sora、Kling、Suno等）製作100秒AI微電影，涵蓋AI繪圖、影片生成、音樂創作、語音生成與影片剪輯技術，探索AI如何提升創意內容製作效率與品質。中期課程將完成一部100秒AI微電影作為期中作業，強化實務能力。

後段課程導入人工智慧入門程式實作，使用Python進行機器學習實作，涵蓋基礎模型（線性迴歸、邏輯迴歸、KNN）與進階應用（決策樹、隨機森林、SVM、分群分析、PCA、類神經網路），讓學生掌握AI模型的建構與應用。

本課程強調實務操作與技術整合，學生將熟悉AI工具應用與程式實作的完整流程，為未來進入AI行銷、創意製作與資料分析領域奠定基礎。

This course combines theoretical teaching with hands-on practice to help students master generative AI applications and AI programming skills, fostering their ability to apply AI in marketing and creative fields.

It is divided into two parts: the first focuses on generative AI, where students will use tools like Vidu, Sora, Kling, and Suno to create a 100-second AI micro-film, covering AI drawing, video generation, music creation, voice synthesis, and video editing, exploring how AI enhances creative production efficiency and quality. A 100-second AI micro-film will be completed as a midterm project to strengthen practical skills.

The latter part introduces AI programming basics using Python, covering machine learning models (linear regression, logistic regression, KNN) and advanced applications (decision trees, random forests, SVM, clustering, PCA, neural networks), enabling students to build and apply AI models.

The course emphasizes practical skills and technology integration, equipping students with a full workflow of AI tool usage and programming for future careers in AI marketing, creative production, and data analysis.

description.zh: 本課程是為非專業學生所設計的哲學概論，介紹西洋哲學的起源、西洋哲學的問題，以及哲學與人生的關係。哲學的問題意識起自人類的自覺，人類意圖認識自己，為宇宙人生尋求解答，哲學的發生本自人類天賦的求知欲，即其本性中對於智慧的追求與愛慕。這種愛慕智慧的精神是希臘文明留給西方世界的遺產，對於知識能持客觀批判的精神，對於真理能存認真熱切的態度，對於人生能有超克苦難的修持。在國際化的世代，我們對西方的認識應更深入其精神層面，此乃本課程規劃的初衷。
description.en: This course is designed for student who is not disciplined in philosophy. As an introduction, we begin at the origin of western philosophy, the philosophical questions and finally, the relationship of human life and philosophy. Philosophy takes place when human being thinking of himself. Man by nature desire to know himself as well as the external world. And due to this love of wisdom, men can be critical to knowledge and be passionate toward truth. Eventually, grasping the sprit of western philosophy , we can view our life in quite a different view. In our time, facing the world of international, we should better understand the western culture, which is rooted in philosophy.

description.zh: 鋼琴擁有寬廣的音域，無論獨奏或合奏，鋼琴都能恰如其分地奏出悠揚音樂。這門課程將介紹鋼琴的起源與構造、各個時代的經典鋼琴作品與著名的鋼琴家，並且讓同學體驗彈奏鋼琴短曲的樂趣。期許能透過欣賞與實作，讓同學更深刻地理解鋼琴音樂之美，培養終身的興趣。
description.en: The piano possesses a broad tonal range, and whether in a solo or ensemble context, it adeptly delivers enchanting music. This course will provide an introduction to the piano's origins and construction, classic piano compositions spanning different periods, and celebrated pianists. Moreover, it will afford students the opportunity to relish the pleasure of playing short piano pieces. By engaging in both appreciation and hands-on practice, students are anticipated to enhance their comprehension of the beauty of piano music and develop a lifelong interest.

description.zh: 歷史相關研究蓬勃發展迄今，不論是史料或新舊的研究著作重新被重視、翻譯與詮釋，這些可稱之為史學著作的經典。這些書籍既有趣味又有意義，捧而讀之，中西歷史、古往今來的風物民情、地貌變遷等流轉仿彿躍於紙上。本課程將介紹這些經典的、趣味的、有意義的歷史名著，藉由數本好書，進而瞭解人類的歷史。

syllabi.outline:
課程概述：
本課程以台灣酒業發展史為主軸，兼述同時代的主要釀酒物產及消費文化，歷史背景參閱張炎憲教授策劃《典藏台灣史》7冊，該套書以台灣主體性前提全面性論述史前到當代台灣。
This course traces the historical development of Taiwan’s liquor industry, while also exploring contemporaneous brewing products and consumer culture.

漢人移民台灣四百年，台灣酒業形成迄今不過百年。從農村副業成長為民間新興產業，1922年被收編為國家專賣事業，2002年又從國家專賣事業回歸到民間自由產銷。開放短短幾十年間，民間酒莊如雨後春筍般林立，各國進口酒類口味豐富多樣。本課程以台灣酒業發展史為主軸，兼述同時代的主要釀酒物產及消費文化，歷史背景參閱張炎憲教授策劃《典藏台灣史》7冊，該套書以台灣主體性前提全面性論述史前到當代台灣。本課程希望啟發學生深入瞭解並思考不同面向的台灣史，關懷當代農業物產與社會飲食文化的歷史脈絡。
Han Chinese migration to Taiwan have been over four centries, the history of Taiwan’s liquor industry spans barely a hundred years.  Evolving from a rural sideline business into a burgeoning private industry, it was incorporated into the state monopoly system in 1922, then return to free production and distribution in 2002.  Within just a few decades of liberalization, local wineries flourished boomingly, while imported liquors from around the world added to the diversity of tastes.  This course traces the historical development of Taiwan’s liquor industry, while also exploring contemporaneous brewing products and consumer culture. Participants are encouraged to gain a deeper understanding of the historical trajectory of Taiwan’s liquor production across different periods, and to reflect on contemporary agricultural products and food-and-drink culture in our society.

description.zh: 這e世紀時代的資訊交流是一個廣泛、多樣化與複雜的；究竟人們如何透過溝通表達意識與行為，卻變成非常重要。有效的溝通程度常視為學習溝通的指標，須視事實、竟見、感覺、嗜好和經驗進行徹底地交融與分享的結果。因此，本課程重視現代社會學習「溝通管理」的二項關鍵技術包括：有效溝通結合自我學習技巧和方法：商業知識與科技結合促成人的系統互動能力，配合多媒體傳輸工具完成學習個人與團體溝通效益。課程涵概主題:1.溝通管理定義與本質元素。2.溝通管理內涵分析。3.學習個人溝通能力。4.學習溝通程序。5.e化自我學習技巧、方法與表達能力。6.學習全球化溝通科技工具。7.團隊溝通的策略與協同戰術。8.塑造整體溝通文化。
description.en: The information exchange is wide, variety, and complicated in the e-era; how do people express their consciousness and behavior turn to become very important. Therefore, "Communication Management," in this course we emphasize on two key techniques of modern society learning including: effective communication with self-learning skill and method; Business knowledge and technology with interactive ability of human system. By using multimedia transmitting tools to complete self and group learning communication and get benefit.

description.zh: 資訊法律課程將讓同學了解網路資訊社會中各層面的相關法律議題。本課程內容著重於各種網路法律問題，例如資訊安全、網路契約的訂定、網域名稱、數位化著作權、商標權，隱私權以及電腦犯罪種類及防治的介紹。另外，本課程也以個案方式，敘述電腦資訊的相關法律問題，並從中了解虛擬世界與現實世界的法律規範，同時測試自己是否具備足夠的資訊法律知識，能夠在快速變遷的資訊社會中立足與發展。
description.en: The course of Information Laws is designed for the students to familiarize such legal issues in most of the aspects available in the current world as information security, internet contracts, domain names, digital copy rights, trademark ownership, individual privacy and the genre & prevention in relation to computers. In addition, we discuss individual cases to further understand the nature of legal issues concerning computerized information. Hopefully, we learn the legal disciplines existent in the virtual and real worlds; besides, the students are supposed to equip themselves with sufficient legal knowledge so that they can survive and thus keep growing in the ever-changing information society.

syllabi.outline:
膳食是生活上一件非常重要的事， 所謂「 You are what you eat.」，「今日的飲食造就明日的細胞組成」，都明白闡述出飲食習慣對個人健康具有直接的影響力。現代人生活上還面臨著各項挑戰，例如我們經常要面對各式各樣的壓力，以及生活環境遭受污染充斥著各種毒素等問題，因此我們必須先瞭解如何避食品毒物，再藉由選擇正確的食物與良好的飲食習慣來維持身體的健康。
本課程前半部先探討近期台灣近期發生的食品安全事件，藉由事件來瞭解如何避開毒物；後半部介紹食物內各種營養素的功能，再進一步探討如何選擇有益的食物來調整身體機能，並促進健康。

description.zh: 本課程是教授學生人工智慧的基本概念與應用，激發學生在人工智慧領域的創新應用。課程內容包括: 人工智慧基礎、機器學習、大數據技術、深度學習、生成對抗網路、創業家思維、設計思考、商業模式、人工智慧與現代科技、人工智慧的製造業應用、人工智慧的服務業應用。

syllabi.outline:
本課程結合理論講授與實務操作，旨在幫助學生掌握生成式AI應用與人工智慧程式實作的核心技能，培養AI技術在行銷與創意領域的應用能力。

課程分為兩大部分：首先聚焦生成式AI應用，學生將學習使用多種AI工具（如Vidu、Sora、Kling、Suno等）製作100秒AI微電影，涵蓋AI繪圖、影片生成、音樂創作、語音生成與影片剪輯技術，探索AI如何提升創意內容製作效率與品質。中期課程將完成一部100秒AI微電影作為期中作業，強化實務能力。

後段課程導入人工智慧入門程式實作，使用Python進行機器學習實作，涵蓋基礎模型（線性迴歸、邏輯迴歸、KNN）與進階應用（決策樹、隨機森林、SVM、分群分析、PCA、類神經網路），讓學生掌握AI模型的建構與應用。

本課程強調實務操作與技術整合，學生將熟悉AI工具應用與程式實作的完整流程，為未來進入AI行銷、創意製作與資料分析領域奠定基礎。

This course combines theoretical teaching with hands-on practice to help students master generative AI applications and AI programming skills, fostering their ability to apply AI in marketing and creative fields.

It is divided into two parts: the first focuses on generative AI, where students will use tools like Vidu, Sora, Kling, and Suno to create a 100-second AI micro-film, covering AI drawing, video generation, music creation, voice synthesis, and video editing, exploring how AI enhances creative production efficiency and quality. A 100-second AI micro-film will be completed as a midterm project to strengthen practical skills.

The latter part introduces AI programming basics using Python, covering machine learning models (linear regression, logistic regression, KNN) and advanced applications (decision trees, random forests, SVM, clustering, PCA, neural networks), enabling students to build and apply AI models.

The course emphasizes practical skills and technology integration, equipping students with a full workflow of AI tool usage and programming for future careers in AI marketing, creative production, and data analysis.

description.zh:
本課程首先說明人在宇宙中的定位、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與天地萬物和諧相處和真愛的永不止息。
課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類共同的智慧，並安排數次的校外教學，以深入瞭解社會脈動，並運用多媒體影片教學以提升學習效果，學生每天做身心觀察學習紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。
description.en:
This course covers topics such as: the role of human beings in the universe, the dearness of life and the pursuit of life-long goals. We then discuss ways to train the students to become brave and to harmonize human beings with the nature, leading to an access to the discovery of true love.
The course is realized through activity involvement, experience sharing and lectures on human wisdom. We have some extramural visits in order to understand social pulses. Multimedia teaching materials are fully utilized to enhance the teaching and learning effects. We request that all the students take note of their mental and physical improvements on a daily basis so that they could examine the progressive path of life.

syllabi.outline:
本課程以「生命」為主軸，包含自我探索、人際互動、生死價值，共三方面主題，藉由全面性的探討與體驗式的學習，引領學生接近生命的內在本質、探索生命的存在價值，以建立了解生命、尊重生命、體驗生命、珍惜生命、熱愛生命的觀念與態度，展開符合自他期待的人生與品格。期待能夠在以下三方面引導同學：
1.情意：探索生命、建立正確的人生態度，找到自我的定位與價值，能夠熱愛自己的生命，也尊重其他的生命，並與其他生命建立良好互動。
2.認知：了解「自我」的不同面向，以及「生死」的意義與價值。
3.技能：熟悉人生主要問題的解決途徑，以及尋求支援的方法與管道，進而培養獨立思考、克服困難的資糧與能力。

description.zh:
法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。
有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
description.en: Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta."  Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law.  This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion.  Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.

法學概論，顧名思義是在介紹法律原理，以啟發學生法學研究的興趣。然而，法學涵蓋的層面甚廣，法學緒論的課程，只能大略介紹各種法律的共通原理，就繁駁的法律現象，作綜合的引說，俾使初學法律的人，不僅能粗知「實定法」的共通原則，還可藉此原則來培養法律見解和修養，執簡馭繁，因而體會法律的性質、內涵和理念。
有關本課程的教授方式，擬先介紹法律的基概念及原理，並以答問之方式訓練學生邏輯反思的能力，同時輔以日常屢見之法律實例問題。如此，學生不僅可以可以學習正確的法律觀念和知識，並可培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，以達保障並維護自己及他人權益之目的。
二、課程目標及授課方式：
?	期能讓同學以鳥瞰的解度一窺整個法律的架構內容。
?	從哲學、科學、歷史學、倫理學、心理學、社會規範等角度來看穿法律的面貌。
?	建立法律學的嚴謹思維，避落入新聞式反射性的淺層粗糙判斷。
?	培養現代法治社會的公民基本法律素養。
?	建立同學生活法律問題的解決能力。
?	法律為一個理論與實務並重的科學，僅專注理論而忽略實務，如鳥無雙翼，缺少實用性，則法律的功效實難發生。老師為實務律師出身，故在介紹理論之外，也會側重實務案例的介紹分析，每堂課開始約會有十到三十分鐘針對當周的法律時事問題及律師執業經驗，從法學緒論的角度切入，在課堂上討論，以收學習之功效。
?	上課時老師不會點名同學回答問題，不用擔心。但本課程非常鼓勵同學上課發問及互動討論。
?	因法律乃一門非常實用的學科，人的一生均會與法律產生關係，法律的學習對同學的人生應有相當的助益。
惟法律學難有生澀難懂之處，老師會盡量以生動的案例（如新聞事件、歷史事件，以及老師打過的官司來進行教學），以提高同學的學習興趣。
故本課程對於法律有興趣者，或者過去對法律很陌生也沒關係，若聽過老的課而對法律產生興趣的話，都非常歡迎來修本門課。惟若僅抱持勉強應付的心態、只為取得學分的同學，請勿選修本堂課。
?	同學均非法律本科，故老師不會吝於給分，最大的期望是同學能於本課堂上有所得！

Introduction of Law is to introduce the theory of law and to promote students' interest to study law. Since the field of law is very broad but the time is limited, this course can briefly explain common principles of law, complex phenomena of law, etc. The main purpose of this course is to let students catch the concept of common principles of "lex scripta."  Also, this course aims to promote students' knowledge about law, thus cultivating their spirit of abiding by law.  This course will introduce the basic concept and theory of law first. Then students will be given logical training through discussion.  Besides, the general cases and problems of law will be covered as well. Through this course, students can not only get correct concepts of law, but learn to protect their/others' right.
syllabi.schedule:
（一）	第一週 導論：?課程基本介紹?學習本課程之態度?老師經歷介紹。
（二）	第二週 法學之基本觀念：?法律是什麼？法律的形成與發展?為何要遵守法律？要求我們遵守法律的依據是什麼？是不是有某些法律可以不遵守？
（三）	第三週 法律與其他學科間的關係：?法律與歷史學?法律與哲學?法律與倫理學?法律與心理學?法律與政治經濟的關係。
（四）	第四週 我國法律形式上之整體介紹：?憲法?刑法?民法?勞動法?二性平等法律?經濟法與智慧財產權法。
（五）	第五週 我國法律體系的介紹：法律的金字塔。
（六）	第六週 法律的種類?公法與私法?普通法及特別法?實體法與程序法?強行法與任意法?固有法與繼受法?國內法與國際法。
（七）	第七週 法律的適用與解釋。
（八）	第八週 法律的制定、公佈、修正與廢止。
（九）	第九週 期中考（應會用報告取代考試）。
（十）	第十週 憲法與大法官會議解釋。
(十一)第十一週 行政法與刑法、刑事訴訟法（一）。
(十二)第十二週 行政法與刑法、刑事訴訟法（二）--案例介紹：何謂罪刑法定主義？何謂嚴格的證明法則？何謂毒樹的果實理論？測謊可不可以當做刑事之證據等等議題之討論。
(十三)第十三週 民法與民法特別法（一）。
(十四)第十四週 民法與民法特別法（二）--案例介紹：交通事故、借貸、租賃、投資、網路上的相關法律問題。
(十五)第十五週 性別平等法律。
(十六)第十六週 經濟法律介紹。
(十七)第十七週：智慧財產法律（一）專利法、商標法。
(十八)第十八週：智慧財產法律（二）著作權法、營業秘密法。

description.zh:
過去研究人類行為多聚焦在人類的缺陷和問題，包括攻擊性、精神疾病、非常態行為等。正向心理學開始集中在研究如何使人變得更快樂，以及生命的意義。
正向心理學的主要目標是強化人類的優勢，例如創造力、開心、心流，以及樂觀。我們應學習讓生活更正向，因為快樂會帶來更多好的工作與學業表現、社會關係，亦會使我們更長壽與健康。
description.en:
Most study of human behavior has focused mainly on what goes wrong in human affairs: aggression, mental disease, abnormal behavior, and so on. Positive psychology is centered on helping people become happier and making life most worth living.
Positive Psychology aims at enhancing human strengths such as creativity, joy, flow, and optimal performance. People have to learn how to make life more positive, because happiness leads to desirable outcomes at school and work, to fulfilling social relationships, and even to good health and long life.

description.zh: 本課程名稱為 “環境與自然保育” 。它包括二大範疇：(1)自然環境和自然資源的保育，(2)自然環境的保存、維護、利用、復原及改良。它將教導學生下列主題：自然保育的基本概念（自然保育的定義、自然保育觀念的發展）、保育生物學（物種形成和滅絕、生物多樣性、物種保護的優先原則、生物入侵）、生態經濟學簡介（生態經濟學的原則、能量流與物質流分析）、自然保護區（自然保護區之概念、自然保護區的保護對象）、自然保育政策（國際自然保育策略、台灣的自然保育機構及相關法規）與自然保育運動（自然保育運動之發展、當前自然保育運動所關心的事）。整體而言, 本課程期盼提升公民生態意識和環境覺知, 使大家對環境保育做出更多貢獻。
description.en: The title of this course is “Environment and Nature Conservation”. It includes two categories: (1) conservation of the natural environment and natural resources, and (2) the preservation, maintenance, restoration and improvement of the natural environment. It will introduce to students the following themes: basic concepts of nature conservation, conservation biology, introduction to ecological economics, nature reservation, nature conservation policy, and nature conservation movement. As a whole, it aims to raise our citizens’ ecological consciousness and environmental awareness and thus enable them to make more contribution to the conservation of our environment.

syllabi.outline: 生態與自然保育是廿世紀的新課題，也是人類目前及未來所面臨的最大考驗。因為環境問題是超越國界的，因此環境的保護是每個人都必須瞭解的，也是每個人應盡的責任。本課程首先在了解自然資源管理的架構，從而掌屋自然保育與生活品質的關係，再就台灣自然資源與環境管理問題，探究分析其根源，最後以自身潛力與未來方向為基礎，發想共同之願景。

name.en: Start to APP Design and Application

description.zh:
學習相似於Microsoft Power Point 的「拖-拉-點-選」操作方式，再加上一小部份的 Low Code程式編碼，即可以設計與製作出:「專業級的 APP」 !
本課程運用學校內的雲端平台: AgilePoint NX，改變了以往撰寫APP 的模式，不再需要撰寫複雜的程式碼，讓學生專注於 APP的邏輯流程與UI(使用者介面)，進而發展貼近市場裡的商業模式，設計出精彩的APP!
課程的教學，採用傳統臺北工專的黑手工程師訓練模式:
「由經入史」:先講解理論架構，進而延伸到產業的實務運用。
嚴格要求上課同學動手實做，達成每週的設定目標。課堂上講師所示範的範例非常豐富，下課後會有一定份量的Homework(實作型作業)。
經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。
「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
description.en: Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

經此系統化訓練，在APP的設計與製作上，將擁有踏實的內涵與技術，增強在校學生，未來在職場上的競爭力。
「讓不懂IT(資訊工程)、非理工背景的學生，更能設計出高人氣的APP! 」
Learn the "Click and Drag" operation method, as like Microsoft Power Point, and adds some Low-Code, you can design and create: "Professional APP"!This course uses the cloud platform in the school: AgilePoint NX, which changes the mode of writing APP in the past, no longer needs to write complex code, let students focus on the logic flow of the APP and UI (user interface), and then close to the market requirement. This course uses the Taipei Tech Practical-Engineer training method:"From Theory to Practical": First explain the theoretical structure, and then extend to the practical application of the industry. Through this systematic training, in the design and production of APP, we will have practical connotation and technology to enhance the competitiveness of students in college and the future in the workplace."Let students who don't understand IT (information engineering) and non-technical backgrounds can design great and popular APPs!"

description.zh: 「社會心理學」主要探討的重點在於日常生活，社會刺激以及情境如何影響個人行為，它需要經過科學的方法進行研究，藉以預測一個人在某種情境下，可能會出現哪些行為。其涉及的學科相當廣泛，除了一般心理學的理論之外，尚包含社會科學哲學、文化人類學、倫理學、環境心理學、團體動力學等相關論述。課程強調理論與實務結合，提升學生參與社會的知能。
description.en: Social Psychology is focus on social stimuli and how situations affect individual behavior everyday life. In order to predict a person’s behavior in a situation, we need to research by scientific methods.  It covers a wide range of professional areas, not only the theories of social psychology but also philosophy of social science, cultural anthropology, ethics, environmental psychology, group dynamics. This course emphasizes the combination of theory and practice to enhance students’ abilities to participate in society.

syllabi.outline:
「社會心理學」主要探討的重點在於日常生活，社會群體刺激以及情境如何影響個人的認知, 態度及行為，它需要經過科學的方法進行研究，藉以預測一個人在某種情境下，可能會出現哪些行為。社會心理學主要是從社會學，群體的角度，探討個人的態度與行為如何受到社會價值以及群體的影響。該課程強調理論與實務結合，提供日常生活以及新聞案例，提升學生參與社會的知能。
Social psychology investigates how social stimulus and social environment affect people’s cognition, attitudes, and behavior. It requires scientific methods to research what people act in certain conditions. Social psychology takes sociological perspective to investigate how individuals’ attitudes and behavior affected by social values and group. The course emphasizes theories and practices, and provides news and events in daily life as examples to enhance students’ social participation.

description.zh:
過去研究人類行為多聚焦在人類的缺陷和問題，包括攻擊性、精神疾病、非常態行為等。正向心理學開始集中在研究如何使人變得更快樂，以及生命的意義。
正向心理學的主要目標是強化人類的優勢，例如創造力、開心、心流，以及樂觀。我們應學習讓生活更正向，因為快樂會帶來更多好的工作與學業表現、社會關係，亦會使我們更長壽與健康。
description.en:
Most study of human behavior has focused mainly on what goes wrong in human affairs: aggression, mental disease, abnormal behavior, and so on. Positive psychology is centered on helping people become happier and making life most worth living.
Positive Psychology aims at enhancing human strengths such as creativity, joy, flow, and optimal performance. People have to learn how to make life more positive, because happiness leads to desirable outcomes at school and work, to fulfilling social relationships, and even to good health and long life.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 影視史學已成為史學新理論，它是一門歷史詮釋學術，涉及歷史真相能否透過影像重現或還原。歷史劇與歷史電影成為學生或公眾歷史知識的來源，但其中與史實之間仍存在一定之落差，近代書寫歷史與影視史學成為傳達史實重要媒介之一與歷史文本的呈現，及其所反應的背後時代因素、主觀意識、當代主流價值觀，或「集體記憶」，或對歷史的主觀認知。本課程希望透過影視歷史文本與已知的、文字的書寫歷史文本相互比對、討論，來釐清史實與影像的虛實。
description.en:
Film and television history has become a new theory in historiography; it is a discipline of historical interpretation that involves whether historical truths can be reproduced or restored through images. 
Historical dramas and films have become sources of historical knowledge for students and the public, but there remains a certain gap between these representations and historical facts.
The modern writing of history and the role of film and television history as one of the important mediums for conveying historical facts and presenting historical texts, as well as the underlying factors of the era, the subjective consciousness , contemporary mainstream meanings, values, or "collective memory," or subjective perceptions of history. Therefore, written, oral, and visual forms can all serve as tools for conveying and understanding historical texts, and must be discussed within the context of the current historical background. description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

syllabi.outline:
課程結構與規劃：以藝術欣賞的形式為課程的主要架構，.內容包括中西名家繪畫與藝術品欣賞、中國文字之美、台灣美術欣賞、台灣生態、原住民藝術，建築與雕塑之美及國際性的藝術博覽會，如義大利威尼斯雙年展(La Biennale di Venezia)，香港的Art  Basel 等。課程內容規劃結合藝術欣賞與藝術概論，並融合藝術與生活、藝術與社會、藝術與歷史、藝術與宗教、藝術與人文關懷、藝術與設計和藝術與生態環境之間的交相連結所造成的多元關係。
課程目標與期許：
培養敏銳的觀察力及繪畫欣賞的素養和對藝術的喜愛及推廣；藉由報告及校外參觀的形式，提供「在旅行中發現文化、在旅行中發現藝術」的學習機會，親身經歷及探尋週遭的在地文化，認識和欣賞是關心和行動的開始，啟發關懷社會、關懷自然環境、愛鄉、愛國之情操。藝術不惟形而上只是少數人的範疇，應該走入社會、大眾化、生活化，並有啟示成教化、助人倫之功效，期望參與的學生能具有多元視野的藝術觀。

description.zh:
所有人際圈都有倫理問題。家庭有家庭倫理，學校有學習倫理，在職場中則存在著職場倫理關係，有待個人學習理解、奉行。職場倫理是人與工作(生產)組織之間的關係，也可以?就是在職場中的人際關係，其牽涉幾個層面，包括正確的工作態度、正確的價值觀念以及正確的人際關係。
職場倫理牽涉到職場中個體或群體對於人際互動判定對錯是非的?為觀?，若不具備或不健全的職場倫理觀念將會導致職場人際圈秩序混亂或被破壞，引來觸犯法律規定底限之懲處不利後果。因此，企業懲戒法律案例形同職場倫理負面教材，可藉之推演人際互動規則、體會個案經驗，來思考合宜的人際往來互動的拿捏取捨。
職場倫理議題牽涉禮貌、法律與溝通技巧等多元問題面向。本課程除從理論面演繹職場倫理內涵，亦採企業懲戒個案探討方式，來協助學生習得適應融入職場生活所需之人際相處知識。
description.en: All kinds of relationship involve ethic issue. Ethic of workplace is the relationship between individuals and organizations, meaning a social relationship of workplace. It involves several aspects, including correct work attitudes, values, and personal relationships. Workplace ethic involves ideas individuals and groups hold in workplace to judge right or wrong about behavior. Without correct or sound ethic in workplace may result in chaos or destruction of order among social networks, or offend the legal baseline. Thus, enterprise punishment cases equal negative examples for workplace ethic. Workplace ethic involves topics of manners, laws and communication skills. This course provides not only theoretical perspective to reason nature of workplace ethic, but also raises cases of enterprise punishment for discussions to help students learn knowledge of interactions in workplace to adapt career life.

description.zh: 大眾傳播與人類社會的關係，正隨科技的進步而日益擴大它的影響力。根據學者研究發現，人類的思想、態度與價值觀念受大眾傳播的影響日漸加深，大傳媒介不但塑造人的思想，同時也影響人們的行為及價值；然而從傳播的功能言，大眾傳播同時具有正面與負面的社會功能，故大眾傳播的發展與過程，殊值重視與探討。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括傳播特性與要素、大眾傳播的能及效果、新聞守門人理論等，並以實例分析新聞的公正客觀性、新聞自由與國家安全、媒體與選舉等傳播爭議性問題。修習本課程可培養學生閱讀新聞的正確性，不玫人云亦云，受媒體報導所擺佈；同時亦可增強學生人際溝通的技巧與能力。
description.en: With the advancement of technology, mass communication is enlarging its influence in human society.  According to  researches, the thoughts, attitudes and value judgements of humans are deeply affected by mass communication.  The media not only shape persons' thoughts, but also have an impact on their behavior and values.  Since mass communication has positive and negative social functions at the same time, its development and process are therefore worthy of paying much attention and exploration to us.  This course includes the study of the theory and practice of mass communication, such as characteristics and elements functions and effects, as well as the theory of the news gatekeepers.  It also uses stories to analyze disputed issues, for example, news objectivism, freedom of the press and national security, and media and election. syllabi.outline:
當前我們身處的社會，分工與網絡日益複雜，我們觀照世界的方式，也逐漸發展出與前幾個世代不同的樣貌。媒體現如今愈趨重要，不只是人們認識世界的介質，更經常試圖引領人們用特定視角理解社會。

本課程透過傳播理論與新聞學的概說，切入實際案例與議題，讓同學以人文科學的角度，讓同學再一次審視自身的現實處境、周遭生活與未來規劃，開展更寬廣的認識與想像，並培養出對媒體產製訊息的識讀。

每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 工業化導致人口從鄉村往都市遷徙，其後果不只是在人類生活環境的改變或者是流行病學問題。都市化過程也造成自然環境改變，生物棲地減少的問題。該課程希望透過了解都市中生態棲地的改變，如何影響鳥類以及其他生物的生存，使學生意識到人類的都市化，對其他物種的衝擊。並從中思考，在便利的都會社會生活之外，該如何在都市生活中建設生態友善的校園。
description.en: Industrialization brings about domestic migration from rural areas to cities. The consequences include not only environmental changes for human life or related epidemiological issues. The process of urbanization also causes changes of natural environment, reducing habitat for wildlife. This course aims to provide students a scope to aware how habitat changes in urban areas impact birds and other wildlife and to design environment-friendly campus in additional to convenient urban social life.

name.zh: 創業之品牌管理與行銷
name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養創業者所須具備的經商視野與格局，並認識品牌與行銷之整體概念。包括認識經商環境與商業模式、了解如何善用品牌與行銷的觀念拓展市場，搭配實務案例之研討，期讓同學能在理解相關商業常識與品牌、行銷的觀念後，進而能發展符合消費者需求的行銷能力，順利拓展市場。

description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

description.zh: 本課程旨在闡明中國傳統思想之精義，疏通其中所涵蘊之問題，希望透過講授與討論，把握中國思想發展之大脈，並展望未來文化之發展。在課程設計方面，依序分先秦諸子、魏晉玄學、隋唐佛學、宋明學、近代思想五大綱領。深入淺出，直探本源，使學者領會中國歷代哲人之睿見，指引人生步上光明之大道。
description.en: This course deals mainly with the essence of Chinese traditional thought, trying to sovle the riddles lying behind the msytery of Asian philosophy. Through lectures and class discussion, students are expected to have a better command of the significant stream of thinking development for the Chinese people and look into the future cultural development. As for the course planning, this course consists of the following five topics: Pre-Chin philosophers, Taoism in Wei and Jin Dynasties, Buddism in Sui and Tang dynasties, Confucianism in Song and Ming Dynasties and modern philosophy. The course will be presented with simple approaches and lots of class discussions in the hope that  students will realize the wisdom explored by important philosophers throughout Chinese history, which will in returen provide students with much more promising and enrihed way of life.

name.en: The History and Culture of Taiwan

description.zh: 台灣位處東南亞與東北亞島弧的中介點，是亞洲大陸與太平洋的接點，因此，歷來有許多不同族群移居，因而形成多彩多樣的多元價值觀並容兼蓄的文化觀。本課程將論述介紹台灣南島文化、荷西殖民時期的基督教、漢人文化、日本文化和近代文明等在台灣社會產生的影響。
description.en: The island of Taiwan is located in the middle of the island arc of Southeastern and Northeastern Asia. Further, it is the intersection of the Asian continent and the Pacific Ocean. Since many different ethnic groups have migrated in together, a multi-dimensional view of value-colorful in itself has thus been formed. This course will make a first-step introduction and discussion on the impact over the Taiwan society processed by the cultural mix of the Austronesians, the Christianity under the occupation of the Netherlands and Spain, the Hans, the Japanese and the modern civilization.

description.zh: 以攝影來進行社會介入的創作作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成在社會學領域中越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。本課程主要分為兩大部分，第一部分將從攝影史發展脈絡，來談攝影的社會使用，第二部分則是探討在當代藝術中，如何將攝影作為一種社會實踐的方式。除課堂講解和集體討論外，本課程也將透過實作討論同學的攝影計畫和作品，期使讓同學對於攝影，可以產生新的社會性思考，並開始進行影像與社會介入的嘗試。
description.en: In the field of contemporary art, photography has been developing into a way of social intervention. This trend also contributes to triggering more dialogues concerning “photography and society” in the discipline of sociology. The course mainly includes two parts: photography history and the photography as a social practice. In the first section, along with the history of photography, the social usages of photography will be introduced. In the second section, how photography art can be a social practice and what kinds of practice have been explored will be . In addition to class lectures and group discussions, the course requires all students to complete their individual photo project in the end of semester and their works will be presented in class.

syllabi.outline: 以攝影來進行社會介入的作品，在當代藝術的領域中已經不再陌生，而這樣的發展也促成了越來越多關於攝影與社會的討論。圍繞著攝影與社會這個主軸，本課程以結合攝影史和社會學知識領域的方式，來講述不同攝影類型，以及如何以影像來表現其社會性的思考。除此之外，本課程也將引導同學透過個人與團體作業練習和評圖過程，進入當代攝影創作與社會參與的對話。

description.zh: 勞動法包括與勞動市場、個別勞動關係及集體勞動關係等方面有關勞工工作權益的法律規範，透過本課程可以學習正確的勞動法律觀念和知識，同時培養縝密思辨的能力，將課堂上所習得的知識應用落實在日常生活中，來保障並維護自己或他人的職場權益。
description.en: The legal specialty called Labor Law can be define as “the legal regulation of the labor market , individual labor relations and collective employer-employee relations. “labor market” pertains to market in which employers and workers exchange labor . Through this course , students can not only get correct concepts of " Labor Law " , but learn to protect their / others' rights in work place.

description.zh: 此門課程主要在於瞭解社會學的意涵，並藉由跨領域的學習，讓不同學科能有對話的空間。課程涵蓋的範圍會兼顧理論與實用性，讓學生能思考當今的社會，理解到產生因素的多元性，並進而使個人眼界能更加開拓。期望學生於課程學習中能夠擁有更多對於整個社會的不同思維，以強化本身學科之所需，不但具有理論性深入的洞察力，也能引用到管理上實質的層面。
description.en: The purpose of this course is to understand sociology. It covers theory and practicability, and make students consider the current society, and understand the generated factors of diversity . Expect students' study can have more for the community as a whole different way of thinking, in order to strengthen their academic needs, not only has the theoretical depth of insight, but also on the substance applied to the management level.

syllabi.outline:
本堂課透過社會學理論的知識與實踐，向同學們引介理解社會的觀點與方法。
極大多數人的生活，都處在「社會」當中。我們必須不斷地與人、與環境互動，才能維繫生命與生活。人們的各種關係在社會中相互構成，影響了社會資源的生產方式、分配與消費。
因此，掌握人們分析社會的方式，才有可能知道社會關係與結構是怎麼運作起來的。藉由本課程所涉及的多樣議題，讓同學們接觸生活圈內及舒適圈外的不同樣貌，並據此反身質問：我們如何參與及想像社會？社會又如何影響著我們的言行與思考？

description.zh: 藥膳在中醫理論指導下，將中草藥與實務相配合，運用傳統烹調技術和現代加工方法製成味、色、形俱佳的、更有保健和治療作用作之食品，其內容廣泛，迄今已有三千年之歷史。所謂藥食同源更是集中而深刻的體現了藥膳之重要性。本課程共分：湯膳概論、穀物湯膳、蔬菜湯膳、果品湯膳、畜肉湯膳、海鮮湯膳、藥草湯膳和美容養生湯膳等。

syllabi.outline:
食物是人類持續生命的重要元素，在人的一生中扮演重要的角色。人們的生活中也因為有飲食相關文化與習慣相伴，而顯得精采與豐富。因此，飲食與生活有著密不可分的關係。
本課程由營養與健康的觀點切入飲食，培養學生具備有關飲食營養與健康的知識，以度過健康的一生。

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:

Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

name.zh: 創業之品牌管理與行銷
name.en: The Brand Management and Marketing of Entrepreneurship

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，同時須考慮新創事業之品牌建構，如果能在創業之初建構一個定位明確的品牌，可使新創事業立即享有良好的品牌權益，提高創業成功的機會。品牌建構完成後，須設計行銷方案，對消費者進行行銷活動，向消費者推銷新創公司之品牌，以塑造良好的品牌權益。此時，消費者對新創公司之品牌會有良好形象之認知，進而提升顧客對新創公司品牌忠誠度，增加創業者創業成功之機會。
description.en:
When entrepreneurs are building a startup company, they also need to consider its brand building. If they can construct a clear positioning of the brand in the beginning, they are able to have their new business with a better brand equity immediately, and improve entrepreneurial chances of success.
After the completion of construction of the brand, entrepreneurs need to design marketing programs for consumer marketing activities, and promote its brand to create good brand equity. In the meantime, consumers will have a better brand awareness of these new companies, enhancing customer loyalty and increasing opportunities for entrepreneurs’ entrepreneurial success.

syllabi.outline: 本課程旨在培養創業者所須具備的經商視野與格局，並認識品牌與行銷之整體概念。包括認識經商環境與商業模式、了解如何善用品牌與行銷的觀念拓展市場，搭配實務案例之研討，期讓同學能在理解相關商業常識與品牌、行銷的觀念後，進而能發展符合消費者需求的行銷能力，順利拓展市場。

description.zh:
本課程首先說明人在宇宙中的定位、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與天地萬物和諧相處和真愛的永不止息。
課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類共同的智慧，並安排數次的校外教學，以深入瞭解社會脈動，並運用多媒體影片教學以提升學習效果，學生每天做身心觀察學習紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。
description.en:
This course covers topics such as: the role of human beings in the universe, the dearness of life and the pursuit of life-long goals. We then discuss ways to train the students to become brave and to harmonize human beings with the nature, leading to an access to the discovery of true love.
The course is realized through activity involvement, experience sharing and lectures on human wisdom. We have some extramural visits in order to understand social pulses. Multimedia teaching materials are fully utilized to enhance the teaching and learning effects. We request that all the students take note of their mental and physical improvements on a daily basis so that they could examine the progressive path of life.

syllabi.outline:
人為萬物之靈，你相信嗎?本課程開啟思考與論辯的交流，希望一起面對人類最重要的問題，一起尋求解方。從認識自己和在乎別人開始，尋找此生的定位，認識人性的尊嚴、生命的可貴、一生的方向；接著說明如何鍛鍊自己成為生命的勇士；最後強調如何與別人對談連結，與萬事萬物和諧相處，讓真愛永不止息。

課程進行方式是透過體驗活動、交流分享和有次第的講授人類最精純的智慧，並安排人物訪談和分組活動，以深入瞭解別人的思維，運用多樣化教學以提升學習效果，學生每週做學習心得紀錄，更可以看到生命進步的軌跡。

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion.  It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

(EMI)  Interpersonal relationships involve understanding oneself and others, including character, attitude, charm, communication, pressure, setbacks, and emotions. It helps students communicate effectively with people of different tastes, beliefs, perspectives, and lifestyles. It encourages open expression of feelings and thoughts to establish cooperative relationships and develop personal potential for better opportunities.

description.zh:
性、性別是人類與生俱來的課題，其與各時代之政治體系、法律規範及社會變遷有密不可分的關係法律中的性別議題，既是法律問題也是社會問題，需要結合法律領域與社會領域的知識，作跨領域教學與學習。
本課程配合性別平等教育政策趨勢，分就不同面向的法律規範中的相關性別議題，來讓學生了解近年來性別平等之相關法律意涵希望能在認知、情意、行動等層面，讓學生習得正確的性別權利意識，進而在國家公私領域中運用相關知識落實性別平等，以促進多元文化之下兩性平權發展。
description.en:
Sex and gender are inherent issues of human beings, and they are inseparable from the political system, legal norms and social changes of all ages. Gender issues in the law are both legal and social issues and need to be combined with the legal field and society Domain knowledge for cross-domain teaching and learning.
This course is in line with the gender equality education policy trend, and divides the relevant gender issues in different aspects of legal norms to let students understand the relevant legal implications of gender equality in recent years. Hopefully, students can learn from the levels of cognition, affection, and action. Correct awareness of gender rights, and then apply relevant knowledge to implement gender equality in the public and private sectors of the country, so as to promote the development of gender equality under multiculturalism.

name.en: Labor Images in Contemporary Taiwan Society

description.zh: 本課程與台北市勞動局合作，以歷年來勞動金像獎獲獎作品以及勞動局推出的勞動紀錄片為主要影像教材，從勞動社會學的觀點出發，對當代台灣社會的勞動相關議題進行介紹。課程涵蓋範圍兼顧理論與實務，除了以影片來進行課程講授與集體討論外，並指導同學以拍攝短片的方式，於學期末呈現他們對於日常生活裡的勞動議題觀察。
description.en: This course is intended to employ the award-winning works of the "Labor Awards" and the "Labor Documentary" launched by the Department of Labor, Taipei City Government over the years to introduce labor-related issues in Taiwan society from the perspectives of labor sociology. In cooperation with the Department of Labor, teaching with film and collective discussion constitute the main methods in this course which covers both the theory and the practice dimensions. In addition, students will be instructed to make a short film to present their observation on labor issues in daily life.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將從認識職業災害出發，闡述當代台灣社會的勞動課題。課程進行除透過相關勞動影片賞析與座談，進行職災與勞動地景的討論外，並將結合實地踏查與桌遊等活動，期以深化對台灣職業安全問題以及勞動權益的探索與認識。

description.zh: 本課程結合跨領域，從人文、藝術、音樂、設計、多媒體、金融，到生物、醫學、材料、電資、工程…等各領域，導入如何利用人工智慧，加上量子計算應用到各層面上，以解決問題到科技研發創新。再介紹元宇宙的概念，然後結合各領域逐步完成元宇宙生態系的構建。
description.en: This course combines cross-fields, from humanities, art, music, design, multimedia, finance, to biology, medicine, materials, electricity, engineering... and other fields. Introduces how to use artificial intelligence and the application of quantum computing to solve problems and scientific innovation. Then introduce the concept of metaverse and gradually complete the construction of metaverse ecosystem.

description.zh: 創業與財務概論課程的主要目的是要使學生了解如何在企業創立的時候，透過財務技術，來評估企業的經營績效與價值。本課程將介紹以下內容：(1) 公司創業的財務報表與科目報導與分析 (2) 基本創業財務分析理論 (3) 公司的償債能力、獲利能力、經營能力、資本結構、現金流量的分析 (4) 特殊行業的財務報表分析 (5) 探討我國最近發佈的會計準則公報對企業與投資人的影響。
description.en: The goal of the introduction to entrepreneurship and finance course is to help students, when the company is in the stage of entrepreneurship, evaluate the performance and measure the values of firms by financial statements. The topics of this course includes (1) entrepreneurship financial reports and analysis; (2) basic entrepreneurship financial statement analysis; 3) solvency, profitability, business performance, financial structure and cash flow analysis; 4) financial statement analysis of special industries 5) recent developments of GAAP.

syllabi.outline:
本課程旨在解析創業者在財務領域須具備的觀念與常識，教學內容係依據教師過去在金融業所看過的業界案例、及曾擔任投資公司財務長、與跨國集團投資與信用管理主管之職場經驗所設計。
透過了解企業財務領域之運作，期培養學生在創業時能運用相關的財務基礎觀念與常識，相關財務知識也可做為個人投資理財參酌。
syllabi.schedule:
預定上課主題:
1. 認識金融機構與投資理財工具
2. 認識利率及其應用、投資計畫報酬估算
3. 認識匯率與外匯市場
4. 認識財務報表與運用
5. 企業的基本面分析與經營策略
6. 創業籌資(兼述股票上市之路)
7. 創業營業計劃與財務評估要點釋例
8. 財務預測與投資計劃評估實例展示

description.zh: 創業者在新創事業時，須考慮消費者對新創事業產品(新創產品)之瞭解及接受程度。如果能在創業之初對消費者進行新創產品之消費者行為調查，可使新創事業在成立之初即找出目標顧客群，並分析出目標顧客的消費偏好，例如：對新創產品的品質要求、功能偏好、購買可能金額、消費通路類別等，創業者可依所瞭解目標顧客的消費偏好，規劃適當的行銷方案，而提高創業成功的機會。
description.en: Entrepreneurs should consider consumers’ understanding and acceptance of new products (innovative products) in their new ventures. If a start-up company conducts consumer behavior survey in the beginning, the new business is able to identify the target customer base from the start, and analyze the target consumer preferences, including quality requirements, functional preferences, amount of possible purchase, types of consumer access. By understanding target consumer preferences, entrepreneurs can plan appropriate marketing programs, and improve business opportunities for success.
