syllabi.notes:
一、SDGs融入課程內容

Week 4-5 消費者決策過程：導入SDG 12（負責任的消費與生產），教導學生分析消費者在永續產品選擇上的決策機制，並設計行銷策略引導負責任消費行為。

Week 16 消費者權益與社會責任：以SDG 12為核心，確保消費者獲得準確透明的產品資訊，做出符合永續性的明智選擇。同時涵蓋SDG 10（減少不平等），探討弱勢消費者群體權益保護。

Week 13 文化、次文化、跨文化消費行為：對應SDG 5（性別平等）和SDG 10（減少不平等），分析性別刻板印象廣告、文化冒犯訊息等議題，培養學生的社會敏感度。

品德教育連結：本課程引導學生思考消費者行為態度及轉變因素，符合6E品德教育中的「啟發思辨」，鼓勵學生討論品德核心價值與生活實踐準則。

二、課程執行方式

教學平台：採用北科i學園plus作為主要課程網頁平台。

聯絡方式：課程相關問題請透過email與授課教師聯繫。

彈性授課機制：因應疫情或不可避狀況導致無法實體上課時，將彈性調整授課方式、進度與評量方式。線上教學採用Microsoft Teams平台（學號@cc.ntut.edu.tw），可於原定上課時間進行同步教學或採非同步方式進行遠距教學。

description.zh:
因是在大專教藝術欣賞的課程，我在設計課程上，即考慮雖同學們不是藝術本科學生，但秉持"雖創作，但會欣賞的原則"，我的課程安排將從上古時代人類的美術創作活動進而引導解釋什麼是人類的美感經驗。讓他們明瞭東方藝術之同與不同，再介紹東西方的繪畫潮流，如西方：從文藝復興至寫實主義，印象主義，至超印象主義，東方：從漢的畫象磚開始至中國畫，書法之演進，中西繪畫之比較，內容是繁而多的。但我將用簡潔扼要的"重點教學法",寓教於樂的方式，讓同學不再懼怕"Art'，甚至可以簡單的分辨出藝術品的年代，作者，及欣賞藝術作品的要領，這是我給此門課所訂的目標。
另一個教學重點是："理論和實際併重"。在每一單元中，我將設計一項簡的[自己動手做]大概祇花 20-30 分鐘讓學生體會和真正看見，明白，藝術家製造藝術品的過程。
很希望能帶學生至博物院或美術館一趟，或至鶯砍參觀陶工廠。總之，一切課程計劃，乃配合學生之程度與興趣。
description.en: Because most students taking this course are not art major; therefore, I adhere to the principle of "Although not creation, appreciation will be instructed."  On course design, my class starts from the artistic creation of human beings in prehistoric time and further introduces the experience of beauty sensed by man and understand the similiar and difference of eastern and western art.  Moreover, I will introduce the fashion of priniting of eastern and western culture.  For example, the western culture: from the Renaissance to realism, impressionism and super impressionism.  Western culture: from a portrait stone of Han Dynasty to Chinese painting, the develpment of calligraphy and comparison of Chinese and western paintings. The teaching content is complicated, but I will simply it and highlight teaching way to let my students enjoy it.

description.zh: 以視覺藝術為探討重點，研究藝術起源以及原始美術、民俗與大眾藝術分野。探究式覺元素和設計原理以及應用媒材、使用技巧，涵蓋素描、水彩、油畫、版畫、混合媒材、雕塑、建築，廣告、包裝、服裝設計、工業產品設計及攝影等。配合幻燈教學，使同學對於視覺藝術有整體性、概括性的認識，以奠定將來從事藝術鑑賞和研究創造之基礎。
description.en: The focus of this course is the exploration of visual arts.  Students will study the origin of art and the distinction among primitive art, folk and popular art. This course also provides students with visual elements, design principles, applied media material, and techniques including charcoal drawing, water-colored painting, oil painting, graphic art, compound material, sculpture, architecture, advertisement, packaging, fashion design, industrial design, and photography. Slide teaching is adopted to give students a comprehensive and general understanding on visual art in order to foster students to appreciate, study, and create art.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.outline:
This is a history course of western classical music, of which the definition, according to The New Harvard Dictionary of Music and The Oxford Dictionary, is "art music” or "serious music", that written in a Western musical tradition, using an established form. "Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.”
The styles of various periods will be introduced, from the Medieval, Renaissance, Classical, Romantic, to the Contemporary eras. The goal of this course is helping students to equip a general comprehension of Classical Music in terms of basic elements of musical art, technical theory, historical, social and cultural background extends to related arts and humanities. 
In addition, basic elements of music notation reading and theory will also be made known to the students.
Other genres such as Alternative Rock and related fields will be interlaced with the Classical Music. 

In order to pursue the most accurate references and info, the major key-points and terminology used in this course will be in English or original European text.
(There are requirements to fulfill this course such as Midterm & Final Exams, as well as in-class presentation or performance. If you're not interested in serious music genre, please DO NOT take this course.)

此門課程為西洋藝術音樂史，即古典音樂歷史。根據「新哈佛音樂辭典」 ( New Harvard Dictionary of Music) 與 「牛津字典」 的詮釋，所謂古典音樂為「嚴肅藝術」音樂，以嚴謹成型的作曲公式創作音樂，經過歷史洗練的時間藝術。透過此課程學生對西洋古典音樂會有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及社會人文背景，從音樂美感構成與相關人文藝術和文化歷史的議題作連結。
(此門課有期中考與期末考, 還有課堂現場報告或表演的要求, 如果對學術類型嚴肅音樂跟搖滾樂歷史沒有興趣, 強烈建議不要選修!)
syllabi.schedule:
1. 古希臘藝術與人文, 信仰: 古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化, 音樂, 文學, 戲劇, 跟人文背景	
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2. 從基督教傳入, 到中世紀: 古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承, 展現於壁畫, 以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響; 音樂記譜方式, 表演方式,天主教會對社會的影響; 拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂, 中世紀歐洲社會與歷史
2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變(舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂
3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4. 文藝復興時期: 宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂, 作曲家 雕塑家. 畫家介紹. 以義大利為首的時代. 此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹; 源於德, 法, 蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯
4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5. 巴洛克時期: 法國巴洛克--英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較, 王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹; 法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮
5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6. 巴洛克時期:	義大利式協奏曲介紹; 巴洛克時代小型管弦曲; 宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異
6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7. 巴洛克時期:	基本舞曲, 組曲形式--宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾
7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8. 巴洛克時期: 德意志巴洛克--韓德爾, 泰雷曼, 巴赫
8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9. 巴洛克時期: 深度探討巴赫生平與作品
9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10. 	期中報告	
10th week: Midterm Report

11. 古典時期: 啟蒙時代崛起, 腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響. 波次坦忘憂宮介紹; 盧梭之民約論, 丹麥王室實現其理念; 俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻—聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹
11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage

12. 古典時期: 德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主,後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼; 海頓, 莫札特, 貝多芬(前期)
12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13. 浪漫派時期: 從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派
13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14. 浪漫派時期: 法國, 北歐, 波西米亞--區域性的不同風格
14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15. 浪漫派時期: 國民樂派, 俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾
15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16. 二十世紀現代樂派: 法國印象樂派, 第二代維也納樂派; 法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成; 包浩斯學院, Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹
16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period
17. 後現代主義: 音樂學界的實驗性音樂;	Phillip Glass獨創的極簡樂風; 電腦與傳統樂器結合
17th week: The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music; comparison with other genres 

18:	期末考
18th week: Final Exam.

description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion.  It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

description.zh: 個人或國家都無法自外於當今的國際社會；政治、經濟、社會、文化各層面皆受到國際間互動的影響下，為增進知識青年具備國際化的視野與認知，以因應時代發展趨勢，在強化技術研究的基礎上，拓展國家、社會與個人的發展空間。本課程內容包括基本理論與國際關係的動態，涵蓋國際社會的結構與演變、國際行為的類型及支配此行為的各種力量、國際事務的現象、本質及因果關係。
description.en: An individual or a country may not keep alien to today's internatonal community. Owing to internationally interactive influence with respect to politic, economy, society and culture, the purpose of the course is to equip intellectual youths with internaitonalized sight and awareness to keep pace with the develolpment trend of times, and to expand the space for national, social and individual development on basic of reinforced technical research. The contents of the course include basic theory and the situation  of international relations, covering the structure and changes in the international community, the type of international behavior, and various forces dominating such behavior, the phenomenon, essence, cause and consequence of international affairs.

syllabi.outline: 全球化時代，無論是個人或是國家都無法自外於國際結構而不受其影響；因此，我們必須對國際現況有基本了解，對於國際結構發展趨勢應該有所掌握。課程規劃前五週著重建構國際大圖像與鋪墊國際關係理論基礎；六至十二週以議題型式為主，輔以當週或當月國際重要事件，帶入國際關係觀察角度；十三至十六週重點放在中美競爭的各面向，從雙邊關係、印太戰略到台灣議題皆包含在內。課程內容深入淺出，隨著各種議題擴展國際視野的同時客觀地建立國際關係系統性認知，培養同學獨立且多元思考，以及正確解讀資訊的能力。

description.zh: 科技發展為促進人類社會進步的主要動力。現今，科技發展中的性別議題與性別政治也漸漸受到國際社會的重視。本課程首先讓學生意識到在科學教育中性別失衡的現象與其成因。之後從社會學、人類學與性別學切入當前性別科技發展中的各項議題。最後將會以全球視角與永續發展指標(SDGs)來檢視科技發展中的性別政治，給予學生更宏觀和深入的分析，培養未來具人文關懷的科技專業人才。
description.en: Science and technology development is the main driving force to promote the progress of human society. Nowadays, gender issues and gender politics in the development of science and technology have been paid more and more attention by the international community. In this class, firstly, students will be aware of the phenomenon of gender imbalance in science education and its causes. Secondly, I am going to talk about current development of gendered technology from perspectives of sociology, anthropology and gender. Finally, I will lead students to examine gender politics in science and technology from a global perspective and sustainable development indicators (SDGs). This class aims to give students a more macro- and in-depth analysis and cultivating future talented humanities and technology professionals.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將以幾波全球化為背景，首先指出性別與科技如何相互建構，接者分析機器與男性氣質的關聯性。以此為基礎，帶領同學認識性別與交織分析如何解決科技研究的盲點，最後反思工程文化的性別議題。The course will be contextualized within several waves of globalization. It will start by examining how gender and technology mutually construct each other, followed by an analysis of the correlation between machinery and masculine traits. Building upon this foundation, it will guide students to understand how gender and intersectional analysis address blind spots in technological research. Finally, it will encourage reflection on gender issues within engineering culture.

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
生命科學是一門綜合知識探討什麼是科學，以科學方法瞭解地球上生命的來源，演化與特徵,與生命活動的環境。地球上存在各式各樣的生命，多樣性的物種，包括類生命的病毒，單細胞(生命的基本單元) 或多細胞生物。人類(異營生物)生活於其中與週遭的物種密切關聯，從環境取得能量(營養攝取)，代謝生長，繁殖，最終死亡。從宏觀看，人類位居生物鏈最頂端，但在微觀環境仍不斷與微生物做競爭。從基礎研究讓我們了解生命的過程(中心準則: DNA-> RNA-> Protein)，疫系統與細菌病毒間的運作，細胞生長發育與疾病的發生，利用動物模式幫助醫學與藥物科技的研發，讓人類更健康更長壽。同時，人類的過度活動也製造龐大的廢棄物造成環境汙染與生態傷害，這些最後將反撲於自己，如現在所面對的物種大量減少，環境賀爾蒙入侵食物鏈，新興病毒崛起。這些課題都是生命科學研究中的一環。現代生命科學不僅研究單獨生物體生命活動的過程，還研究眾多生物個體之間的相互關係（生物演化與多樣性問題），生物個體與環境的關係（生態問題）。這些基本知識都是現代大學生應該具備的。也為未來跨領域合作準備。課程將對每一課題從生命科學歷史到現在發展作敘述來引發同學興趣。
Life science is discussing all aspects of knowledge about biology to which we human could not get away. In this course, you will learn how life is started and study evolution, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, immunology and disease, microbiology, environmental toxicology and physiology. I will also introduce you the newly developed biotechnology and how importance of environmental protection to human life. All of the information included in these classes is so important that modern college students should not missed.

syllabi.outline:
面對快速變化的世界與社會問題，唯有「創新」能抵擋甚至超越變化。「創新思考」能幫助我們從不同視角認識問題，甚至解決問題。
本課程將從何謂創新、創新從何而來、創新的兩難、創新的擴散等重要的理論視角開始，多面向地「思考創新」。還要認識技術創新、產品創新、市場創新、通路創新、服務創新與社會創新等創新的不同面向，並藉由多元的案例分析激發學生思考。除了創新的經典理論與案例分析之外，我們還要一起學習和練習「創意思考的方法」。最後請同學靈活運用先前學過的創新理論與方法，提出一個你想改變或解決的創新企劃。

description.en: The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.outline:
音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.
syllabi.schedule:
第一週  引序
1. 課前準備、報告評量方式
2. 音樂基本要素
3. 音樂有畫面、聲音看得見/「歌與畫的邂逅」音樂會賞析
4. 我見我思－聽曾宇謙 心動時刻

第二週  音樂藝術美學
1. 音樂美學的發展
2. 絕對音樂與標題音樂形式內容藝術性
3. 音樂美的範疇~
    克萊斯勒小提琴作品：愛之喜、愛之悲為例
4. 大提琴家馬友友音樂美學9觀點

第三、四週  樂器與音樂曲式
1. 樂器世界、認識管弦樂團
2. 音樂曲式多樣貌~韋瓦第「四季」小提琴協奏曲
3. 器樂曲與人聲詮釋之比較~1812序曲賞析

第五、六週 台灣歌謠之美
1. 台灣福佬歌謠發展
2. 各式不同詮釋台灣歌謠展演風格

第七、八週 英美名歌巡禮
1. 英國民謠文化發展
2. 佛斯特美國民謠之父

第九週  期中考週 音樂隨想作業活動

第十、十一週 合唱藝術 (第十一週課程調課全班參加11/18/二通識午間音樂會欣賞)
1.  合唱之美
2. Carmina Burana 《布蘭詩歌》-將中世紀的游吟與現代歌詠結合
3. 美國史溫格重唱團與英國國王歌手作品賞析

第十二週  古典與現代音樂融合
1. 莫札特交響曲與流行女團SHE作品
2. 遇見波蘭鋼琴詩人蕭邦~周杰倫流行歌曲創作
3. 歌劇在波希米亞狂想曲的創作影響

第十三、十四週  經典音樂劇
1. 音樂劇入門
2. 法國作曲家Schonberg作品：
   雨果劇作/悲慘世界與越戰背景/西貢小姐

第十五、十六週  歌劇選粹
1.莫札特喜歌劇-費加洛婚禮
2.福茂公司動畫歌劇系列	

第十七週  校園民歌風華
1.校園民歌運動緣起
2.台灣現代民歌之父楊弦
3.李泰祥創作-古典引入校園民歌流行化元素

第十八週  期末考週

第3、4週課程，講述1812序曲，俄國作曲家柴可夫斯基以發生於1812年法國拿破崙大軍攻打俄國戰役為背景所創作的音樂作品，樂曲中呈現戰爭情緒，百姓面對戰爭來臨的聖詠祈願和平到來！

description.en: Interpersonal Relationship is to discuss about self-understanding and perception of other people, including how to handle key issues related to character, attitude, attractiveness, communication, pressure, frustration and emotion.  It helps students to learn effective communication, open their minds to express personal feeling and thought, and try to communicate with other people having different tastes, convictions, standpoints and ways of living so as to establish a harmonic and cooperative relationship and furtherly to develop personal potential and strive for better opportunity of development.

description.zh: 個人或國家都無法自外於當今的國際社會；政治、經濟、社會、文化各層面皆受到國際間互動的影響下，為增進知識青年具備國際化的視野與認知，以因應時代發展趨勢，在強化技術研究的基礎上，拓展國家、社會與個人的發展空間。本課程內容包括基本理論與國際關係的動態，涵蓋國際社會的結構與演變、國際行為的類型及支配此行為的各種力量、國際事務的現象、本質及因果關係。
description.en: An individual or a country may not keep alien to today's internatonal community. Owing to internationally interactive influence with respect to politic, economy, society and culture, the purpose of the course is to equip intellectual youths with internaitonalized sight and awareness to keep pace with the develolpment trend of times, and to expand the space for national, social and individual development on basic of reinforced technical research. The contents of the course include basic theory and the situation  of international relations, covering the structure and changes in the international community, the type of international behavior, and various forces dominating such behavior, the phenomenon, essence, cause and consequence of international affairs.

syllabi.outline: 全球化時代，無論是個人或是國家都無法自外於國際結構而不受其影響；因此，我們必須對國際現況有基本了解，對於國際結構發展趨勢應該有所掌握。課程規劃前五週著重建構國際大圖像與鋪墊國際關係理論基礎；六至十二週以議題型式為主，輔以當週或當月國際重要事件，帶入國際關係觀察角度；十三至十六週重點放在中美競爭的各面向，從雙邊關係、印太戰略到台灣議題皆包含在內。課程深入淺出，隨著各種議題擴展國際視野的同時客觀地建立國際關係系統性認知，培養同學獨立且多元思考，以及正確解讀資訊的能力。

description.zh: 教學目標：針對當前社會中之政治、經濟、社會、文化等各層面所形成之重大問題與現象加以探討，予以概略整合性之介紹，以使學生對社會現況更加瞭解並進而關懷所生活之環境。開課基礎：以原開設之社會科學概論為基礎，而向實務面擴充之課程。教學內容：採單元教學、口授、作業、探討意見交換並行方式進行。1.真正的民意－政治生態與國會。2.尖銳的對立－政黨競爭。3.台灣經驗－經濟奇蹟。4.高齡化的社會－銀髮族與人生。5.應關懷的族群－社福。6.立國的基礎－教育改革。7.慾望街車－犯罪與司法。8.和平發展之關鍵－兩岸關係。9.其他。
description.en:
Teaching goal: Analyze the significant problems and phenomena concerning politics, economy, society and culture, and give a brief account of such phenomena with a view to facilitating students' understanding of the status quo and encouraging students to devote care to their living environment. Pre-course requirement: A basic grasp of "the Introduction of Social Science" is required for more advanced and expanded discussions in this course are based on it. 
Teaching activities: Lecturing, assignments, and discussions. Teaching units: Political patterns and parliament, Competition of Parties, Taiwan Economical Miracle, Elders and Their Life, Welfare for Minorities, Education Reformation, Crime and Justice, Cross-affair Relations, Others.

syllabi.outline: 當前社會的諸多現象與議題，都與生活結構及政經發展息息相關。本堂課由時下的民生議題切入，分析事件的前因後果，並回顧相關的社會因素，讓學生能夠開展多樣的視野，藉此讓學生能對現實處境、周遭生活與未來規劃，有更寬廣的認識與想像。

description.zh: 透過一系列的資料採集、參考與互動，包含經驗分享、影片欣賞等，帶領修課同學探索創新（Innovation）、創業（Startup）以及最重要的 – 創業家創新精神（Entrepreneur Innovative Thinking）之本質。無論是工作上的創造，學習上的創造，或者是(創)事業上的創造，都必然需要一定程度的創新，才能在全球化競爭以及指數型科技（Exponential Technology）發展的趨勢下存活，最終獲得勝利、創造價值。
description.en: Through series of classes to train students embracing the innovative thinking and gradually internalize it to become innovative entrepreneurship. Since the generation is changing so rapidly, the competitors are no longer came from local land but from everywhere in global village. Under this highly competitive world, every one of us need to fully embrace the true value of innovation, and incubate our own entrepreneurship with hack spirit, which will lead us to an island of innovation.

syllabi.outline:
面對快速變化的世界與社會問題，唯有「創新」能抵擋甚至超越變化。「創新思考」能幫助我們從不同視角認識問題，甚至解決問題。
本課程將從何謂創新、創新從何而來、創新的兩難、創新的擴散等重要的理論視角開始，多面向地「思考創新」。還要認識技術創新、產品創新、市場創新、通路創新、服務創新與社會創新等創新的不同面向，並藉由多元的案例分析激發學生思考。除了創新的經典理論與案例分析之外，我們還要一起學習和練習「創意思考的方法」。最後請同學靈活運用先前學過的創新理論與方法，提出一個你想改變或解決的創新企劃。
syllabi.schedule:
1. 課程導論：介紹課程與評分；你想創新/改變什麼？何謂創新？
2. 思考如何創新？創新從何而來？創新者的基因
3. 管理領域與經濟領域的創新思維：破壞式創新與創造性破壞
4. 創新的類型與4P：技術創新、4P創新、服務創新、流程創新、社會創新
5. 產品/設計創新：設計思考
6. 產品/市場創新：藍海策略、紫牛行銷
7. 通路創新：長尾、平台經濟、訂閱經濟 
8. 服務創新、流程或方法創新：體驗經濟、大數據
9. 社會創新：美麗新世界
10. 創新的擴散：KOL的原理
11. 創意方法：Brainstorming, mind map, SCAMPER,六頂思考帽、設計思考五步驟(Design Thinking)
12. 期中考
13. 創新提案：Ideas (反饋與分組)
14. 創新思考練習：產品Ｘ創意方法＋創新擴散
15. 創新思考練習：通路/ 服務創新Ｘ創意方法＋創新擴散
16. 創新思考練習：社會創新Ｘ創意方法＋創新擴散
17. 創新計畫：Plan (創新計畫報告分享)
18. 創新計畫：Plan (創新計畫報告分享)
syllabi.assessment:
1. 課堂參與：出席率、回答問題或主動提問。20%
2. 期中考試：選擇題，基本理論概念與定義。20%
3. 個人作業：創新提案，提出一個你想運用創新思考來解決或改變的問題，以及對此的基本分析。20%
4. 小組報告：展開一個創新計畫，企劃書中必須運用創新理論。2-5人一組。40%（注：創新計畫中若包含公益、企業社會責任、永續發展等品德內涵會適度加分。）

description.zh:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。
description.en:
The course enable participant to realize the essential features of innovation via cases study. Various types of innovation cases are included, such as: technology innovation, service innovation and management innovation. We also plan to invites some successful constants to give participants talk and share their experiences, including the challenge and their resolving process.
The real case study enables participants to understand the entrepreneurship and the steps to start a business. The participants are required to complete the case reading and a preview report is required in advance the class. We hope that every participant can propose their opinion and persuade others colleges of their viewpoints.

description.zh: 生命科學概論，重心放在人體生命科學，並強化醫學的角色。此外，中西醫結合的觀點，詮釋抗老、防癌。以身心靈養生的方式，強化預防醫學。並從人類疾病的本源性病因，根本探討。當然，如何增強免疫力，袪除自由基是主軸。在探究人體潛能、身心靈養生或疾病的本源性原因時，都必須重視「經絡」系統。總之生命是非常奧妙的，不僅只物質面，更要重視心靈層面，中西醫整合方向，必是廿一世紀的主流。
description.en: This course focuses on human life science and emphasizes the roles of medicine on improving the life quality of human beings. It also uses the point of view of integration traditional Chinese and western medicine to interpret how to prevent the aging of body and occurrence of cancers. This course also focuses on how to keep the body, mind and spirit in the best conditon in order to prevent the occurrence of human diseases. In addition, it deeply discusses the eseential etiology of human disease and teaches audiences how to enhance the body immunity and how to get rid of free radicals. The importance of meridian system of the human body and its relationships to human potentiality, body, mind spirit and diseses are also discussed. Life is marvelous. The completeness of life depends on the saisfaction of not only the material but also menetal and spiritual needs. Integration of the traditional Chinese and western medicine to improve the life quality of human beings is the main issue.

syllabi.outline:
生命科學是一門綜合知識探討什麼是科學，以科學方法瞭解地球上生命的來源，演化與特徵,與生命活動的環境。地球上存在各式各樣的生命，多樣性的物種，包括類生命的病毒，單細胞(生命的基本單元) 或多細胞生物。人類(異營生物)生活於其中與週遭的物種密切關聯，從環境取得能量(營養攝取)，代謝生長，繁殖，最終死亡。從宏觀看，人類位居生物鏈最頂端，但在微觀環境仍不斷與微生物做競爭。從基礎研究讓我們了解生命的過程(中心準則: DNA-> RNA-> Protein)，疫系統與細菌病毒間的運作，細胞生長發育與疾病的發生，利用動物模式幫助醫學與藥物科技的研發，讓人類更健康更長壽。同時，人類的過度活動也製造龐大的廢棄物造成環境汙染與生態傷害，這些最後將反撲於自己，如現在所面對的物種大量減少，環境賀爾蒙入侵食物鏈，新興病毒崛起。這些課題都是生命科學研究中的一環。現代生命科學不僅研究單獨生物體生命活動的過程，還研究眾多生物個體之間的相互關係（生物演化與多樣性問題），生物個體與環境的關係（生態問題）。這些基本知識都是現代大學生應該具備的。也為未來跨領域合作準備。課程將對每一課題從生命科學歷史到現在發展作敘述來引發同學興趣。
Life science is discussing all aspects of knowledge about biology to which we human could not get away. In this course, you will learn how life is started and study evolution, genetics, molecular biology, cell biology, immunology and disease, microbiology, environmental toxicology and physiology. I will also introduce you the newly developed biotechnology and how importance of environmental protection to human life. All of the information included in these classes is so important that modern college students should not missed.

description.zh: 本課程是為非專業學生所設計的哲學概論，介紹西洋哲學的起源、西洋哲學的問題，以及哲學與人生的關係。哲學的問題意識起自人類的自覺，人類意圖認識自己，為宇宙人生尋求解答，哲學的發生本自人類天賦的求知欲，即其本性中對於智慧的追求與愛慕。這種愛慕智慧的精神是希臘文明留給西方世界的遺產，對於知識能持客觀批判的精神，對於真理能存認真熱切的態度，對於人生能有超克苦難的修持。在國際化的世代，我們對西方的認識應更深入其精神層面，此乃本課程規劃的初衷。
description.en: This course is designed for student who is not disciplined in philosophy. As an introduction, we begin at the origin of western philosophy, the philosophical questions and finally, the relationship of human life and philosophy. Philosophy takes place when human being thinking of himself. Man by nature desire to know himself as well as the external world. And due to this love of wisdom, men can be critical to knowledge and be passionate toward truth. Eventually, grasping the sprit of western philosophy , we can view our life in quite a different view. In our time, facing the world of international, we should better understand the western culture, which is rooted in philosophy.

name.en: The Development of Taiwan Technology History

description.zh: 台灣科技發展史將討論二十世紀前半（1900-1950）部份重要技術引入台灣後，造成的影響與社會變遷。依時間先後，先從農業技術的變革-綠色革命。其次研讀有關電力與水利的技術發展，然後進入工業化初期的台灣社會變遷，以及二次大戰期間軍需工業所引導出的初期重化工業。除了這些技術與產業變革之外，也將兼論及技術人物群像與職業教育的開端。
description.en: The main topics for class will discuss the important technology how to influence Taiwan society during 1900-1950. This class includes some important developments: Green revolution -it discuss about agriculture development; the technology development of electricity and water conservancy. In some topic we discuss about Taiwan society change in early days industrialization and chemical industry during world war II. Except those topics, technologists and the beginning of professional education in Taiwan will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將討論二十世紀後半(1950-1990)台灣重要科技產業與經濟發展的關聯性，同時也將從日常生活科技與社會的角度分析科技物設計的緣由，最後再帶入工程文化的認識與反思。This course will discuss the relationship between technology and industrial development in Taiwan during the second half of the 20th century (1950-1990). It will also analyze the reasons behind the design of technological objects from the perspectives of everyday life technology and society. Finally, it will delve into the understanding and reflection of engineering culture.

本學期各週的主題都對應到性別平等的概念，從各類文本揭示的性別分界、跨國籍、流行文化、性別認同等議題，引導學生思考與回應。著重啟發思辨（Explanation）和正向期許（Expectation）。

description.zh: 近代以降，由於戰爭的影響，臺灣歷經不同的政權和政體，諸如大清帝國、日本帝國及中華民國等。國際局勢、殖民統治、捍衛國土等緣由引發各式各樣的戰爭，戰爭促進臺灣的政治、社會、經濟、文化等層面的變革。因此以戰爭為主軸，認知臺灣在世界地緣位置的重要性，及其引起的各種戰爭類型，呈現戰爭在近現代臺灣各時期的各種風貌。臺灣是個位於西太平洋海陸交接地區的島嶼，在世界局勢變動的潮流之中，塑造其特有的戰爭型式及內涵。再者，臺灣各地有諸多戰爭遺址，不乏國定古蹟，可以藉由戰爭史的脈絡得知戰爭遺址的歷史空間及其文化資產的重要性。
description.en: Since modern times, due to the influence of wars, Taiwan has experienced different regimes and political systems, such as the Qing Empire, the Japanese Empire, and the Republic of China. The international situation, colonial rule, and defense of the country have triggered various wars. Wars have promoted changes in Taiwan’s politics, society, economy, and culture. Therefore, taking war as the main core, understanding the importance of Taiwan's geopolitics in the world, and the types of wars it caused, presents the various features of wars. Taiwan is an island located in the land-sea junction of the Western Pacific Ocean. In the changing tide of the world situation, Taiwan has shaped its unique war style and connotation. Furthermore, there are many military relics throughout Taiwan, and there are many national historical sites. Students can learn about the historical space of military relics and the importance of their cultural assets through the context of war history.

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

syllabi.outline:
主題：美好關係探索與實踐(請耐心看完說明)-★暫定5週採線上課程

本課程從家庭關係開啟自我探索、情緒舒展、自我擁抱到關係開展，融入簡單的理論概念，透過繪本、影片、體驗、互動、討論分享、塗繪、書寫等表達性藝術，在舒緩的氣氛中，引導同學逐步建構自我與人我關係發展的力量。

●溫馨提醒：
這門課從社會教育出發，僅提取部分心理學基礎概念，非學理性課程，亦非單向式講授，注重體驗互動，屬生活應用與實踐性質，課中常需跨出腳步與人互動連結，是一趟向內也向外的心靈探險，採類工作坊模式進行，請審慎評估再選課；第一堂即分組，須出席。

◎選課提醒：
●如非課程需要，上課禁用3C。
●如非身體不適，上課禁止睡覺。
●第一堂即分組，若無法準時出席請勿選課。
●課堂中常需與人互動分享，若還未有此心理準備請暫勿選課。
●課中多有表達性創作體驗，需自備物材：
  剪貼簿、A4紙或A4空白筆記本、12色粉蠟筆、膠水、剪刀、每組一張全開
  大書面紙、雜誌圖片等)。

每堂課皆以建構心靈健康為設計，如自我內在關係、家人關係、情緒釋壓、人我關係連結等，第一週到第十七週皆然。
第4項優質教育：確保包容和公平的教育
課堂互動中，以邀請與鼓勵取代勉強與責罰，尊重學生。課程引導尊重個人差異，欣賞不同特質展現，並提供多元且開放式的參與機會。如：第二、四、十六、十七週。
第5項性別平等
從廣義的尊重性別平等出發，提取性別權力關係與互動，並延伸情感教育的溝通協商與處理情感挫折的能力，融於第四、八、九週課程，進行體驗式學習。 
第17項夥伴關係
課程重視人際互動與群體合作，許多環節設計都需小組討論、策畫執行才有辦法完成，如第一、二、三、四、九、十五、十七週及第十八週期末報告。

description.zh: 婚姻是一般人所必經的過程，家庭是生活的場所，關係著人生的幸福與美滿。本課程強調美滿婚姻與幸福家庭是一門學問，因此，課程內容包括：對婚姻與家庭有正確的認知、積極的態度、完整的規劃，並培養有認真努力去實踐的方法與能力。如何追求真正的快樂與幸福？除了在婚姻與家庭中追求平等化、合理化、自由化、公平化外，自我成長、相互尊重都是本課程的學習目標，以協助學生思考婚姻與家庭的終生大事。
description.en: Marriage is a process that most people will go through.  Family is where you belong to, and where the satisfaction and happiness come from. We believe that it is a kind of scholarship to have a high-quality marriage and a wonderful family.  The contents of this course include having the correct understanding of marriage and family, cultivating positive attitude, developing complete plans, and realizing them with all efforts. This course will help students think totally about marriage and family, learn to pursue equality, reasonableness and liberty, keep growing and respect each other, so that we can obtain the real delight and happiness.

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

syllabi.outline:
生命週期涵括人生全期，而黃金階段泛指20~35歲之青年期，雖然已經是法定之成年人，但卻是成年人之最早階段，人生之重大基礎皆在此探索與樹立的。其中，情感、愛情、性事、性別傾向也是在此階段被合理地期待著發展，但往往生涯才是被過度地觀注和投入，在離開校園進入社會之前，給自己一個探索性情愛的機會吧。
本課程末後階段則說明性別平等與性犯罪等相關法規，如家庭暴力防治法、性騷擾防治法、跟蹤騷擾防治法等等，提供務實法規之理解。

Life circle is the understanding of whole human being and golden age is between 20 to 35. It's the important base of life. You need to explore your feeling, loves, sex and gender for yourselves. We hope you can reduce the only duty of career development and increase understanding of intimate relationships. otherwise, we will introduce the Taiwanese regulations of gender equality in the end of courses.

親密關係是人際關係的核心問題，它關係著交友的態度、婚姻生活的幸福與社會的祥和。本課程由對兩性差異性的了解為基礎，以尊重為原則，在平等互助的精神中，建立兩性關係的和諧。本課程內容包括理論與實際的配合，儘量以生活化的內容貫穿其間，並注重課程內容的可實踐性，以協助學生處理兩性關係的難題。
另從生命週期之青年任務、家庭親子關係、世代背景來討論青年現時狀態，所面臨之獨立自主與發展自我和生涯的課題，也需要學習認識伴侶與相處，以及進入愛情的情感歷練，理解親密與界線，經歷分手與再追尋，在青年的黃金十年之中，探索自我生涯、人際關係、現實世界與親密關係的定位。

In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves and partners. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 人的身體一接觸自然界，便開始各個器官的功能，人不如機器，無法汰換零件，加上身體機能遇到問題之後，許多人往往不知如何處理應對，甚至身體出現徵兆也渾然不知。所以此科目最主要的目的是希望藉由對醫學的認識，讓大學生們更瞭解自己的身體，進而保護並時時自我偵測身體是否正常運作，要培養健全的大學生，而不是只會讀書的大病貓。
description.en: Once the human body contacts the natural environment, the organs of the body begin to function.  But the human body can not change it's organizational like machine.  So when our body's function is in trouble, we always have no idea how to solve it, either to find out.  One of these course's objection is to let college students understanding their own body by learning some important medical concepts.  We hope that our country both has excellent and healthy college students,  and not all sick.

syllabi.outline:
人的身體一旦接觸自然環境，便開始運作各個器官的功能。然而，與機器不同，人體無法任意更換零件。一旦身體機能出現問題，許多人常因缺乏相關知識，無法正確應對，甚至對早期徵兆渾然不覺。因此，本課程的主要目的是透過基礎醫學知識的介紹，幫助大學生了解自身身體構造與運作原理，培養自我健康管理的能力，能及早發現異常並主動應對。我們希望培養的是身心健全、具備健康素養的大學生，而非僅知埋首書本、卻忽視自身健康的學生。
Once the human body comes into contact with the natural environment, all of its organs begin to function. Unlike machines, however, the human body cannot simply replace its parts when problems arise. When physical functions begin to decline or show signs of abnormality, many people lack the knowledge to respond appropriately—or worse, fail to recognize the warning signs altogether.
The primary goal of this course is to provide students with a foundational understanding of medical science, enabling them to better understand how their bodies work. By doing so, they can monitor their own health, detect abnormalities early, and take proactive steps to maintain their well-being. Our aim is to cultivate well-rounded, healthy university students—not those who excel only academically while neglecting their physical health.

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

name.en: The Development of Taiwan Technology History

description.zh: 台灣科技發展史將討論二十世紀前半（1900-1950）部份重要技術引入台灣後，造成的影響與社會變遷。依時間先後，先從農業技術的變革-綠色革命。其次研讀有關電力與水利的技術發展，然後進入工業化初期的台灣社會變遷，以及二次大戰期間軍需工業所引導出的初期重化工業。除了這些技術與產業變革之外，也將兼論及技術人物群像與職業教育的開端。
description.en: The main topics for class will discuss the important technology how to influence Taiwan society during 1900-1950. This class includes some important developments: Green revolution -it discuss about agriculture development; the technology development of electricity and water conservancy. In some topic we discuss about Taiwan society change in early days industrialization and chemical industry during world war II. Except those topics, technologists and the beginning of professional education in Taiwan will be introduced.

syllabi.outline: 本課程將討論二十世紀後半(1950-1990)台灣重要科技產業與經濟發展的關聯性，同時也將從日常生活科技與社會的角度分析科技物設計的緣由，最後再帶入工程文化的認識與反思。This course will discuss the relationship between technology and industrial development in Taiwan during the second half of the 20th century (1950-1990). It will also analyze the reasons behind the design of technological objects from the perspectives of everyday life technology and society. Finally, it will delve into the understanding and reflection of engineering culture.

name.zh: 當代藝術與文化創意產業
name.en: Contemporary Art and Creative Industries of Culture

description.zh: 這門課的目標是介紹並討論當代人文思潮與創作的關係與研究。18星期的課程包括一次課外教學，以及邀請演講者和學生對話與討論，並有一套精選的幻燈片和錄影帶配合講授課程。
description.en: This course is to introduce a basic understanding of prevailing trend of contemporary thought and research of its relation of contemporary creation. An 18 weeks program including one field trips and possible some discussions with guest speakers. A concise selection of slides and videotapes are applied with lectures.

syllabi.outline: 藝術不僅是審美與表達的載體，更是創新思維的催化劑。本課程探索當代藝術如何與科學、產業、社會議題交匯，我們從藝術與科學的對話出發，探討視覺藝術如何受到不同科學的影響，並探討新興領域如文化科技應用作品、沉浸式展演、數位IP等，探討當代藝術如何拓展文化機構與文化產業的邊界。同時，課程也關注當代藝術的社會參與，包括環境永續、身份認同與潮流文化等，並透過知名經典的展覽與藝術家作品，以及時尚與藝術融合等知名創作，剖析創意如何形塑未來。課程將結合業師講座與代表性作品解析，鼓勵學生從跨領域的視角理解藝術，培養跨域與文化創新的思維模式。

description.zh: 為了讓學生有機會學習有系統的瞭解、接納自己，體諒父母、尊長，關愛別人，回饋社會，進而發揮潛能，自主自在的過一生，乃設計此種10～15人的獨特小團體，運用團體動力，以「交流分析」(Transactional Analysis,TA)為主要理論架構，採理論與實務、個別與團體並重方式，在師生積極參與中，討論、分享、成長。課程內容主要包含交流分析概述，人格結構與功能分析，自我圖，關愛經濟，愛的證言，交流方式分析，時間結構分析，心理遊戲分析，心理劇本分析的理論與習作等。
description.en: In a systematic way, this course will help students understand themselves, accept themselves, and understand their parents and elders.  Also, it teaches students how to care for other people and have contributions to society with a view to promoting students' potential and live their life self-confiently and freely.  The class is to be desinged into groups composed of 10 to 15 students in each section in order to make use of group interactions, to encourage students to actively participate in class discussion and experience sharing.  On the basis of Transactional Analysis(TA), both theory and practice, individual and group activities are emphasized.  Through such a focus, students will go through various stages leading to personal growth.  The contents of this course include: an introduction to TA, an analysis on personality, self-realization, caring and love experiences, transactional analysis, psychological tests, and game analysis, theory and exercise on psychological plays.

description.zh:
性、性別是人類與生俱來的課題，其與各時代之政治體系、法律規範及社會變遷有密不可分的關係法律中的性別議題，既是法律問題也是社會問題，需要結合法律領域與社會領域的知識，作跨領域教學與學習。
本課程配合性別平等教育政策趨勢，分就不同面向的法律規範中的相關性別議題，來讓學生了解近年來性別平等之相關法律意涵希望能在認知、情意、行動等層面，讓學生習得正確的性別權利意識，進而在國家公私領域中運用相關知識落實性別平等，以促進多元文化之下兩性平權發展。
description.en:
Sex and gender are inherent issues of human beings, and they are inseparable from the political system, legal norms and social changes of all ages. Gender issues in the law are both legal and social issues and need to be combined with the legal field and society Domain knowledge for cross-domain teaching and learning.
This course is in line with the gender equality education policy trend, and divides the relevant gender issues in different aspects of legal norms to let students understand the relevant legal implications of gender equality in recent years. Hopefully, students can learn from the levels of cognition, affection, and action. Correct awareness of gender rights, and then apply relevant knowledge to implement gender equality in the public and private sectors of the country, so as to promote the development of gender equality under multiculturalism.

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

syllabi.outline:
生命週期涵括人生全期，而黃金階段泛指20~35歲之青年期，雖然已經是法定之成年人，但卻是成年人之最早階段，人生之重大基礎皆在此探索與樹立的。其中，情感、愛情、性事、性別傾向也是在此階段被合理地期待著發展，但往往生涯才是被過度地觀注和投入，在離開校園進入社會之前，給自己一個探索性情愛的機會吧。
本課程末後階段則說明性別平等與性犯罪等相關法規，如家庭暴力防治法、性騷擾防治法、跟蹤騷擾防治法等等，提供務實法規之理解。

Life circle is the understanding of whole human being and golden age is between 20 to 35. It's the important base of life. You need to explore your feeling, loves, sex and gender for yourselves. We hope you can reduce the only duty of career development and increase understanding of intimate relationships. otherwise, we will introduce the Taiwanese regulations of gender equality in the end of courses.

親密關係是人際關係的核心問題，它關係著交友的態度、婚姻生活的幸福與社會的祥和。本課程由對兩性差異性的了解為基礎，以尊重為原則，在平等互助的精神中，建立兩性關係的和諧。本課程內容包括理論與實際的配合，儘量以生活化的內容貫穿其間，並注重課程內容的可實踐性，以協助學生處理兩性關係的難題。
另從生命週期之青年任務、家庭親子關係、世代背景來討論青年現時狀態，所面臨之獨立自主與發展自我和生涯的課題，也需要學習認識伴侶與相處，以及進入愛情的情感歷練，理解親密與界線，經歷分手與再追尋，在青年的黃金十年之中，探索自我生涯、人際關係、現實世界與親密關係的定位。

In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves and partners. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.en: "Erudition & Refinement" is among the most essential in the field of General Education. The Lecture focuses on a "single theme" through the teaching/learning of "a diversity of knowledge. The course areas cover universe. The lecture will consist of six to eight units, which will be taught by different experts and scholars. In addition to the classroom teaching, there may also be "Experiencing Teaching On the Spot"-or rather, a visit to the location in question or practicum.

課程目標：
透過資訊安全教育，培養學生的資安意識與技能，增進科技素養，建立防禦思維與實作能力，提升資訊應用中的安全性，並啟發其持續學習與探索資訊安全領域的興趣，以奠定終身學習與生涯發展的基礎。本課程之內容為：一、資訊與網路安全簡介，二、安全與風險管理，三、存取控制概念，四、網路攻擊技術與防禦，五、安全操作系統與應用，六、資訊安全弱點與威脅，七、資安事件處理與應變，八、資通安全框架應用。

This course is designed to cultivate students' awareness and skills in information security through education, enhance their technological literacy, establish defensive thinking and practical abilities, improve the security of information applications, and inspire continued learning and exploration in the field of information security. The course aims to lay the foundation for lifelong learning and career development. The course includes: 1. An introduction to information and network security; 2. Security and risk management; 3. Concepts of access control; 4. Network attack techniques and defenses; 5. Secure operating systems and applications; 6. Information security vulnerabilities and threats; 7. Incident handling and response; 8. Applications of cybersecurity frameworks.

description.zh: 現代科技文明進展得非常迅速，這使得一般人日常生活中，可能經常享受到這些科技所帶來的便利，但卻習以為常，以為天生下來就是這樣的，這些現代的科技，可能是關於電機的、物理的、化工的、光電的、材料的......，更有可能同時涉及了其他許多個領域，更可能有許多人希望能夠了解這些科技的來龍去脈，一窺其究竟，人類在沒有土木工程學之前，早已能建築萬里長城和金字塔，許許多多的科技是由嘗試錯誤，經驗的累積逐漸得來的，當然，隨著知識的不斷窮究其理，"知而後行"的高科技也就會越來越多，我們在這裡也試圖去追蹤各項科技的演進史與現況方面讓大家知道羅馬不是一天所造成的，另一方面也讓大家有從另一個角度重新思考的機會，也許這些科技進化到現在，還稱不上成熟的階段，您也許可以找出另一種更好的方法來改進它們！
description.en: Modern technology is growing fast. People thus enjoy the convenience in company with the technology—which they do and they just take it for granted to do. It may have something to do with electrical engineering, physics, chemical engineering, electro-optical engineering, materials…Some problems involves more than one field. People are curious about the technology and willing to know how to solve the problems. Human beings are able to build the pyramids and the Long Walls before they know anything about civil engineering—knowledge actually piled up by trial and error or accumulated experience. As knowledge expands, hi-end technology which requires “know-how” becomes more popular. In this course, we try to trace the history and the current situations: “Rome was not built in a day.” On the other hand, we might take another chance to RE-think a deeper problem: technology evolves without getting to maturity. Human beings will be enforced to find some other ways to improve it.

syllabi.outline: 現代科技文明進展得非常迅速，雖然一般人日常生活中經常享受到這些科技所帶來的便利，但卻習以為常而忽略背後的原理，本課程介紹各項科技技術的入門技術與發展歷史，引導同學以批判性思考角度省思科技產業發展，培養對科技發展相關議題（倫理、環保、商業等等）獨立思考的能力；另外本課程也準備數週的專題討論，特別討論能源相關議題，因為無論何種科技，均與能源使用有關，本課程一方面介紹節能科技，另一方面也討論綠能（包含太陽能、風能、生質能與其他新能源）的開發及使用。

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

syllabi.notes:
本課程涉及
SDG2：消除飢餓
SDG3：健康福祉
SDG5：性別平等
SDG6：潔淨水與衛生
SDG13：氣候行動
*指標對應授課內容：
SDG2：消除飢餓；第3週授課主題「飲食與健康」對應SDG2中的發展國民飲食營養相關指引及素材。
SDG3：健康福祉；第2-7週授課主題「健康促進」「癌症防治」「傳染病的認識與預防」「物質濫用防制」對應SDG3的推動第四期國家癌症防治計畫；積極推動多元愛滋篩檢與諮詢服務、感染者診斷即刻服藥、以及暴露愛滋病毒前預防性投藥（PrEP）等防治政策，15-49歲愛滋感染新增人數持續下降；持續透過多元管道推動慢性呼吸道疾病防治工作，以降低慢性呼吸道疾病過早死亡機率；提高藥、酒癮治療服務涵蓋率。
SDG 5：性別平等；第7週授課內容愛滋病、HPV、猴痘、病毒性肝炎，從傳染病談性教育與性傳染病防治。
SDG6：潔淨水與衛生；在第1週健康促進課程導論介紹影響健康的環境因素，第3週健康飲食、第4週腸道傳染病，都與水質衛生息息相關。
SDG13：氣候行動；第16週授課主題「環境急症-過冷、過熱與氣候變遷對健康的影響」對應SDG13中的採取緊急行動應對氣候變遷及其衝擊，增進氣候變遷調適能力。

description.zh: 現今企業面臨嚴峻的挑戰，諸如科技變革、市場波動、政治鬥爭、氣候變遷等，變動頻繁的經濟、社會、自然環境，都是對企業永續經營的考驗。近年來，「永續創新」幫助企業永續發展的作用引起學者、經理人和政策制定者的廣泛關注，由於創新是解決經濟、社會和環境問題的關鍵，企業愈來愈傾向於投入永續創新，透過全新或改良的產品、服務、管理流程、系統程序、商業模式等，創造共享的社會和商業價值，減少對環境造成的負面影響。因此，永續創新指的是持續提升產品、流程與人力品質，共同為您的客戶、員工與環境打造一個更光明永續的未來。
description.en: Nowadays, firms face severe challenges, such as technological revolutions, market fluctuations, political conflict, and climate change. This swiftly transforming economic, social, and environmental milieu poses rigorous tests to corporate sustainability. In recent years, the concept of "sustainable innovation" has garnered significant attention from academics, executives, and policymakers, acting as a cornerstone in facilitating the sustainable progression of organizations. Innovation stands as an essential tool in grappling with economic, societal, and environmental quandaries, prompting an increasing number of companies to channel resources towards sustainable innovation. Such investment aims to generate shared socio-economic value and curtail adverse environmental impacts by pioneering or refining business products, services, processes, procedures, and methodologies. Therefore, sustainable innovation refers to continuously improving the quality of products, processes and people, and

syllabi.schedule:
第1週	ESG概述與SDGs	ESG目的、實踐、發展趨勢與永續發展目標
第2週	ESG的理論基礎	ESG三維度、企業社會責任與ESG投資理論
第3週	環境ESG	核心要素、環境ESG的法規和國際標準國際
第4週	氣候變化與碳排管理	氣候變化與溫室氣體效應、碳排管理與產品碳足跡
第5週	資源管理和循環經濟	資源短缺的原因、資源短缺對於環境、社會和經濟的影響與循環經濟行動計劃
第6週	ESG的社會	ESG與SDGs、ESG與社會公平與ESG企業的社會責任與
第7週	ESG的治理	ESG治理的指標與報告與ESG治理的風險管理
第8週	ESG績效的評估	ESG績效評估的指標、ESG績效評估的框架與ESG績效評估的數據收集
第9週	ESG報告與披露	ESG報告的目的和價值與ESG報告的內容和範圍
第10週	期中報告	研讀ESG台灣上市公司的永續報告書及大學社會責任年度報告書
第11週	台灣ESG現狀、挑戰與未來	ESG對開發中國家和未開發國家的影響差異性? 台灣ESG發展現況
第二部分 永續創新的實踐
第12週	永續產品設計(實踐個案)	綠色材料、降低排放量，或使用可回收且效率更高的耗材
第13週	永續製造(實踐個案)	精實生產與實踐、智慧製造
第14週	服務管理(服務永續個案)	服務最佳化方案與服務零件管理
第15週	人力資源永續管理(加速與學習技能個案)	了解擴增實境之類的技術如何透過沉浸式訓練內容同時加速推動遠端與在職學習
第16週	永續經營(施振榮先生之王道心法)	宏碁集團創辦人施振榮先生創業四十年來，對於現代企業的文化、經營、管理都有獨到的看法，他曾出版過一系列相關的好書，我曾拜讀過《利他，最好的利己》及《微笑走出自己的路》，對他的經驗和智慧欽佩不已。
第17週	從變局到新局─隱形冠軍的永續之路	「台灣產業本身就可視為一種隱形冠軍的概念，已在全球供應鏈上享有關鍵影響力。帶動轉型思維並培養更具競爭力的產業新世代。
第18週	期末報告	聚焦於永續性的三大面向：環境、社會及經濟。在審視產品生命週期時，製造商應當預期會有在生命週期之初引入永續概念的必要，產品設計及工程階段都迫切需要永續方面的改進。模仿個案作法,以團體做出一個簡易創新的想法與如何實踐。(以國外案例優先)

description.zh: 梁任公說：「孔子這個人有多少價值，連帶的論語也有多少價值。」所以論語是瞭解孔子最好的一部古經典。本課程旨在透過論語誘使學者對孔子的精神面貌有一番真切的體認，並使學者由而知曉儒家何以能深深影響著二千多年來國人的思想言行。
description.en: As Qishau Liang states, "Lueng Yu is as valuable as Confucius." Therefore, Lung Yu is the best classics, which provide easy access to deepening the understanding of Confucius. The course aim at sharpening students' knowledge about Confucius and Confucian school that has exerted profound influence on Chinese for over two thousand years.

As Qishau Liang states, "Lueng Yu is as valuable as Confucius." Therefore, Lung Yu is the best classics, which provide easy access to deepening the understanding of Confucius. The course aim at sharpening students' knowledge about Confucius and Confucian school that has exerted profound influence on Chinese for over two thousand years.

description.zh: 本課程以培養學生尊重與欣賞不同族群、不同時空、不同價值觀所產生的音樂而設。藉由對音樂元素、本質的認知及介紹，欣賞各時期作曲家之代表作品，培養西方音樂的基本常識，建立音樂欣賞的專業態度。教學目標：1.提高學生音樂欣賞的素養，充實其音樂生活的內涵，2.激發學生對音樂的興趣，培育愛樂人口，增進社會祥和的原動力，3.介紹古今中外音樂名家名作，啟發學生對音樂創作的認知與敬重，4.建立學生對古典音樂、民族音樂、應用音樂及通俗音樂等不同類型音樂的正確認知與包容力，培養世界性的音樂觀。授課內容：1.概論, 2.歌樂, 3.器樂, 4.儀式音樂, 5.舞蹈音樂, 6.戲劇音樂。
description.en: This course aims to cultivate students' ability to appreciate music of different ethnic groups, different time and place, different value systems. Through the introduction of basic music elements as well as the appreciation of the masterpieces of various composers, it is hoped that students will build up basic music knowledge about music and enhance professional music appreciation potentiality in music. The goals include: 1. Elevating students' capability in music appreciation 2. Inspiring students' interest in music with a view to improving our society into a harmonious world. 3. Introducing domestic and international famous composers' pieces 4. Touring of various forms of music: classical, ethnic, applied and popular music. Contents of this course include: 1.Introduction 2. Vocal music 3. Instrumental music 4. Ritual music 5. Dance music 6. Theatre music

syllabi.outline:
本課程的特色是希望藉由管弦樂音樂的播放，與實體樂器的展示、示範演出，互相結合，使同學在欣賞高水準的音樂之餘，更能實際接觸到平常接觸不到的實體樂器，實際的觀察樂器的構造，近距離的欣賞到樂器，能聽到實際上發出的聲音，從而對材料機械，科技與樂器聲響之間的關係，有一個真實而全新的認識，進而引發對音樂的認識以及興趣。
The feature of the course is that, through playing music, physical instrument display an demonstration of performances, the students come into contact with the usual musical instruments. Observing the instrument configuration and listening the sound in close distance lead to a true and a new understanding of the relationship between material mechanics and musical sound, and thus trigger and interest in music.

name.zh: 二十世紀中國現代文學與文化建構
name.en: The modern literature and cultural construction in twentieth century China

description.zh: 本課程關注的焦點將以都市文學和民族/文化/現代建構為基底，以“五四”文學以來的總體概述為起始的一個發現之旅。課程將以夏志清的中國現代小說史為起點，進而以李歐梵對於民國初年出版商和作家和他們的貢獻作為對照，來做為現代城市文化風景的呈現。課程中將以安德森”想像的共同體”為背景，解釋它被各種文化論述所引用的觀點，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於民族建構的貢獻。
description.en: We arrange the course that is based on urban literatures, with issues about the race, culture and the construction of the modern world. The students in the course will be guided into a tour of discovery, which is summed up and initiated from “May 4th Movement”. The progress of course will be mapped out from “A History of Modern Chinese Fiction” compiled by C. T. Hsia (夏志清), and then the analysis from Leo Lee, and other writers, will be compared to exhibit the style and features of modern urban literatures. According to the theory of “Imagined Communities” which is authored by B. Anderson, we will also explain the viewpoints from different cultures, and comment on the analyses to the race construction with varied points of view.

syllabi.outline:
This course adapts a genealogy perspective and begins with a general overview of modern Chinese literature as a journey of discovery. The course will start with an introduction of A new literary history of modern China edited by Wang David Der-wei Wang (王德威), and then review how Wang succeeded Chih-tsing Hsia’s (夏志清)   work to present a new, diversify, and historically poetic version of Chinese literature history. This course will take these authors as cases for discussion, mapping Lu Hsun (魯迅)and Eileen Chang (張愛玲). With further navigating their positions in the literary genealogy, the lecturer aims to address how their literary works construct contemporary culture. In addition, two films, Spring in a Small Town and New Women, will be discussed in order to understand the cultural situation at that time.
本課程將以華語譜系為視角，以中國現代文學的總體概述為起始，進行一場發現之旅。課程將以王德威的《哈佛新編中國現代文學史》切入，介紹王德威如何繼承夏志清的工作，呈現新格局、輻射的、「史蘊詩心」的中國文學史呈現。課程中將著重介紹魯迅、張愛玲的文學地位，解釋他們在文學系譜上承前啟後的位置，以各種面向來看待文學作品對於當代文化建構的貢獻。此外，也將特別探討《小城之春》與《新女性》兩部電影，以了解當時的文化情境。

description.zh:
每個人都不想孤獨地活著，學習建立親密關係是幸福的來源。
本課程透過講解、討論、體驗、分享，幫助學生認識自己，發揮最大潛能，懂得溝通連結，能處理情緒與壓力，尊重個別差異與性別平等，從而尋覓最對的人。
在親密關係中鼓勵彼此做最真最喜歡的自己，也樂於分工合作，建立最美好的家庭，進而活出有意義有價值的人生。
本課程是真正的成年禮，從自我到互依，是成長與成熟的必修課。
description.en:
Nobody wants to live a lonely life. Having an intimate relationship is a source of happiness.
In this course, students will be given a skill set for understanding themselves, exploring their potential and managing emotional stress. They will also learn to communicate and connect with others through personal sharing, group discussions and in-class exercises. Issues like individual difference and gender equality will be emphasized, since respecting each other is the base for any good relationship, not to mention finding the right partner.
It is only when both partners are true to themselves and like the way they are in the relationship will they be willing to share the hard and fun work of building a family and living a meaningful life together.
One can see this course as a rite of passage into adulthood.  It is a prerequisite for growing mature, from being self-centered to being able to rely on one another.

description.zh: 現代人的健康問題50％以上導因於生活型態與行為模式，傳統以疾病治療為主的醫療模式已無法因應目前民眾的健康需求，健康促進、危急救護等觀念正被廣泛應用，本課程內容包含三大部分，包括「健康及其影響因素」、「健康促進相關議題」、「安全教育與急救」，藉由系統性健康教育與資訊傳播，使學生能習得正確健康知能及技能，幫助學生建立健康行為模式，使其健康能獲得更好的自我控制。
description.en: More than 50% of modern men’s health problems attributes from living style and behavior. The tradition way for curing illness has failed to fulfill people’s requirements. Conceptions such as health promoting and emergencies dealing are now being wildly used. This course mainly focuses on three issues, including “health and its affected cause,” “related issues on health promotion”, and “safety education and emergency treatment.” Through systematical health education and information spreading, students acquire the correct health knowledge and skills, to help students lead a healthy life and to get a better self-control on own health.

description.zh: 本課程旨在介紹電子科技產業趨勢及智慧財產權管理策略，第一部分介紹電子科技產業發展趨勢；第二部分介紹智慧財產權管理策略與模式；第三部分以個案研討方式，帶領學生討論相關產業之智慧財產權管理實務，包含品牌管理、專利布局策略、商標申請與運用、著作權議題、營業秘密之保護等相關案例。

description.zh: 本課程探討永續能源技術與政策對環境與公共健康的影響，內容涵蓋太陽能、核能、海洋再生能源等技術，並結合能源法規、環境健康、氣候變遷等議題。課程透過提供跨領域視角，幫助學生理解能源發展如何影響社會、經濟與健康，培養分析與解決永續發展問題的能力。
description.en: This course explores the impact of sustainable energy technologies and policies on the environment and public health. It covers technologies such as solar energy, nuclear energy, and marine renewable energy, and integrates topics like energy regulations, environmental health, and climate change. By offering an interdisciplinary perspective, the course helps students understand how energy development affects society, economy, and health, while fostering the ability to analyze and solve sustainable development issues.

description.zh:
新創事業面臨許多的挑戰，包括：避與大企業競爭，找到存活的依據、從無到創立強勢品牌、創立或擴張自有市場/消費者據點等。本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何平衡有限資源以迎向挑戰。
新創企業已發展成熟的企業是不一樣，主要是因為新創事業的資源有限，創業家必須同時兼顧許多面向並回應顧客所需。本課程旨在協助修課同學思考創建企業應注意的各種面向評估自己的創能力。
課程包含了三大部份，第一部份為創新與創業概念啟發；第二部份在辨別市場機會與發展市場；最後第三部份為新創事業行銷管理。行銷活動能夠將企業的產品及服務傳遞給顧客；並將產品、服務及企業本身的資訊帶到市場上；將顧客資訊回饋給企業。創業行銷管理能夠幫助創業者向潛在投資者及企業夥伴銷售創意以獲得資源，也讓創業家透過創新的商業手法來充分利用稀少的資源。
description.en:
Managers must have excellent leadership skills in order to A start-up company has lots of challenges, such as: niche market located and brand diffusion. The course intends to encourage the participant to become an entrepreneur and handle with these challenges. A start-up company is different from well-developed one due to limited resources. Usually, to response customer’s requirement, the entrepreneur must take multiple criteria into consideration simultaneously.
    The course includes three parts. Part I build students’ concept about innovation and entrepreneurship. Part II is about market identification. Part III is about marketing management of a start-up company. The efficient marketing activities enable business to approach customer’s requirement, to bring their customer product (or services) and get customer’s feedback. Also, the marketing management helps entrepreneur to reach their potential investor to obtain more resources.

syllabi.outline:
透過分析創新成功之實際個案，讓修課同學了解創新的本質。課程中將介紹不同類型的創新個案，包括：技術創新、產品創新、服務創新與管理創新。本課程也擬搭配邀請成功之創業顧問與談，提供實務經驗，分享創業者該有的認知以及創業的重要理念，當然也包括分享他們在邀創業過程中所面臨的各類挑戰。
創業是每個人都曾經懷抱過的夢想，透過創新成功之個案的分析，可以了解到個案公司是如何有步驟的循序漸進。針對每個個案，我們要求每位同學於課前完成個案的閱讀，並於上課前交出本次課程的課前預習心得。我們希望每位參與的同學都能在討論時充分表達意見，遇有不清楚或不同意見時能夠勇於提出他們的看法。本課程擬營造出一種研究的環境，讓學生可以針對個案盡其所能清楚的提出建議並來說服同儕。

description.zh:
近年來各大學積極推動「大學社會責任實踐（University Social Responsibility, USR）計畫」，期許大學師生對在地方發展及公共議題發揮熱情與創意，與地方居民及企業協力推動社區及產業發展。
大學社會責任工作主要是透過社會創新，解決社會問題，來實踐社會責任所謂社會創新，就是用創新的方法來解決社會問題，產生「社會影響力」（Social Impact），並設法改變處在社會問題「當中的人」以及與這個人有關的「社會情境」（social context），來產生長久的社會影響
本課程，將向同學生講解社會責任基本觀念，以介紹學社會責任的理念構想與實踐經驗，並移地教學，地方場域問題作為主題報告討論素材等方式，來增強學生進行社會創新的態度、認知和行為。
description.en: In recent years, universities have actively promoted the "University Social Responsibility (USR) Program", expecting university teachers and students to show enthusiasm and creativity in local development and public issues, and work with local residents and enterprises to promote community and industrial development. This course will explain the basic concepts of social responsibility to the students, introduce the concepts and practical experience of each USR project team of our school, and use the case experience to share and discuss, and use USR field issues as the topic report discussion material. Guide students to participate in university social responsibility work, and enhance the attitude, cognition and behavior of social innovation.

name.en: Satellite Remote Sensing Applications and Lab

description.zh: 本課程將介紹衛星遙測技術基礎，包括衛星通訊軟體及硬體，以及在地球科學、環境管理、農業和城市規劃中的應用。透過理論講授、案例研究和實習，學生將了解衛星遙測技術原理及其在各領域的實際應用。課程強調實際應用和解決問題的能力，並提供實習機會，讓學生參與衛星遙測專案，培養操作技能和解決問題的能力。
description.en: This course will cover the basics of satellite remote sensing technology, including satellite communication software and hardware, as well as its applications in Earth sciences, environmental management, agriculture, and urban planning. Through theoretical lectures, case studies, and practical exercises, students will gain an understanding of the principles of satellite remote sensing technology and its practical applications in various fields. The course emphasizes practical applications and problem-solving skills, providing labs for students to participate in satellite remote sensing projects and cultivate their operational skills and problem-solving abilities.

description.zh: 本課程致力於深入研究各種低軌道衛星地面站系統的複雜結構和相關元素。課程首先介紹低軌道衛星地面站系統的基本概念，包括其在衛星通訊中的角色和功能。學生將深入了解地面站系統在支援低軌道衛星通訊方面的重要性。接著，課程將詳細介紹不同類型的地面站，如海事衛星、GEO/LEO地面站以及固定式/移動式地面站。學生將學會分析這些地面站的特點、應用場景，以及相應的技術要求。課程的內容還包括天線次系統，涵蓋天線的種類、原理和性能特點。同時，課程將探討LOC（地面中控系統）的功能和重要性，使學生瞭解地面站系統的集中控制和管理。接下來，學生也將深入研究資料介接網路，包括資料的傳輸方式、協定和安全性，以確保地面站系統的有效運作。最後，課程將關注其他支援系統，包括電源、控制和機構等，使學生全面理解地面站系統的整體結構和運作機制。透過實例分析，學生將獲得地面站系統架構解析的實際能力。
description.en: This course introduces the structure and key components of Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite ground station systems. Students will learn the fundamental roles and functions of these systems in satellite communication, gaining insights into various types such as maritime, GEO/LEO, and fixed/mobile ground stations. The course examines their application scenarios and technical requirements, and explores antenna subsystems, including their types and performance. It also covers the Local Operations Center (LOC), highlighting centralized control and system management. Additionally, data interface networks are discussed, with emphasis on transmission methods, protocols, and security. Supporting systems like power and control mechanisms are introduced. Practical case studies help students understand and analyze ground station architectures.

This course explores the complex structure of various Low Earth Orbit (LEO) satellite ground station systems, introducing fundamental concepts and their roles in satellite communication. Students gain a profound understanding of the pivotal role these systems play in supporting LEO satellite communication. The course analyzes different ground station types, including maritime satellites, GEO/LEO ground stations, and fixed/mobile ground stations, detailing their characteristics, applications, and technical requirements. It also covers antenna subsystems, the Local Operations Center (LOC), data interface networks, and supporting systems like power and control. Practical case analyses help students develop skills in deciphering ground station system architecture.

description.en: This course develops professional English communication for a globalized world, integrating technology, business, social, and cultural perspectives. Students explore key topics like emerging technologies, international business, and digital economies, learning to analyze information and communicate effectively in diverse professional contexts. The course emphasizes understanding these areas to enhance global workplace proficiency.

syllabi.outline:
This course is designed to:
(1) strengthen students' previously acquired knowledge of English by reviewing fundamental grammatical concepts and sentence structures through level-appropriate reading materials;
(2) develop reading skills through explanation of challenging vocabulary, phrases, and syntax, along with the analysis of fundamental writing techniques;
(3) familiarize students with practical conversational expressions and enhance their confidence in cross-cultural communication; and
(4) reinforce their competence and performance in listening, speaking, reading, and writing through consistent practice.

In addition, the course incorporates the use of artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support language learning. Students will explore how AI-assisted platforms—such as grammar checkers, pronunciation analyzers, conversation simulators, and personalized vocabulary trainers—can be used to enhance autonomous learning, provide real-time feedback, and improve overall language proficiency.

本課程旨在：

(1) 鞏固學生既有的英語知識，透過符合其程度的閱讀教材，複習基本語法概念與句型結構；
(2) 發展閱讀能力，透過講解困難詞彙、片語與句法結構，並分析基礎寫作技巧，以提升理解與寫作表達；
(3) 使學生熟悉實用的會話用語，並增強其跨文化溝通的自信心；
(4) 透過反覆練習，加強聽、說、讀、寫四項語言技能的能力與表現。

此外，課程亦納入人工智慧（AI）工具於語言學習中的應用。學生將學習如何運用各類 AI 輔助平台——如文法檢查器、發音分析工具、模擬對話系統，以及個人化詞彙學習軟體——以提升自主學習成效，獲得即時回饋，並全面增進語言能力。

syllabi.outline:
Through weekly readings and class discussion, this course will help develop students’ English conversation and reading skills.  In the course of practicing such skills, we will focus on an idea central to understanding the language and the culture of the West, and thus an idea central to understanding the people (their values, motivations, principles) of Western culture.   [Past topics for this course include: Monsters and the Human; Comedy and Humor; The Nature of Good and Evil; The Hero in the West; Baseball and Society; The Idea and the Importance of Beauty; Exploration and Discovery].   Examining essays and films centered around such a topic, we will consider what the significant idea tells us about Western society and its people.

透過每週閱讀和課堂討論，本課程將幫助培養學生的英語會話和閱讀能力。  在練習這些技能的過程中，我們將集中在理解西方語言和文化的核心思想，從而理解西方文化中的人們（他們的價值觀、動機和原則）的核心思想。   [本課程的過去主題包括：怪物與人類；喜劇與幽默；善與惡的本質；西方英雄；棒球與社會；美的概念與重要性；探索與發現。   透過研究圍繞這一主題的文章和電影，我們將思考這個重要想法如何告訴我們有關西方社會及其人民的資訊。

description.zh: 本課程通過閱讀各種文本（包括新聞文章、社論、報告和研究論文）來檢視當代文化中之社會和政治動態。 透過引導學生觀察、分析和理解當代/流行文化的複雜性和模糊性。 本課程將閱讀及討論引人入勝的文化故事、事件和趨勢，培養學生的批判性分析能力和文化素養。
description.en:
This course examines important social, political, ethical, and aesthetic ideas in contemporary culture by examining a variety of audio-visual and written texts, including news articles, editorials, research papers, academic essays, videos, websites, movies, and stories.  Students will practice observing and analyzing significant cultural phenomena in an effort to better understand how ideas, beliefs, and values develop and change over time, and are shaped by both longstanding traditions and by ever-changing popular trends.
The course introduces fascinating cultural stories, events, issues, and trends to be studied, in order to develop students’ critical thinking, analytic skills, and cultural literacy.

description.zh: 音樂概論以透過此課程讓學生對音樂有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及文化背景，同時在探索音樂美感構成上的標準，我們可以從探索不同歷史時期的人文思想背景，了解對於當時音樂創作理念與風格發展的影響，以及音樂審美觀念的發展演變之影響，立基於探索音樂的發展方向、藝術本質及審美意涵，對音樂藝術概念及美學思想之延伸探討。
description.en: Through this course—Introduction to Music, students would have a general understanding of music, understand the elements of music, technical theory and cultural background, at the same time in the music aesthetic to explore the composition of the standard, through exploring the different historical periods of humanistic background, to understand for the time that the idea of music composing and the impact of musical style development, as well as the development of music aesthetic concept of the evolution of the impact, based on discussing the development of music, the essence of art, and aesthetic meaning, to develop the concept of musical art, as well as a probe into the extension of aesthetic thought.

syllabi.outline:
This is a history course of western classical music, of which the definition, according to The New Harvard Dictionary of Music and The Oxford Dictionary, is "art music” or "serious music", that written in a Western musical tradition, using an established form. "Classical music is generally considered to be serious and to have a lasting value.”
The styles of various periods will be introduced, from the Medieval, Renaissance, Classical, Romantic, to the Contemporary eras. The goal of this course is helping students to equip a general comprehension of Classical Music in terms of basic elements of musical art, technical theory, historical, social and cultural background extends to related arts and humanities. 
In addition, basic elements of music notation reading and theory will also be made known to the students.
Other genres such as Alternative Rock and related fields will be interlaced with the Classical Music. 

In order to pursue the most accurate references and info, the major key-points and terminology used in this course will be in English or original European text.
(There are requirements to fulfill this course such as Midterm & Final Exams, as well as in-class presentation or performance. If you're not interested in serious music genre, please DO NOT take this course.)

此門課程為西洋藝術音樂史，即古典音樂歷史。根據「新哈佛音樂辭典」 ( New Harvard Dictionary of Music) 與 「牛津字典」 的詮釋，所謂古典音樂為「嚴肅藝術」音樂，以嚴謹成型的作曲公式創作音樂，經過歷史洗練的時間藝術。透過此課程學生對西洋古典音樂會有總體認識，了解音樂的元素、技術理論及社會人文背景，從音樂美感構成與相關人文藝術和文化歷史的議題作連結。
(此門課有期中考與期末考, 還有課堂現場報告或表演的要求, 如果對學術類型嚴肅音樂跟搖滾樂歷史沒有興趣, 強烈建議不要選修!)
syllabi.schedule:
1. 古希臘藝術與人文, 信仰: 古歐洲在基督教傳入前的文化, 音樂, 文學, 戲劇, 跟人文背景	
1st week: Introduction to Western Art Music—Greek origin as the foremost culture before Christianity entered Europe

2. 從基督教傳入, 到中世紀: 古歐洲承襲希臘時代以來的傳承, 展現於壁畫, 以及基督教傳入歐洲後對文化及藝術的影響; 音樂記譜方式, 表演方式,天主教會對社會的影響; 拜占庭建築到哥德式大教堂, 中世紀歐洲社會與歷史
2nd week: The Medieval Period--folk music, church music in relation to arts and culture

3. 中世紀到文藝復興音樂的演變(舞蹈與民謠): 庶民文化與音樂
3rd week: From Medieval to Renaissance period--Madrigals, church music, dance music.

4. 文藝復興時期: 宗教音樂由單一旋律演化為複音音樂, 作曲家 雕塑家. 畫家介紹. 以義大利為首的時代. 此時期受歡迎的樂器介紹; 源於德, 法, 蘇格蘭宗教改革與英國王室的關聯
4th week: Renaissance period--from Monophony to Polyphony; Introduction to Italian composers, artists, and some of the most popular musical instruments; the Reformed Church and Martin Luther that not only changed the society and belief system but also aethesticism in arts. 

5. 巴洛克時期: 法國巴洛克--英國巴洛克與法國巴洛克比較, 王室音樂跟庶民音樂介紹; 法王路易十四世與凡爾賽宮
5th week: Baroque--Louis XIV and his influence on French music,in comparison to English Baroque

6. 巴洛克時期:	義大利式協奏曲介紹; 巴洛克時代小型管弦曲; 宗教信仰不同形成南歐與北歐教堂建築文化迴異
6th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends--Corelli, Lully and Couperin, Introduction to Concerto Grosso

7. 巴洛克時期:	基本舞曲, 組曲形式--宮廷舞步與巴洛克芭蕾
7th week: Baroque--Italian and French legends continues--Vivaldi, Scarlatti, and Rameau--Court Dance and French Ballet

8. 巴洛克時期: 德意志巴洛克--韓德爾, 泰雷曼, 巴赫
8th week: Baroque--Comparison among Handel, Telemann, and J.S.Bach

9. 巴洛克時期: 深度探討巴赫生平與作品
9th week: Baroque--J.S. Bach in-depth--his string works, orchestral music, choral music, keyboard music, and Fugues.

10. 	期中報告	
10th week: Midterm Report

11. 古典時期: 啟蒙時代崛起, 腓特烈二世 (普魯士) 對德意志音樂藝術的影響. 波次坦忘憂宮介紹; 盧梭之民約論, 丹麥王室實現其理念; 俄羅斯凱撒琳大帝對藝術的貢獻—聖彼得堡冬宮博物館介紹
11th week: Classical period (Classicism)--The Age of Enlightenment--Frederick the Great as a passionate patron of music and art; Danish royal house contributing Jean-Jacques Rousseau's ideology in Denmark; Catherine the Great and The Hermitage

12. 古典時期: 德奧樂派 (第一代維也納樂派); 葛路克與哈布斯堡家族及其小公主,後來為法國波旁王朝最後的皇后瑪麗．安東尼; 海頓, 莫札特, 貝多芬(前期)
12th week: The First Viennese School; Gluck and Habsburg family; Marie Antoinette

13. 浪漫派時期: 從貝多芬中期開啟德奧浪漫派
13th week: Romantic period--Beethoven and the beginning of Romantic era; how Schubert was influenced by Beethoven 

14. 浪漫派時期: 法國, 北歐, 波西米亞--區域性的不同風格
14th week: The pinnacle of Romantic era--Chopin, Schumann, Brahms, Liszt, Tchaikovsky, to the late Romantic period

15. 浪漫派時期: 國民樂派, 俄羅斯音樂與十九世紀俄國芭蕾
15th week: A counterpart of Romantic style with Naionalism--Music by Bohemian and Russian composers; 19th Century Russian ballet and music

16. 二十世紀現代樂派: 法國印象樂派, 第二代維也納樂派; 法國印象畫派與樂派的相輔相成; 包浩斯學院, Art Deco (裝飾風藝術) Art Nouveau (新藝術運動) 介紹
16th week: Impressionist Music, The Second Viennese School and related art styles in the period
17. 後現代主義: 音樂學界的實驗性音樂;	Phillip Glass獨創的極簡樂風; 電腦與傳統樂器結合
17th week: The Contemporary Music--from Twelve- tone music (The 2nd Viennese School) to Existentialism, music of Minimalism, and experimental music; comparison with other genres 

18:	期末考
18th week: Final Exam.

name.en: Cross Strait Relations and International Politics

description.zh:
本課程由全球化框架來檢視兩岸關係的演進、現況、及發展趨勢。
由政治、經濟、乃至社會心理層面分析海峽兩岸錯綜複雜的互動關係。
並檢視國際政治經濟體系中，美國與日本兩大國對兩岸關係的影響。
description.en:
This introductory course on the complex cross-strait interactions will examine
Taiwan’s role in the intricate web of international power politics; as well as the structure of hegemonic power rivalry, particularly Sino-US-Japan triangle, and its impact on cross strait relations. The material will cover the evolution, status quo, and developmental path of the cross strait relations in a global framework.

name.zh: 新世紀生醫產業創新科技
name.en: Innovative biomedical industries in the new millennium

description.zh: 介紹新興生醫產業的趨勢與其跨領域之特性。課程內容含: 生醫產業簡介, 新世紀人類基因體大計畫, 微生物工程新應用, 新型蛋白質藥劑之開發, 分子醫療診斷之革新, 生醫產業之電腦新科技, 遠距醫療服務新模式, 創新健康管理與保險制度的創新, 生醫產業與科技法律, 生醫產業與社會倫理, 幹細胞新產業, 組織再生新產業, 超級老鼠的誕生, 美美的生醫美容, 抗癌症研究之新科技, 抗傳染疾病之新科技。評分的方式以學生報告為主。
description.en: The course is to introduce the trends and the characteristics of biomedical industries in the new millennium. The course covers areas such as human genome project, biotechnology application with microbes, new protein drug, innovative medical technology, computation biology in biomedical industries, new business models in telemedicine, health care management and innovative insurance trends, technology laws in biomedical industries, social responsibility and biomedical industries, stem cell technology, new industries from tissue engineering and so on. The grading method of the course is based on the oral and written reports.

syllabi.outline:
Introduce the trend of the emerging biomedical industry and its cross-field characteristics. Course content includes: Introduction to the Biomedical Industry, New Century Human Genome Project, New Applications of Microbial Engineering, Development of New Protein Pharmaceuticals, Innovations in Molecular Medical Diagnosis, New Computer Technology in the Biomedical Industry, New Models of Telemedicine Services, Innovative health management and insurance system innovation, biomedical industry and technology law, biomedical industry and social ethics, new stem cell industry, new industry of tissue regeneration, the birth of super mice, beautiful biomedical beauty, new anti-cancer research technology, New technology to fight infectious diseases. The grading method is mainly based on student reports.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.
