description.zh: 課程將以體驗式教學訓練，提升學員表達技巧、舞台技巧、臨場反應。本課程主要目的在教授學生以設計思考思維與策略，運用主題式課程實戰小組簡報及個人簡報，快速釐清簡報製作及表達過程中重點，提升修課學員個人簡報製作能力及表達能力，幫助學生在未來創業及就業上以出色之個人簡報能力獲得面試者及投資者的青睞，領先於起跑點取得優勢。
description.en: The course will use experiential teaching training to improve students' expression skills, stage skills, and on-the-spot reactions. The main purpose of this course is to teach students establishing design thinking strategies. During the course practice group presentations and personal presentations training students to quickly clarify the key points in the process of presentation production and presentation, to improve the students' personal presentation production and presentation skills. Furthermore, assist students' entrepreneurship and employment in the future. Students who finished this course will be favored by interviewers and investors with his excellent personal presentation skills. And he will gain an advantage over the starting point.

description.zh: 帶領學生學習掌握人性因素需求與友善環境之設計思維與方法，預期學生能藉由學會設計思考流程延伸至創新創業的服務可能。結合與各式產業相關的人工智慧與永續環境校定特色主題，帶領同學作生活科技創新發想。
description.en: This course leads students to learn design thinking and methods to master the needs of human factors and a friendly environment. It is expected that students can extend the service possibilities of innovation and entrepreneurship by learning the design thinking process. Combining artificial intelligence and sustainable environment to design a special theme, leading students to create innovative ideas for life science and technology.

syllabi.outline: 設計思考是利用新的設想、新的技術手段轉變成更新並且改進過後的服務方式。從社會的角度而言，服務的創新是創造和開發人類自身價值,提高和完善生存質量，改善社會生態環境的活動。因此，服務創新通過滿足物質需求、精神和心理需求，並提供解決問題的能力，保障人們的精神和心理上的健康，得到滿足感和成就感。 本課程旨在啟發修課同學創業的興趣並協助修課同學思考新創事業如何提供改善對人類的服務。 以人的角度為出發設計出最好的設計

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh: 為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。
description.en: To encourage and help students using new technologies or new business models to solve problems in the society and the business world, this intense, pre-accelerator, 18-week course invites different professors and mentors with entrepreneurship experiences to help students develop their start-up ideas through workshops and startup competitions. The goal of this course is to help students realize their ideas and create actionable business solutions that can change the society.

syllabi.outline:
為了鼓勵以及幫助學生用技術或者商業模式，聯合學校老師或是跨校同學，用商業的手段共同解決社會或者商業問題，本課程將以衝刺班的形式，邀請有創業經驗的老師、業師，透過工作坊的形式，幫助學生逐週的推進創業進度以及創業競賽演練，目標是幫助學生落實創業想法，應用在社會中並且帶來改變。

如果你想體驗創業前該具備的專業與過程，如果你想學習在未來不論是升學(簡報設計、創業計畫書)或就業(Wix網站、Line官方帳號)或探索自己(行銷、財務)，任何一項能力都能讓你在未來年薪百萬甚至創業，因此這堂課絕對不是輕鬆可及的營養學分，但絕對是你人生經歷中的營養學分。

To encourage and help students use technology or business models, collaborate with school teachers or cross-school classmates, and jointly solve social or business problems through business methods, this course will be conducted in a sprint class format. We will invite teachers and industry professionals with entrepreneurial experience to help students progress weekly through workshops and entrepreneurship competition drills. The goal is to help students implement their entrepreneurial ideas, apply them to society, and bring about change.

If you want to experience the professional skills and processes required before starting a business, or if you want to learn skills that will be valuable whether you pursue further education (presentation design, business plan writing), employment (Wix website, Line official account), or self-exploration (marketing, finance), any of these abilities can help you earn a million-dollar annual salary in the future or start your own business. Therefore, this course is not an easy elective but a valuable life experience.

description.zh: 隨著科技的發展與產值快速成長，網路、電商、商業新模式等各式創業大行其道，成為許多創業者的新選擇，本課程邀請國內知名創業楷模或創業成功典範之企業經理人分享創業成功之經驗。以真實具體的創業經驗為教材，讓學生更深刻體驗創業家之精神。希冀以觀摩學習典範企業的具體經驗，帶領學生學習企業創新與創業的思維，進而激發學生追求成就的渴望，強化青年學子對人生願景的規劃。
description.en: Along with the prosperous development of Internet, the output value of E-commerce is growing fast. Launching a business on the internet has become a new choice for many entrepreneurs. We invite the domestic business manager, as the model of outstanding and successful enterprise, to share his experiences of achievement with students. By offering the real and specific examples, business manager will make students learn further about the enterprisers' entrepreneurship. Through their experiences, we hope students can learn innovations and creations of enterprise; furthermore, students can be inspired to pursue their ambition to strengthen their wills to plan the future.

description.zh: 輔具是輔助器具的簡稱，舉凡日常生活，能使活動更容易、方便的各種用具皆屬之，正確的使用輔具可以改變身心障礙者或老年人原本有障礙的生活，走入社會，降低社會成本。本課程為專案導向課程，課程中除教授輔具設計基本概念，透過實際個案訪談分析目標對象，以工作坊形式找出使用者痛點，進而發展解決方案，提出適切的輔具資源，以幫助身心障礙者或老年人族群。
description.en: Assistive device is the abbreviation of auxiliary equipment. For everyday life, all kinds of utensils that make activities easier and convenient belong to it. Correct use of assistive device can change the life of people with physical and mental disabilities or the elderly who have obstacles, and enter the society and reduce Social costs. This is a project-oriented course. The course introduces the concept of auxiliary equipment; students can also analyze target audience through different case studies. During workshops, it helps students indicate users’ pain points and develop the solutions. The goal of this course is to come out with the resources to help people with disabilities or the elderly.

description.zh:
隨著高齡化社會的來臨與國家對於身心障礙者生活福祉的重視，輔助科技相關資源與人才需求日益倍增，各類輔具產品使用已成為這些族群在醫療照護上與生活品質提升上不可或缺的一環。本門課程為「生醫輔助科技跨域微學程」之入門基礎課程，建立學生對輔助科技有基本的通盤認識，期許未來具備相關能力投入輔助創新產品研發。若未來有志投入輔助科技相關產業工作，建議微學程可由此門課程開始選修。
由於輔助科技涵蓋醫學與工程相關領域專業知識技術的整合，故由本校與臺北醫學大學攜手合作，兩校多位教師一同共授，提供兩校各20位學生選修，以促進學生或教師間的交流合作，本課程上課地點除了在本校，將有部分週次於北醫校園上課。
description.en: With the advent of aging society and the country's emphasis on the well-being of people with physical and mental disabilities, the demand of assistive technology resources and manpower is getting increased. The use of various assistive products has become an indispensable part for these people in medical care and quality of life. Assistive technology covers and integrates expertise in medicine and engineering related fields. The aims of this course are to let students have the comprehensive understanding of the current status and future trends of assistive technology. This course is the basic course for the “Assistive Technology Interdisciplinary Program”. If students consider to involve assistive technology-related industries in the future, we encourage students to enroll this course.

description.en: This course explores the rapidly developing fields of big data for the efficiency of decision making in various fields. The topics are about basic concepts of data manipulations, analytic, and communications which are including: introduction to big data; basic knowledge of data mining; special topics of big data in business Analytics, and data analytic project. The course will help students careful consideration of what is desired from big data, how big data analytic to add value to business, etc. Students can gain a strong data science knowledge set and techniques via in-depth case studies, most current readings and experiences, and most current and future technology exploration.

description.zh: 本課程將介紹完整的無人機系統架構，並引導學生組裝無人機和開發新應用。課程內容包括無人機原理、基本操作、硬體組裝、開源機載控制軟體(ArduPilot)、通訊協定(MAVLink)、地面控制站(Mission Planner)、影像傳輸等等。熟悉架構之後，將介紹進階應用。例如結合4G/5G網路控制多台無人機、使用3D列印改造機體、AI影像辨識等等。修課學生須具備基本電子電路知識、微處理機架構概念，並具備進階程式設計能力。
description.en: This course will introduce the complete Unmanned Aircraft Systems and lead students to assemble the Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs). Students will learn the UAV theory, basic operations, hardware assembly, open-source embedded control software (ArduPilot), communication protocol (MAVLink), ground control station (Mission Planner), video transmission, etc. Additionally, we will introduce advanced topics and new applications, such as combining 4G/5G networks to control multiple drones, using 3D printing to customize the aircraft, installing AI models to do image recognition, etc. To take this course, students must have basic knowledge of electronic circuits and microprocessor architecture. Advanced programming capabilities is also necessary.

syllabi.outline:

name.zh: 人工智慧於衛星系統應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence in Satellite System Applications

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧技術於衛星影像分析的應用，涵蓋影像資料處理、模型訓練、最佳化與產業應用。學生將學習如何結合人工智慧模型進行精準偵測，並透過與業界合作解決實務問題，如海事監控及環境監測，提升跨領域協作與問題解決能力，問題導向學習的方式將促進學生獲取實務經驗及就業競爭力，為科技產業發展做好準備。
description.en: This course aims to equip students with expertise in applying artificial intelligence techniques to satellite image analysis, covering image data processing, model training, optimization, and industrial applications. Students will learn how to integrate AI models for precise detection tasks and collaborate with industry partners to solve practical problems, such as maritime surveillance and environmental monitoring. This will enhance students' cross-disciplinary collaboration and problem-solving skills. A problem-based learning approach will facilitate students in gaining practical experience and improving their competitiveness in the job market, thus preparing them for the advancement of the technology industry.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要目的在於使用各種深度學習的方法，應用在微波遙測資料上面。主要以案例的方式介紹各種應用，因此除了會說明核心的演算法之外，也會介紹使用的訓練資料集的格式、前處理等內容。課程前段會先回顧基本的遙測影像特性以及深度學習技術，包含CNNs, RNNs, GANs和YOLOs等，常見於遙測資料應用的方法。課程中段會已實際的範例說明上述幾種方法的使用情境與成效。課程最後會要求學生以文獻研讀的方式說明不同深度學習方法在微波遙測上的實例。

The primary objective of this course is to apply various deep learning methods to microwave remote sensing data. It introduces diverse applications primarily through case studies, covering not only core algorithms but also the format of training datasets and preprocessing techniques. The initial part reviews fundamental remote sensing image characteristics and deep learning techniques, including CNNs, RNNs, GANs, and YOLOs—methods commonly applied to remote sensing data. The middle part demonstrates the practical scenarios and effectiveness of these approaches through real-world examples. The final part requires students to conduct literature reviews, presenting case studies of different deep learning methods applied to microwave remote sensing.

name.zh: 人工智慧於通訊網路優化
name.en: Artificial Intelligence in Communication Network Optimization

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧技術在通訊網路中的應用，特別是在衛星通訊系統和無線網路中的實踐。學生將學習通訊網路的基礎概念、衛星次系統、軌道力學與資料解析，並瞭解無線網路架構、資源分配及網路切片技術。此外，學生將掌握如何利用人工智慧和深度強化學習技術進行資源優化、訊號處理與異常檢測，並應用實驗平台進行模擬和實驗，最終具備設計、實施並優化通訊網路的能力。
description.en: This course aims to equip students with the skills to apply artificial intelligence techniques in communication networks, particularly in satellite communication systems and wireless networks. Students will learn the fundamental concepts of communication networks, satellite subsystems, orbital mechanics, and data analysis, as well as the architecture of wireless networks, resource allocation, and network slicing technologies. Additionally, students will master how to use artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning techniques for resource optimization, signal processing, and anomaly detection. They will also apply experimental platforms for simulations and experiments, ultimately gaining the ability to design, implement, and optimize communication networks.

description.zh: 本課程介紹以ARM CPU為核心之嵌入式系統。內容包含：ARM CPU基礎架構，ARM CPU指令集，ARM之C語言工具，ARM 發展環境，開發電路板，模擬器，Linux驅動程式之撰寫及安裝，分散式網路架構，以及應用實例。
description.en: This course introduces small single-board computers serving as embedded systems and explains the architecture of X86 and ARM CPUs. This lecture will present the history of the ARM development environment, emulators, distributed network architectures, and industrial applications of ARM architecture. In the course, students learn to install Linux on development boards and write software to communicate with ARM processors. The exercises involve setting commands for the ARM cores and receiving signals from our embedded systems using C language tools.

name.en: Special Topics on Advanced Materials Chemistry

description.zh: 本課程為整合型課程，以多主題方式介紹當代與下世代先進材料化學技術，包含先進奈米合成技術、奈米微影科技、功能性催化材料化學、生醫材料化學、功能性高分子設計以及軟性元件製作等。本課程為跨系院課程，由多位教師共同授課，提供跨領域知識學習與培養學生跨領域思考。
description.en: This course is an integrated course that introduces emerging and next-generation advanced materials chemistry in a multi-topic approach, including advanced nanomaterials synthesis, nanolithography technology, catalytic materials chemistry, biomaterials chemistry, functional polymer design, and the production of soft electronic devices. It is an interdepartmental course, lectured by multiple teachers, and providing multidisciplinary knowledge learning.

name.en: Introduction to Theory and Applications in Wind Engineering

description.zh: 風工程是一個跨領域的學科，屬於研究所課程，適合已有良好工程力學以及流體力學基礎的學生選修。然而為了推廣我國工程師及土木系大學生了解此門學問，本課程設計為大四及研究所學生選修的先導型課程。本課程內容涵蓋大氣邊界層、鈍體空氣動力學以及空氣彈力學的基礎知識，進而闡述建築物耐風設計以及橋梁耐風設計的概念，配合我國以及國際上常用之耐風設計規範作為解說及練習，輔助學生對於風工程有一定的認識。其他如空氣污染擴散、通風節能減熱、計算流體力學應用等與風相關的主題，亦在本課程提出概略性的介紹以及發展現況。
description.en: Wind Engineering is a cross-disciplinary subject that belongs to the institute course and is suitable for students who have a good background in engineering mechanics and fluid mechanics. However, in order to promote the knowledge of Wind Engineering to engineers and civil engineering students, this course is designed as the precursor courses selected by seniors and graduate students. This course covers the basic knowledge of atmospheric boundary layer, bluff body aerodynamics and air-elasticity, and then expounds the wind-resistant design of buildings and the concept of wind-resistant design of bridges. It is used as an explanation and practice with the wind-resistant design codes commonly used internationally. Students have a certain understanding of wind engineering. Other wind-related topics such as air pollution diffusion, ventilation energy conservation and heat reduction, computational fluid dynamics applications, etc., also provide a brief introduction and development status in

syllabi.outline: This course is designed as the precursor course selected by seniors and graduate students. It covers the basic knowledge of the atmospheric boundary layer, bluff-body aerodynamics, aero-elasticity, the wind-resistant design of buildings, and the concept of wind-resistant design of bridges. National and international wind codes for buildings and bridges are introduced with practices based on wind tunnel test data. Other related wind issues are also conceptually introduced in this course.

name.en: Introduction to Theory and Applications in Wind Engineering

description.zh: 風工程是一個跨領域的學科，屬於研究所課程，適合已有良好工程力學以及流體力學基礎的學生選修。然而為了推廣我國工程師及土木系大學生了解此門學問，本課程設計為大四及研究所學生選修的先導型課程。本課程內容涵蓋大氣邊界層、鈍體空氣動力學以及空氣彈力學的基礎知識，進而闡述建築物耐風設計以及橋梁耐風設計的概念，配合我國以及國際上常用之耐風設計規範作為解說及練習，輔助學生對於風工程有一定的認識。其他如空氣污染擴散、通風節能減熱、計算流體力學應用等與風相關的主題，亦在本課程提出概略性的介紹以及發展現況。
description.en: Wind Engineering is a cross-disciplinary subject that belongs to the institute course and is suitable for students who have a good background in engineering mechanics and fluid mechanics. However, in order to promote the knowledge of Wind Engineering to engineers and civil engineering students, this course is designed as the precursor courses selected by seniors and graduate students. This course covers the basic knowledge of atmospheric boundary layer, bluff body aerodynamics and air-elasticity, and then expounds the wind-resistant design of buildings and the concept of wind-resistant design of bridges. It is used as an explanation and practice with the wind-resistant design codes commonly used internationally. Students have a certain understanding of wind engineering. Other wind-related topics such as air pollution diffusion, ventilation energy conservation and heat reduction, computational fluid dynamics applications, etc., also provide a brief introduction and development status in

syllabi.outline: This course is designed as the precursor course selected by seniors and graduate students. It covers the basic knowledge of the atmospheric boundary layer, bluff-body aerodynamics, aero-elasticity, the wind-resistant design of buildings, and the concept of wind-resistant design of bridges. National and international wind codes for buildings and bridges are introduced with practices based on wind tunnel test data. Other related wind issues are also conceptually introduced in this course.

name.zh: 氣候變遷與組織溫室氣體計算理論
name.en: Climate change and organization greenhouse gases accounting: theoretical approach

description.zh: 本課程從IPCC的氣候變遷評估報告出發，引導學生了解氣候變遷的重要性以及未來企業活動如何與氣候變遷結合，除著重介紹組織實體如何計算其營運活動的溫室氣體排放量外，亦介紹如何運用溫室氣體盤查數據設定組織轉型策略及淨零目標。本課程內容結合國際通用方法GHG Protocol與ISO 14064-1:2018、IPCC 2006與2019修訂之計算理論，並介紹我國環境部的計算要求以及與淨零目標設定、轉型風險相關之國際倡議，透過完整的計算理論與實務演練，來完成一份組織溫室氣體盤查與計算。
description.en: This course is based on the IPCC's Climate Change Assessment Report and aims to guide students in understanding the importance of climate change and how future cooperation activities can integrate with it. Apart from focusing on how organizations calculate the greenhouse gas emissions from operational activities, it also introduces how to utilize greenhouse gas inventory data to set transformation strategies and net-zero targets. The course integrates internationally recognized methods like the GHG Protocol, ISO 14064-1:2018, as well as IPCC 2006 and 2019 revisions for calculation theories. It also covers national calculation requirements from Taiwan's Ministry of Environment (MOENV) and international initiatives related to setting net-zero goals and transformation risks. Through comprehensive theoretical approach and practical application, students will complete an organizational greenhouse gas inventory and calculation.

description.zh: 本課程主要的目標為從應用與設計的角度,帶領同學進行多感官回饋技術的實作及實驗。從實作及實驗中學生將了解不同回饋技術在應用面上的可能性及其設計考量,並學習人機互動系統的啟發式評估、沉浸式量表、半結構式訪談,從而剖析及理解人機互動系統的表現(程式語言:C++)。此外本課程將以小組實習方式來進行,期望藉由合作學習和雛型製作來強化學生跨領域提案之創新能力。
description.en: The main goal of this course is to guide students to implement and experiment with multisensory feedback technologies from an application and design perspective. Through hands-on exercises and experiments, students will understand the capabilities of different feedback technologies in terms of application and design considerations, and learn heuristic evaluation, immersive scale, and semi-structured interviews of human-computer interaction systems to analyze and understand the performance of human-computer interaction systems (programming language: C++). In addition, this course will take the form of group exercises in the innovative ability to strengthen students' cross-field proposals through cooperative learning and prototyping skill.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

syllabi.outline: 本課程以循序漸進的設計引導學生從零開始理解程式語言的語法與邏輯，透過習題實作與上機考試訓練「數理與邏輯推理能力」、「解決問題能力」與「科技素養」。同時，本課程強調跨領域應用，鼓勵學生選擇與自身背景相關的主題進行程式實作，例如社會統計分析、醫療資料簡化或人文資料可視化，進而建立「跨域整合能力」。在學習歷程中，學生也將培養精準表達與有效溝通的能力，從而達成通識教育所重視的「自主學習」與「公民責任」等基本素養之涵養。

本課程為對應教育部臺灣大專院校人工智慧學程(TAICA)於本校開設校級人工智慧(AI)課程之「人工智慧探索應用學分學程」先修課程。本學分學程屬於人工智慧應用學分學程，屬於學分學程內最容入門的選項，主要給跨域學生修習，因此課程設計從先修的程式設計和機開始，透過循序漸進的修課規劃，讓學生除有完備的人工智慧技術外，也解相關 議題，最後透過人工智慧專題應用，讓學生們解人工智慧技術在產業上地的考。因此本課程設定適合所有跨域(非電資專業)的學生。

syllabi.outline:
This course introduces students to the core concepts and methods of statistics, with a focus on
learning how to use data effectively in the face of uncertainty. Key topics include data
visualization, descriptive statistics, probability, statistical inference, and linear regression.
Emphasis will be placed on building intuition and practical understanding rather than mathematical
rigor.
Students will develop the skills to make sense of data, draw meaningful conclusions, and
communicate results with clarity and confidence. The tools and thinking developed in this course
are valuable for making informed decisions and conducting research across a wide range of
disciplines. They also form the foundation of many modern applications, including data science,
machine learning, and artificial intelligence.
Requirements and Expectations
This is an English-medium course. English must be used at all times in class, including for
homework, quizzes, exams, and all other course-related work.
We will use NTU COOL to share course materials and announcements. You are expected to
check both NTU COOL and your school email daily to stay informed and up to date.
All cell phones and other communication devices should be turned off or silenced during class.
Students may be cold-called to answer questions. Active and voluntary participation in discussions
is highly encouraged

name.zh: 電腦視覺實務與深度學習

f. Computer Vision Security

Week 12 to 16: Generative Computer Vision
a. Unconditional Generative Models
b. Vision-Language Models
c. Conditional Generative Models
d. Multimodal Large Models

name.zh: 生成式人工智慧與機器學習導論
生成式AI文字與圖像生成原理實務

syllabi.outline: 「生成式 AI:文字與圖像生成的原理與實務」是一門兼具理論深度與實作樂趣的課程,專為希望深入了解生成式 AI 的技術與應用的學生而設計。不論對 AI 的認識是基礎還是進階,都希望透過這門課程,帶領同學探索生成式 AI 的無限可能。學生將會學習神經網路、GAN、Transformer、大型語言模型、RAG、AI Agents、Diffusion Models 等技術,並運用工具如 OpenAI API、LangChain、HuggingFace 及 AISuite 等等,完成從文字生成到圖像生成的多樣應用。
syllabi.schedule:
**配合政大課程 9/2開課**

週次1  課程介紹與生成式 AI 概述 
課程目標與內容簡介,為什麼要研究生成式 AI,介紹 Colab 平台的基礎操作。

週次2  神經網路的概念 
簡介神經網路的核心概念(感知器、多層感知器)、激發函數與反向傳播,實作一個簡單的 MNIST 手寫數字分類。

週次3  紅極一時的生成對抗網路 (GAN) 
介紹曾經被當作生成式 AI 希望的生成對抗網路(GAN),包括 GAN 的生成原理、著名的應用範例,及為什麼暫時不再是主流的原因。

週次4  大型語言模型原來這麼簡單 
文字生成 AI 的基本概念,包括 RNN 及transformers 有「記憶」的神經網路簡介,及 seq2seq 模型、詞嵌入等等原理。

週次5  Transformers 全攻略 
RNN 及 transformers 的數學基礎與架構,複習基本矩陣運算、瞭解注意力模式的原理。

週次6  大型語言模型(LLM)的應用及倫理議題的挑戰
著名的大型語言模型 (LLM),常見應用,及倫理議題的討論。

週次7  打造自己的對話機器人 
使用 AISuite,用程式的方式打造自己的對話機器人。

週次8  專家講座 
學界或業界專家分享生成式 AI 相關實務主題。

週次9  檢索增強生成(RAG)的原理及實作 
RAG 的概念、資料檢索與生成的結合方法,實作基於 LangChain 的 RAG 系統

週次10  Agentic AI 與 AI Agents 
什麼是 AI Agents?學習不同的 AI Agent設計模式,並且運用 AISuite 實作

週次11  變分自編碼器(VAE)開始的冒險旅程 
解釋 VAE 的原理,及為什麼這相對簡單的模型,會成為圖像生成 AI 的重要想法,發展出目前重要圖像生成的 diffusion models

週次12  文字生圖 AI 的原理及實作
Diffusion Models 的進階主題,包括 CLIP、排程器、LoRA 等概念。並且用Hugging Face 的 diffusers 套件打造自己的圖像生成 AI Web APP。

週次13  用 Fooocus 實現 Diffusion Models的進階技術
介紹「理解」使用者輸入文字的 CLIP 模型,著名的圖像生成 AI 模型及運用方式

週次14  生成式 AI 流行工具及應用範例 
介紹主流生成式 AI 工具,及應用範例。

週次15  生成式 AI 應用與發展趨勢 
介紹生成式 AI 新近發展。例如我們介紹文字生成預測 token 的模型,還有圖像生成diffusion models,有「互相攻佔」對方地盤的現象。探討其中的原理和可能走向這個方向的原因。

週次16  在 Gather.town 線上研討會型式的期末專題成果分享

期末專案: 20%
上課參與 5%

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

Upon completion of the internship period, the internship organization have to provide a certificate of internship and a grade assessment. Students should submit a internship report within one week after the completion of the internship. The principle of the evaluation ratio for the internship is 50% for the internship organization and 50% for the counselor。

name.zh: 人工智慧於通訊網路優化
name.en: Artificial Intelligence in Communication Network Optimization

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧技術在通訊網路中的應用，特別是在衛星通訊系統和無線網路中的實踐。學生將學習通訊網路的基礎概念、衛星次系統、軌道力學與資料解析，並瞭解無線網路架構、資源分配及網路切片技術。此外，學生將掌握如何利用人工智慧和深度強化學習技術進行資源優化、訊號處理與異常檢測，並應用實驗平台進行模擬和實驗，最終具備設計、實施並優化通訊網路的能力。
description.en: This course aims to equip students with the skills to apply artificial intelligence techniques in communication networks, particularly in satellite communication systems and wireless networks. Students will learn the fundamental concepts of communication networks, satellite subsystems, orbital mechanics, and data analysis, as well as the architecture of wireless networks, resource allocation, and network slicing technologies. Additionally, students will master how to use artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning techniques for resource optimization, signal processing, and anomaly detection. They will also apply experimental platforms for simulations and experiments, ultimately gaining the ability to design, implement, and optimize communication networks.

name.zh: 人工智慧於衛星系統應用
name.en: Artificial Intelligence in Satellite System Applications

description.zh: 本課程旨在培養學生掌握人工智慧技術於衛星影像分析的應用，涵蓋影像資料處理、模型訓練、最佳化與產業應用。學生將學習如何結合人工智慧模型進行精準偵測，並透過與業界合作解決實務問題，如海事監控及環境監測，提升跨領域協作與問題解決能力，問題導向學習的方式將促進學生獲取實務經驗及就業競爭力，為科技產業發展做好準備。
description.en: This course aims to equip students with expertise in applying artificial intelligence techniques to satellite image analysis, covering image data processing, model training, optimization, and industrial applications. Students will learn how to integrate AI models for precise detection tasks and collaborate with industry partners to solve practical problems, such as maritime surveillance and environmental monitoring. This will enhance students' cross-disciplinary collaboration and problem-solving skills. A problem-based learning approach will facilitate students in gaining practical experience and improving their competitiveness in the job market, thus preparing them for the advancement of the technology industry.

syllabi.outline:
本課程主要目的在於使用各種深度學習的方法，應用在微波遙測資料上面。主要以案例的方式介紹各種應用，因此除了會說明核心的演算法之外，也會介紹使用的訓練資料集的格式、前處理等內容。課程前段會先回顧基本的遙測影像特性以及深度學習技術，包含CNNs, RNNs, GANs和YOLOs等，常見於遙測資料應用的方法。課程中段會已實際的範例說明上述幾種方法的使用情境與成效。課程最後會要求學生以文獻研讀的方式說明不同深度學習方法在微波遙測上的實例。

The primary objective of this course is to apply various deep learning methods to microwave remote sensing data. It introduces diverse applications primarily through case studies, covering not only core algorithms but also the format of training datasets and preprocessing techniques. The initial part reviews fundamental remote sensing image characteristics and deep learning techniques, including CNNs, RNNs, GANs, and YOLOs—methods commonly applied to remote sensing data. The middle part demonstrates the practical scenarios and effectiveness of these approaches through real-world examples. The final part requires students to conduct literature reviews, presenting case studies of different deep learning methods applied to microwave remote sensing.

name.zh: 人工智慧於射頻模組優化
name.en: Artificial Intelligence  in RF Module Optimization

description.zh: 本課程讓學生深入瞭解射頻模組的基本架構及其在無線通訊技術中的應用，並且掌握人工智慧與深度強化學習的基本概念，學習如何利用人工智慧技術優化射頻模組性能，如增強信號強度和降低干擾。此外，課程將涵蓋電磁模擬軟體及其在射頻模組中的應用，並指導學生設置環境，編寫人工智慧演算法，實現自動化模擬與優化，最終培養獨立解決問題的能力。
description.en: This course enables students to gain an in-depth understanding of the basic structure of RF modules and their applications in wireless communication technology. It also covers the fundamental concepts of artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning, teaching students how to use AI techniques to optimize RF module performance, such as enhancing signal strength and reducing interference. Additionally, the course will introduce electromagnetic simulation software and its applications in RF module simulation, guiding students to set up the environment, write AI algorithms, and achieve automated simulation and optimization, ultimately cultivating the ability to solve problems independently.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生須利用暑假至資訊相關機構連續實習八週，並不得低於三百二十小時。學生應於校外實習完成後一週內繳交校外實習報告，由實習輔導老師諮詢公司主管後評定實習成績。
description.en: This course is designed to enhance students' on-job practical experiences. Students will work full-time on-site at a computer science (information engineering) related company or research organizations for 8 weeks during the summer. Through the program, students would learn the hands-on professional technology. Each student would be required to submit a written report right after the end of the internship for grading.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

name.zh: 數位轉型與創新商業模式
name.en: Digital Transformation and Innovative Business Models

description.zh: 本課程在於協助同學了解數位轉型的浪潮趨勢，以及適應新科技所改變的商業模式。課程將介紹創新的商業模式例如共享經濟、金融科技、線上至離線、使用者生成內容等平台模式應用。每個模式將會連結到實務中企業個案，以協助同學進一步深入了解與分析創新的模式概念。本課程將涵蓋數位轉型與創新模式的基本概念，以數位轉型與科技適應角度，透過實務案例來了解創新商業模式。
description.en: This course aims to help students understand the trend of digital transformation and technology adaption in business models. The innovative business models will be introduced such as sharing economy, FinTech, online-to-offline, user-generated content, and so on. The matched cases will be selected to elaborate and analyze the innovative business models. This course will provide comprehensive knowledge of innovative business models by digital transformation and technology adaption (information and communication technology).

syllabi.outline: This course is designed to provide students with both the theoretical foundations and practical insights of digital transformation. It explores how emerging technologies reshape business models through innovative forms such as the sharing economy, FinTech, and user-generated content. By combining literature reviews, case studies, group discussions, and presentations, students will develop the ability to critically analyze digital transformation strategies and propose innovative business models. The course assessment includes a midterm team report and a final individual project, ensuring both collaborative and independent learning outcomes.

name.en: Course in English language Proficiency Tests

description.zh: 本課主旨在設計課程，提供練習，俾使學生嫻熟各式的英語測驗，如全民英檢、托福測驗、TOEIC 測驗或類似性質的測驗，希冀能夠藉由本課程的修習，提升學生不斷的學習外國語的興致，並且，藉由通過考試取得證照，增加未來職場的競爭力。
description.en: This course is designed to familiarize the students with various kinds of language proficiency tests such as GEPT, TOEFL, TOEIC and many others to the same end. It is our hope that the students who finish taking the course will go on with their enthusiasm on studying foreign languages; besides, through the acquisition of the certificate when the students pass the tests, they are sure to enhance their capability in the increasingly competitive job markets.

description.zh: 本課程之目的在於介紹一些廣泛、基本及實際的微電子製造程序（其中最主要者為積體電路之製造程序）。首先說明製造方法上之三個 主要部分：擴散（diffusion）、平版照相術（lithography）及薄膜沉積（thin-film deposition）然後再介紹這些方法如何應用在各種元件所需之物理特性及元件設計有關之訊息後者則需要了解各種製造策略之目的及限制時再隨時給予介紹。

description.zh: 以英語語言、教學法、及學生在專業領域的英語需求為主軸，專業英文ESP 系列課程涵蓋以下關鍵面向：學術英文、專業實踐/應用英文、內容和語言整合英文教學，議題與趨勢，以及語言技巧能力。 此系列課程專為本校大二修習校訂共同英文的學生設計，強化英語能力，並應用英文於專業領域之發展。
description.en: Drawing upon the English language, pedagogy, students’ needs for English in specialized domains, the ESP series encompass the following key dimensions: English for general academic purposes, English for professional practice / application, content and language integrated learning, issues and trends, and integrative language skills for testing and communication. The courses are designed for the second year (sophomore), non-native English speaking students to strengthen their English competence and become more proficient in their fields of study.

Students are encouraged to utilize their domain expertise to participate in professional communication in English. Centered on the training of professional use of the English language, the ESP curriculum as the crux of a highly-integrated work of domain knowledge and the English learning development embodies the indispensable credentials required for a global profession.

name.en: PBL Based Projects in Learning Analysis

description.zh: 本課程強調資訊分析理論與實務的結合用，因此課程中會逐步教導學生相關分析理論與演算法，透過Rapidminer，可以讓學生輕鬆在操作元件拖拉之中，完成一個妥善的分析流程，並可以產生多樣化的視覺化呈現，從實作中強化操作相關軟體的基本能力。並結合教育機構與產業引導實際場域發生之問題或整合校務研究資料於專題課程，參與校務分析研究：考量資安的個資議題，擬將校內部份去識別化後之資料，經過編碼變造處理後於課堂使用，讓學生將實際進行問題分析、模型發展、系統開發、模擬實驗及最後的研究結論與模型驗證。最後，透過特定主題教案的設計，讓學習者進一步的去思考數據分析的邏輯，從教學者的角度更深入理解教育大數據分析。
description.en:
This course focuses on the integration of information analysis theory and practice. As such, students will be gradually introduced to relevant analysis theories and algorithms. By using Rapidminer, students can easily complete the proper analysis process by dragging and dropping operating components. This software allows students to generate a diverse range of visual presentations, strengthening their ability to operate related software through practical application.
Additionally, this course will work in conjunction with educational institutions and industries to address real-world problems and integrate school research data in special courses. Students will participate in school affairs analysis and research, considering issues related to personal data and information security. The course will also involve planning to de-identify data in the school, which will be used in the classroom after being altered via code. This approach will allow students to conduct problem analysis, model

description.zh: 本課程透過系列主題講座，帶領學員從多元視角理解當代國際局勢、外交發展與跨文化溝通策略。課程邀請外交官、國際事務專家、駐外代表及具實務經驗的講者分享全球趨勢、國際關係熱點議題與外交談判技巧，幫助同學建立宏觀國際視野與外交思維，強化其在多元文化背景下的溝通與協調能力。課程將以專題講座、互動對談與案例分析等形式進行，並引導同學反思台灣在全球脈絡中的角色與機會，培養具備國際素養與行動力的未來領導者。
description.en: This course, delivered through a series of thematic lectures, guides students in understanding contemporary international affairs, diplomatic developments, and cross-cultural communication strategies from diverse perspectives. Diplomats, international affairs experts, overseas representatives, and experienced practitioners will be invited to share insights on global trends, key international issues, and diplomatic negotiation skills. The course aims to help students develop a broad international outlook and diplomatic mindset, enhancing their ability to communicate and collaborate effectively in multicultural contexts. Through lectures, interactive discussions, and case analyses, students will be encouraged to reflect on Taiwan’s role and opportunities in the global landscape, cultivating internationally competent and action-oriented future leaders.

description.zh: 本課程介紹電腦科學中圖形識別的基本原理與相關技術，使學生了解各種圖形識別的分類方法，經由對分類問題的分析，瞭解如何將輸入樣本依不同特性加以分類，並熟悉圖形識別系統之相關議題如：分割、特徵擷取、分類、後處理、訓練、監督/非監督式學習、機器學習，進而了解分類問題，增進其解決實際圖形識別分類問題的能力。課程內容包括下列課題：圖形識別概論, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood, 非參數法學習, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Positive Boolean Function多分類器, Linear Discriminant Functions，高維資料分類, 分類正確率評估(Accuracy Assessments)及其他重要的應用，例如: 文件分析、生物辨識、影像監控、遙測影像分類、醫療診斷、資料探勘等概念，最後並透過相關論文的研讀及討論，了解近代圖形識別的最新發展趨勢。
description.en: The course includes: Introduction to Pattern Recognition, Bayesian Decision Theory, Maximum-Likelihood & Bayesian Parameter Estimation, Non-Parametric Classification - Density Estimation, K-Nearest Neighbor Estimation, The Nearest-Neighbor Rule, Multi-Classifier - Positive Boolean Function, Linear Discriminant Functions, Pattern Recognition of High Dimensional Data Sets, Pattern Recognition for Remote Sensing Images, Biometric Certification, Video Surveillance, Accuracy Assessments and Other Related Topics.

description.zh:
本課程主要分為專利權的觀念建立，及並以自然語言處理（NLP）作為主要工具，專利權進行量化分析。
專利權部份：
壹、保護創新：1. 如何透過專利保護科技創新、2. 專利的迷思。
貳、專利與創新：1. 如何由需求或靈感取得創新、2. 如何使創新轉化為實質專利 3. 如何從專利撰寫演化出創新。
參、專利概念與規法：1. 我國專利體系介紹、2. 專利相關法規之介紹、3. 專利取得的流程、4. 發明專利實體審查基、5. 專利說明書及圖示的撰寫格式、6. 何謂發明單一性及優先權的使用。
肆、專利說明書搜尋及閱讀：1. 各國專利的搜尋引擎、2. 專利工具的使用、3. 閱讀專利說明書。
伍、專利說明書的撰寫與申請：1. 專利說明書撰寫之重要 2. 專利說明書之格式 3. 專利說明書之撰寫技巧。
陸、專利戰略與佈局：1. 商戰專利佈局模式、2. 專利舉發實務、3. 專利舉發方式、4. 專利舉發程序、5. 專利舉發策略運用、6. 舉發撤銷要件。
柒、專利侵害及訴訟實例：1. 從案例中學習專利侵害的攻防與法院訴訟的爭點、2.專家演講(法官，技審官，審查官，律師) 邀請領域的專家分享實務經驗。

專利權數據部份：
壹、專利數據收集：深入探討數據清理，篩選，確保學生能夠為分析準備適當的數據集

syllabi.outline:
Course Description: 
	This course offers an in-depth exploration into patent analytics. Participants will traverse topics such as research methodologies specific to patents, foundational aspects of patent law, the pivotal role of semiconductors in patenting, keyword-centric patent searches complemented by pertinent case studies, the integration of linguistics and logic in understanding patents, the practical applications of ChatGPT, and the utility of Natural Language Processing in patent data analysis.

Course Topics:
1.	Research Methodology in Patent Analytics:
	•	Overview of innovation trends
	•	Analyzing McKinsey and Gartner reports for patent insights
2.	Basics of Patent Law:
	•	Intellectual Property: Understanding the Basics
	•	What makes an invention patentable?
	•	Constructing and analyzing a patent claim
	•	Understanding patent structures
	•	The thin line between innovation and non-obviousness
	•	Crafting an effective patent strategy
3.	Semiconductors and Their Importance in Patenting:
	•	Introduction to semiconductor processes, manufacturing, and devices
	•	Deep dive into VLSI design, IP, MCU, CPU, GPU, firmware, OS, and software
	•	A look at solid-state devices
	•	Advanced Process Technologies (Refer to Advanced-Process-Technologies.pdf for detailed insights)
4.	Keyword-driven Patent Search & Case Studies:
	•	Patent cases on advanced devices: Planar FET, FinFET, GAA
	•	Patent cases involving AI methodologies
5.	Language, Logic, and Meaning in Patent Analysis:
	•	Introduction to linguistics in patent analysis (Reference: https://chowkafat.net/Lingtopic.html)
	•	Basics of semantics and its importance in patent comprehension
	•	Deep dive into formal semantics and generalized quantifier theory
	•	Deciphering the logical form and structure in patents
	•	Introduction to propositional logic and its application in patent analysis
	•	Unraveling predicate logic in patent contexts
6.	Practical Applications using ChatGPT:
	•	Using ChatGPT for instructional language and problem-solving in patent analytics
	•	Case study: Constructing a GAA using ChatGPT
	•	ChatGPT in research methodologies and patent search
7.	Natural Language Processing (NLP) in Patent Analysis:
	•	Understanding word embedding and word vectors
	•	Techniques for determining similarity in patent documents using NLP

description.zh:
戰略管理使用綜合管理視角去解決相關的制定和實施企業和企業級戰略的問題。
該課程包括開發識別問題的能力，評估戰略選擇，並瞭解戰略的形成和執行的組織過程。它建立在功能區課程所獲得的知識，並使用案例研究和項目，以提高學生的分析和決策能力。前提：必須參與上學期的課程或與得到研究生導師的許可。
description.en: Strategic management uses a general management perspective in addressing issues related to the formulation and implementation of corporate and business level strategy. The course involves developing the ability to identify issues, evaluate strategic options and understand the organizational process by which strategies get formed and executed. It builds on the knowledge gained in functional area courses and uses case studies and projects to improve students' analytical and decision-making skills. Prerequisite: Must be taken in last semester or with permission of the Graduate Advisor.

description.zh: 國際商務市場行銷管理。包括在國際環境中的市場研究、定價、促銷和分銷。審查市場的問題出現不同程度的外資參與（出口，許可證，外國分公司）。先修課程：MARK5311市場行銷。
description.en: Management of marketing in international business. Includes marketing research, pricing, promotion, and distribution in the international environment. Examines marketing problems arising from various degrees of foreign involvement (exports, licensing, foreign subsidiaries). Prerequisite: MARK 5311 (MARKETING).

description.zh: 專注於戰略和機構的國際層面，並提供了一個框架，在日益複雜的全球經濟裡制定戰略。本課程旨在為學生提供對跨國公司經營裡的文化，政治，競爭，技術，法律和人口環境的理解。然後，它通過在國際背景下獲得成功的全球產業和戰略來探討全球競爭的性質。還涵蓋了跨國公司管理中的組織設計與戰略控制相關問題。
description.en: Focuses on the international dimensions of strategy and organization and provides a framework for formulating strategies in an increasingly complex global economy. The course seeks to provide students with an understanding of the cultural, political, competitive, technological, legal, and demographic environments in which multinational firms operate. It then examines the nature of global competition by exploring the characteristics of global industries and strategies that have been successful in an international context. Also covered are issues related to organizational design and strategic control in the management of multinational enterprises.

description.zh: 資料科學為最熱門的職業之一，各行各業對於數據分析的人才需求正在蓬勃發展，本課程在於培育從事資料科學或機器學習的人員來發展相關知識和技能。課程內容以線性代數、機率、統計學等工程數學為理論學習基礎，操作Python作為資料科學的實作工具，包括其相關Python基礎語法、各種資料型態、數據 可視化、開源工具等。接著學習利用Python取得數據資料，進而操作各種迴歸 分析來手動分析數據資料，並實作梯度遞減，決策樹等最佳化演算方法。最後則是介紹機器學習、深度學習等最新的AI演算方法來分析大數據並輔助決策。
description.en: Data Science has been ranked as one of the hottest professions and the demand for data practitioners is booming. This course is designed to develop people engaged in data science or machine learning to develop relevant knowledge and skills. You will understand how data science works based on mathematics, such as linear algebra, probability and statistics. Python is the best tool to learn how to conduct data science analyze data. Learn the basic language skills, common data types, visualization tools and extended modules for data grabbing and regression analysis. Gradient decent and decision tree for optimization will be covered. Finally, AI algorithm, machine learning, and deep learning, are introduced how data help in decision making.

description.zh: 本課程以深入淺出之方式，介紹與機器學習之相關技術及演算法，目標是修習本課程之學生具有閱讀機器學習相關文獻之基本知識，並能從事相關之實務或電腦模擬實驗之工作，因此本課程著重在廣泛介紹各類之演算法之應用，而非深究少數演算法之深奧數學原理．本課程涵蓋之演算法，包含：最佳化基本知識，隨機最佳化演算法，隨機搜尋，決策樹，隨機森林，類神經網路及深度學習相關演算法，基因演算法，貝氏定理及應用，高斯混合模型，隱藏式馬可夫鍊(及訓練演算法)，支援向量機，線性及邏輯迴歸，分群方法，降維方法，提升方法，決策融合技巧，及增強式學習等。
description.en: This introductory course covers most of the techniques and algorithms related to the current trend in the machine learning field. The goal of this course is that students complete this course can read and understand the literature in the machine learning field, and can conduct computer simulations for experiments or apply the techniques to practical problems. Therefore, this course intends to cover a broad range of algorithms with emphasis on applications, rather than to cover only a few algorithms with extensive mathematical treatments. The algorithms covered in this course include: foundations of optiminizations, random search, decision tree, random decision forests, neural networks and deep learning, genetic algorithm, Bayes' theorem and its applications, Gauss mixture model, hidden Markov model (with its training algorithm), support vector machine, linear and logistic regressions, clustering algorithms, dimension reduction techniques (LDA, PCA, ICA, FA), boosting methods, decision.

syllabi.outline: This course introduces the concepts, techniques, and applications of machine learning. Topics mainly include Symbolists (e.g., Decision Tree), Connectionists (e.g., Artificial Neural Networks), Bayesians (e.g., Hidden Markov Model), Analogizers (e.g., kNN), and Evolutionaries (e.g., GA), Natural Language Processing and Speech Recognition. The lecture format will be a combination of slide presentation, chalk talk and computer demonstration. In addition to the theoretical study, students are guided to survey the related references, discuss and brainstorm by group, and conduct the practice projects, so that the capability of creativity and innovation can be developed during the course.
syllabi.schedule:

4. Machine Learning with WEKA (9hr)
5. Evolutionary Computing (8hr)
6. Natural Language Processing (5hr)
7. Speech Recognition (9hr)
8. Students' Project Presentation (4hr)

description.zh: 隨著雲端運算服務的廣為使用及網際網路服務的發展，如何處理與儲存大數據，並探勘有用的知識是企業成功關鍵。本課程內容包括決策理論之基本觀念、如何處理與分析大數據、以及如何更進一步從大數據分析連接在真實世界裡相關決策問題應用。
description.en: With the development of cloud computing services and internet services, the ability to store big data and transform into applicable knowledge is critical. This course includes an overview of the basic concepts of decision theory, and how to handle and process big data with applications on the real-world decision problems.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en:
英文概述
English Description 	The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

Your grade will be based on the quality of your work in the following areas.

1. Attendance and Participation (10%)
You are expected to attend every class period, do all the assigned readings, and participate in in-class discussion actively.

2. Activities and Assignments (20%) 
There will be several in-class activities and homework assignments throughout the course. 

3. Discussion Leads (10%)
For each class, there will be a few readings which everyone should do. Assigned students will present the readings and lead the discussion for that week. 

4. Final Project and Showcase (30%)
You will design a language course. You will present your course design to the class during the last 2-3 weeks of the semester. The course design portfolio will be due on Week 18.

5. Final Exam (20%)
You will design a course/unit in class.

description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 大眾傳播與人類社會的關係，正隨科技的進步而日益擴大它的影響力。根據學者研究發現，人類的思想、態度與價值觀念受大眾傳播的影響日漸加深，大傳媒介不但塑造人的思想，同時也影響人們的行為及價值；然而從傳播的功能言，大眾傳播同時具有正面與負面的社會功能，故大眾傳播的發展與過程，殊值重視與探討。本課程兼顧理論與實例的探討，包括傳播特性與要素、大眾傳播的能及效果、新聞守門人理論等，並以實例分析新聞的公正客觀性、新聞自由與國家安全、媒體與選舉等傳播爭議性問題。修習本課程可培養學生閱讀新聞的正確性，不玫人云亦云，受媒體報導所擺佈；同時亦可增強學生人際溝通的技巧與能力。
description.en: With the advancement of technology, mass communication is enlarging its influence in human society.  According to  researches, the thoughts, attitudes and value judgements of humans are deeply affected by mass communication.  The media not only shape persons' thoughts, but also have an impact on their behavior and values.  Since mass communication has positive and negative social functions at the same time, its development and process are therefore worthy of paying much attention and exploration to us.  This course includes the study of the theory and practice of mass communication, such as characteristics and elements functions and effects, as well as the theory of the news gatekeepers.  It also uses stories to analyze disputed issues, for example, news objectivism, freedom of the press and national security, and media and election. syllabi.outline:
This course aims to explore how media influence our lives, culture, and social structures, while guiding students to reflect on their own roles within the media environment. 
The course is divided into four major sections, moving from the external to the internal dimensions of media—beginning with media consumption, then moving through media texts, and finally media production—to gradually build an understanding of how media operate.
We will start by examining the role of the audience: how individuals consume, engage with, or even resist media. Next, we will analyze media texts—including, but not limited to, television, film, advertising, and magazines—to investigate how they “represent” (or distort) different aspects of our lives. We will then turn to the operations of media industries, considering how underlying economic and political structures shape media content. Finally, the course will extend to today’s new media landscape, focusing on the transformations and challenges brought about in the digital age.
By integrating theory with case studies, this course encourages students to critically view, analyze, and engage with contemporary media culture, cultivating both media sensitivity and media literacy.

description.zh:
面對科技發展日新月異，社會急驟變遷的新世紀，只習得專業上的一技之長，已不足以和協圓滿地實踐有意義的人生。有鑑於此，乃以生涯發展與生涯諮商的理論與研究為基礎，配合學生的發展，希翼能透過教育的歷程，使學生的專業知識能和未來的工作與生活規劃，產生有意義的聯結，進而為學生提供一個短程與長程的生涯發展與選擇的準備與指引。
授課內容包括生涯理念介紹、興趣、性格、價值觀探索，生
涯決定因素，生涯技巧，生涯角色調適，生涯選擇與規劃技
巧，生涯訪談，生涯高原調適，轉型期調適，性別、職業歧
視，雙生涯家庭，就業準備等主要生涯課題的研討與習作。
description.en: In face of a new century with continuous scientific development and rapid social changes, to learn one single professional skill is not enough to fulfill a meaningful life in a harmonic and satisfactory manner. In view of this, based on the theory and research of career development and consultation in association with the development of students,  it is hoped to produce a meaningful linking between their professional knowledge and job and life planning through the course of eucation, and further to provide them a preparation and guide for short and long-range career development and choice. The contents of the course include the discussion and exercise related to major career topics such as introduction to the concept of career, the discussion of interest, character and value, decisive factors of career, skills of career, role adjustment in career, career choice and planning skill, career interview, uphill adjustment in career, adjustment in transit period, sex and occupation.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

description.zh: 專注於戰略和機構的國際層面，並提供了一個框架，在日益複雜的全球經濟裡制定戰略。本課程旨在為學生提供對跨國公司經營裡的文化，政治，競爭，技術，法律和人口環境的理解。然後，它通過在國際背景下獲得成功的全球產業和戰略來探討全球競爭的性質。還涵蓋了跨國公司管理中的組織設計與戰略控制相關問題。
description.en: Focuses on the international dimensions of strategy and organization and provides a framework for formulating strategies in an increasingly complex global economy. The course seeks to provide students with an understanding of the cultural, political, competitive, technological, legal, and demographic environments in which multinational firms operate. It then examines the nature of global competition by exploring the characteristics of global industries and strategies that have been successful in an international context. Also covered are issues related to organizational design and strategic control in the management of multinational enterprises.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生至機械相關機構實習（實習實際天數依「校外實習」實行辦法另訂之），參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告，彙交系上保存。

description.zh: 本課程的目的在介紹生物反應工程，也就是如何將工程原理應用在生物程序。本課程內容可分為二大部分：生物系統的概述與工程的原理應用，第一部分將包括細胞的結構、複製與生長，生物化學反應的種類及其特性，細胞的主要代謝路徑等，第二部分則探討生物反應器的種類及其操作特性與應用，生物反應器內的質傳、熱傳及流動型態，產品回收與純化。
description.en: The objective of the course is to introduce the fundamental concepts of bioprocess engineering, which is the application of engineering principles to design, develop, and analyze bioprocesses. The course will first survey the basics ideas from microbiology and biochemistry. Subsequently, the emphasis will be the application of engineering concepts to biological problems. The following topics will be included: enzyme kinetics, major metabolic pathways, cell growth, stoichiometry, bioreactor operation, and product recovery and purification.

syllabi.outline: 本課程的目的在介紹生物反應工程，課程的的第一部分介紹微生物，包括微生物的分類、細胞結構及一般特性，微生物的生長與控制，微生物的生理與代謝，微生物的應用; 第二部分探討生物反應器的種類及其操作特性與應用; 第三部分研讀相關國際期刊論文。
syllabi.schedule:
1. Introduction

3. Microbial nutrition and growth
4. Microbial control
5. Major metabolic pathways
6. Applied microbiology
7. Stoichiometry of microbial growth and product formation
8. Operating considerations for bioreactors
9. SCI paper reading and discussion

description.en: The course is designed to help students' career developments and to enhance their working experiences prior to their graduation. Students will work at a electric-optic engineering related company or research organization on-site. The duration is one full-time semester. Students would learn the real-life operations of professional technology, acknowledge the differences between the school and working environments, understand the business needs, and develop their professional ethics. Through the program, students would be able to self-evaluate the gaps between their own capabilities and the professional needs, and establish or adjust their career development plans accordingly. A student would require to work full-time on-site the company and submit a full semester paper to fulfill the program requirements.

syllabi.outline: 以專題設計方式，訓練學生獨立運用生成式AI進行企劃、分析、評斷、組織、歸納與創新思考，並實際演練完整之設計過程。學生經由分組或獨自完成一設計主題。上學期課程以題目界定、資料收集、分析調查、結論定義、構想發展及草模提交等為教學內容，下學期則進行細部設計、模型製作、專刊編輯、展示佈置以及設計報告提交等為教學內容,以培養專業設計之能力。

01 ~ 06 專題一：運用生成式AI探討消費者需求、品牌視覺形象需求、社會與永續需求、需求轉換成產品功能規格。
07 ~ 12 專題二：運用生成式AI根據功能規格轉換成產品概念，發展構想與測試概念可行性。
10 ~ 18 專題三：運用生成式AI探討進行產品原型分析，包括外觀品質、易用性、效能、社會與環境影響。

為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
    學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it.

syllabi.schedule:
自主學習引導流程

一、目標定義階段–引導學生定義學習目標，發現自我學習問題和機會。
二、資料釐清階段–引導學生收集資料理解與分析學習問題，明確地回應自我學習的路徑。
三、解法發展階段–引導學生設計情境，創造、發明多種解決學習問題的解決方案。
四、實驗測試階段–引導學生經由所發展的解法(解決學習問題)，以實驗測試，逐漸生成目標結果。
五、展示與回饋階段–引導學生完成成果並且公開，獲得使用者/社會的回饋。
syllabi.assessment: 五階段成果報告，各佔20%

description.en: To help students cultivate the ability of self-learning, this course allows students to engage themselves in developing course content, to plan and to execute a real-world project. "Active learning" encourages students to learn by interaction, communication, collaboration, critically analyzing arguments, and problem-solving. Instructors will assist to guide and to support in the process of learning. Students are expected to develop a process to solve real-life problems collaboratively. Written reports and oral presentations are required for course evaluation.

description.zh:
(1)	藉由學生主動實現自己有興趣之主題，培養自我學習能力。
(2)	於特定的主題當中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。
(3)	教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習與成長。 
(4) 學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定學習計畫，並於開學前提出申請，由專任教師指導，審查及評核學期成績。
description.en:
(1)	Develop self-learning skills by actively implementing topics of interest to students
(2)	Among the specific topics, the ability to think critically and solve problems is learned.
(3)	Teachers act as mentors and guide students to learn and grow from practice
(4) Students set up learning plans according to their own interests and abilities, and apply before the school starts. They are supervised by full-time teachers to review and evaluate semester performance.

description.zh:
為培養大學部學生自主學習能力，由學生主動積極創造並實現自己有興趣之主題。學生於特定主題之創造與實現中，學習到思考批判與問題解決等能力。教師擔任輔助指導角色，引導學生從實踐中學習問題解決能力。
學生根據自己的興趣與能力訂定自主學習計畫，並於開學前向各系提出申請，由本系專任老師擔任指導教師，審查計畫及評核學期成績。
description.en:
This course aims to develop undergraduates’ active learning skills by making students engage in the creation and realization of topics of students’ own interest. In the process of specific topic creation and realization, students will proactively learn critical-thinking and problem-solving skills. Instructors cultivate the active engagement of students in problem solving, without actually participating in it. 
In this course, students are required to draw up self-learning plans based on their own interests and capabilities and then submit their plans to the departmental office for approval by the beginning of the semester.

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively. The individual department or graduate institute may make proper adjustments according to the situations in need.

商業與管理群教材教法

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為增進學生之實務能力，學生利用整學期到工業工程與管理相關機構實習，參與校外合作機構所提供之訓練，觀摩學習專業工廠之實際運作。實習期滿後須由實習機構出具實習證明及成績考核；學生必須撰寫實習心得報告。須在同一機構連續實習4.5月，學生應全職於實習機構實習。
description.en: The course is developed to increase on-job practice capability of students. Participants practice and learn the real operation of the industrial engineering and management related fields in one of the corporative industrial engineering company during one semester. A practice intern and a well-prepared report must be completed to the course requirement. It is necessary to practice in one corporative industrial engineering and management company full-time at least 4.5 months.

name.zh: 人工智慧於射頻模組優化
name.en: Artificial Intelligence  in RF Module Optimization

description.zh: 本課程讓學生深入瞭解射頻模組的基本架構及其在無線通訊技術中的應用，並且掌握人工智慧與深度強化學習的基本概念，學習如何利用人工智慧技術優化射頻模組性能，如增強信號強度和降低干擾。此外，課程將涵蓋電磁模擬軟體及其在射頻模組中的應用，並指導學生設置環境，編寫人工智慧演算法，實現自動化模擬與優化，最終培養獨立解決問題的能力。
description.en: This course enables students to gain an in-depth understanding of the basic structure of RF modules and their applications in wireless communication technology. It also covers the fundamental concepts of artificial intelligence and deep reinforcement learning, teaching students how to use AI techniques to optimize RF module performance, such as enhancing signal strength and reducing interference. Additionally, the course will introduce electromagnetic simulation software and its applications in RF module simulation, guiding students to set up the environment, write AI algorithms, and achieve automated simulation and optimization, ultimately cultivating the ability to solve problems independently.

syllabi.schedule:
週次	/單元主題	/內容描述
第1週	課程導論與射頻模組概述	課程介紹、射頻模組基本架構、應用範例、學習目標設定
第2週	無線通訊與射頻模組基本原理	無線傳輸、頻譜利用、射頻元件基礎
第3週	電磁模擬軟體入門	軟體基本操作、模型建立、範例演練
第4週	射頻模組性能評估指標	信號強度、干擾、效率、帶寬等性能指標
第5週	人工智慧與深度學習基礎	機器學習、深度學習、神經網路基本概念
第6週	AI在射頻設計中的應用	參數優化、預測模擬結果、案例討論
第7週	深度強化學習原理與應用	強化學習理論、策略學習、演算法介紹
第8週	電磁模擬軟體與AI結合實務	設計模擬流程、資料收集、數據分析
第9週	編寫AI演算法與實作	Python、TensorFlow/PyTorch基礎、多元資料處理
第10週	AI模型訓練與調整	模型建立、訓練技巧、超參數調整

description.zh: 本課程主要目的為讓學生可以利用暑期或其它時間至學校認可之校外公私立機構進行或參與實習，以增進學生之實務能力。學生於學校認可之校外機構實習總累計時數不得低於320小時。學生實習期滿後，應依據各系規定繳交相關實習相關成果報告，彙交所屬系保存，並作為成績核定之依據。學生校外實習學期成績之評定比例原則：實習單位占50%，輔導老師占50%，各系得依其屬性調整之。
description.en: The main purpose of this course is to elevate an all-round ability for the students at NTUT. During the summer break or other periods of time, students are required to go to government-based organizations or industry/business-oriented agencies with respect to promoting practice of ability. The course takers will need to stay in the same individual organization or agency with an accumulated amount of time of no less than 320 hours. After the students complete the requirements in question, these organizations and agencies will offer them certificates -- or proof of any kind -- in accordance with the real performance on site. The grading principle will be equivalently decided by the thesis advisor (50%) and the on-site organization or agency (50%), respectively.
